स: स The thirty-second consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, corresponding to S.

स m. (सः) 1 A snake. 2 ŚIVA. 3 VIṢṆU. 4 Air, wind. 5 The abbreviated name of the musical note ष ज्. 6 He, the nominative case masc. of तद the third personal pronoun: before many letters the Visarga is rejected. f. (सा) 1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. 2 She, the nominative case fem. of तट्. n. (सं) 1 Knowledge. 2 Meditation. 3 A carriage road. 4 A fence. Ind. (In composition,) With, together with; being substituted for सम् or सह; combined with nouns it forms adjectives and adverbs; as सकोपः angry, सकोपम् angrily; सगर्ब्बः proud, सगर्व्वम् haughtily; सविनयः modest, well behaved, सविनयम् respectfully; ससम्भ्रमः flurried, ससम्भ्रमम् flurriedly, &c. सानन्दः joyful, सानन्दं joyfully. E. षो to go, &c., aff. ड.

सं ind. (In composition,) With, together with, &c.; being the optional form of writing सम् before a consonant: before consonants of the first five classes, the Anusvāra may be again changed to the nasal of the class to which the letter it precedes belongs, as सं for सम्, and कल्प make सङ्कल्प, &c.: before the semivowels, the sibilants, and ह, it preferably remains unaltered; practice however is very arbitrary in this respect, and the change is expressed or not, in all manuscripts according to the pleasure of the writer.
सं: सं ind. (In composition,) With, together with, &c.; being the optional form of writing सम् before a consonant: before consonants of the first five classes, the Anusvāra may be again changed to the nasal of the class to which the letter it precedes belongs, as सं for सम्, and कल्प make सङ्कल्प, &c.: before the semivowels, the sibilants, and ह, it preferably remains unaltered; practice however is very arbitrary in this respect, and the change is expressed or not, in all manuscripts according to the pleasure of the writer.
संय: संय m. (-यः) The skeleton. E. सम् together, यस to restrain, aff. ड.
संयत्: संयत् mf. (-यत्) War, battle. E. सम् before यम to restrain, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् added.
संयत: संयत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Checked, restrained, controuled, suppressed. 2 Bound, confined, fettered, imprisoned. E. सम् before यम to restrain, aff. क्त.
संयतात्मन्: संयतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Self-subdued, of well regulated spirit. E. संयत, and आत्मन् self.
संयतेन्द्रिय: संयतेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of subdued or controuled passions and desires. E. संयत, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
संयद्वर: संयद्वर m. (-रः) A king, a prince. E. सम् before यम to restrain, ष्वरच् Uṇādi aff.; or संयत् war, वर chief.
संयन्तृ: संयन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Constraining, a constrainer. E. सम् before यम to restrain, aff. तृच्.
संयम: संयम m. (-मः) 1 Restraint, forbearance. 2 Humanity, avoiding the infliction of pain on others. E. सम् before यम to restrain, aff. अप्.
संयमत्: संयमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) Curbing, restraining, subduing, who or what does so. E. सम् before यम to restrain, शतृ aff.
संयमन: संयमन n. (-नं) 1 Restraining, checking. 2 Forbearance, self-denial or controul. 3 Binding, confinement. 4 Holding, detaining. 5 A religious vow or obligation. 6 A cluster of four houses. f. (-नी) The capital of YAMA. E. सम् implying completeness, or entirely, and यम to restrain, aff. ल्युट्.
संयमित: संयमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Checked, controuled, restrained. 2 Bound, confined, held, detained. E. सम् before यम to check, aff. क्त.
संयमिन्: संयमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Who or what checks, restrains, curbs, &c. m. (-मी) A saint, a sage, one who subdues or controuls his passions. E. संयम restraint, इनि aff.
संयात्रा: संयात्रा f. (-त्रा) Travelling into another island or continent, voyaging, travelling by water. E. सम् before या to go, त्रन् aff.
संयान: संयान m. (-नः) A mould. n. (-नं) Accompanying, going together. E. सम् together, या to go or get, aff. ल्युट्.
संयाम: संयाम m. (-मः) 1 Forbearance, check, controul, restraint. 2 Humanity, abstaining from giving pain to others. E. सम् before यम to restrain, aff. घञ्.
संयामवत्: संयामवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Forbearing. E. संयाम, and मतुप् aff.
संयाव: संयाव m. (-वः) A sort of roll, or a thin cake of unleavened bread, fried with Ghee, pounded and again made up into an oblong form with fresh bread, sugar, and spices, and again fried with Ghee. E. सम् together, यु to mix, and घञ् aff.
संयुक्त: संयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Joined with, connected, attached. 2 Mixed, blended. 3 Endowed with, possessed of. 4 Accompanied or attended by. E. सम् together, युज to join, aff. क्त.
संयुग: संयुग m. (-गः) 1 War, battle. 2 Union, mixture. E. सम् before युज to join, क aff.
संयुज्: संयुज् mfn. (-युक्) 1 Possessed of or endowed with good qualities. 2 Connected or associated with. 3 Joined, united. E. सम् before युज to join, aff. क्विप्, and the consonant unchanged.
संयुत: संयुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Connected, joined, mixed, blended, attached to. E. सम् together, यु to join, aff. क्त.
संयुयूषु: संयुयूषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to mix, join, unite, to bring together in any way. E. सम् before यु to join, desid. v., उ aff.
संयोग: संयोग m. (-गः) 1 Intimate union or association. 2 Living with, being in company with. 3 Adherence, junction. 4 (In grammar,) A conjunct consonant. E. सम् before युज to join, घञ् aff.
संयोगित: संयोगित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Joined, annexed, connected. E. संयोग union, इतच् aff.
संयोजन: संयोजन n. (-नं) 1 Copulation, coition. 2 Joining, uniting. E. सम् with, युज to join, aff. ल्युट्.
संयोजित: संयोजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Joined, attached, annexed. E. सम् together, युज to join, aff. क्त.
संरक्त: संरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Inflamed, angry. 2 Empassioned. E. सम् before रञ्ज to be affected, क्त aff.
संरक्ष: संरक्ष m. (-क्षः) Care, preservation, protection. E. सम्, and रक्ष preserving.
संरक्षण: संरक्षण n. (-णं) Taking care of, protecting, preserving. E. मम् before रक्ष to preserve, ल्युट् aff.
संरक्षित: संरक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken care of, preserved, protected. E. सम् before रक्ष to preserve, क्त aff.
संरक्ष्य: संरक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Fit, proper, or necessary to be taken care of, guarded, preserved, &c. E. सम् before रक्ष to preserve, यत् aff.; also संरक्षणीय and संरक्षितव्य.
संरब्ध: संरब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Incensed, angry. 2 Agitated. E. सम् before रभि to sound, क्त aff.
संरम्भ: संरम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Wrath, rage. 2 Pride, arrogance. 3 Flurry, agitation. 4 Swelling with heat and redness. E. सम् before रभि to sound, and घञ् aff.
संरम्भपरुष: संरम्भपरुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Exceedingly harsh, rough, or scurrilous. E. संरम्भ, and परुष harsh.
संरम्भरस: संरम्भरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Angry, resentful. E. संरम्भ, and रस taste.
संरम्भित्व: संरम्भित्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Wrath. 2 Pride. 3 Agitation. E. संरम्भिन्, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, संरम्भिता.
संरम्भिन्: संरम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) 1 Proud. 2 Angry. 3 Flurried. E. संरम्भ, and इनि aff.
संराग: संराग m. (-गः) 1 Anger. 2 Affection. E. सम्, रञ्ज to be affected, घञ् aff.
संराधन: संराधन n. (-नं) Propitiating, pleasing by worship. E. सम् before राध to accomplish, ल्युट् aff.
संराधित: संराधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Propitiated, pleased. E. सम् before राध to accomplish, क्त aff.
संराव: संराव m. (-वः) Sound, noise. E. सम् before रु to sound, aff. घञ्.
संराविन्: संराविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Roaring, shouting, making a noise or uproar. E. सम् before रु to sound, घिनुण् aff.
संरुद्ध: संरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Checked, stopped, impeded, curbed, opposed. E. सम् before रुध to obstruct, क्त aff.
संरूढ: संरूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Confident, audacious, presuming. 2 Budded, blossomed. E. सम् before रुह to grow, aff. क्त.
संरोध: संरोध m. (-धः) 1 Hindering, stopping, opposing, preventing. 2 Impediment, obstruction. 3 Bond, fetter. 4 Curb, check. 5 Throwing, sending. E. सम् before रुध to obstruct, aff. घञ्.
संलक्षण: संलक्षण n. (-णं) Distinguishing, characterising. E. सं before लक्ष to mark, ल्युट् aff.
संलक्षित: संलक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Marked, distinguished. E. सम् before लक्ष to mark, क्त aff.
संलक्ष्य: संलक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) To be marked with or by. E. सम् before लक्ष to mark, यत् aff.
संलग्न: संलग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Joined, united, adherent. E. सम्, and लग्न attached to.
संलज्जमान: संलज्जमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ashamed. E. सम् before लस्ज to be ashamed, शानच् aff.
संलय: संलय m. (-यः) Sleep, sleepiness. E. सं before ली to join, and अच् aff.
संलाप: संलाप m. (-पः) 1 Conversation, discourse. 2 In the drama, high discourse, dialogue of profound or occult meaning. E. सम् with, together with, and लप to speak, aff. घञ्.
संलापक: संलापक n. (-कं) A species of minor drama, a controversial drama. E. संलाप, कन् added.
संलापित: संलापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Discoursing, conversing. E. संलाप, and इतच् aff.
संलापिन्: संलापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Discoursing, who or what discourses. E. संलाप, and इनि aff.
संवंहयत्: संवंहयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Increasing. E. सम्, वहि to grow, causal v., शतृ aff.
संवत्सर: संवत्सर m. (-रः) A year. E. सम् with, completely, and वत्सर a year; or सम् with वस to abide, सर Uṇādi aff., and त substituted for the final.
संवद्: संवद् ind. 1 A year. 2 A year of VIKRAMĀDITYA'S era. E. सम् before वद to speak, aff. विच्, or सम् before वय to go, क्विप् aff., य rejected, and तुक् final augment.
संवदन: संवदन n. (-नं) 1 Communication of tidings or intelligence. 2 Sight, seeing. nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Subduing by charms, overpowering any thing or person by magical compounds, or drugs, or mystical gems, &c. 2 A charm, an amulet, the article by which the above is effected. E. सम् with वद to speak, युच् aff.
संवनन: संवनन n. (-नं-ना) Subduing by magical drugs or charms: see the last. E. सम् before वन to ask, aff. ल्युट्.
संवर: संवर n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Self-control. 3 Covering, concealing. m. (-रः) 1 The name of a demon. 2 Collection, comprehension. 3 Contraction, compression. 4 A mound, a bridge, &c. E. सम् before वृ to choose, aff. अप्, more usually derived from शम्ब or षम्ब to collect, and then written शम्बर or सम्बर q. v.
संवर्त: संवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Destruction of the universe. 2 Beleric myrobalan. 3 The name of a Muni. 4 A cloud. 5 Being, becoming. E. सम् before वृत to be, aff. घञ्.
संवर्त्त: संवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Destruction of the universe. 2 Beleric myrobalan. 3 The name of a Muni. 4 A cloud. 5 Being, becoming. E. सम् before वृत to be, aff. घञ्.
संवर्तक: संवर्त्तक m. (-कः) 1 BALADEVA. 2 The plough of BALADEVA. 3 Submarine fire. E. सम् before वृत to be or abide, aff. वुन्.
संवर्त्तक: संवर्त्तक m. (-कः) 1 BALADEVA. 2 The plough of BALADEVA. 3 Submarine fire. E. सम् before वृत to be or abide, aff. वुन्.
संवर्तकिन्: संवर्त्तकिन् m. (-की) BALADEVA, the elder brother of KṚṢṆA. E. संवर्त्तक his plough, and इनि aff.
संवर्त्तकिन्: संवर्त्तकिन् m. (-की) BALADEVA, the elder brother of KṚṢṆA. E. संवर्त्तक his plough, and इनि aff.
संवर्ति: संवर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) The new leaf of a water-lily. E. सम् before वृत to be, aff. इनि.
संवर्त्ति: संवर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) The new leaf of a water-lily. E. सम् before वृत to be, aff. इनि.
संवर्तिका: संवर्त्तिका f. (-का) The new leaf of a water-lily. E. सम् near, (the stalk,) वृत to be, aff. वुन्.
संवर्त्तिका: संवर्त्तिका f. (-का) The new leaf of a water-lily. E. सम् near, (the stalk,) वृत to be, aff. वुन्.
संवर्द्धक: संवर्द्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Augmenting, augmentative, prospering, an augmentor, &c. E. सम् before वृद्ध to increase, aff. वुन्.
संवर्द्धन: संवर्द्धन n. (-नं) 1 Augmenting, increasing. 2 Prospering, thriving. 3 Bringing up, cherishing. E. सम् before वृद्ध to increase or prosper, aff. ल्युट्.
संवर्द्धित: संवर्द्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cherished, protected, brought up, patronised, &c. E. सम् before वृद्ध to increase, क्त aff.
संवर्मित: संवर्म्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fully armed. E. सम्, and वर्म्म armour, इतच् aff.
संवर्म्मित: संवर्म्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fully armed. E. सम्, and वर्म्म armour, इतच् aff.
संवलित: संवलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Mixed, mingled. 2 Encompassed, surrounded. 3 Having, possessed of. 4 United. E. सम् together, वल to surround, aff. क्त.
संवसथ: संवसथ m. (-थः) A village. E. सम् before वस to abide, अथ Uṇādi aff.
संवाटिका: संवाटिका f. (-का) An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.)
संवात्: संवात् mfn. (-वान्-वाती-वान्ती-वात्) Blowing, breathing, (as wind.) E. सम् before वा to blow, शतृ aff.
संवाद: संवाद m. (-दः) 1 Communication of intelligence, information, news. 2 Assent, concurrence. 3 Conformity, correspondence, sameness. E. सम् with, वद to speak, aff. घञ्.
संवार: संवार m. (-रः) 1 Contraction, diminution. 2 Compression of the lips, &c. in pronunciation. E. सम् before वृ to choose, aff. घञ्.
संवास: संवास m. (-सः) 1 A house, a dwelling. 2 An open space, either within or without a town, for the meeting and diversion of the townsmen. 3 Company, society. E. सम् with, वास an abode.
संवाह: संवाह m. (-हः) 1 An attendant employed to rub and knead the body. 2 Rubbing the body. E. सम् before वाह to exert one's self, and अच् aff.; or when the action is implied, वह to obtain or bear, aff. घञ्.
संवाहक: संवाहक m. (-कः) An attendant rubbing and kneading the limbs. E. सम् before वह to obtain, (pleasure or ease,) causal form, aff. ण्वुल्.
संवाहन: संवाहन n. (-नं) 1 Rubbing the person, kneading the limbs. 2 Bearing, carrying. E. सम् before वह to obtain or bear, (causal form,) aff. ल्युट्
संवाहित: संवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rubbed, kneaded, (as the limbs.) E. सम् before वह to bear, causal v., क्त aff.
संवाह्य: संवाह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 To be rubbed or kneaded. 2 To be borne. E. सम् before वह to bear, ण्यत् aff.
संविग्न: संविग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Agitated, flurried, alarmed. E. सम् before विज to fear, क्त aff.
संविग्नमानस: संविग्नमानस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Distracted. E. संविग्न, and मानस the mind.
संवित्ति: संवित्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Understanding, intellect. 2 Accommodation, reconciliation. 3 Recognition, recollection of a thing or person previously known. E. सम् before विट् to know, aff. क्तिन्: see the next.
संविद्: संविद् f. (-वित् or विट्) 1 Intellect, understanding. 2 Promise, assent. 3 Contract, engagement, agreement, covenant. 4 Knowledge. 5 A watch-word, a cry of battle. 6 War, battle. 7 Name, appellation. 8 Sign, signal. 9 Institute, prescribed custom or observation. 10 Pleasing, delighting. 11 Hemp. E. सम् with, together with, विद to know, &c., aff. क्विप्.
संविदित: संविदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised, agreed. 2 Known, understood. E. सम् before विद to know, aff. क्त.
संविद्ध्यतिक्रम: संविद्ध्यतिक्रम m. (-मः) Non-performance of agreements. E. संविट्, and व्यतिकम departure.
संविधान: संविधान n. (-नं) Mode, rite. E. सम्, वि before धा to have, ल्युट् aff.
संविधानक: संविधानक n. (-कं) Strange or unusual occurrence. E. संविघान, and कन् added.
संविभक्त: संविभक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Parted, divided. E. सम् and वि before भज to divide, क्त aff.
संविभाग: संविभाग m. (-गः) 1 Part, portion, share. 2 Distributing, apportioning. E. सम्, and वि before भज to divide, घञ् aff.
संविषा: संविषा f. (-षा) A plant, (Betula?) E. सम् intensitive, विष poison.
संवीक्षण: संवीक्षण n. (-णं) Search, inquiry, looking for or after any thing. E. सम्, and वि intensitives, ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.
संवीत: संवीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Surrounded, enclosed, encompassed. 2 Covered, clothed. E. सम् completely, व्येञ् to surround, aff. क्त.
संवुवूर्षु: संवुवूर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) Wishing to conceal, disguise, hide, cover, &c. E. सम् before वृ to screen, desid. v., उ aff.
संवृत: संवृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Covered. 2 Closed. 3 Contracted, compressed, (as the lips, &c. in pronunciation.) E. सम् before वृ to be, क्त aff.
संवृत्त: संवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Covered, concealed, hidden. 2 Furnished with, filled with, possessed of. 3 Being, become. 4 Past, gone. m. (-त्तः) VARUṆA, deity of the ocean. E. सम् with, वृत to be, &c., aff. क्त.
संवृत्ति: संवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Hiding, concealing. 2 Covering. 3 Possession, endowment. 4 Secret purpose. E. सम् with, वृत to screen or cover, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
संवेग: संवेग m. (-गः) 1 Hurry, flurry, haste proceeding from fear, &c. 2 Haste, speed. E. सम् intensitive, विज to be agitated, aff. घञ्.
संवेद: संवेद m. (-दः) Perception, consciousness. E. सम्, with विद to know, aff. घञ्.
संवेश: संवेश m. (-शः) 1 Sleep, sleeping. 2 Dreaming, a dream. 3 Copulation. 4 A stool, a chair, a seat. E. सम् before विश to enter, aff. घञ्.
संवेशन: संवेशन n. (-नं) Copulation, coition. E. मस् before विश to enter, ल्युट् aff.
संव्यान: संव्यान n. (-नं) 1 An upper-garment. 2 Cloth, clothes, vesture. 3 Covering, a covering. E. सम् completely, व्येञ् to cover, aff. ल्युट्.
संव्यूढ: संव्यूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Mixed, united. E. सम् and वि before ऊह to reason, क्त aff.
संव्यूह: संव्यूह m. (-हः) Combination, mixture, union. E. सम्, and वि before ऊह to reason, क aff.
संशप्तक: संशप्तक m. (-कः) A picked man or soldier, one of a select band sworn never to recede, and stationed to prevent the flight of the rest, a brother in arms. E. सम् with, together, शप्त sworn, कन् aff.
संशय: संशय m. (-यः) Doubt, uncertainty. E. सम् before शी to sleep, अच् aff.
संशयस्थ: संशयस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Doubtful, uncertain. E. संशय, and स्थ who or what stays.
संशयात्मन्: संशयात्मन् m. (-त्मा) A sceptic. E. संशय, and आत्मन् self.
संशयान: संशयान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dubious, uncertain. E. सम् before शीङ् to sleep, शानच् aff.
संशयापन्न: संशयापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Affected with doubt, hesitating, dubious. 2 Doubtful, uncertain. E. संशय, and आपन्न having.
संशयापन्नमानस: संशयापन्नमानस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Irresolute, dubious, uncertain. E. संशय doubt, आपन्न affected, and मानस the mind.
संशयालु: संशयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Dubious, doubting, sceptic. E. संशय doubt, आलुच् aff.
संशयितृ: संशयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Dubious, sceptical, a sceptic. E. सम् before शीङ् to sleep, तृच् aff.
संशय्य: संशय्य ind. Having doubted or deliberated, being in doubt. E. सम् before शी to sleep, ल्यप् aff.
संशरण: संशरण n. (-णं) Commencement of a combat, charge, attack. E. सम् together, शॄ to injure, aff. ल्युट्.
संशित: संशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Certain, certified, ascertained, established. 2 Completed, effected, finished. 3 Completing, effecting, diligent and attentive in accomplishing. E. सम् before शो to destroy, aff. क्त.
संशितव्रत: संशितव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Faithful to a vow or obligation. E. संशित completing, व्रत a vow.
संशिश्रीषु: संशिश्रीषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to adhere to or depend upon, to serve, &c. E. सम् before श्रि to serve, desid. v., उ aff.
संशुद्ध: संशुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Pure, purified. 2 Clean. 3 Refined. 4 Discharged, acquitted, (as a debt.) 5 Acquitted, (of a crime.) E. सम्, and शुद्ध pure.
संशुद्धि: संशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Cleaning the body. 2 Purification in general. 3 Correction. 4 Acquittal of debt, &c. 5 Acquittance of charge or crime. E. सम् completely, शुद्धि purification, cleansing.
संशुष्क: संशुष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) Dry, dried. E. सम् before शुष्क dry.
संशोधन: संशोधन n. (-नं) 1 Cleaning, cleansing, purifying the body by ablutions, &c. 2 Correcting. 3 Refining. 4 Discharging, paying. E. सम् before शोधन purifying.
संशोध्य: संशोध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 To be rectified or purified. 2 To be paid or acquitted (as a debt, &c.) E. सम्, शुध to be pure, यत् aff.; संशोधनीय, &c.
संश्चत्: संश्चत् n. (-श्वत्) Deceit, trick, illusion, juggling. E. सम् before चि to collect, Uṇādi aff. अति, and सुट् augment.
संश्यान: संश्यान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Contracted, rolled up, gathered up, shrunk, collapsed. E. सम् together, श्यै to go, aff. क्त.
संश्रय: संश्रय m. (-यः) 1 Protection, refuge, asylum. 2 Seeking the alliance of a powerful prince, as a safety against actual or future enemies. E. सम् intensitive, श्रि to serve, aff. अच्.
संश्रव: संश्रव m. (-वः) Promise, assent, agreement. E. सम्, and श्रु to hear, aff. अप्.
संश्राव: संश्राव m. (-वः) Sprinkling, aspersion, pouring out. E. सम्, श्रु to ooze, causal v., घञ् aff.
संश्रित: संश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Protected, supported. m. (-तः) A servant, a follower, a dependant. E. सम् before श्रि to serve, aff. क्त.
संश्रुत: संश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Promised, agreed, assented. E. सम् before श्रु to hear, aff. क्त.
संश्लिष्ट: संश्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Close together, adjoining, touching. 2 Bound, united. 3 Embraced. E. सम् before श्लिष्ट united.
संश्लेष: संश्लेष n. (-षं) 1 Embrace, embracing. 2 Union, connection, junction, contact, association. E. सम् with, श्लिष to unite, aff. घञ्.
संश्वत्: संश्वत् n. (-श्वत्) Fraud, trick, cheating, deception. E. सम् before श्वि to increase, aff. अति, deriv. irr.; also संश्वत्.
संसक्त: संसक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Near, adjoining, contiguous. 2 Possessing, endowed with, affected by. 3 Connected or acquainted with. 4 Attached to, intent on. 5 Tied or attached. E. सम् before षञ्ज to embrace, &c., aff. क्त.
संसक्तयुग: संसक्तयुग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Harnessed, yoked. E. संसक्त, and युग a yoke.
संसक्ति: संसक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Proximity, contact. 2 Union, junction. 3 Acquaintance, intimacy, connection with. 4 Devotion or addiction to. 5 Tying, fastening. E. सम् before षञ्ज to embrace or adhere to, aff. क्तिच्.
संसज्जमान: संसज्जमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Prepared, ready. E. सम्, षस्ज to go, शानच् aff.
संसद्: संसद् f. (-सट् or सत्) An assembly, a meeting. E. सम् before षद to go, aff. क्विप्.
संसरण: संसरण n. (-णं) 1 Going, proceeding in general. 2 Going well or unobstructedly. 3 The unresisted march of troops. 4 The beginning of war or battle. 5 A highway, the principal road through a village or town. 6 The world. 7 Birth, the production of living beings. 8 A resting place for passengers near the gates of a city. E. सम् together, &c., सृ to go, aff. ल्युट्.
संसर्ग: संसर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 Union, proximity, approximation, contact. 2 Acquaintance, familiarity, intercourse. 2 Co-existence. 4 Sensual attachment. E. सम् with, सृज to go, aff. घञ्.
संसर्गाभाव: संसर्गाभाव m. (-वः) Logical nonexistence or annihilation; of three kinds, prior, incidental, and final, or absence of birth or production, destruction of present being, and necessary end or cessation of existence. E. संसर्ग union, and अभाव nonexistence.
संसर्गित्व: संसर्गित्व n. (-त्वं) Familiarity, fellowship. E. संसर्गिन्, and त्व added; also with तल्, संसर्गिता.
संसर्गिन्: संसर्गिन् mfn. (-र्गी-र्गिणी-र्गि) Familiar, friendly, keeping company, acquainted, an acquaintance. 2 United or mixed with, in contact with, &c. E. सम् before सृज to go, aff. घिनुण्.
संसर्जन: संसर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Abandoning, leaving. 2 Voiding. E. सम् before सृज to quit, ल्युट् aff.
संसर्ज्जन: संसर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Abandoning, leaving. 2 Voiding. E. सम् before सृज to quit, ल्युट् aff.
संसर्प: संसर्प m. (-र्पः) An equable or gentle motion, as the creeping of a snake, the gliding of a stream, &c. E. सम् before सृप to go, aff. घञ्.
संसर्पिन्: संसर्पिन् mfn. (-र्पी-र्पिणी-र्पि) Flowing, gliding. E. सम् intensitive prefix, सृप to go, घिनुण् aff.
संसार: संसार m. (-रः) 1 The world, the habitation of mortals. 2 Mundane existence. E. सम् together, (mankind,) सृ to go, aff. ख.
संसारगुरु: संसारगुरु m. (-रुः) KĀMA or love. E. संसार the world, and गुरु the spiritual preceptor.
संसारमार्ग: संसारमार्ग m. (-र्गः) The vulva. E. संसार the world, (or mankind,) and मार्ग a road.
संसारिन्: संसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Worldly, mundane. m. (-री) An animal or sentient being. E. संसार the world, इनि aff.
संसिद्ध: संसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Perfected, fully done or accomplished. E. सम् before सिद्ध effected.
संसिद्धि: संसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Nature, disposition, the natural state or quality. 2 Perfection, completion, accomplishment. 3 A passionate or intoxicated woman. E. सम् before सिद्धि completion.
संसिस्मयिषमाण: संसिस्मयिषमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Wishing or purposing to ridicule, laugh at, &c. E. सम् before स्मि to smile, desid. v., शानच् aff.
संसिसृक्षु: संसिसृक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Wishing to unite. E. सम् before सृज to create, desid. v., उ aff.
संसूचन: संसूचन n. (-नं) 1 Telling, informing. 2 Reproaching, scolding. E. सम् before षूच to inform, ल्युट् aff.
संसूचित: संसूचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Informed, apprised, told. 2 Reproved, scolded. E. सम् before षूच to inform, क्त aff.
संसृति: संसृति f. (-तिः) 1 The world. 2 Flow, stream, current. E. सम् and सृ to go, क्तिन् aff.
संसृष्ट: संसृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 United, joined, connected. 2 Mixed. 3 Reunited, rejoined. 4 Connected as partners or coparceners. 5 Clean dressed, clad in clean garments. 6 Involved in. E. सम् before सृज to leave or make, aff. क्त.
संसृष्टत्व: संसृष्टत्व n. (-त्वं) Union, association. 2 Re-union. 3 (In law,) The voluntary co-residence or re-union of father and son, or of brothers with each other, after partition of property. E. संसृष्ट associated, aff. क्त.
संसृष्टरूप: संसृष्टरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Mixed, adulterated. E. संसृष्ट, and रूप nature.
संसृष्टि: संसृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Uniting, combining. 2 Collecting, assembling. 3 Living together in one family. 4 (In rhetoric,) The use of a number of figures in one passage. E. सम् before सृज to make, क्तिन् aff.
संसृष्टिन्: संसृष्टिन् m. (-ष्टी) A coparcener, a brother, whether of whole or half blood, who after the partition of the family property continues or returns to reside with his father, his paternal uncle, or his other brothers. E. संसृष्ट united or re-united, and इनि aff.
संसेवन: संसेवन n. (-नं) Waiting on, serving. E. सम् before सेव to serve, ल्युट् aff.
संसेवित: संसेवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Waited on, served, attended. E. सम् before सेव to serve, क्त aff.
संस्कर्तृ: संस्कर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ) Who or what polishes, completes, initiates, &c. E. सम् before कृ to make, तृच् aff.
संस्कर्त्तृ: संस्कर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ) Who or what polishes, completes, initiates, &c. E. सम् before कृ to make, तृच् aff.
संस्कार: संस्कार m. (-रः) 1 Completing, accomplishing, finishing, perfecting. 2 Apprehension, conception. 3 The power of memory, the faculty of recollection. 4 Faculty in general, one of the twenty-four qualities enumerated by logicians. 5 An essential  and purificatory rite or ceremony amongst the Hindus; as those of the three first classes, commencing with conception and ending with marriage; or गर्भाघानं sacrifice on conception; पुंसवनं on vitality in the fœtus; सीमन्तोन्नयनं in the fourth, sixth, or eighth month; जातकर्म्म giving the infant clarified butter out of a golden spoon to taste, before dividing the navel string; नामकरणं naming the child on the tenth, eleventh, twelfth, or hundred and first day: निःक्रमणं carrying him out to see the moon on the third lunar day of the third light fortnight, or to see the sun in the third or fourth month; अन्नप्राशनं feeding him with rice in the sixth or eighth month, or when he has cut teeth: चूडाकार्य्यं tonsure in the second or third year: उपनयनं investiture with the string in the fifth, eighth, or sixteenth year: विवाहः or marriage is the tenth and last Saṃskāra. 5 Embellishment, decoration, elegance. 6 Purity, perfection. 7 Preparing as an article of medicine or food, cooking, dressing, compounding, &c. 8 Purification, consecration. 9 Impression, form, mould. E. सम् implying perfection, कृ to make, अण् aff. and सुट् augment.
संस्कारज: संस्कारज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced from a purificatory ceremony, &c. E. संस्कार as above, with the power of the fifth case, and ज born.
संस्कारवर्जित: संस्कारवर्जित m. (-तः) A Brahman, &c. who has not received the usual initiatory ceremonies. E. संस्कार purificatory rite, and वर्जित deprived of; also संस्काररहित, संस्कारहीन, &c.
संस्कारहीन: संस्कारहीन m. (-नः) A man of the three first classes, who has not been invested with the mystic thread, and who has not received the other ceremonies necessary to purification. E. संस्कार a rite, &c. हीन lost.
संस्कृत: संस्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wrought, made, artificially produced. 2 Excellent, best. 3 Decorated, ornamented. 4 Cooked, dressed. 5 Cleaned, cleansed. 6 Purified. 7 Finished, perfect, completed. 8 Consecrated. 9 Initiated. m. (-तः) 1 A word regularly formed, a regular derivative. 2 A learned man. 3 A man of the three first classes who has received all the purificatory rites. n. (-तं) Language formed by perfect grammatical rules, the classical and sacred language of the Hindus. E. सम् implying completion or perfection, कृत made, and सुट् augment.
संस्कृतात्मन्: संस्कृतात्मन् m. (-त्मा) 1 A man who has undergone the initiatory rites. 2 A sage. E. संस्कृत, and आत्मन् self.
संस्कृतोक्ति: संस्कृतोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Classical or polished language. E. संस्कृत, and उक्ति speech.
संस्कृत्य: संस्कृत्य ind. Having perfected, polished, adorned, &c. E. सम् before कृ to do, ल्यप् aff.
संस्कृत्रिम: संस्कृत्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Perfected, polished. 2 Fabricated, made. E. सम् before कृ to make, त्रि aff. and मन् added.
संस्क्रिया: संस्क्रिया f. (-या) 1 Funeral ceremonies, as burning the dead body, &c. 2 Any purificatory rite: see संस्कार. E. सम् before क्रिया act, action.
संस्तर: संस्तर m. (-रः) 1 A bed, a couch. 2 A bed made of leaves, &c. 3 Sacrifice. E. सम् before स्तृ to spread, aff. अप्.
संस्तब्ध: संस्तब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Made firm, rigid, &c. 2 Confirmed, corroborated. 3 Stopped, stayed. E. सम् before स्तभि to stop, क्त aff.
संस्तम्भ: संस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Fixing, making firm, (as a post.) 2 Confirming, establishing. 3 Paralysis, muscular rigidity. 4 Stop, stay. E. सम् before स्तभि to stop, घञ् aff.
संस्तम्भनीय: संस्तम्भनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be made firm. 2 To be stopped. E. सम् before ष्टभि to stop, अनीयर् aff.
संस्तभ्य: संस्तभ्य ind. 1 Having made firm, stable, rigid, &c. 2 Having confirmed or established. E. सम् before स्तभि to stop, aff. ल्यप्.
संस्तव: संस्तव m. (-वः) 1 Acquaintance, intimacy. 2 Praise. E. सम् together, ष्टु to praise, aff. अच्.
संस्तवान: संस्तवान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Eloquent, talking fluently and well. E. सम् before ष्टु to praise, आनच् Uṇādi aff.
संस्ताव: संस्ताव m. (-वः) 1 The place occupied at a sacrifice by the Brahmans reciting hymns and prayers. 2 Celebrating or hymning in chorus, the repetition of the verses of the Vedas by a number of Brahmans. E. सम् together, (in chorus,) ष्टु to praise, (the gods,) घञ् aff.
संस्तुत: संस्तुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Intimate, acquainted. 2 Praised, hymned, eulogised. E. सम् before ष्टु to praise, aff. क्त.
संस्तुति: संस्तुति f. (-तिः) Praise, celebration. E. सम् before ष्टु to praise, क्तिन् aff.
संस्त्याय: संस्त्याय m. (-यः) 1 Assemblage, collection, heap or number. 2 Vicinity, proximity. 3 Spreading, expansion, diffusion. 4 A house. E. सम् before ष्ट्यै to crowd, aff. घञ्.
संस्थ: संस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Staying, stopping, fixed, stationary. 2 Staying with, associated, domesticated. m. (-स्थः) 1 A spy, a secret emissary. 2 A countryman, a neighbour, a person of the same country, &c. 3 A dweller, an inhabitant. f. (स्था) 1 Continuance in the right way, correct conduct. 2 State or condition of being, time of life, &c. 3 Occupation, business, profession. 4 Stop, stay. 5 End, completion. 6 Manifestation, appearance. 7 Resemblance, likeness. 8 A sort of sacrifice. 9 Loss, destruction. 10 Death, dying. 11 Form. 12 An assembly. 13 A royal ordinance. E. सम् implying completeness, association, &c., and ष्ठा to stay, affs. क or अङ् and टाप्.
संस्थान: संस्थान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Like, resembling. n. (-नं) 1 Form, figure, shape. 2 Death, dying. 3 Fabrication, construction. 4 A place where four roads meet. 5 Any place. 6 A mark, a spot, a sign. 7 A heap, a quantity. 8 Primary formation, the aggregation of the primitive atoms. 9 A vicinity, a neighbourhood, a common place of abode. E. सम् before ष्ठा to stay or stand, aff. ल्युट्.
संस्थापन: संस्थापन n. (-नं) 1 Placing, fixing. 2 Establishing. 3 Collecting. 4 Restraining. E. सम् before ष्ठा to stay, causal v., aff. ल्युट्.
संस्थापित: संस्थापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Placed, fixed, deposited. 2 Established. 3 Accumulated. 4 Controuled, restrained. E. सम् before ष्ठा to stay, causal v., क्त aff.
संस्थाप्य: संस्थाप्य ind. Having placed. E. सम् before ष्ठा to stay, causal v., ल्यप् aff.
संस्थित: संस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dead, deceased. 2 Ended, finished. 3 Established, fixed. 4 Staying, stationary. 5 Residing, being in or at. 6 Heaped, collected. 7 Placed in or on. 8 Near or contiguous to. 9 Like, resembling. E. सम् before ष्ठा to stay, aff. क्त.
संस्थिति: संस्थिति f. (-तिः) 1 Death, dying. 2 Abode, abiding, being or being stationary. 3 Abiding, being or residing with. 4 Duration, continuance. 5 State or condition, (of life.) 6 Contiguity, connexion. 7 Heap, accumulation. 8 Restraint. E. सम् before स्थिति staying: see संस्था.
संस्पर्श: संस्पर्श m. (-र्शः) 1 Touching, contact, laying hold of. 2 Perception, sense. f. (-र्शा) A fragrant plant, commonly Chakawal. E. सम् before स्पृश to touch, aff. अच्.
संस्पर्शज: संस्पर्शज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or produced by sense, by contact, &c. E. संस्पर्श, and ज born.
संस्पृष्ट: संस्पृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Touched. E. सम् before स्पृश to touch, क्त aff.
संस्फाल: संस्फाल m. (-लः) A ram. E. सम् before स्फल to shake, aff. घञ्.
संस्फुट: संस्फुट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Blossomed, blown. E. सम् before स्फुट to blow, क aff.
संस्फेट: संस्फेट m. (-टः) War, battle. E. सम् before स्फिट to disrespect, aff. खञ्.
संस्फोट: संस्फोट m. (-टः) War, battle. E. सम् before स्फुट to hurt or kill, aff. घञ्, or with इ aff. संस्फोटि.
संस्मरण: संस्मरण n. (-णं) Remembering, calling to mind. E. सम् intensitive, and स्मरण remembering.
संस्मृत: संस्मृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Remembered, called to mind. E. सम्, and स्मृ to remember, क्त aff.
संस्मृति: संस्मृति f. (-तिः) Remembering, remembrance. E. सम् before स्मृ to remember, aff. क्तिन्.
संस्राव: संस्राव m. (-वः) Flowing, oozing. E. स्रु to go, with सम् pref. and ण aff.
संहत: संहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Strong knit, well limbed. 2 Compact, close. 3 Joined, attached or approximated to. 4 Closed, shut. 5 Collected, assembled. 6 Struck, hurt, wounded, killed. 7 Acting or making effort together, combining, combined. 3 Closely allied. E. सम् with, together with, हन to hurt or strike, aff. क्त.
संहतजानुक: संहतजानुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Knock-kneed. E. संहत approximated, close, and जानु the knee, कन् aff.; also without the aff. संहतजानु.
संहततल: संहततल m. (-लः) The two hands open, and the palms brought together. E. संहत closed, ला to get or be, aff. क.
संहतता: संहतता f. (-ता) Close approximation or contact, &c.: see the next. E. संहत, and तल् aff.
संहतत्व: संहतत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Compactness. 2 Combination, &c. 3 Approximation, contact. E. संहत, and त्व aff.; also संहतता with तल्.
संहति: संहति f. (-तिः) 1 Assemblage, collection, heap, number, host, multitude, &c. 2 Combination, joint effort. 3 Union, junction. 4 Compactness. E. सम् together, हन to strike or hurt, aff. क्तिन्.
संहनन: संहनन n. (-नं) 1 The body. 2 Rubbing the limbs. E. सम् before हन to strike or hurt, aff. ल्युट्.
संहरण: संहरण n. (-णं) 1 Collecting, accumulating. 2 Restraining, checking. 3 Taking, seizing. 4 Destroying. E. सम् before हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
संहर्ष: संहर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Air, wind. 2 Pleasure, joy. 3 Erection of the hair of the body, either from pleasure, or disease. 4 Envy, emulation. 5 Trituration, rubbing, grinding. E. सम् before हृष to be pleased, or घृष to rub, &c., aff. अण्.
संहर्षयोगिन्: संहर्षयोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Joyful, delighted. E. संहर्ष, and योगिन् who joins.
संहवन: संहवन n. (-नं) A group of four houses. E. सम् together, हु to sacrifice, aff. ल्युट्.
संहात: संहात m. (-तः) One of the twenty-one hells.
संहार: संहार m. (-रः) 1 Destruction, loss. 2 The destruction of the world. 3 A division of Tartarus. 4 Abridgment, abbreviation. 5 Collection, assemblage. 6 Restraining, suppressing. 7 Practice, skill. E. सम् together, हृ to take, aff. घञ्.
संहित: संहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Attached, joined. 2 Collected, assembled. 3 Placed, fixed. 4 Provided, furnished, equipped. f. (-ता) 1 An arrangement of the text of the Vedas into short sentences, regulated when the style is verse by the species of verse, and when prose by the subject, and denominated after the person or persons by whom the arrangement was originally made: it is also sometimes considered as synonymous with a Śākhā; a branch or school of the Vedas, of which sixteen are reckoned to the Ṛg-veda, one hundred and one to the Yajuṣ, one thousand in the Sāma, and nine in the Atharvan. 2 A compendium, a collection more or less compressed of laws, legends, &c. 3 (In grammar,) Proximity of two letters without an intermediate pause, Sandhi or junction, though usually considered rather as the state preparatory to the actual junction than the junction itself. 4 A compilation, a code, a digest. E. सम् before घा to have, aff. क.
संहूति: संहूति f. (-तिः) Clamour, shout, tumultuous exclamation. E. सम् together, हूति calling out.
संहृत: संहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seized, laid hold of. 2 Scuttered, thrown. 3 Destroyed. 4 Compressed, contracted, abridged. 5 Curbed, restrained. E. सम् before हृ to take, aff. क्त.
संहृति: संहृति f. (-तिः) 1 Destruction, loss, disappearance. 2 Conraction, abridgment. 3 Taking, seizure. E. सम् before हृ to take, क्तिन् aff.
संहृत्य: संहृत्य ind. Having contracted or reduced in bulk. 2 Having abridged, &c. E. सम्, हृ to take, ल्यप् aff.
संह्राद: संह्राद m. (-दः) Sound, noise. E. सम् before ह्रद to sound, घञ् aff.
संह्रादिन्: संह्रादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Sounding, making a noise. E. सम् before ह्रद to sound, घिनुण् aff.
संह्रीण: संह्रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Bashful, modest, ashamed. E. सम्, and ह्री to be ashamed, क्त aff.
सक: सक m. (-कः) He, that man. E. स he, कन् added.
सकट: सकट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Bad, vile. m. (-टः) A small tree, (Trophis aspera.) E. स with, कट bad.
सकटान्न: सकटान्न n. (-न्नं) Impure food. E. सकट, and अन्न boiled rice.
सकण्टक: सकण्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Thorny, prickly. 2 Troublesome, perilous. m. (-कः) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.) E. स for सम् like or with, कण्टक a thorn.
सकर: सकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Bearing or returning tax or toll. 2 Having rays, &c. E. स with, कर tax, &c.
सकरुण: सकरुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Tender, compassionate. E. स with, करुण compassion.
सकर्ण: सकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Hearing, listening. E. स for सह with, कर्ण the ear.
सकर्मन्: सकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) 1 Performing any act or rite. 2 Following similar business. E. स with or same, कर्म्म act.
सकर्म्मन्: सकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) 1 Performing any act or rite. 2 Following similar business. E. स with or same, कर्म्म act.
सकर्मक: सकर्म्मक m. (-कः) (In grammar,) The transitive verb. E. स with कर्म्म act, and कन् added.
सकर्म्मक: सकर्म्मक m. (-कः) (In grammar,) The transitive verb. E. स with कर्म्म act, and कन् added.
सकल: सकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) All, whole, entire. E. स with, कला a part, अच् aff.
सकाकौल: सकाकौल m. (-लः) One of the twenty-one hells.
सकारण: सकारण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having a cause, originating from a cause. E. स with, कारण cause.
सकाल: सकाल n. adv. (-लं) Betimes, early in the morning. E. स with, काल time.
सकुल: सकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having a family, belonging to one, &c. m. (-लः) A sort of fish; also शकुल. E. स with, कुल a family.
सकुल्य: सकुल्य m. (-ल्यः) 1 A kinsman, one of the same family name and common origin: see सगोत्र. 2 A distant kinsman or relation; one who shares a divided oblation, as the grandson's grandson or other descendant as far as three degrees from him, or the offspring of the grandfather's grandfather or other remoter ancestor. E. स same, कुल्य of family: some authorities extend the name of Sakulya to the tenth descendant.
सकृत्: सकृत् m. (-कृत्) Fæces, ordure: more usually, शकृत्. ind. 1 Once. 2 With, together with. 3 Always. E. सकृत् substituted for एक one.
सकृत्प्रज: सकृत्प्रज m. (-जः) A crow. E. सकृत् once, प्रज progeny.
सकोप: सकोप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Angry, displeased. E. स with, कोप wrath.
सक्त: सक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Attached, joined, in contact with. 2 Diligent, attentive, intent. 3 Devoted or addicted to. E. षञ्ज to embrace or adhere to, aff. क्त.
सक्ति: सक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Contact, union, junction, cohesion. 2 Devotion or addiction to. E. षञ्ज to embrace or adhere to, aff. क्तिन्.
सक्तु: सक्तु m. (-क्तः) Rice or corn fried and then ground. E. षच to moisten, Uṇādi aff. तुन्; also read शक्तु.
सक्तुक: सक्तुक m. (-कः) A species of poison. E. कन् added to the preceding.
सक्तुफला: सक्तुफला f. (-ला) The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.) E. सक्तु barley meal, and फल fruit; of a similar white colour; also सक्तुफली.
सक्थि: सक्थि n. (-क्थि) 1 The thigh. 2 Part of the frame of a cart. E. षञ्ज to unite, Uṇādi aff. क्थिन्.
सखि: सखि m. (-सखा) 1 A friend. 2 An associate, a companion. f. (-खी) A woman's female friend or companion, a confidante, &c. E. स for समान all, (the world,) ख्या to celebrate, aff. इन्, and ङीष् fem. aff.; the masc. noun is irregularly inflected.
सखित्व: सखित्व n. (-त्वं) Friendship. E. सखि a friend, and त्व aff.; also सखिता.
सखीजन: सखीजन n. (-नं) A female friend or confidante. E. सखी, and जन a person.
सख्य: सख्य n. (-ख्यं) Friendship. m. (-ख्यः) A friend. E. सखि a friend, य aff. of the property or pleonasm.
सग: सग (ए) सगे r. 1st cl. (सगति) To cover; also षग.
सगन्ध: सगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Fragrant, odoriferous. m. (-न्धः) A relation, a coheir. E. स for सम same, like, and गन्ध connexion; or स with, and गन्ध smell, scent.
सगर: सगर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Poisonous. m. (-रः) A sovereign of Ayodhyā, the father of ASAMAÑJA by KEŚINĪ, and sixty thousand sons by SUMATI: the latter being turned into a heap of ashes by the sage KAPILA, GARUḌA instructed the king to perform their funeral ceremonies with the waters of Gaṅgā, to be brought from heaven for that purpose; this was finally accomplished by the devotion of BHAGĪRATHA, the great-grandson of ASAMAÑJA, who having led the river to the sea, denominated it Sāgara, in honor of this his ancestor. E. स for सह with, गर poison; being born together with a poison given to his mother by the other wife of his father.
सगर्भ: सगर्भ m. (-र्भः) A brother by the same father and mother. E. स for समान the same, and गर्भ embryo.
सगर्भ्य: सगर्भ्य m. (-र्भ्यः) A brother of whole blood, one by the same father and mother. E. स for समान same, गर्भ embryo, यत् aff.
सगर्व: सगर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) 1 Proud. 2 Elated. E. स with, गर्व्व pride.
सगर्व्व: सगर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) 1 Proud. 2 Elated. E. स with, गर्व्व pride.
सगुण: सगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having or endowed with properties, qualities, &c. E. स with, गुण a quality.
सगोत्र: सगोत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Being of one family, of kin, related. m. (-त्रः) 1 A distant kinsman. 2 A kinsman of the same family name, or one sprung from a common ancestor; one connected by funeral oblations of food and water. n. (-त्रं) A family, a race or lineage. E. स for समान like, common, and गोत्र family.
सग्धि: सग्धि f. (-ग्धिः) Eating together. E. स for सम् with, अद to eat, क्तिच् aff.; घस is substituted for the root, the स rejected, and घ changed to ग.
सघ: सघ r. 5th cl. (सघ्नोति) To hurt, to kill; also षघ.
सङ्कट: सङ्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Narrow, contracted. 2 Crowded. 3 Impassable, impervious. n. (-टं) 1 Difficulty, trouble. 2 A defile, a pass. E. सम् before कटच् aff.
सङ्कटाक्ष: सङ्कटाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Winking, leering. m. (-क्षः) A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. सङ्कट contracted, अक्षि the eye.
सङ्कथा: सङ्कथा f. (-था) Conversation, discourse, talking together. E. सम् together, कथा speech; also सङ्कथन, &c.
सङ्कर: सङ्कर m. (-रः) 1 Mixing, blending, confounding. 2 A mixed caste or race, one proceeding from the promiscuous intercourse of the four tribes in the first instance, and again from their commerce with the descendants of such a connexion, or the indiscriminate cohabitation of those descendants amongst one another: most Hindus of the present age are of one of the many branches of this race, the highest of which is impure and inferior to the Śūdra: under this term two kinds of men are included according to the Rāmāyaṇa; the one denominated योनिसङ्कर, mixed or degraded by birth; and आचारसङ्कर degraded by conduct. 3 Dust, sweepings. 4 The crackling of flame. E. सम् before कॄ to scatter, or कृ to make, aff. अप्.
सङ्करीकरण: सङ्करीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Reducing to the state of the mixed or outcaste tribes, causing loss of caste. 2 Blending, mixing. 3 Confusion, either in kind, number, or arrangement. E. सङ्कर a mixed race, च्चि augment, and करण doing.
सङ्करीकृत: सङ्करीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blended, mixed, confusedly. 2 Outcaste. E. सङ्कर, and कृत made, च्चि aug.
सङ्कर्षण: सङ्कर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Attracting, drawing. 2 Ploughing, making furrows, &c. m. (-णः) BALADEVA. E. सम् before कृष to plough.  &c., aff. युच् or ल्युट्. As applied to the demigod it refers to his removal in embryo from the womb of DEVAKĪ to that of ROHIṆĪ.
सङ्कल: सङ्कल m. (-लः) 1 Collection, quantity. 2 Addition. E. सम् together, कल to number, aff. अच्.
सङ्कलन: सङ्कलन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Contact, junction. 2 Blending, clinging, twining, intermixture. 3 Heaping as corn, &c. n. (-नं) Addition, (in arithmetic.) E. सम् with or like, कल to number, aff. युच्.
सङ्कलित: सङ्कलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heaped, piled, arranged. 2 Brought in contact, blended, intermixed. 3 Added. n. (-तं) Addition, (in arithmetic.) E. सम् before कल to number, aff. क्त.
सङ्कल्प: सङ्कल्प m. (-ल्पः) 1 Volition, will, resolve, mental determination. 2 A solemn vow or declaration of purpose. 3 Expectation of desired consequences from any voluntary act. E. सम् before कृप to be able, aff. घञ्.
सङ्कल्पज: सङ्कल्पज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born of, or proceeding from the hope or expectation of advantage. m. (-जः) KĀMA or love. E. सङ्कल्प, and ज born; also सङ्कल्पजन्मन्, &c.
सङ्कल्पजन्मन्: सङ्कल्पजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) KĀMADEVA. E. सङ्कल्प volition, and जन्मन् birth.
सङ्कल्पभव: सङ्कल्पभव m. (वः) KĀMA. E. सङ्कल्प will, and भव born.
सङ्कल्पयोनि: सङ्कल्पयोनि m. (-निः) KĀMA, the deity of love. E. सङ्कल्प will, and योनि place of birth.
सङ्कल्परूप: सङ्कल्परूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Of the nature of or conformable to the will or purpose. E. सङ्कल्प, and रूप form.
सङ्कल्पसम्भव: सङ्कल्पसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced from or arising out of the hope or desire of advantage. m. (-वः) Love or KĀMA. E. सङ्कल्प, and सम्भव birth.
सङ्कल्पात्मक: सङ्कल्पात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Willing, resolving, referring to volition. E. सङ्कल्प, and आत्मक one with.
सङ्कल्पित: सङ्कल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Proposed, sought as the result of any act. E. सङ्कल्प, and इतच् aff.
सङ्कसुक: सङ्कसुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Unsteady, fickle, changeable. 2 Uncertain, doubtful. 3 Weak, feeble. 4 Bad, weak, wicked. E. सम् before कस to go, Uṇādi aff. उकन्.
सङ्कार: सङ्कार m. (-रः) 1 Dust, sweepings. 2 The crackling of flame. f. (-री) A girl recently deflowered, a new bride, &c. E. सम् before कृ to make, अण् aff.
सङ्काश: सङ्काश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Like, similar, (in composition.) 2 Near. E. सम् before काशृ to shine, aff. अच्.
सङ्किल: सङ्किल m. (-लः) A burning torch, a fire-brand. E. सम् before किल to be white, aff. क.
सङ्कीर्ण: सङ्कीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Crowded, confused. 2 Miscellaneous. 3 Impure. 4 Mixed. 5 Of mixed and consequently impure origin or caste. 6 Contracted, narrow. 7 Spread, diffused. 8 Scattered. 9 Indistinct, confused, (as a writing.) E. सम् before कॄ to scatter, aff. क्त.
सङ्कीर्णचारिन्: सङ्कीर्णचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wandering about, going into all sorts of places. E. सङ्कीर्ण, and चारिन् who goes.
सङ्कीर्णयोनि: सङ्कीर्णयोनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Of mixed or impure origin. E. सङ्कीर्ण, and योनि place of birth.
सङ्कीर्तन: सङ्कीर्त्तन nf. (-नं-ना) Celebrating, praising, honour, glorification. E. सम् before कॄत to praise, aff. युच्.
सङ्कीर्त्तन: सङ्कीर्त्तन nf. (-नं-ना) Celebrating, praising, honour, glorification. E. सम् before कॄत to praise, aff. युच्.
सङ्कीर्तित: सङ्कीर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, renowned, celebrated. E. सम् intensitive, कॄत to praise, aff. क्त.
सङ्कीर्त्तित: सङ्कीर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, renowned, celebrated. E. सम् intensitive, कॄत to praise, aff. क्त.
सङ्कुचित: सङ्कुचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unblown, unopened. 2 Closed, shut. 3 Narrowed, contracted. E. सम् before कुच to contract, aff. क्त.
सङ्कुल: सङ्कुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Crowded, confused, filled with so as to be impervious. n. (-लं) 1 Inconsistent and contradictory speech. 2 War. 3 A crowd, a mob. 4 A flock, a flight. E. सम् together, कुल to accumulate, aff. क.
सङ्कृति: सङ्कृति f. (-तिः) A form of metre, a stanza of four lines, of 24 syllables each. E. सम् complete, कृति a metre.
सङ्केत: सङ्केत r. 10th cl. (सङ्केतयति) 1 To call or invite. 2 To counsel or advise. 3 To fix or appoint a time.

सङ्केत m. (-तः) 1 Engagement, agreement, appointment, convention. 2 Condition, provision, the circumstances under which any thing is necessarily or naturally effected. 3 Sign, gesture, gesticulation. E. सङ्केत to appoint a time, &c., aff. अच्.
सङ्केतस्थान: सङ्केतस्थान n. (-नं) Place of assignation. E. सङ्केत, and स्थान place.
सङ्कोच: सङ्कोच m. (-चः) 1 Shutting, closing, contracting, contraction. 2 Binding, tying. 3 A sort of fish, a scate, (Raia Sancura, HAM.) n. (-त्रं) Saffron. E. सम् before कुच to contract, aff. घञ्.
सङ्कोचन: सङ्कोचन n. (-नं) Astringing, causing to shrink or close. E. मम्, कुच to contract, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
सङ्क्रन्दन: सङ्क्रन्दन m. (-नः) INDRA. E. सम् before क्रदि to cry out, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
सङ्क्रम: सङ्क्रम mn. (-मः-मं) 1 Difficult progress, clambering up rocks, fording torrents, making way through almost impervious or inaccessible passes, &c. 2 The means of effecting such a passage, a causeway, a bridge, &c. m. (-मः) 1 Going, moving, travelling. 2 The passage of a planetary body through the zodiac. 3 Passage from one point to another, traversing, transit, transition. 4 Concurrence. E. सम् before क्रम to go, aff. अच्.
सङ्क्रमण: सङ्क्रमण n. (-णं) 1 Going from or to, passage, transition. 2 Going with, concurrence. E. सम्, and क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.: see the last.
सङ्क्रमितृ: सङ्क्रमितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who goes or proceeds, who or what passes from one to another. E. सम्, क्रम to go, तृच् aff.
सङ्क्रान्त: सङ्क्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Passed, gone from one to another, transferred, &c. 2 Entered (into a new sign). 3 Depicted, imaged, reflected. E. सम् before क्रम to go, aff. क्त.
सङ्क्रान्ति: सङ्क्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 The actual passage of the sun or other planetary bodies from one sign of the zodiac into another. 2 Passage in general, proceeding from one time or condition of life to another, from one place to another, &c. 3 Going, proceeding in general. 4 Imitation, reflexion. E. सम् before क्रम to go, aff. क्तिन्.
सङ्क्राम: सङ्क्राम m. (-मः) 1 Difficult progress or passage over steep rocks, through narrow defiles, &c. 2 A bridge of ropes, &c.: see सङ्क्रम. E. सम् before क्रम to go, aff. घञ्.
सङ्क्रीडण: सङ्क्रीडण n. (-णं) Sporting, playing. E. सम् before क्रीड to play, ल्युट् aff.
सङ्क्रीडमाण: सङ्क्रीडमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Sporting, playing. E. सम् before क्रीड to play, शानच् aff.
सङ्क्रुद्ध: सङ्क्रुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Violent, enraged. E. सम्, and क्रुद्ध angry.
सङ्क्लेद: सङ्क्लेद m. (-दः) 1 The fluid secretion which is supposed to form upon conception, and to be the rudiment of the foetus. 2 Moisture, wet, damp. E. सम् to gether, and क्लेद moisture.
सङ्क्षय: सङ्क्षय m. (-यः) 1 The destruction of the world. 2 Loss, destruction in general. E. सम् completely, क्षि to perish, aff. अच्.
सङ्क्षिप्त: सङ्क्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Abridged, abbreviated, concise, compressed. 2 Small, compact. 3 Thrown. 4 Sent. 5 Taken from or away, seized. E. सम् before क्षिप to throw or send, aff. क्त.
सङ्क्षिप्ति: सङ्क्षिप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Abridgment. 2 Throwing. 3 Sending. 4 Ambuscade. 5 Transition from one feeling to another. E. सम्, क्षिप to throw, क्तिन् aff.
सङ्क्षीयमाण: सङ्क्षीयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Perishing, being destroyed. E. सम् before क्षि to waste, शानच् aff.
सङ्क्षेप: सङ्क्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Abridgment, abbreviation, conciseness, compression. 2 Sending. 3 Throwing. 4 Taking away. 5 Assisting in another's duty. E. सम् before क्षिप to throw or send, aff. घञ्.
सङ्क्षेपण: सङ्क्षेपण n. (-णं) 1 Abridgment, brevity. 2 Sending. 3 Throwing. 4 Taking away. E. सम् before क्षिप to throw or send, aff. ल्युट्.
सङ्क्षोभ: सङ्क्षोभ m. (-भः) 1 Overturning, upsetting. 2 Shaking, trembling, agitation. 3 Pride, arrogance. E. सम् before क्षुभ to tremble, aff. घञ्.
सङ्क्ष्णुवान: सङ्क्ष्णुवान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Whetting, sharpening. 2 Inflaming, exciting. E. सम् before क्ष्णु to sharpen, शानच् aff.
सङ्ख्य: सङ्ख्य n. (-ङ्ख्यं) War, battle. f. (-ङ्ख्या) 1 Number in general, or a number, a numeral. 2 Deliberation, reasoning, reflection. 3 Intellect, understanding. E. सम् before ख्या substituted for चक्ष to speak well, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
सङ्ख्यता: सङ्ख्यता f. (-ता) Number, numeration, counting. E. तल् added to the last; also सङ्ख्यत्व.
सङ्ख्यात: सङ्ख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Numbered, counted, reckoned. E. सम् before ख्या to tell, aff. क्त.
सङ्ख्यान: सङ्ख्यान n. (-नं) Numbering, numeration, reckoning. E. सम् before ख्या to tell, aff. ल्युट्.
सङ्ख्यावत्: सङ्ख्यावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Having or being possessed of number, numbered. 2 Intelligent, discriminating. m. (-वान्) A learned Brahman, a Paṇḍita, a teacher. E. सङ्ख्या number, &c., and मतुप् poss. aff.
सङ्ख्येय: सङ्ख्येय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Numerable, to be counted or numbered. E. सङ्ख्या a number, यत् aff.
सङ्ग: सङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Meeting, encountering. 2 Association, intercourse, friendship. 3 Joining, uniting. 4 Desire, wish, cupidity. 5 Addiction or devotion to. 6 Confluence of rivers. E. सम् together, गम to go, aff. ड, or षंज to embrace. घञ् aff.
सङ्गणिका: सङ्गणिका f. (-का) Incomparable or unequalled discourse. E. सम् before गण to count, aff. ण्वुल्.
सङ्गत: सङ्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Apposite, proper, (as speech.) 2 Mixed, united. 3 Met, encountered. 4 Collected, accumulated. 5 In conjunction, (planets.) n. (-तं) 1 Friendship, acquaintance. 2 Union, meeting. E. सम् before गत gone.
सङ्गति: सङ्गति f. (-तिः) 1 Meeting, union, mixture. 2 Knowledge. 3 Association, intercourse. 4 Frequenting, going to. 5 Questioning for continued or further information. E. सम् together, गति going.
सङ्गम: सङ्गम m. (-मः) 1 Meeting, union, mixture, junction, the encounter of persons, the association of friends or lovers, the confluence of rivers, the fitness or adaptation of two things to each other, &c. 2 (In astronomy,) Planetary conjunction. E. सम् together, like, suitably, गम going: see also सङ्ग, सङ्गत, सङ्गति, &c.
सङ्गर: सङ्गर m. (-रः) 1 War, battle. 2 Misfortune, calamity. 3 Promise, assent, agreement. 4 A bargain, a transaction of sale. 5 Poison. 6 Knowledge. n. (-रं) The fruit of the Śami tree. E. सम् before गॄ to swallow, aff. अप्.
सङ्गरहित: सङ्गरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Indifferent, stoical, free from attachment. E. सङ्ग, and रहित free from.
सङ्गवर्जित: सङ्गवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Free from worldly attachments or affections. E. सङ्ग, and वर्ज्जित abandoned.
सङ्गवर्ज्जित: सङ्गवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Free from worldly attachments or affections. E. सङ्ग, and वर्ज्जित abandoned.
सङ्गविच्युति: सङ्गविच्युति f. (-तिः) 1 Separation from, or dissolution of worldly affection. 2 Disunion. E. सङ्ग, and विच्युति separation.
सङ्गिन्: सङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) 1 Uniting with, going to or with, attached. 2 Devoted or addicted to, intent on. 3 Libidinous, lustful, desirous. E. सङ्ग union, इनि aff.
सङ्गिरमाण: सङ्गिरमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Promising. E. सम् before गॄ to speak, शानच् aff.
सङ्गीत: सङ्गीत n. (-तं) 1 The exhibition of song, dancing, and music, as a public entertainment. 2 The art or science of music, and dancing. E. सम् together, and गीत sung.
सङ्गीति: सङ्गीति f. (-तिः) 1 Conversation, discourse. 2 The science of music and dancing. E. सम् together, गा to sing, क्तिन् aff.
सङ्गीर्ण: सङ्गीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Promised, agreed. E. सम् before गॄ to speak, aff. क्त.
सङ्गुप्त: सङ्गुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Hidden, concealed. m. (-प्तः) A Buddha or Bauddha saint. E. सम् before गुप्त hidden.
सङ्गूढ: सङ्गूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Heaped, piled, arranged. 2 United, joined, brought in contact. 3 Contracted, abridged. E. सम् before गुह to hide, aff. क्त.
सङ्गृहीत: सङ्गृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken, accepted, seized. 2 Assented to. E. सम् before ग्रह to take, क्त aff.
सङ्गोपन: सङ्गोपन mfn. (-नं) Hiding, concealment. E. सम् before गुप to hide, aff. ल्युट्.
सङ्ग्रह: सङ्ग्रह m. (-हः) 1 A compilation and abridgment. 2 A catalogue, a list or summary. 3 Quantity, collection. 4 Restraining, confining. 5 Taking, seizing. 6 Propitiating, pleasing, attaching. 7 Protecting, guarding. 8 A place where any thing is kept. 9 Assent, promise. 10 Elevation, loftiness. 11 Velocity. 12 Clenching the fist. 13 Effort, exertion. E. सम् before ग्रह to take, aff. अप्.
सङ्ग्रहण: सङ्ग्रहण n. (-णं) 1 Taking, accepting, seizing. 2 Sexual intercourse. 3 Hope. 4 Collecting. 5 Compiling. f. (-णी) Diarrhœa, dysentery. E. सम् before ग्रह to take, and ल्युट् aff.
सङ्ग्राम: सङ्ग्राम r. 10th cl. (सङ्ग्रामयति-ते) 1 To fight. 2 To make war.
सङ्ग्राम m. (-मः) War, battle. E. सङ्ग्राम to fight, aff. ण.
सङ्ग्रामपटह: सङ्ग्रामपटह m. (-हः) A large military drum. E. सङ्ग्राम war, and पटह a drum.
सङ्ग्राह: सङ्ग्राह m. (-हः) 1 Laying hold of forcibly, seizing, griping. 2 The fist. 3 Clenching the fist. 4 The gripe of a shield. E. सम् before ग्रह to seize, aff. घञ्.
सङ्घ: सङ्घ n. (-ङ्घं) 1 Flock, multitude, number, a collection of living beings either of the same or different species. 2 A heap, a quantity in general. E. सम् before हन to kill or hurt, aff. घञ्.
सङ्घचारिन्: सङ्घचारिन् m. (-री) A fish in general. E. सङ्घ a shoal, चर to go, णिनि aff.
सङ्घजीविन्: सङ्घजीविन् m. (-वां) A hired porter or labourer, a cooly. E. सङ्घ a crowd, and जीविन् who lives.
सङ्घट्ट: सङ्घट्ट m. (-ट्टः) 1 Clash, shock, collision. 2 Friction, rubbing together. 3 Meeting, encounter. 4 Embracing. f. (-ट्टा) A large creeper. E. सम् before घट्ट to go, aff. अच्, and टाप्.
सङ्घट्टन: सङ्घट्टन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Meeting, encountering, occurrence. 2 Union, junction, contact, cohesion. 3 Close contact, cleaving or adhering to, the intertwining of wrestlers, the embraces of lovers, &c. 4 Friction, rubbing together. E. सम् before घट्ट to move, aff. युच्.
सङ्घर्ष: सङ्घर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Envy, emulation, rivalry, vieing or contending for superiority. 2 Trituration, rubbing, grinding. 3 Going gently, gliding, flowing. E. सम् before घृष to rub, aff. घञ्.
सङ्घशस्: सङ्घशस् ind. Collectively, altogether. E. सङ्घ, and शसि aff.
सङ्घाटिका: सङ्घाटिका f. (-का) 1 A bawd, a procuress. 2 A pair, a couple. 3 An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) 4 Smell. E. सम् before घट to unite, aff. ण्वुल्, fem. form.
सङ्घात: सङ्घात m. (-तः) 1 Assemblage, multitude, heap, quantity. 2 Association, combination. 3 Composition of words, formation of compound terms. 4 Killing, striking, hurting, 5 Phlegm. 6 A particular mode of walking in dramatic representation. 7 A division of Tartarus. E. सम् before हन to strike or kill, घञ् aff.
सङ्घातवत्: सङ्घातवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having or connected with many, a heap, &c. E. सङ्घात, and मतुप् aff.
सङ्घुष्ट: सङ्घुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Resonant, resounding. m. (-ष्टः) Sound, cry, noise. E. सम् before घुष to sound, aff. क्त; also optionally with the augment, इट्, सङ्घुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं.)
सचराचर: सचराचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) All whether animate or inanimate. E. स with, चर moving, अचर stationary.
सचि: सचि m. (-चिः) Friendship, intimacy, connexion. f. (-चिः-ची) The wife of INDRA. E. षच to be connected, aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added; also शचि, and शची.
सचिल्लक: सचिल्लक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Blear-eyed. E. स for सह with, चिल्ल a bad eye, कन् aff.
सचिव: सचिव m. (-वः) 1 A friend, a companion, an associate. 2 A minister, a counsellor. E. सचि friendship, वा to go or get, aff. क.
सचेतन: सचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Rational. 2 Conscious, sensible. E. स with, चेतन intellect.
सचेतस्: सचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) Conscious, reflective, understanding. E. स with, चेतस् mind
सचेल: सचेल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Clothed, dressed. E. स with, चेल clothes.
सचेष्ट: सचेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Active, making effort. m. (-ष्टः) The mango, (Mangifera Indica.) E. स with, चेष्टा effort.
सच्चरित: सच्चरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Honest, upright. 2 Virtuous. E. सत् good, चरित conduct.
सच्चिदंश: सच्चिदंश m. (-शः) Intellect, intellectual part or portion. E. सत् being, चित् intellect, and अंश part.
सच्चिदानन्द: सच्चिदानन्द n. (-न्दं) BRAHMA, or the Supreme Spirit. E. सत् being present, चित् intellect, and आनन्द happiness; the external source of wisdom and happiness.
सच्छूद्र: सच्छूद्र m. (-द्रः) A Śūdra, who has gone through the same ceremonies as the other classes, which though not directed by and indeed contrary to law, is in some places customary. E. सत् pure, and शूद्र a Śūdra.
सजम्बाल: सजम्बाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Muddy, clayey. E. स for सह, with जम्बाल mud.
सजल: सजल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Watery, wet. E. स with, जल water.
सजाति: सजाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of the same sort or species, of the same tribe, &c. m. (-तिः) The son of a man and woman of the same caste. E. स for समान same, and जाति species.
सजातीय: सजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Descended from parents of the same tribe or caste. 2 Of the same tribe. 3 Of the same species. 4 Like, similar. E. स for समान same, जाति sort, kind, and छ aff.
सजुस्: सजुस् mfn. (-जूः-जूः-जुः) Associated, an associate or companion. ind. (-जूः) With, together with. E. स with जुष to please, aff. क्विप्.
सज्ज: सज्ज mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं) 1 Armed, accoutred. 2 Fortified. 3 Prepared, got ready. 4 Ornamented, decorated. 5 Covered, clothed. f. (-ज्जा) 1 Dress, decoration. 2 Armour, mail. E. षस्ज to go, aff. अच्.
सज्जन: सज्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Of good family, well born. 2 Respectable, reputable. 3 Good, virtuous. 4 Arming, putting on armour. 5 Dressing, preparing. n. (-नं) 1 A guard, a sentry, a picquet. 2 A ferry, a Ghāt. f. (-ना) 1 Caparisoning an elephant. 2 Dress, decoration. 3 Arming, accoutring. E. षस्ज to go, aff. युच्, or सत् excellence, जन a person.
सज्जमान: सज्जमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Arming. 2 Dressing. 3 Getting ready, preparing. 4 Hesitating, (in speech.) E. षस्ज to go, शानच् aff.
सज्जित: सज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Armed, accoutred. 2 Dressed, decorated, ornamented. 3 Prepared, made. E. सज्जा armour, इतच् aff.
सज्जीकरण: सज्जीकरण n. (-णं) Arming, arraying, preparing, decorating. E. सज्ज armed, and करण् making, च्चि augment.
सज्जीकृत: सज्जीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Armed, accoutred, prepared, decorated. E. सज्ज, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
सज्जीभूत: सज्जीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Armed, prepared, decorated. E. सज्ज, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
सज्य: सज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Strung, (as a bow,) having a bowstring. E. स with ज्या a bowstring.
सञ्चकित: सञ्चकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Afraid, timid. E. सम्, and चकित timid.
सञ्चत्: सञ्चत् m. (-ञ्चत्) Cheating, juggling. E. सम् together, चि to collect, अति Uṇādi aff. and the radical vowel rejected.
सञ्चय: सञ्चय m. (-यः) Heap, quantity, number, multitude. E. सम् together, चि to collect, aff. अच्.
सञ्चयन: सञ्चयन n. (-नं) 1 Collecting, gathering. 2 Collecting the ashes or bones of a body which has been burnt. E. सम् together, चि to collect, aff. ल्युट्.
सञ्चयिन्: सञ्चयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Who or what collects. E. सम्, चि to collect, घिनुण् aff.
सञ्चर: सञ्चर m. (-रः) A defile, any narrow or difficult pass, a road along the edge of a mountain, or a bridge over a mountain stream, &c. 2 Difficult passage, travelling along almost impracticable routes. 3 A road, a way. 4 The body. 5 Killing. E. सम् before चर to go, aff. घ; also सञ्चार.
सञ्चलन: सञ्चलन nf. (-नं-ना) Trembling, shaking. E. सम् before चल to go, युच् aff.
सञ्चान: सञ्चान m. (-नः) A bird, a hawk (?).
सञ्चाय्य: सञ्चाय्य m. (-य्यः) A particular sacrifice, at which the juice of the acid Asclepias is drank. E. सम् together, चि to collect, participial aff. ण्यत् form irr. आय being substituted for the regular change: see सञ्चेय.
सञ्चार: सञ्चार m. (-रः) 1 Difficult progress. 2 Difficulty, distress. 3 Leading, guiding. 4 Inciting. 5 Impelling, setting in motion. 6 Contagion, communication or transmission of disease. 7 Course, transition. 8 A gem supposed to be in the head of a serpent. E. सम् before चर to go, aff. घञ्: see सञ्चर, or सम् and चर to go, causal v., अच् aff.
सञ्चारक: सञ्चारक m. (-कः) 1 A leader, a guide. 2 An instigator. 3 An orator. E. सम्, चर to go, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
सञ्चारजीविन्: सञ्चारजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Indigent, distressed, calamitous, in want of aid or protection. E. सञ्चार difficulty, and जीविन् living.
सञ्चारण: सञ्चारण n. (-णं) 1 Leading, guiding. 2 Impelling, instigating. 3 Moving, setting in motion. E. सम् before चर to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
सञ्चारिका: सञ्चारिका f. (-का) 1 A female messenger or go-between. 2 A bawd. 3 A brace, a pair. 4 Smell. E. सम् before चर to go, ण्वुल् aff.
सञ्चारित: सञ्चारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Led, guided. 2 Driven, impelled. 3 Set in motion, moved. 4 Communicated, (as disease.) E. सम् before चर to go, causal v., क्त aff.
सञ्चारिन्: सञ्चारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Fickle, changeable, not permanent. 2 Moving, going. 3 Difficult, inaccessible. 4 Moving, putting in motion. 5 Transmitted, hereditary, (as disease.) 6 Contagious. m. (-री) 1 Incense. 2 A division of the Bhāvas, the same as the व्यभित्रारिन् q. v. or the reverse of the स्थायिन् or fixed and steady sentiments. 3 Air, wind. E. सम् before चर to go, णिनि aff.
सञ्चित: सञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Assembled, accumulated, collected, gathered. E. सम्, चि to collect, क्त aff.
सञ्चित्रा: सञ्चित्रा f. (-त्रा) A plant, (Salvainia cucullata.) E. सम् completely, चित्र variegated.
सञ्चिन्तन: सञ्चिन्तन n. (-नं) Considering, reflecting. E. सम् before चिति to think, ल्युट् aff.
सञ्चिन्तित: सञ्चिन्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Deliberated, weighed. E. सम्, चिति to think, क्त aff.
सञ्चिन्त्य: सञ्चिन्त्य ind. Having considered, reflected, thoughtful. E. सम्, त्रिति to think, ल्यप् aff.
सञ्चूर्णन: सञ्चूर्णन n. (-नं) Breaking to pieces, reducing to powder. E. सम्, चूर्ण to grind, ल्युट् aff.
सञ्चूर्णित: सञ्चूर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut or broken to pieces, pulverised, comminuted. E. सम् before चूर्ण to pound, क्त aff.
सञ्चेय: सञ्चेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be collected or accumulated. E. सम्, त्रि to gather, ण्यत् aff.
सञ्चोदित: सञ्चोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ordered, commanded. E. सम्, and चोदित ordered.
सञ्छन्न: सञ्छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Covered. E. सम् completely, and छन्न covered.
सञ्छिन्न: सञ्छिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Cut, cut off. 2 Dissipated, removed. E. सम् before छिद to cut, क्त aff.
सञ्ज: सञ्ज r. 1st cl. (सञ्जति) To go or move.
सञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 ŚIVA. f. (-ञ्जा) A she-goat. E. सम् uniformly, all (mankind), जन to be born, (or created by whom,) and ढ aff.
सञ्जनन: सञ्जनन n. (-नं) Begetting, causing, producing. E. सम् before जन to be born, ल्युट् aff.
सञ्जनयत्: सञ्जनयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Begetting, producing, causing. E. सम् before जन to be born, causal v., शतृ aff.
सञ्जवन: सञ्जवन n. (-नं) A group of four houses. E. सम् together, जु to go, aff. युच्; also संयवन, and सञ्जीवन.
सञ्जात: सञ्जात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Become. E. सम्, and जात born.
सञ्जानान: सञ्जानान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Knowing, observing. 2 Watching, who or what keeps watch. E. सम् before ज्ञा to know, शानच् aff.
सञ्जीवन: सञ्जीवन n. (-नं) 1 Animating, bringing to life. 2 A cluster of four houses. 3 A hill. E. सम् together, जीव to live, युच् aff.
सञ्जुघुक्षा: सञ्जुघुक्षा f. (-क्षा) Wish or attempt to preserve. E. सम् before गुह to hide, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
सञ्जुघुक्षु: सञ्जुघुक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Wishing to preserve, hide, conceal, &c. E. सम् before गुह to hide, desid. v., उ aff.
सञ्ज्वर: सञ्ज्वर m. (-रः) 1 Heat, the heat of fire, burning, scorching, a burn. 2 Fever. E. सम् before ज्वर to burn, aff. अच्.
सञ्ज्वरातुर: सञ्ज्वरातुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Overcome by or affected with fever, fevered, feverish. E. सञ्ज्वर, and आतुर distressed.
सञ्ज्वारिन्: सञ्ज्वारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Affected with fever, fevered, diseased. E. सम् before ज्वर to be feverish, घिनुण् aff.
संज्ञ: संज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Knock-kneed. n. (-ज्ञं) A yellow fragrant wood. f. (-ज्ञा) 1 Name, appellation. 2 Thought, mind, intellect. 3 Gesture, sign, gesticulation. 4 The sacred verse or Gāyatrī of the Vedas. 5 One of the wives of the sun. 6 (In grammar,) The technical name of any affix, &c. E. सम् before ज्ञा to know, aff. अङ् and टाप्, that by which any thing is known.
संज्ञप्ति: संज्ञप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Killing, slaying. 2 Apprising, informing. E. सम् before ज्ञा to know; also, to slay, (causal form,) aff. क्तिन्.
संज्ञापन: संज्ञापन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Apprising, informing. 3 Teaching. E. सम् before ज्ञा to know; also to slay, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
सज्ञावत्: सज्ञावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Recovered after insensibility, become sensible. 2 Having a name or denomination. E. सज्ञा sign, name, &c., मतुप् aff.
सज्ञाविषय: सज्ञाविषय m. (-यः) An epithet or attributive. E. सज्ञा, and विषय object.
सज्ञित: सज्ञित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Called, denominated. E. सज्ञा, and इतच् aff.
सज्ञु: सज्ञु mfn. (-ज्ञुः-ज्ञुः-ज्ञु) Knock-kneed. E. सम् together, and ज्ञु for जानु the knee.
सट: सट mfn. subst. (-टः-टा-टं) An ascetic's clotted hair, or the hair collected into a loose braid and twisted forwards upon the forehead. 2 A mane. 3 A crest. E. षट to be a part of, and अच् aff.
सटाङ्क: सटाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A lion. E. सटा mane, and अङ्क mark.
सटि: सटि f. (-टिः-टी) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet,) but applied also to the Curcuma amada: see सटि. E. षट to be a part of, इन् aff. and ङीष् optionally added.
सटीक: सटीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Accompanied or explained by a commentary. E. स with, टीका a comment.
सट्ट: सट्ट r. 10th cl. (सट्टयति) To hurt or kill.
सट्टक: सट्टक n. (-कं) A sort of minor drama in Prākṛta only.
सठ: सठ r. 1st cl. (साठयति) 1 To finish, to complete. 2 To leave unfinished. 3 To go, to move.
सणसूत्र: सणसूत्र n. (-त्रं) Packthread. E. see शणसूत्र, the sibilants being interchanged.
सण्ड: सण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A eunuch: see षण्ड, and शण्ड, &c. the sibilants being interchanged.
सण्डीन: सण्डीन n. (-नं) Perching, alighting, (as a bird.) E. सम् before डी to fly, aff. क्त, form irr.
सत्: सत् mfn. (-सन्-सती-सत्) 1 True. 2 Good, virtuous. 3 Being, existing. 4 Excellent, best. 5 Venerable, respectable. 6 Wise, learned. 7 Firm, steady. 1 Right, proper. f. (-सती) 1 A virtuous wife; in ordinary use applied especially to the wife who burns herself with her husband's corpse. 2 The goddess UMĀ. 3 A fragrant earth, commonly Surat earth. 4 A species of the Pratiṣṭhā metre. n. (सत्) The true God, the always present and all-pervading spirit. ind. (सत्) In composition, a particle of reverence or respect, implying, good, right, fit, &c. as सत्क्रिया virtue, doing what is right, &c. E. अस to be, aff. of the participle of the present tense शतृ.
सतत: सतत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eternal, continual. n. adv. (-तं) Eternally, continually. E. सम् before तन to spread, aff. क्त, and the म rejected optionally.
सतत्त्व: सतत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) Natural property, nature. E. स for समान universal, तत्त्व nature.
सतानन्द: सतानन्द m. (-न्दः) The sage GAUTAMA, the author of the Nyāya or logical philosophy. E. सत् the good, and आनन्द who delights.
सति: सति f. (-तिः) 1 End, destruction. 2 Gift, giving. E. षण to give or षो to destroy, क्तिन् aff.; also साति.
सतीत्व: सतीत्व n. (-त्वं) Virtuousness or purity in a wife. E. सती, see सत्, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, सतीता.
सतीन: सतीन m. (-नः) Peas, or a particular kind of pulse. E. सति, from सत् being, life, इन् master, and with कन् added सतीनक.
सतीनक: सतीनक m. (-कः) Peas; also सितीनक, and सतीलक, &c.: see the last.
सतीर्थ: सतीर्थ m. (-र्थः) A fellow student, the pupil of the same spiritual preceptor. E. स for सह same, तीर्थ a teacher.
सतीर्थ्य: सतीर्थ्य m. (-र्थ्यः) A fellow student: see the last. E. स for सह the same, तीर्थ a teacher, and यत् aff.
सतील: सतील m. (-लः) 1 A bambu. 2 Air, wind. mf. (-लः-ला) Peas, pulse, or a particular kind, called Teorā. E. सती a good wife, लक्ष to make, aff. ड.
सतीलक: सतीलक m. (-कः) Pulse in general, or a particular sort. E. सतील wind, कै to utter, aff. ड; also सितीलक, सतीनक, सातीलक.
सतृष्: सतृष् mfn. (-तृट्) 1 Thirsty, greedy, cupidinous. 2 Thirsty, (literally.) E. स for सहित with, तृष thirst, literally or figuratively.
सत्कर्मन्: सत्कर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 A good act, piety, virtue. 2 Hospitality. 3 Funeral obsequies. 4 Expiation. E. सत्, and कम्मन् act; also सत्, क्रिया, &c.
सत्कर्म्मन्: सत्कर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 A good act, piety, virtue. 2 Hospitality. 3 Funeral obsequies. 4 Expiation. E. सत्, and कम्मन् act; also सत्, क्रिया, &c.
सत्कदम्ब: सत्कदम्ब m. (-म्बः) A tree, (Nauclea cordifolia.) E. सत् good, कदम्ब the Cadamba tree.
सत्काञ्चनार: सत्काञ्चनार m. (-रः) A sort of ebony: see रक्तकाञ्चन.
सत्काण्ड: सत्काण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A hawk, a kite.
सत्कार: सत्कार m. (-रः) 1 Reverence, respect. 2 Hospitable treatment or reception. E. सत्, and कार making.
सत्कृत: सत्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Worshipped, adored. 2 Respected, revered. 3 Welcomed, saluted. 4 Entertained, treated with hospitality. 5 Done rightly or properly. n. (-तं) 1 Hospitality. 2 Respect. 3 Virtue. E. सत् excellent, and कृत made.
सत्कृति: सत्कृति f. (-तिः) 1 Doing good, acting properly, virtue, morality, &c. 2 Treating with respect. E. सत् good, and कृति act.
सत्कृत्य: सत्कृत्य ind. Having treated with respect, &c. E. सत्, and कृत्य having made.
सत्क्रिया: सत्क्रिया f. (-या) 1 Funeral or obsequial ceremonies. 2 Any purificatory ceremony. 3 Doing good, charity, virtue, &c. 4 Worship, homage. 5 Respectful treatment. 6 Salutation, welcome, courtesy. 7 Hospitality. E. सत् good, and क्रिया act.
सत्तम: सत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Best, excellent. 2 Very venerable or respectable. 3 Most virtuous. E. सत् good, and तमप् aff.
सत्ता: सत्ता f. (-त्ता) 1 Being, existence. 2 Goodness, excellence. E. सत् being, तल् aff. of the abstract; also सत्त्वं.
सत्र: सत्र r. 10th cl. (सत्रयते) 1 To act liberally. 2 To be connected. 3 To spread or extend.
सत्त्र: सत्त्र n. (-त्त्रं) 1 Sacrifice, oblation. 2 Liberality, munificence. 3 Covering, clothing, concealing. 4 Fraud, roguery, cheating. 5 A wood, a forest. 6 Wealth. 7 A house. 8 A tank, a pond. E. सद to go, Uṇādi aff. त्रन्; in writing, one त may be omitted, and it occurs, सत्र.
सत्त्रशाला: सत्त्रशाला f. (-ला) An apartment in which Brahmans or mendicants, &c. are presented with food and gifts. E. सत्र giving, and शाला a house.
सत्त्रा: सत्त्रा ind. With, together with. E. स for सह with, त्रा to preserve, aff. क्विप्; also written, सत्रा.
सत्त्रि: सत्त्रि m. (-त्त्रिः) 1 A cloud. 2 An elephant. 3 A victor, a conqueror. E. षद to go, or waste, to destroy, &c. Uṇādi aff. त्रि.
सत्त्रिन्: सत्त्रिन् m. (-त्त्री) 1 A liberal housekeeper, one constantly performing sacrifice and distributing alms. 2 An embassador,  an agent residing in a foreign country. 3 A priest superintending or performing a sacrifice. E. सत्त्र munificence, &c. इनि aff.
सत्त्व: सत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) 1 One of the three Guṇas or properties of man and nature; the quality of excellence or goodness: that which enlightens, constitutes knowledge, and is the cause of truth, and the predominance of which renders the person, in whom it resides, virtuous, gentle, devout, charitable, chaste, honest, &c., and the thing, pure, mild, &c. 2 Substance, thing, either elementary substance, as earth, air, fire, &c. or any thing of which some property may be predicated. 3 Mind, intellect. 4 Nature, natural property or disposition. 5 Vigour, power. 6 Strength. 7 Self-possession or command. 8 Breath. 9 Being, existence. 10 Essence, substance. 11 Wealth. 12 Certainty. 13 Life, the principle of being. 14 A substantive noun. 15 A demon, a goblin. mn. (-त्त्वः-त्त्वं) An animal, a being. E. षद to perish, aff. त्वत्, or सत् being, good, excellent, &c. त्व aff. of the abstract; one त being rejected also, it is read सत्व.
सत्त्वगुण: सत्त्वगुण m. (-णः) The property of goodness; see the last. E. सत्त्व, and गुण attribute.
सत्त्वता: सत्त्वता f. (-ता) Purity, goodness, the existence of the Sattva Gauṇa, or property of truth and virtue, &c. E. तल् abstract added to the last.
सत्त्वमेजय: सत्त्वमेजय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Frightening animals, making them tremble. E. सत्त्व, and एज to shake, खश् aff.
सत्त्ववत्: सत्त्ववत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Pure, virtuous, endowed with the quality of goodness. 2 Natural. 3 Existent, &c. E. सत्त्व and मतुप् aff.
सत्त्वविहित: सत्त्वविहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done spontaneously or naturally 2 Virtuous, upright. E. सत्त्व, and विहित effected.
सत्त्वसंशुद्धि: सत्त्वसंशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Purity of nature or disposition. E. सत्त्व, and संशुद्धि purity.
सत्त्वसम्पन्न: सत्त्वसम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Equable, even-minded, neither elated by prosperity nor depressed by misfortune. 2 Good, excellent. E. सत्त्व the good quality, and सम्पन्न endowed with.
सत्त्वस्थ: सत्त्वस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Excellent, holy, pure. 2 Being or existing in the nature of things. 3 Animate, inherent in animals. E. सत्त्व, and स्थ what stays or is.
सत्त्वानुरूप: सत्त्वानुरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) According to nature or natural quality. E. सत्त्व, and अनुरूप conformable to.
सत्त्वोत्साह: सत्त्वोत्साह m. (-हः) Natural energy or perseverance. E. सत्त्व, and उत्साह effort.
सत्पत्र: सत्पत्र n. (-त्रं) The new leaf of a water-lily. E. सत् good, and पत्र a leaf.
सत्पथ: सत्पथ m. (-थः) 1 A good road. 2 Correct or virtuous conduct, doctrine, &c. E. सत् good, and पथ a road.
सत्परिग्रह: सत्परिग्रह m. (-हः) Acceptance of gifts from proper persons. E. सत्, and परिग्रह acceptance.
सत्पशु: सत्पशु m. (-शुः) An animal fit for a sacrifice, a victim. E. सत् good, and पशु an animal.
सत्पात्र: सत्पात्र n. (-त्रं) A worthy or virtuous person. E. सत्, and पात्र a vessel.
सत्पात्रवर्ष: सत्पात्रवर्ष m. (-र्षः) Judicious liberality, bestowing favours on the worthy. E. सत्पात्र, and वर्ष raining.
सत्पुत्त्र: सत्पुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 The father of a son. 2 A virtuous son. E. सत् being, or good, and पुत्त्र a son.
सत्पुरुष: सत्पुरुष m. (-षः) A worthy or spirited man. E. सत्, and पुरुष a male.
सत्प्रतिपक्ष: सत्प्रतिपक्ष m. (-क्षः) Contrariety of doctrine or argument, knowledge of the opposite arguments proving the existence or non-existence of a thing. E. सत् being, प्रतिपक्ष opposition.
सत्फल: सत्फल m. (-लः) The pomegranate. E. सत् good, and फल fruit.
सत्य: सत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 True. 2 Sincere, honest, speaking the truth. n. (-त्यं) 1 Truth. 2 An oath. 3 The first Yuga or age, the golden age, comprising one million seven hundred and twenty-eight thousand years. 4 Demonstrated conclusion. m. (-त्यः) 1 RĀMACANDRA. 2 The uppermost of the seven Lokas or worlds, the abode of BRAHMĀ, and heaven of truth. f. (-त्या) 1 SĪTĀ, the wife of RĀMA. 2 The mother of Vyāsa. 3 Speaking the truth, sincerity, veracity. ind. (सत्यम्) Indeed, verily, a particle of interrogation, and asseveration. E. सत् being, and यत् aff.
सत्यक: सत्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) True, veracious. n. (-कं) Ratification of a bargain. E. सत्य as above, and कन् added.
सत्यङ्कार: सत्यङ्कार m. (-रः) Ratification of a bargain. E. सत्य truth, कार making, confirming, सम् augment.
सत्यङ्कारकृत: सत्यङ्कारकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Given or deposited in order to bind or ratify a bargain. E. सत्यङ्कार as above, and कृत made.
सत्यता: सत्यता f. (-ता) Truth, trueness. E. तल् added to सत्य; also with त्व, सत्यत्वं.
सत्यधन: सत्यधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Virtuous, sincere, upright. E. सत्य, and घन wealth.
सत्यभामा: सत्यभामा f. (-मा) One of KṚṢṆA'S wives. E. सत्य true, भाम beautiful, fem. form.
सत्यभारत: सत्यभारत m. (-तः) VYĀSA, the poet. E. सत्य true, भारत the Mahābhārata.
सत्ययुग: सत्ययुग n. (-गं) The first of the four Yugas or ages, the period of general virtue and purity, or golden age, comprising a term of 1, 728, 000 years. E. सत्य truth, and युग age.
सत्ययौवन: सत्ययौवन m. (-नः) A Vidyādhara or demigod so named. E. सत्य truth, and यौवन youth.
सत्यरत: सत्यरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Honest, sincere. m. (-तः) VYĀSA. E. सत्य truth, and रत devoted to.
सत्यवक्तृ: सत्यवक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) A speaker of truth. E. सत्य, and वक्तृ who speaks.
सत्यवचन: सत्यवचन n. (-नं) 1 Speaking truth. 2 Acknowledging or admitting the truth. E. सत्य, and वचन speech.
सत्यवचस्: सत्यवचस् mfn. (-चाः-चाः-चः) Speaking truth, veracious. m. (-चाः) A Ṛṣi, a saint, a seer. n. (-चः) Truth. E. सत्य truth, वचस् speech.
सत्यवत्: सत्यवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत) True, possessing or practising truth. m. (-वान्) The name of a king. f. (-वती) 1 The mother of VYĀSA. 2 The wife of NĀRADA. 3 The wife of ṚṢIKA, a saint. E. सत्य truth, and मतुप् aff.
सत्यवतीसुत: सत्यवतीसुत m. (-तः) The poet VYĀSA. E. सत्यवती his mother's name, and सुत son.
