सत्यवद्य: सत्यवद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) True-speaking, veracious. n. (-द्यं) Truth. E. सत्य, and वद to speak, with क्यप् or यत् aff.
सत्यवाच्: सत्यवाच् mfn. (-वाक्) Speaking the truth, veracious, sincere. m. (-वाक्) 1 A crow. 2 A Ṛṣi, a saint. E. सत्य true, वाच् speech.
सत्यवादित्व: सत्यवादित्व n. (-त्वं) Speaking truth. E. सत्यवादिन्, and त्व aff.
सत्यवादिन्: सत्यवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Speaking truth. E. सत्य truth, and वादिन् who speaks.
सत्यवृत्त: सत्यवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Practising or speaking the truth. E. सत्य truth, and वृत्त chosen.
सत्यव्रत: सत्यव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Practising or adhering to the truth, veracious, honest, sincere. m. (-तः) A king, the 25th of the solar dynasty in the second age. E. सत्य the truth, व्रत religious observance.
सत्यसङ्काश: सत्यसङ्काश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Likely, probable, plausible, like the truth. E. सत्य truth, and सङ्काश like; also, similar compounds, as सत्यसन्निभ, &c.
सत्यसङ्गर: सत्यसङ्गर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) True, veracious. m. (-रः) KUVERA, the god of wealth. E. सत्य the truth, सम् with गॄ to swallow, aff. अप्.
सत्यसन्ध: सत्यसन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Veracious, adhering to or observing the truth. m. (-न्धः) 1 BHARATA, the younger brother of RĀMA. 2 The prince JANAMEJAYA. f. (-न्धा) DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the PĀṆḌU princes. E. सत्य truth, सम् before धा to have or hold, aff. क
सत्यसाक्षिन्: सत्यसाक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) An unexceptionable witness. E. सत्य, and साक्षिन् a witness.
सत्याकृति: सत्याकृति f. (-तिः) Ratification of a bargain. E. सत्य truth, आङ् before कृ to make, to confirm, aff. क्तिन्.
सत्याग्नि: सत्याग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A name of the saint AGASTYA. E. सत्य the truth, and अग्नि fire.
सत्यात्मन्: सत्यात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) True. m. (-त्मा) A virtuous and upright man. E. सत्य, and आत्मन् same.
सत्यानुरक्त: सत्यानुरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Upright, true. E. सत्य, and अनुरक्त attached to.
सत्यान्टत: सत्यान्टत n. (-तं) Commerce, trade, traffick. E. सत्य truth, and अन्टत falsehood, a mixed practice of truth and lies.
सत्यापन: सत्यापन nf. (-नं-ना) Ratification of a bargain. E. सत्य nominal verb, to speak or observe the truth, causal form, सत्याप, and ल्युट् or युच् aff.
सत्योत्कर्ष: सत्योत्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) Eminence or excellence in truth. E. सत्य, and उत्कर्ष excellence.
सत्योद्य: सत्योद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Speaking the truth. E. सत्य the truth, उद्य to be said or uttered.
सत्रप: सत्रप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Ashamed, modest. E. स with त्रपा shame.
सत्रिजातक: सत्रिजातक n. (-कं) Meat which has been once fried with spices, &c. then soaked and dried, and again dressed with Ghee and condiments. E. स for सह, with त्रि three, जातक species of production.
सत्व: सत्व n. (-त्वं) The quality of excellence or goodness, &c.; see सत्त्व.
सत्वर: सत्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Quick, expeditious. n. adv. (-रं) Quickly, swiftly. E. स for सह with, त्वरा dispatch.
सत्वरता: सत्वरता f. (-ता) Quickness, speed. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, सत्वरत्वं.
सत्संसर्ग: सत्संसर्ग m. (-र्गः) Association with the good or respectable. E. सत्, and संसर्ग connexion.
सत्सङ्ग: सत्सङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Association with the good. E. सत्, and सङ्ग association.
सत्सन्निधान: सत्सन्निधान n. (-नं) Association or intercourse with the wise and good. E. सत्, and सन्निघान propinquity.
सत्समागम: सत्समागम m. (-मः) Association with the good. E. सत्, and समागम encounter.
सत्सहाय: सत्सहाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Having a friend. 2 Having virtuous friends. E. सत् being, or good, &c. सहाय a friend.
सत्सार: सत्सार m. (-रः) 1 A painter. 2 A poet. E. सत् excellence, सार essence.
सथूत्कार: सथूत्कार n. (-रं) Sputtering in speech. E. स for सहित with, थूत imitative sound, and कार making.
सदंशक: सदंशक m. (-कः) A crab. E. स with, दंशक a tooth.
सदंशवदन: सदंशवदन m. (-नः) A heron. E. स with, दंश a tooth or beak, and वदन face.
सद: सद m. (-दः) The fruit of trees. E. षद to go, अच् aff.
सदञ्जन: सदञ्जन n. (-नं) Calx of brass. E. सत् good, excellence, अञ्जन stibium.
सदन: सदन n. (-नं) 1 A house. 2 Water. 3 Perishing, decaying. 4 Exhaustion. E. षद to go or perish, aff. युच्.
सदय: सदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Benevolent, compassionate. E. स with, दया clemency.
सदर: सदर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Fearful, afraid. E. स with, दर fear.
सदस्: सदस् fn. (-दाः-दः) An assembly, a meeting. E. षद to go, (to which,) Uṇādi aff. असुन्.
सदसत्: सदसत् mfn. (-सन्-सती-सत्) 1 Existent and non-existent. 2 True and false. 3 Perceptible and non-perceptible. E. सत्, and असत् untrue, &c.
सदसदात्मक: सदसदात्मक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Being both real and unreal, existent and non-existent, substantial though imperceptible. E. सदसत्, and आत्मक self.
सदसद्विवेक: सदसद्विवेक m. (-कः) Discrimination between true and false, &c. E. सदसत्, and विवेक judgment.
सदस्य: सदस्य m. (-स्यः) 1 An assistant or by-stander at a sacrifice, &c. one whose business it is to notice and correct mistakes. 2 Any person present at an assembly, a spectator, an assessor, a member, &c. E. सदस् an assembly, यत् aff.
सदा: सदा ind. Always, at all times. E. स for सर्व्व all, दाच् aff.
सदागति: सदागति m. (-तिः) 1 The sun. 2 Air, wind. 3 Final happiness, emancipation from life. 4 The Supreme Spirit. E. सदा always, गति going, duration.
सदाचार: सदाचार m. (-रः) The traditionary observances of the Hindu castes, as preserved in the land lying between the Sarasvatī and Dṛṣadvatī rivers. 2 Virtuous conduct. E. सत् pure, virtuous, and आचार observance.
सदातन: सदातन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Eternal. m. (-नः) VIṢṆU. E. सदा always, ट्युल् aff.
सदातोया: सदातोया f. (-या) A plant, (Mimosa octandra.) E. सदा always, and तोय water.
सदात्मन्: सदात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Good, virtuous. E. सत्, and आत्मन् self.
सदादान: सदादान n. (-नं) Liberality, munificence. m. (-नः) 1 The elephant of INDRA. 2 A name of GAṆEŚA. 3 An elephant in must. E. सदा always, दान giving, or the ichor that exudes from the elephant's temples.
सदानन्द: सदानन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Always happy. E. सदा, and आनन्द happiness.
सदानर्त: सदानर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A wagtail. E. सदा always, नर्त्त a dancer.
सदानर्त्त: सदानर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A wagtail. E. सदा always, नर्त्त a dancer.
सदानीरवहा: सदानीरवहा f. (-हा) A small river in the north of Bengal. E. सदा always, नीर water, वह bearing.
सदानीरा: सदानीरा f. (-रा) The Karatoya, a small river in the north of Bengal. E. सदा always, नीर water.
सदापुष्प: सदापुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The cocoanut. f. (-ष्पी) A shrub, gigantic swallow-wort, the white variety. E. सदा always, and पुष्प a flower.
सदाफल: सदाफल m. (-लः) 1 The cocoanut tree. 2 The glomerous fig tree. 3 The jack, (Artocarpus integrifolia?) 4 The Bel, (Ægle marmelos.) E. सदा always, and फल fruit.
सदाभव्य: सदाभव्य mf. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Attentive, present. E. सदा always, भव्य being.
सदाभद्रा: सदाभद्रा f. (-द्रा) A shrub, (Gmelina arborea.) E. सदा always, भद्र auspicious.
सदायोगिन्: सदायोगिन् m. (-गी) VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. E. सदा always, योग union by meditation, &c., इनि aff.
सदाशिव: सदाशिव m. (-वः) ŚIVA. E. सदा always, शिव auspicious.
सदाश्रित: सदाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Attached or belonging to the virtuous, pure, good, lovely, &c. 2 Always connected with or dependant on. E. सत् good, &c., or सदा always, and आश्रित connected.
सदुत्तर: सदुत्तर n. (-रं) A proper or good reply. E. सत्, and उत्तर answer.
सदृक्ष: सदृक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Like, similar. E. स for सम् same, दृक्ष to see, क्म aff.
सदृश्: सदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Like, similar. E. स for सम् same, दृश to see, aff. क्विप्.
सदृश: सदृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) 1 Like, resembling, similar. 2 Fit, proper, right. E. स for सम् the same, दृश to see, aff. कञ्.
सदृशता: सदृशता f. (-ता) Likeness, sameness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, सदृशंत्वं.
सदेश: सदेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Of the same country or place. E. स for समान the same, and देश country.
सद्गति: सद्गति f. (-तिः) 1 Felicity or fortune. 2 Good conduct. E. सत्, गति going.
सद्गुण: सद्गुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Good, pure, virtuous. 2 Excellent, eminent. E. सत्, and गुण quality.
सद्धेतु: सद्धेतु m. (-तुः) (In logic,) The co-existence of cause and effect. E. सत् being, हेतु cause.
सद्भाव: सद्भाव m. (-वः) 1 A pure or holy disposition or nature. 2 A good temper. 3 Amiability, kindly feeling. 4 The quality or nature of being, entity. 5 The property of goodness. E. सत्, and भाव quality.
सद्भूत: सद्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) True. E. सत् true, and भूत been.
सद्मन्: सद्मन् n. (-द्म) 1 A house, a dwelling. 2 Water. E. षद to go, aff. मनिन्.
सद्मचिति: सद्मचिति f. (-तिः) A number of houses. E. सद्म, and चिति an assemblage.
सद्यःकृत: सद्यःकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done promptly or quickly. n. (-तं) A name, an appellation. E. सद्यस् instantly, and कृत made.
सद्यःशोथा: सद्यःशोथा f. (-था) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. सद्यस् instantly, and शोथा a swelling.
सद्यस्: सद्यस् ind. Instantly, momentarily, at the moment, in an instant. E. स for सम् the same, and द्यस for अहन् a day.
सद्यस्क: सद्यस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) New, recent. E. सद्यस् in the moment, क्यप् aff.
सद्युवती: सद्युवती f. (-ती) A virtuous maiden. E. सत्, and युवती a young woman.
सद्योजात: सद्योजात m. (-तः) A calf. E. सद्यस् in a moment, and जात born.
सद्योभाविन्: सद्योभाविन् m. (-वी) A calf. E. सद्यस् in a moment, भाविन् being.
सद्रु: सद्रु mfn. (-द्रुः-द्रुः-द्रु) 1 Resting, staying. 2 Going. E. सद to go or sit, रु aff.
सद्वंश: सद्वंश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Of high birth, of a good race. E. सत्, and वंश a race.
सद्वसथ: सद्वसथ m. (-थः) A village. E. सत् good, वस to abide, अथच् aff.
सद्वृत्त: सद्वृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Amiable, well-behaved. 2 Moral, virtuous. 3 Well rounded, handsomely orbicular. n. (-त्तं) Amiableness, good or amiable disposition. E. सत् good, and वृत्त, selected, &c.
सधन: सधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wealthy, rich. E. स with, घन wealth.
सधर्मन्: सधर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) 1 Like, equal, resembling. 2 Of the same sect or caste, performing like duties. 3 Of the same or similar properties. E. स for समान same, घर्म्म merit, practice, and अनिच् aff.
सधर्म्मन्: सधर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) 1 Like, equal, resembling. 2 Of the same sect or caste, performing like duties. 3 Of the same or similar properties. E. स for समान same, घर्म्म merit, practice, and अनिच् aff.
सधर्मचारिणी: सधर्म्मचारिणी f. (-णी) A wife, one married with religious rites. E. स with, (her husband,) घर्म्म duty, चारिणी who proceeds.
सधर्म्मचारिणी: सधर्म्मचारिणी f. (-णी) A wife, one married with religious rites. E. स with, (her husband,) घर्म्म duty, चारिणी who proceeds.
सधर्मिन्: सधर्म्मिन् mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) Observing the same customs or laws. f. (-र्म्मिणी) A wife wedded according to the ritual of the Vedas. E. स same or with, घर्म्म virtue or duty, इनि aff.
सधर्म्मिन्: सधर्म्मिन् mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) Observing the same customs or laws. f. (-र्म्मिणी) A wife wedded according to the ritual of the Vedas. E. स same or with, घर्म्म virtue or duty, इनि aff.
सधवा: सधवा f. (-वा) A wife, whose husband is living. E. स for सह with, घव a husband.
सधि: सधि m. (-धिः) A name of AGNI or fire. E. स with, धा to have, aff. कि.
सधिस्: सधिस् m. (-धिः) An ox, a bull. E. षह to bear, Uṇādi aff. इसि, and ह changed to ध.
सध्र्यञ्च्: सध्र्यञ्च् mfn. (-ध्र्यङ्-ध्रीची-ध्र्यक्) Accompanying, going with, a companion. f. (-ध्रीची) A woman's female friend, a confidante. E. सध्रि substituted for सह with, अञ्च to go, क्विप् aff.
सन: सन mf. (-नः-नी) The flapping of an elephant's ears. m. (-नः) 1 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali. 2 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) f. (-नी) 1 GAURĪ. 2 Light, lustre. E. षन to give, to serve, &c., aff. अच्.
सनक: सनक m. (-कः) 1 One of the companions of VIṢṆU, or four sons of BRAHMĀ, inhabiting the Janaloka. 2 An inspired legislator. E. षन to serve, वुन् aff.
सनत्: सनत् m. (-नत्) BRAHMĀ. ind. Always, perpetually. E. षन to serve or give, aff. अति.
सनत्कुमार: सनत्कुमार m. (-रः) 1 One of the four sons of BRAHMĀ, and eldest of the progenitors of mankind. 2 One of the twelve emperors of India according to the Jainas. E. सनत् always, कुमार a youth: i. e. continent; retaining the purity of that age, or being devoid of human passion; otherwise, सनत् BRAHMĀ, and कुमार son.
सनन्द: सनन्द m. (-न्दः) One of the four sons of BRAHMĀ, inhabiting the Janaloka. E. स with, नन्द pleasure.
सनपर्णी: सनपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) E. सन the Asana or Pentaptera, and पर्ण a leaf; more usually असनपर्णी.
सनस्: सनस् n. (-नः) 1 Excrement, ordure. 2 ŚIVA'S trident(?) 3 Crystal (?) E. षन to give, असुन् aff.
सनसूत्र: सनसूत्र n. (-त्रं) Packthread, or a net made of it. E. see शणसूत्र.
सना: सना ind. Always, eternally, perpetually. E. षण to serve, आच aff.
सनातन: सनातन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 Eternal, continual, perpetual. 2 Firm, fixed, permanent. m. (-नः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 ŚIVA. 3 BRAHMĀ. 4 A guest of the Manes, or one who is to be fed whenever he chooses to attend the obsequial ceremonies or Śrāddhas. f. (-नी) 1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. 2 A name of DURGĀ. 3 SARASVATĪ. E. सना always, and द्यु or द्युल् aff.
सनाथा: सनाथा f. (-था) A woman whose husband is living. E. स for सह with, नाथ a lord or husband.
सनाभि: सनाभि mfn. (-भिः-भिः-भि) 1 Like, resembling. 2 Affectionate. m. (-भिः) 1 A kinsman, one of the same family name: it is considered also the same as the Sapiṇḍa or gentile, a relation as far as the seventh degree, and qualified to offer the funeral cake. 2 A uterine brother. E. स with or same, नाभि navel.
सनामक: सनामक m. (-कः) The Morunga tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
सनि: सनि m. (-निः) 1 Service, worship. 2 Giving, donation. mf. (-निः-नी) Request, solicitation, respectful solicitation as addressed to a spiritual preceptor, &c. 2 Quarter, region, point of the compass. E. षन to honour, to give, इनि Uṇādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.
सनिष्ठीव: सनिष्ठीव n. (-वं) Sputtered speech, utterance interrupted by saliva. E. स for सह, with, निर् before ष्ठीव to eject saliva, घञ् aff., deriv. irr.
सनिष्ठेव: सनिष्ठेव n. (-वं) Speech uttered with emission of saliva or sputtered. E. स with, नि before ष्ठीव to spit, aff. घञ्; also सनिष्ठीव.
सनीड: सनीड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Near, proximate. E. स for समान same, नीड nest or abode.
सन्त: सन्त m. (-न्तः) The hands opened and joined.
सन्तत: सन्तत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eternal, continual. 2 Spread, extended. 3 Continued, continuous. 4 Much, many. n. adv. (-तं) Eternally. E. सम् before तन to spread, aff. क्त.
सन्तताभ्यास: सन्तताभ्यास m. (-सः) The regular study and perusal of the Vedas. E. सन्तत constant, continual, and अभ्यास exercise.
सन्तति: सन्तति f. (-तिः) 1 Race, lineage. 2 A son, a daughter, offspring, progeny. 3 Descent, succession. 4 A continuous line, a row, a range. 5 Extent, expanse, spreading, stretching. E. सम् with, equally, तन to spread, aff. क्तिन्.
सन्तप्त: सन्तप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Suffering pain or distress, distressed, afflicted, wretched. 2 Suffering from extreme heat. 3 Burnt, scorched. 4 Inflamed with passion, &c. E. सम् before तप to heat, aff. क्त.
सन्तमस्: सन्तमस् n. (-मः) Great or universal darkness. E. सम् completely, तमस् gloom.
सन्तमस: सन्तमस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Darkened, clouded. E. सम्, and तमस darkness, अच् added.
सन्तर्जन: सन्तर्ज्जन n. (-नं) Abusing, reproving, scolding. E. सम् before तज्ज to abuse, ल्यट् aff.
सन्तर्ज्जन: सन्तर्ज्जन n. (-नं) Abusing, reproving, scolding. E. सम् before तज्ज to abuse, ल्यट् aff.
सन्तर्जित: सन्तर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abused, scolded, reproved. E. सम before तर्ज्ज to abuse, क्त aff.
सन्तर्ज्जित: सन्तर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abused, scolded, reproved. E. सम before तर्ज्ज to abuse, क्त aff.
सन्तर्पण: सन्तर्पण n. (-णं) Satisfying, satiating, gratifying. E. सम् before तृप to be satisfied, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
सन्तर्पित: सन्तर्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Satisfied, satiated. E. सम् before तृप to be satisfied, causal v., क्त aff.
सन्तान: सन्तान m. (-नः) 1 Family, race, lineage. 2 Offspring, progeny, a son or daughter. 3 One of the trees of heaven. 4 Spreading, expansion. E. सम् before तन to spread, aff. घञ्.
सन्तानक: सन्तानक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What spreads, scatters, &c. m. (-कः) The tree of heaven. f. (-निका) 1 Cream, the coagulum of milk, &c. 2 A cobweb. 3 The blade of a knife or sword. 4 Froth, foam. E. सम् before तन to spread, aff. ण्वुल्.
सन्तानसन्धि: सन्तानसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) Peace cemented by family alliance. E. सन्तान, and सन्धि peace.
सन्ताप: सन्ताप m. (-पः) 1 Heat, burning heat. 2 Affliction, pain, distress. 3 Passion. 4 Repentance. E. सम् completely, तप to heat, aff. घञ्.
सन्तापन: सन्तापन n. (-नं) 1 Burning, scorching. 2 Paining, affliction. 3 Exciting passion. m. (-नः) One of the arrows of KĀMADEVA or love. E. सम् before तप to heat, causal form, युच् or ल्युट् aff.
सन्तापहर: सन्तापहर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Cooling. 2 Consolatory, consoling. E. सन्ताप, and हर what removes.
सन्तापित: सन्तापित mfn. (-तः-तां-तं) 1 Pained, distressed, afflicted. 2 Suffering from heat. 3 Inflamed with passion. E. सम् before तप to burn, causal. v., aff. क्त, and इट् augment.
सन्ताप्य: सन्ताप्य ind. Having caused to be heated. E. सम्, तप to be hot, causal v., ल्यप् aff.
सन्ति: सन्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 End, destruction. 2 Gift, giving. E. षण to give, क्तिच् aff.; also सति and साति.
सन्तुष्ट: सन्तुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Delighted, pleased. E. सम् intensitive prefix, तुष्ट pleased.
सन्तोष: सन्तोष m. (-षः) 1 Joy, pleasure, delight, satisfaction, happiness. 2 Thumb and forefinger. E. सम् intensitive prefix, तुष to be pleased, aff. घञ्.
सन्तोषण: सन्तोषण n. (-नं) 1 Pleasing, propitiating. 2 Comforting. E. सम् before तुष to be pleased, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
सन्तोषित: सन्तोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Consoled, comforted. 2 Gratified. E. सम् before तुष to be pleased, causal, v., क्त aff.
सन्तोष्टव्य: सन्तोष्टव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be pleased, comforted, gratified, &c. सम्, तुष to be pleased, causal v., तव्य aff.
सन्तोष्य: सन्तोष्य ind. Having pleased or gratified. E. सम् before तुष to be pleased, causal v., ल्यप् aff.
सन्त्यक्त: सन्त्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Left, abandoned. E. सम्, and त्यज to leave, क्त aff.
सन्त्यजन: सन्त्यजन n. (-नं) Leaving, abandoning. E. सम्, त्यज to leave, ल्युट aff.
सन्त्रस्त: सन्त्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Frightened, alarmed. E. सम् before त्रस to fear, क्त aff.
सन्त्रास: सन्त्रास m. (-सः) Fear, alarm. E. सम् before त्रस to fear, घञ् aff.
सन्दंश: सन्दंश m. (-शः) A pair of tongs or nippers. E. सम with, दंश biting.
सन्दंशक: सन्दंशक n. (-कं) A pair of tongs. f. (-का) 1 A pair of nippers, or small shears or tongs. 2 A vice. E. सम् before दंश to bite or nip, aff. क्वुन्, fem. form.
सन्दधान: सन्दधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Having, possessing. 2 Being at peace with, making peace. 3 Fixing or placing in or on. E. सम् before धा to have, शानच् aff.
सन्दर्भ: सन्दर्भ m. (-र्भः) 1 Weaving garlands, collecting flowers into a wreath or chaplet, &c. 2 Stringing, collecting, arranging. E. सम् with, together, दृभि to collect, aff. अच्.
सन्दर्शन: सन्दर्शन n. (-नं) 1 Looking, seeing. 2 Shewing. 3 Appearance. E. सम् completely, दर्शन seeing, or सम् before दृश to see, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
सन्दर्शयत्: सन्दर्शयत् mfn. (-न्य-यन्ती-यत्) Shewing, pointing out. E. सम् before दृश to see, causal v., शतृ aff.
सन्दर्शित: सन्दर्शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shewn, pointed out. E. सम् before दृश to see, causal v., क्त aff.
सन्दान: सन्दान n. (-नं) A rope, a cord, (for tying cattle especially.) m. (-नः) The elephant's temples, or part whence the ichorous fluid issues when the animal is in must. E. सम् before दो to cut, aff. ल्युट्; or सम् with, दान the temporal juice.
सन्दानित: सन्दानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, tied. E. सन्दान a rope, इतच् aff.
सन्दानिनी: सन्दानिनी f. (-नी) A cow-house. E. सन्दान a rope for tying cattle, इनि and ङीप् affs.
सन्दामितक: सन्दामितक n. (-कं) A poem of three stanzas.
सन्दाव: सन्दाव m. (-वः) Flight, retreat. E. सम् before दु to go, aff. घञ्.
सन्दिग्ध: सन्दिग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Doubted, questioned, doubtful. 2 Entertaining doubt, uncertain. E. सम् before दिह to augment, aff. क्त.
सन्दिग्धमति: सन्दिग्धमति m. (-तिः) A sceptic, one who is uncertain or doubtful of the results of religious observances, &c. E. सन्दिग्ध doubted, doubting, and मति mind.
सन्दिग्धनिश्चय: सन्दिग्धनिश्चय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Confident in a doubtful matter. E. सन्दिग्ध, and निश्त्रय certainty.
सन्दिग्धलेख्य: सन्दिग्धलेख्य n. (-ख्यं) A writing or document of doubtful meaning or authority. E. सन्दिग्ध, and, लेख्य a writing.
सन्दिग्धार्थ: सन्दिग्धार्थ m. (-र्थः) 1 A disputed debt, either in its amount or existence. 2 Doubtful interpretation or meaning. E. सन्दिग्ध doubted, अर्थ property or meaning.
सन्दित: सन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, tied. E. सम् before दो to cut, aff. क्त.
सन्दिदर्शयिषु: सन्दिदर्शयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to shew. E. सम् before दृश to see, causal v., desid. v., उ aff.
सन्दिशत्: सन्दिशत् mfn. (-शन्-शती-शत्) Informing, telling. E. सम् before दिश to shew, शतृ aff.
सन्दिष्ट: सन्दिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Told, communicated, related as news or information. 2 Promised, agreed, engaged. n. (-ष्टं) News, tidings, information. E. सम् with, दिश to shew, aff. क्त.
सन्दिष्टार्थ: सन्दिष्टार्थ m. (-र्थः) A herald, a pursuivant, a royal messenger who communicated oral instructions or orders. E. सन्दिष्ट communicated, अर्थ meaning.
सन्दिहान: सन्दिहान mfn. (-नः-ना-न) Dubious, uncertain. E. सम् before दिह to collect, aff. शानच्.
सन्दिह्यमान: सन्दिह्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Doubtful, uncertain, obscure. E. सम् before दिह to collect, pass. v., शानच् aff.
सन्दी: सन्दी f. (-न्दी) A small bed or couch. E. सम् before दो to cut, aff. ड, and ङीष् fem. aff.
सन्दृष्ट: सन्दृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Seen, beheld. 2 Foreseen, anticipated. E. सम दृश, to see, क्त aff.
सन्दृश्यमान: सन्दृश्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being seen or looked at. 2 Being foreseen. E. सम् before दृश to see, pass. v., शानच् aff.
सन्देश: सन्देश m. (-शः) News, tidings, information. E. सम् together, दिश to shew, aff. घञ्.
सन्देशवाच्: सन्देशवाच् mf. (-वाक्) Communication of intelligence. E. सन्देश news, and वाच् speech.
सन्देशहर: सन्देशहर m. (-रः) A messenger, an envoy, an ambassador. E. सन्देश tidings, and हर who takes.
सन्देशहारक: सन्देशहारक m. (-कः) A messenger, an envoy, an ambassador. E. सन्देश news, and हारक who conveys.
सन्देह: सन्देह m. (-हः) Doubt, uncertainty. E. सम् before दिह to collect, aff. घञ्.
सन्दोह: सन्दोह m. (-हः) Assemblage, multitude. E. सम् together, दुह to fill, aff. घञ्.
सन्द्राव: सन्द्राव m. (-वः) Flight, retreat. E. सम् with, द्रु to go, to run, aff. घञ्.
सन्ध: सन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) 1 Possessing as an integrant part, intimately blended with. 2 Holding, possessing, having placed in or on. 3 Joined, united. f. (-न्धा) 1 Promise, assent, agreement. 2 State, condition, the steady continuance in any state, steadiness, fixation. 3 Intimate union or association, identification. 4 Twilight. E. सम् together, धा to have or hold, aff. क, or अङ् and टाप् fem. aff.
सन्धातव्य: सन्धातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be united or allied with, to be reconciled, to be connected, &c. E. सम् before धा to have, तव्य aff.
सन्धान: सन्धान n. (-नं) 1 Holding together, uniting, joining. 2 Tying, binding. 3 Peace, alliance. 4 Association, company. 5 Supporting, reception, receiving, sustaining. 6 Mixing, joining, intimate union or combination. 7 A relish, something eaten to excite thirst. 8 Sour rice-gruel. 9 Pickles, &c. acid preparation of the Bel and other fruits. 10 Spirituous liquor. 11 Contracting the skin, &c. by astringent applications. nf. (-नं-नी) Distillation, distilling, the manufacture of spirituous liquors. f. (-नी) A braziery, a foundery, a place where the base metals are stored or wrought. E. सम् together, घा to hold, aff. ल्युट्.
सन्धानकरण: सन्धानकरण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Who or what heals, re-unites, allies, connecting, re-uniting, &c. n. (-णं) 1 Uniting, combining. 2 Healing. 3 Allying, making peace. E. सन्धान, and करण making, the act or instrument.
सन्धानकर्तृ: सन्धानकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Uniting, connecting, healing, &c. E. सन्धान, and कर्त्तृ what makes.
सन्धानकर्त्तृ: सन्धानकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Uniting, connecting, healing, &c. E. सन्धान, and कर्त्तृ what makes.
सन्धानित: सन्धानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bound, tied. 2 Strung together. E. सन्धान holding together, aff. इतच्.
सन्धानिनी: सन्धानिनी f. (-नी) A cow-house. E. सन्धान a binding, इनि and ङीष् aff.
सन्धारण: सन्धारण n. (-णं) Holding, observing, practising. E. सम् before धृ to hold, and ल्युट् aff.
सन्धार्य: सन्धार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be observed or followed. E. सम् before धृ to hold, ण्यत् aff.
सन्धार्य्य: सन्धार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be observed or followed. E. सम् before धृ to hold, ण्यत् aff.
सन्धि: सन्धि m. (-न्धिः) 1 Union, junction, connexion, combination. 2 Peace, making peace, pacification. 3 A hole, a chasm. 4 A hole made in a wall or underneath it to enter a building for hostile or felonious purposes, a breach, a mine, &c. 5 Breaking, dividing. 6 The vulva. 7 A division of a drama, apparently applicable to each subject represented or sentiment excited, as considered severally and detached from the rest, though contributing to the connexion of the whole; contrast of incident, change of situation, transition of passion or emotion, &c. 8 An interval, a pause or rest. 9 A joint, an articulation of the body. 10 The union of letters, either at the end and beginning of different words, or in the middle of compound terms, to avoid dissonance or hiatus. 11 A period at the expiration of each Yuga or age, or one-sixth of its duration, intervening before the commencement of the next; a Sandhi, also, of the same length as the Satya Yug, occurs at the end of each Manvantara, and each Kalpa. 12 (Inmensuration,) The connecting link of a perpendicular. E. सम् together, घा to have or hold, aff. कि of either the act, condition or instrument; whence the word becomes applicable to a chasm, &c. as to an interval, which whilst it divides, also connects, two parts or places.
सन्धिका: सन्धिका f. (-का) Distillation. E. सम् together, घा to have, aff. क, and कन् added, fem. form.
सन्धिचौर: सन्धिचौर m. (-रः) A house-breaker. E. सन्धि a breach, and चौर a thief.
सन्धिजीवक: सन्धिजीवक m. (-कः) One who seeks for wealth by dishonest means, especially as a go-between. E. सन्धि union, (of others,) and जीवक who lives by.
सन्धित: सन्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Tied, bound, strung, fastened together. 2 Allied, united, reconciled. 3 Pickled. (-तं) Pickles and preparations of various fruits. E. सन्धा union, and इतच् aff.
सन्धित्सु: सन्धित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing to be at peace or in alliance with. E. सम् before धा to have, desid. v., उ aff.
सन्धिनी: सन्धिनी f. (-नी). 1 A cow with calf, or one which has taken the bull. 2 One who is milked unseasonably. E. सन्धा joining, इनि aff.
सन्धिबन्धन: सन्धिबन्धन n. (-नं) A tendon, a nerve, a ligament. E. सन्धि a joint, and बन्धन binding.
सन्धिरन्ध्रका: सन्धिरन्ध्रका f. (-का) A hole or breach in a wall. E. सन्धि a breach, रन्ध्र a hole, कन् added, fem. form.
सन्धिला: सन्धिला f. (-ला). 1 A river. 2 Spirituous liquor. 3 A hole in a wall, a breach. 4 A chasm, a pit, a mine. E. सन्धि a hole, &c. लच् aff.
सन्धिविग्रहाधिकार: सन्धिविग्रहाधिकार m. (-रः) War ministry, charge of peace and war. E. सन्धि, विग्रह war, अधिकार office.
सन्धिविग्रहाधिकारिन्: सन्धिविग्रहाधिकारिन् m. (-री) Chief political minister. E. इनि added to the last.
सन्धिविचक्षण: सन्धिविचक्षण m. (-णः) An able negociator. E. सन्धि, and विचक्षण skilled; also similar compounds, as सन्धिकुशल, &c.
सन्धिविद्: सन्धिविद् m. (-वित्) A negociator, a minister. E. सन्धि, and विद् who knows.
सन्धिवेला: सन्धिवेला f. (-ला) A particular period, and one which connects the part of the day or fortnight, as morning, noon, and evening, new moon, the first or thirteenth day of the fortnight, and full moon. E. सन्धि union, and वेला time.
सन्धिहारक: सन्धिहारक m. (-कः) A house-breaker. E. सन्धि a breach, and हारक who carries away.
सन्धुक्षित: सन्धुक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lighted, inflamed, kindled. E. सम् before घुक्ष to kindle, क्त aff.
सन्धेय: सन्धेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be joined, united, &c. 2 To be reconciled or at peace with. 3 To be allied, connected, &c., what or who may or ought to be allied, &c. E. सम् before धा to have यत् aff.
सन्ध्या: सन्ध्या f. (-न्ध्या) 1 Twilight, either morning or evening. 2 The period that elapses between the expiration of one Yuga or age, and the commencement of another. 3 A period of time, forenoon, afternoon, or mid-day. 4 Religious abstraction, meditation, repetition of Mantras, sipping water, &c. to be performed by the three first classes of Hindus, at particular and stated periods in the course of every day, especially at sunrise, sunset, and also, though less essentially, at noon. 5 Reflexion. 6 Promise, assent. 7 Boundary, limit. 8 Joining, union. 9 A flower; according to some the tuberose, to others, the jasmine. 10 Twilight, personified as the daughter of BRAHMĀ, and wife of ŚIVA. 11 The name of a river. E. सन्धि a joint, (of the day,) and यत् aff.
सन्ध्यांश: सन्ध्यांश m. (-शः) 1 Twilight. 2 The period at the end of each Yuga. E. सन्ध्या as above, and अंश portion.
सन्ध्यांशु: सन्ध्यांशु m. (-शुः) Twilight. E. सन्ध्या, and अंशु a ray.
सन्ध्याकाल: सन्ध्याकाल n. (-लं) 1 Twilight. 2 The intervals of a Yuga. E. सन्ध्या, and काल time.
सन्ध्याचल: सन्ध्याचल m. (-लः) The name of a mountain. E. सन्ध्या twilight, and अचल a mountain.
सन्ध्यात्रय: सन्ध्यात्रय n. (-यं) The three periods of the day. E. सन्ध्या, and त्रय triad.
सन्ध्यानाटिन्: सन्ध्यानाटिन् m. (-टी) ŚIVA. E. सन्ध्या evening twilight, and नाटिन् who dances.
सन्ध्याबल: सन्ध्याबल m. (-लः) An imp, a Rākṣasa, a goblin. E. सन्ध्या evening, and बल strength.
सन्ध्याबलि: सन्ध्याबलि m. (-लिः) Any image of NANDĪ, the bull of ŚIVA, either of clay, wood, or stone, placed in a temple of the deity. E. सन्ध्या evening, (when ŚIVA is worshipped,) and बलि an offering.
सन्ध्याभ्र: सन्ध्याभ्र n. (-भ्रं) A sort of red chalk, that called golden. E. सन्ध्या twilight, and अभ्र talc.
सन्ध्याराग: सन्ध्याराग n. (-गं) Redlead. E. सन्ध्या twilight, and राग the colour.
सन्ध्याराम: सन्ध्याराम m. (-मः) BRAHMĀ. E. सन्ध्या the daughter of the deity, of whom he became enamoured, and आङ् before रम to sport, aff. घञ्.
सन्ध्यासमय: सन्ध्यासमय m. (-यः) 1 Evening twilight. 2 The period after each Yuga. E. सन्ध्या, and काल time.
सन्न: सन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Shrunk, diminished. 2 Lost, gone. 3 Still, motionless. 4 Dispirited. n. (-न्नं) A little, a small quantity. E. षद to go, क्त aff.
सन्नक: सन्नक m. (-कः) A tree, commonly Piyāl: see the सन्नकद्रु.
सन्नकण्ठ: सन्नकण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं) Choking, choked, scarce able to articulate. E. सन्न gone, कण्ठ the throat.
सन्नकद्रु: सन्नकद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A tree, commonly Piyāl, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) E. सन्नक said to mean here, sharp, hot, and द्रु a tree; also सन्नक.
सन्नत: सन्नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bent, bowed down. E. सम्, and नत bowed.
सन्नति: सन्नति f. (-तिः) 1 Reverence, obeisance, reverential salutation. 2 Humility. 3 Sound. E. सम् before नम to bow, and क्तिन् aff.
सन्नद्ध: सन्नद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Armed, mailed, accoutred. 2 Arranged, arrayed, prepared for battle. 3 Murderous, felonious, provided with arms for the destruction of others. 4 Wearing amulets, provided with charms, &c. 5 Near, at hand. E. सम् before नह to bind, aff. क्त.
सन्नय: सन्नय m. (-यः) 1 Multitude, number, quantity. 2 Rear, rear-guard. E. सम् together, नी to get or guide, aff. अच्.
सन्नहर्ष: सन्नहर्ष m. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) Destitute of joy, distressed. E. सन्न gone, हर्ष joy.
सन्नाह: सन्नाह m. (-हः) Armour, mail, either of iron or thick quilted cotton. E. सम् before नह to bind, aff. घञ्.
सन्नाह्य: सन्नाह्य m. (-ह्यः) A war elephant. E. सन्नाह armour, यत् aff. of fitness.
सन्निकर्ष: सन्निकर्ष mf. (-र्षः-र्षा) Proximity, nearness. E. सम् together, नि before कृष to attract, aff. अच्, fem. टाप्.
सन्निकर्षण: सन्निकर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Proximity. 2 Approximation, approximating, bringing or approaching near to. E. सम् and नि before कृष to make furrows, aff. ल्युट्.
सन्निकृष्ट: सन्निकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Near, proximate. E. सम्, and नि prefixed to कृष to make furrows, aff. क्त.
सन्निक्षार: सन्निक्षार m. (-रः) The Piyāl tree, (Buchanania latifolia.) E. सम्, and नि before क्षर to ooze, aff. घञ्.
सन्निचय: सन्निचय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Collected. E. सम् with, निचय heap.
सन्निध: सन्निध n. (-धं) Proximity. E. सम्, and नि before धा to have, aff. क.
सन्निधातृ: सन्निधातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Receiving, keeping in deposit or near to, who or what places near to, &c. E. सम्, and नि before धा to have, तृच् aff.
सन्निधान: सन्निधान n. (-नं) 1 Proximity. 2 Appearance, perceptibility. 3 Placing, depositing. 4 Receiving, taking charge of. E. सम्, and नि before धा to have, aff. ल्युट्.
सन्निधाय: सन्निधाय ind. Having placed or placed near at hand. E. सम् and नि before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
सन्निधि: सन्निधि f. (-धिः) 1 Proximity, approximation. 2 Perceptibility, presence, appearance, becoming or being visible or perceptible. 3 Placing. 4 Receiving. E. सम् and नि before धा to have, and कि aff.; also सन्निध and सन्निधान.
सन्निपतित: सन्निपतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Assembled, collected. 2 Mixed, blended. 3 Alighted, descended. 4 Come, arrived. E. सम् and नि before पत to go, aff. क्त.
सन्निपात: सन्निपात m. (-तः) 1 Collection, assemblage, multitude. 2 Union, junction, contact. 3 Mixture, miscellaneous collection. 4 Morbid state of the three humours. 5 Alighting, descending. 6 Arrival. E. सम् and नि before पत to go, aff. घञ्.
सन्निपातक: सन्निपातक m. (-कः) Dangerous illness. E. कन् added to the last.
सन्निबद्ध: सन्निबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound firmly, fast tied or fettered. E. सम् and नि intensitives, बद्ध bound.
सन्निबन्ध: सन्निबन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Binding, tying. 2 Connexion, consequence 3 Effectiveness. E. सम् completely, or सत् good, निबन्ध fastening.
सन्निबन्धन: सन्निबन्धन n. (-नं) Binding or tying fast. E. सम् and नि intensitives, and बन्धन tying.
सन्निभ: सन्निभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Like, similar. E. सम्, and निभ like.
सन्निमग्न: सन्निमग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Immersed, plunged in. 2 Asleep, sleeping. E. सम्, and निमग्न immersed.
सन्निमित्त: सन्निमित्त n. (-त्तं) For a good cause, for the sake of the good. E. सत्, and निमित्त cause.
सन्नियुक्त: सन्नियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Appointed, employed. 2 Attached to, connected with. E. सम् and नि before युज to join, क्त aff.
सन्नियोग: सन्नियोग m. (-गः) 1 Attachment or application to, connection or union with. 2 Deputation, appointment. E. सम् and नि before युज to join, घञ् aff.
सन्निरुद्ध: सन्निरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Stopped, obstructed, checked. E. सम् and नि before रुघ to oppose, क्त aff.
सन्निरोध: सन्निरोध m. (-धः) Hindrance, check, obstruction, suppression. E. सम् and नि before रुघ to hinder, घञ् aff.
सन्निविष्ट: सन्निविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Near, present, at hand. 2 Entered into. 3 Collected, assembled. 4 Neighbouring. E. सम् and नि before विश to enter, aff. क्त.
सन्निवेश: सन्निवेश m. (-शः) 1 An open space, either in a town or its vicinity, where the people take exercise or diversion. 2 Vicinity, proximity, neighbourhood. 3 Fabrication, manufacture, construction, preparation. 4 Putting in, causing to enter. 5 Union, junction. 6 Assemblage, collection. 7 The collective form or figure of an asterism. E. सम् and नि before विश to enter, aff. घञ्.
सन्निवृत्त: सन्निवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Ceasing, forbearing. 2 Stopped, ceased. 3 Returned, coming back. E. सम् and नि before वृत्त to be, क्त aff.
सन्निवृत्ति: सन्निवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Restraint, forbearance, avoiding, forsaking. 2 Returning, coming back. E. सम्, and निवृत्ति desisting, stopping.
सन्निषण्ण: सन्निषण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) Stationary, seated, halted. E. सम् and नि before षद to go, क्त aff.
सन्निहित: सन्निहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Near, proximate, at hand, present. 2 Staying. being. E. सम् together, निहित placed.
सन्निहितापाय: सन्निहितापाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Transient, brief. E. सन्निहित, and अपाय loss.
सन्मान: सन्मान n. (-नं) Respect for the good. E. सत्, and मान respect.
सन्मार्ग: सन्मार्ग m. (-र्गः) Good or virtuous conduct. E. सत्, and मार्ग a way.
सन्न्यसन: सन्न्यसन n. (-नं) 1 Abandonment of the world. 2 Entrusting to. E. सम् and नि before अस to throw, ल्युट् aff.
सन्न्यस्त: सन्न्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Abandoned, deserted. 2 Entrusted or delivered to. E. सम् and नि before अस to throw, क्त aff.
सन्न्यस्य: सन्न्यस्य ind. Having left or abandoned. 2 Having consigned or delivered to. E. सम् and नि before अस to throw, ल्यप् aff.
सन्न्यास: सन्न्यास m. (-सः) 1 Abandonment of all worldly affections and possessions. 2 Abandonment in general. 3 Deposit, trust, or relinquishment to. 5 Sudden death. 6 Indian spikenard. E. सम् and नि before अस to throw, to cast off, and घञ् aff.
सन्न्यासिन्: सन्न्यासिन् m. (-सी) 1 The Brahman of the fourth order, the religious mendicant. 2 An ascetic, a devotee. E. सन्न्यास abandonment of the world, इनि aff.
सपक्ष: सपक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Winged. 2 Having a side or party. m. (-क्षः) A partisan, a follower, an adherent, one of the same side or party. E. स for समान same, and पक्ष party.
सपत्रकृत: सपत्रकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distressed, afflicted. m. (-तः) A wounded deer or other animal. E. स for सह with, पत्र the leaf, the barb of the arrow, and कृत made; also सपत्राकृत, &c. being metaphorically applied to distress or pain in general.
सपत्राकरण: सपत्राकरण n. (-णं) Excessive pain: see the last.
सपत्राकृति: सपत्राकृति f. (-तिः) Agony, affliction, excessive pain or distress: see the last.
सपत्न: सपत्न m. (-त्वः) An enemy, an adversary. f. (-त्वी) A woman whose husband has other wives. E. स for समान the same, पति a husband, ङीष् aff. and नुक् augment, अच् added for the masc. form.
सपत्नारि: सपत्नारि m. (-रिः) A sort of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa.)
सपदि: सपदि ind. 1 Instantly, in a moment, at the moment. 2 Quickly, swiftly. E. सम् before पद to go, इन् aff. and the nasal rejected.
सपर्या: सपर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Worship, reverence. E. सपर Kaṇḍvādi root, said to imply worship, यक् and टाप् affs.
सपर्य्या: सपर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Worship, reverence. E. सपर Kaṇḍvādi root, said to imply worship, यक् and टाप् affs.
सपिण्ड: सपिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kinsman, especially one connected by the offering of the funeral cake to either or all of the manes of the father, grandfather, and great-grandfather, and their wives respectively, as sprung from them in directly collateral lines; the relationship stops with every fourth person, as the fifth cannot perform the offering of a cake to the father even of the deceased. The following are enumerated as Sapiṇḍas; the son, son's son, and son's grandson; widow, daughter and daughter's son; the father, the mother, the brother, brother's son, and brother's grandson; father's daughter's son; father's brother's son and grandson; paternal grandfather's daughter's son; paternal grandfather; paternal grandmother, paternal grandfather's brother, brother's son and grandson; and lastly the great grandfather's daughter's son: these all present oblations in which the deceased is either included, or may participate: other enumerations, including the oblations he was bound to offer, &c. extend the connection of Sapiṇḍa to seven persons both in an ascending or descending line. E. स for समान common, and पिण्ड ball of meat, &c. offered to the manes of the deceased ancestors, at the Śrāddhas performed in honor of them.
सपिण्डीकरण: सपिण्डीकरण n. (-णं) Offering food to the deceased relatives called Sapiṇḍas: see the last. 2 Investing a person with the rights of relationship, indicated by offering the funeral cake. E. सपिण्ड, करण making, च्चि aff.
सपिण्डीकृत: सपिण्डीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Comprehended in the relationship of Sapiṇḍa or offering of a common cake. E. सपिण्ड, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
सपीति: सपीति f. (-तिः) Drinking together. E. स for सह with, and पा to drink, aff. क्तिन्.
सप्तक: सप्तक mfn. (-कः-का or -की-कं) 1 Seven. 2 Seventh. n. (-कं) A collection of seven stanzas of the Ṛg Vedas. f. (-की) A woman's girdle. E. सप्तन् seven, (strings, &c.) कन् and घातु or ङीप् affs.
सप्तजिह्व: सप्तजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) AGNI, or fire. E. सप्त seven, and जिह्वा a tongue or flame.
सप्तज्वाल: सप्तज्वाल m. (-लः) AGNI or fire. E. सप्त seven, ज्वाला a flame.
सप्ततन्तु: सप्ततन्तु m. (-न्तुः) A sacrifice, an offering or oblation. E. सप्त seven, (prayers, or the tongues of AGNI,) तन to spread, aff. तु.
सप्तति: सप्तति f. sing. (-तिः) Seventy. du. (-ती) Two seventies. plu. (-तयः) Many seventies. E. सप्तन् seven, डति aff.
सप्तदश: सप्तदश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Seventeenth. E. सप्त, दशन् seventeen, aff. डट्.
सप्तदशन्: सप्तदशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Seventeen. E. सप्तन seven, and दशन् ten.
सप्तदीधिति: सप्तदीधिति m. (-तिः) AGNI or fire. E. सप्त seven, दीधिति a ray of light.
सप्तधा: सप्तधा ind. In seven ways. E. सप्तन् seven, धा aff.
सप्तधातु: सप्तधातु m. (-तुः) The seven parts of the body, or chyle, blood, flesh, adeps, marrow, bone, and semen. E. सप्त seven, and घातु element.
सप्तन्: सप्तन् mfn. plu. only (सप्त) Seven. E. षप to be collected, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, तुट् augment.
सप्तपर्ण: सप्तपर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Seven-leaved. m. (-र्णः) A tree, (Alstonia scholaris.) n. (-र्णं) A sort of sweetmeat, made of the expressed juice of the grape, pomegranate and date, with sugar, spices, honey, and Ghee. E. सप्त seven, and पर्ण a leaf.
सप्तपुत्त्रसू: सप्तपुत्त्रसू f. (-सूः) The mother of seven children. E. सप्त seven, पुत्त्र a child, and सू mother.
सप्तप्रकृति: सप्तप्रकृति plu. (-तयः) The seven constituent parts of a kingdom, or prince, minister, city, country, treasure, force, and ally or friend. E. सप्त, and प्रकृति constituent.
सप्तभद्र: सप्तभद्र m. (-द्रः) The Sirisha tree, (Acacia Sirisa.) E. सप्त seven, and भद्र auspicious.
सप्तम: सप्तम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Seventh. f. (-मी) The seventh day of the fortnight. E. सप्तन् seven, डतम aff.
सप्तरक्त: सप्तरक्त m. plu. (-क्ताः) The seven external parts of the body of a red colour, or the palms of the hands, the soles of the feet, the corners of the eyes, the tongue, the palate, the lips and nails. E. सप्त seven, and रक्त red or blood.
सप्तरात्र: सप्तरात्र n. (-त्रं) A period of seven nights. E. सप्त, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
सप्तर्षि: सप्तर्षि m. plu. (-र्षयः) The constellation Ursa Major, the seven stars of which are the seven great saints, MARĪCI, ATRI, AṄGIRAS, PULASTYA, PULAHA, KRATU, and VASIṢṬHA. E. सप्त seven, and ऋषि a sage.
सप्तला: सप्तला f. (-ला) 1 Double jasmine, (J. zambac fl. multiplicatis.) 2 A plant, commonly Carmaghās. 3 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 4 A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.) E. सप्त seven, (leaves, &c.) ला to get or have, aff. क.
सप्तसप्ति: सप्तसप्ति m. (-प्तिः) The sun. E. सप्त seven, and सप्ति a horse.
सप्तहस्त: सप्तहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Of seven cubits. 2 Having seven hands, &c. E. सप्त, and हस्त a hand.
सप्तांशुपुङ्गव: सप्तांशुपुङ्गव m. (-वः) The planet SATURN. E. सप्त seven, अंशु a ray of light, पुङ्गव eminent.
सप्ताङ्ग: सप्ताङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Having seven members or parts. E. सप्त, and अङ्ग a part.
सप्तार्चिस्: सप्तार्च्चिस् mfn. (-र्च्चिः) Evil-eyed. m. (-र्च्चिः) 1 AGNI or fire. 2 The planet SATURN. E. सप्त seven, and अर्च्चिस् a flame.
सप्तार्च्चिस्: सप्तार्च्चिस् mfn. (-र्च्चिः) Evil-eyed. m. (-र्च्चिः) 1 AGNI or fire. 2 The planet SATURN. E. सप्त seven, and अर्च्चिस् a flame.
सप्ताश्व: सप्ताश्व m. (-श्वः) The sun. E. सप्त seven, and अश्व a horse.
सप्तास्र: सप्तास्र n. (-स्रं) A heptagon. E. सप्त, and अस्र an angle.
सप्ताह: सप्ताह n. (-हं) A week. E. सप्त, and अह for अहन् a day.
सप्ति: सप्ति m. (-प्तिः) A horse. E. षप to be collected, (in a troop,) ति aff.
सफर: सफर mf. (-रः-री) A small glistening fish, commonly Punthi, a sort of carp, (Cyprinus sophore, HAM.) E. श the initial changed to सः see शफर.
सफल: सफल mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं) Productive, fruitful, bearing fruit, yielding a profit, &c. E. स for सह with, and फल fruit.
सबधूक: सबधूक m. (-कः) A man with his wife. E. स with, बधू a wife, and कन् added.
सबलि: सबलि m. (-लिः) Evening twilight. E. स for सह with, बलि offering of food to evil spirits; the proper hour for such ceremonies.
सबाध: सबाध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 1 Painful, hurtful. 2 Oppressive, extortionary. E. स with, बाधा pain.
सब्रह्मचर्य: सब्रह्मचर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Studying together, being disciples of one teacher. E. स with, ब्रह्मचर्य्य studentship.
सब्रह्मचर्य्य: सब्रह्मचर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Studying together, being disciples of one teacher. E. स with, ब्रह्मचर्य्य studentship.
सब्रह्मचारिन्: सब्रह्मचारिन् m. (-री) A fellow student, one engaged in the same studies and observing the same austerities. E. स for सह with, and ब्रह्मचारिन् the religious student.
सभय: सभय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fearing, fearful. E. स with, भय fear.
सभर्तृका: सभर्त्तृका f. (-का) A woman whose husband is alive. E. स with, भर्त्तृ a husband, कन् and टाप् affs.
सभर्त्तृका: सभर्त्तृका f. (-का) A woman whose husband is alive. E. स with, भर्त्तृ a husband, कन् and टाप् affs.
सभा: सभा f. (-भा) 1 A house. 2 An assembly, a meeting. E. स for सह together, भा to shine, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
सभाज: सभाज r. 10th cl. (सभाजयति) 1 To serve, to gratify by service. 2 To please or satisfy. 3 To see.
सभाजन: सभाजन n. (-नं) Courtesy, politeness, civility in receiving or taking leave of a friend. E. सभाज to please or gratify, aff. ल्युट्.
सभाजित: सभाजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Treated with courtesy, gratified, pleased. E. सभाज to please, क्त aff.
सभापति: सभापति m. (-तिः) 1 The keeper of a gaming house. 2 The president of an assembly. E. सभा an assembly, (of gamblers, &c.) and पति master.
सभावशकर: सभावशकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Influencing or fascinating an assembly. E. सभा, and वशकर what subdues.
सभासद्: सभासद् m. (-सत् or सद्) One of a company, an assistant at an assembly or meeting; (in law,) an assessor. E. सभा an assembly, and सद् who goes.
सभास्तार: सभास्तार m. (-रः) An assistant at an assembly, one of a company. E. सभा an assembly, and स्तृ to cover, aff. अण्.
सभिक: सभिक m. (-कः) The keeper of a gaming house. E. सभा an assembly, ठक् aff; also with the penultimate vowel made long सभीक.
सभीक: सभीक m. (-कः) The keeper of a gaming house: see the last.
सभोचित: सभोचित m. (-तः) A Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman or teacher. E. सभा an assembly, and उचित fit, proper.
सभ्य: सभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) 1 Trusted, confidential, faithful. 2 Relating to an assembly, fit for or suitable to it. m. (-भ्यः) 1 An assistant at an assembly. 2 An assessor. 3 A person of honourable parentage. 4 The keeper of a gaming house. E. सभा an assembly, &c. य aff.
सभ्यतम: सभ्यतम m. (-मः) A distinguished person, one who is an ornament of society. E. सभ्य, and तमप् affix of superl.
सभ्यता: सभ्यता f. (-ता) Politeness, refinement in manners. E. सभ्य, and तल् aff.
सम्: सम् ind. A particle and prefix implying; 1 Union, junction, (with, together.) 2 Assemblage, collection. 3 Beauty or perfection. 4 Intensity. As a prefix it corresponds to con, co, com, &c. Before a consonant the final of this word is changed to Anusvāra, and is written सं.
सम: सम mfn. pron. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 All, whole, entire. (adj.) 2 Like, similar. 3 Good, virtuous. 4 Full, complete. 5 Same, even, equal. 6 Indifferent, impartial. 7 Mean. f. (-मा) A year. n. (-मं) 1 A figure of rhetoric, identity or sameness of objects compared to one another. 2 (In geometry,) A mean; a fourth proportional to the two perpendiculars and the link or segment. E. सम to be confused or unconfused, aff. अच्.
समकन्या: समकन्या f. (-न्या) A girl fit to be married. E. सम complete, कन्या a virgin.
समकाल: समकाल n. (-लं) The same time, the same moment. E. सम, and काल time.
समक्न: समक्न m. (-क्नः-क्ना-क्नं) Going or moving equally, kept equal or together. E. सम् together, अञ्च to go, क्त aff.
समक्ष: समक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Before, in presence or sight of, visible. E. सम् with अक्षि the eye, aff. टच्.
समखात: समखात m. (-तः) An oblong excavation, thence also a parallelopipedon, (in geometry.) E. सम equal, खात dug.
समगन्धक: समगन्धक m. (-कः) Compounded perfume. E. सम same, even, गन्ध smell, कन् aff.
समग्र: समग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) All, entire, whole, full, complete. E. सम the whole, ग्रह to take, ड aff.
समङ्गा: समङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) 1 Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) 2 A sort of fern, (Lycopodium imbricatum.) 3 A sort of sensitive plant. E. सम् together, अगि to go or grow, aff. अच्.
समचित्त: समचित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Indifferent, unattached. 2 Equable, even tempered. E. सम, and चित्त the mind.
समचित्तत्व: समचित्तत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Indifference. 2 Equanimity. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, समचित्तता.
समज: समज m. (-जः) 1 A multitude of beasts. 2 A number of blockheads. n. (-जं) A forest, a wood. E. सम alike, जन to be born, ड aff.
समज्ञा: समज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Fame, reputation. E. सम all, ज्ञा to know, क and टाप् affs.
समज्या: समज्या f. (-ज्या) 1 An assembly, a meeting. 2 Fame, celebrity. E. सम् together, अज to go, क्यप् aff.
समञ्जस: समञ्जस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Proper, right, fit. 2 Exercised, experienced. 3 Correct, accurate, true. 4 Virtuous, good. n. (-सं) Propriety, fitness. E. सम् with, together with, अञ्जसा truly.
समण्ठ: समण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A potherb, a sort of cucumber.
समता: समता f. (-ता) Sameness, similarity, equality. E. सम equal, like, तल् aff.; also समत्व n. (-त्वं).
समतिक्रम: समतिक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Deviating from, transgressing. 2 Going over or beyond. E. सम् and अति before क्रम to go, अच् aff.
समतिक्रान्त: समतिक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Surpassed, exceeded. 2 Gone over or beyond. 3 Transgressed. E. सम्, and अति before क्रम to go, क्त aff.
समतिरिक्त: समतिरिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Much, exceeding, abundant. E. सम् with, and अतिरिक्त much.
समत्रिभुज: समत्रिभुज m. (-जः) An equilateral triangle. E. सम, and त्रिभुज triangle.
समतीत: समतीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Past, gone. E. सम्, and अतीत past.
समत्विष्: समत्विष् mfn. (-त्विट्) Equally bright or lovely. E. सम, and त्विष् light.
समत्सर: समत्सर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Envious, jealous. E. स with, मत्सर envy.
समदर्शिन्: समदर्शिन् m. (-र्शी) Impartial, equally viewing both sides. E. सम, and दर्शिन् who sees.
समदुःख: समदुःख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Sympathizing, feeling for another's woe. E. सम, and दुःख pain.
समधिक: समधिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Exceeding, abundant, plentiful. E. सम् intensitive, and अधिक more.
समधिगमन: समधिगमन n. (-नं) Surpassing, overcoming. E. सम्, and अधि before गम to go, ल्युट् aff.
समधृत: समधृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Equal or equivalent to. E. सम, and धृत held.
समध्व: समध्व mfn. (-ध्वः-ध्वा-ध्वं) Travelling in company. E. सम् same, अध्वन् a road, the final dropped.
समनुज्ञात: समनुज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Assented or agreed to, permitted. allowed. E. सम् and अनु before ज्ञा to know, क्त aff.
समनुज्ञान: समनुज्ञान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Permitted, allowed. n. (-नं) Assent, concurrence, permission. E. सम् and अनु before ज्ञा to know, ल्युट् aff.
समनुव्रत: समनुव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Entirely devoted to. E. सम्, and अनुब्रत devoted to.
समन्त: समन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) All, entire, universal. m. (-न्तः) Limit, term, boundary, end. E. सम् intensitive, अन्त end.
समन्ततस्: समन्ततस् ind. 1 All round, on every side. 2 Wholly, altogether. E. सम with, अन्त end, term, तसिल् aff.
समन्तदुग्धा: समन्तदुग्धा f. (-ग्धा) The milk hedge-plant, (Euphorbia tirucalli, &c.) E. समन्त every way, दुग्ध milk.
समन्तभद्र: समन्तभद्र m. (-द्रः) A Jina or Buddha. E. समन्त every way, and भद्र auspicious.
समन्तभुज्: समन्तभुज् m. (-भुक्) AGNI or fire. E. समन्त universally, भुज what eats or consumes.
समन्तात्: समन्तात् ind. All around, on every side. E. समन्त in the fifth case, used as a particle.
समन्यु: समन्यु mfn. (-न्युः-न्युः-न्यु) Fierce, angry, enraged. m. (-न्युः) ŚIVA. E. स for सह with, मन्यु wrath.
समन्वय: समन्वय m. (-यः) 1 Connected consequence. 2 Natural succession or order. E. सम्, and अन्वय order.
समन्वित: समन्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Possessed of, endowed with, possessing, affected with, full of. E. सम् intensitive or conjunctive, and अन्वित endowed with.
समपाद: समपाद n. (-दं) An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet even. E. सम even, पाद the foot; also read समपद.
समबुद्धि: समबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Philosophical, stoical, looking on all things alike, calm, indifferent. E. सम, and बुद्धि understanding.
समभाव: समभाव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Of like nature or property. m. (-वः) 1 Equability. 2 Sameness. E. सम, and भाव nature.
समभिप्लुत: समभिप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Overwhelmed. E. सम्, and अभि before प्लु to go, क्त aff.
समभिसरण: समभिसरण n. (-णं) 1 Seeking, wishing, endeavouring to gain. 2 Approaching, going to or against. E. सम्, and अभि before सृ to go, ल्युट् aff.
समभिहरण: समभिहरण n. (-णं) Taking, seizing. E. सम्, and अभि before सृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
समभिहार: समभिहार m. (-रः) 1 Repetition, reiteration. 2 Excess, surplus. E. सम् with, अभि before हृ to take, aff. घञ्.
समभूमि: समभूमि f. (-भिः) Even ground. E. सम even, and भूमि ground.
समभ्यर्चन: समभ्यर्च्चन nf. (-नं-ना) Worshipping, reverencing. E. सम्, and अभि before अर्च्च to worship, युच् aff.
समभ्यर्च्चन: समभ्यर्च्चन nf. (-नं-ना) Worshipping, reverencing. E. सम्, and अभि before अर्च्च to worship, युच् aff.
समभ्यर्चित: समभ्यर्च्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Honoured, worshipped. E. सम्, and अभि before अर्च्च to respect, क्त aff.
समभ्यर्च्चित: समभ्यर्च्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Honoured, worshipped. E. सम्, and अभि before अर्च्च to respect, क्त aff.
समम्: समम् ind. With, together with. E. षम् to be confused or unconfused, aff. अच्.
सममय: सममय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Of like origin, proceeding from the same cause, &c. E. सम same, मयट् aff.
सममात्र: सममात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Of the same size or measure. E. सम same, मात्रच् aff.
सममिति: सममिति f. (-तिः) Mean measure. E. सम, and मिति measure.
समय: समय m. (-यः) 1 Time. 2 Oath, affirmation by oath or ordeal. 3 Established moral or ceremonial custom. 4 Demonstrated conclusion. 5 Agreement, covenant, contract, bargain. 6 Engagement, appointment. 7 Order, instruction. 8 Sign, hint, indication. 9 Religious obligation or observance. 10 Leisure, interval, opportunity. 11 Season, fit or proper time for any thing. 12 Speech, declaration. 13 Limit, boundary. 14 End of trouble or distress, (in dramatic action.) E. स for सम with, मी to mete, to measure, aff. अच्, or सम alike, इण् to go, aff. अच्.
समयकार: समयकार m. (-रः) Making an appointment or engagement, fixing a time. E. समय an agreement, and कार making.
समयभेद: समयभेद m. (-दः) Breaking an agreement. E. समय, and भेद breaking.
समयव्यभिचार: समयव्यभिचार m. (-रः) Violating or breaking an agreement. E. समय, and व्यभिचार improper conduct.
समया: समया ind. 1 Near. 2 Within, midst. 3 At such a time, at a fixed or appointed time. 4 Duly, seasonably, in due time or season. E. सम alike, इण् to go, आ Uṇādi aff.
समयाध्युषित: समयाध्युषित n. (-तं) A time at which neither stars nor sun are visible. E. समय time, अधि over, उषित abided.
समर: समर mn. (-रः-रं) War, battle, conflict. E. सम् with, together, ऋ to go, aff. अप्.
समरज्जु: समरज्जु f. (-ज्जुः) Mean string or soundings. E. सम, and रज्जु a string.
समरमूर्द्धन्: समरमूर्द्धन् m. (-र्द्धा) The front or van of battle. E. समर, and मूर्द्धन् front.
समरूप्य: समरूप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Of like or same source or origin. E. सम same, रूप्य aff.
समर्चन: समर्च्चन n. (-नं) Worshipping, adoration. E. सम् before अर्च्च to worship, ल्युट् aff.
समर्च्चन: समर्च्चन n. (-नं) Worshipping, adoration. E. सम् before अर्च्च to worship, ल्युट् aff.
समर्चित: समर्च्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Worshipped, adored, honoured. E. सम् before अर्च्च to worship, क्त aff.
समर्च्चित: समर्च्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Worshipped, adored, honoured. E. सम् before अर्च्च to worship, क्त aff.
समर्ण: समर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Asked, solicited. E. सम्, and अर्द्द to ask, क्त aff.
समर्थ: समर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Strong, powerful. 2 Connected in sense. 3 Fit, proper. 4 Able, adequate to, capable. m. (-र्थः) The construction of words. E. सम् with, अर्थ to ask, aff. अच्, or अर्थ meaning, sense.
समर्थक: समर्थक n. (-कं) Aloe wood, (Amyris agallocha.) E. समर्थ fit, (for perfume,) कन् added.
समर्थता: समर्थता f. (-ता) 1 Strength, power, prowess. 2 Ability, capability, adequacy. 3 Signification of terms. E. तल् aff. of the abstract, added to समर्थ; also समर्थत्व n. (-त्वं)
समर्थन: समर्थन n. (-नं) 1 Deliberation, deciding on the propriety or impropriety of any thing; also समर्थना. 2 Perseverance in an arduous undertaking, attempting difficulties or impossibilities. 3 Reconciling differences, allaying a dispute. 4 Objecting, objection. E. सम् before अर्थ to ask, or request, aff. ल्युट्.
समर्द्धक: समर्द्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Granting a boon. E. सम् before ऋधु to augment, aff. खुल्.
समर्पण: समर्प्पण n. (-णं) Delivering, consigning, presenting. E. सम्, and अर्प्पण delivering.
समर्प्पण: समर्प्पण n. (-णं) Delivering, consigning, presenting. E. सम्, and अर्प्पण delivering.
समर्पणीय: समर्प्पणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be delivered, presented, made over &c. E. सम्, and अर्प्पणीय to be delivered; also समर्प्पयितव्य and समर्प्प्य.
समर्प्पणीय: समर्प्पणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be delivered, presented, made over &c. E. सम्, and अर्प्पणीय to be delivered; also समर्प्पयितव्य and समर्प्प्य.
समर्पित: समर्प्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delivered, made over, consigned. E. सम्, and अर्प्पित delivered.
समर्प्पित: समर्प्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delivered, made over, consigned. E. सम्, and अर्प्पित delivered.
समर्पितवत्: समर्प्पितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Giving or making over, delivering. E. सम्, and अर्प्पितवत् delivering.
समर्प्पितवत्: समर्प्पितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Giving or making over, delivering. E. सम्, and अर्प्पितवत् delivering.
समर्याद: समर्य्याद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Bounded, limited. 3 Correct in conduct. E. स for सह with, मर्य्यादा a limit.
समर्य्याद: समर्य्याद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Bounded, limited. 3 Correct in conduct. E. स for सह with, मर्य्यादा a limit.
समल: समल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Dirty, muddy, filthy. n. (-लं) Fæces, ordure. E. स for सह with, मल dirt.
समवतार: समवतार m. (-रः) A place of pilgrimage, as a sacred stream, &c. E. सम् with, अव below, तृ to cross or pass over, aff. अण्.
समवर्ण: समवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Of the same caste, colour, &c. m. (-र्णः) Community of caste, &c. E. सम, and वर्ण caste.
समवर्तिन्: समवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती) YAMA, the ruler of Tartarus. E. सम all, equal, वृत to be or to select, aff. णिनि.
समवर्त्तिन्: समवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती) YAMA, the ruler of Tartarus. E. सम all, equal, वृत to be or to select, aff. णिनि.
समवनत: समवनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bent, bowed. E. सम्, and अव before णम to bow, aff. क्त.
समवश्यात: समवश्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone away, wasted, destroyed. E. सम्, and अव before श्यै to go, क्त aff.
समवसर्ग्य: समवसर्ग्य mfn. (-र्ग्यः-र्ग्या-र्ग्यं) To be let go or let out. E. सम्, and अव before सृज to loose, ण्यत् aff.
समवाकार: समवाकार m. (-रः) A sort of dramatic entertainment. E. सम्, and अव with आङ्, before कृ to make, aff. घञ्; described, as that in which the chiefs are engaged in mutual conflict or contest.
समवाप्ति: समवाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Obtaining, getting. E. सम्, and अव before आप to get, क्तिन् aff.
समवाय: समवाय m. (-यः) 1 Multitude, assemblage, collection, aggregate, quantity. 2 One of the categories or Padārthas of logic, intimate and constant relation, as of yarn and the cloth made of it. 3 Connection of species in a genus, or parts of a whole. E. सम् and अव before अय to go, aff. घञ्.
समवायसम्बन्ध: समवायसम्बन्ध m. (-न्धः) Inseparable relation, as of properties with substances, material with manufacture, species with genus. E. समवाय, and सम्बन्ध connection.
समवायिन्: समवायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Multitudinous, aggregated. 2 Connected intimately. n. (-यि) Intimate and inseparable cause, as earth of pottery, thread of cloth, &c. E. समवाय, and इनि aff.
समवायिकारण: समवायिकारण n. (-णं) Inseparable cause or relation, as of material with produce, &c. E. समवायिन्, and कारण cause.
समवृत्ति: समवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Moderate, equable. E. सम, and वृत्ति practice.
समवेत: समवेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Mixed, mingled, blended. 2 Collected, assembled. 3 Connected with, related to, as properties with things. 4 Comprised in one genus. E. सम्, and अव before इत gone.
समवेध: समवेध m. (-धः) Mean depth. E. सम, and वेध perforation.
समश्नुवान: समश्नुवान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Spreading over, pervading, extending throughout. E. सम् intensitive, अश to pervade, शातच् aff.
समष्ठिला: समष्ठिला f. (-ला) A sort of potherb, said to grow in watery places; according to some authorities, a kind of cucumber, to others a shrub, called commonly गांडरद्धवी. E. सम together, स्था to stay, इलच् aff. deriv. irr. or सम with, अस्थि a bone, (a seed,) ला to get or have, aff. क, also समष्ठीला.
समसन: समसन n. (-नं) 1 Contracting, contraction. 2 Combination, conjunction, formation of compound terms. E. सम् together, अस to throw or direct, aff. ल्युट्.
समसन्धि: समसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) Alliance or peace on equal terms. E. सम, and सन्धि union.
समसन्धित: समसन्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Allied on equal terms. 2 Bound or connected equally. E. सम, and सन्धित bound.
समसुप्ति: समसुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) The end of the Kalpa, and destruction of the universe E. सम universal, सुप्ति sleep.
समस्त: समस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 All, whole, entire, complete. 2 Compound, compounded. 3 Abridged, contracted. m. (-स्तः) A whole, the aggregate of all the parts. E. सम् together, अस to throw or direct, aff. क्त.
समस्थ: समस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Even, equal, level, uniform. 2 Like, similar. E. सम even, स्थ what abides.
समस्थल: समस्थल nf. (-लं-ली) Level ground. f. (-ली) The Doab, the country between the Ganges and Jumna rivers. E. सम level, स्थल soil.
समस्थलीकृत: समस्थलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Levelled, made level, filled up (as a marsh or river). E. समस्थल, and कृत made, च्चि aff.
समस्य: समस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 To be collected together. 2 To be made entire or complete. f. (-स्या) Part of a stanza, proposed as a trial of skill to be completed. E. सम even or complete, क्यच् affix, and सुक् augment; or सम् together, अस to direct, ण्यत् aff.
समस्यार्था: समस्यार्था f. (-र्था) Part of a stanza to be completed as a trial of skill. E. समस्य to be completed, अर्थ meaning.
समांश: समांश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Entitled to an equal share. m. (-शः) An equal portion, a part. E. सम, and अंश part.
समांशहारिन्: समांशहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Sharing equally, a coheir. E. समांश, and हारिन् who takes.
समांशिन्: समांशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) A coheir entitled to an equal share. E. सम same, अंश part or portion, and इनि aff.
समांसमीना: समांसमीना f. (-ना) A cow bearing a calf every year. E. समा a year, in the second case, repeated, and ख aff.
समाकर्षिन्: समाकर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) Possessing a diffusive fragrance. E. सम, and आङ् before कृषि to go, aff. णिनि.
समाकुल: समाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Agitated, bewildered, confused. E. सम्, and आङ् before कुल to accumulate, क aff.
समाकुलत्व: समाकुलत्व n. (-त्वं) Agitation, anxiety. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, समाकुलता.
समाक्रान्त: समाक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Pervaded, spread. 2 Overcome, surpassed. E. सम्, and आङ् before क्रम to go, aff. क्त.
समाख्या: समाख्या f. (-ख्या) Fame, reputation. E. सम् all, आङ् before ख्या to tell or declare, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
समाख्यात: समाख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Famed, celebrated. 2 Notorious, public. E. सम्, and आङ् before ख्या to say, क्त aff.
समागत: समागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Arrived, approached. 2 Met, encountered. 3 United, joined. E. सम् together, and आगत come.
समागति: समागति f. (-तिः) 1 Arrival, approach. 2 Union, joining. 3 Encountering, meeting. 4 Similar condition or progress. E. सम् with, or सम् same, आङ् before गम to go, aff. क्तिन्.
समागम: समागम m. (-मः) 1 Union, junction. 2 Arrival, approach. 3 Association, acquaintance, intercourse. 4 Encounter, meeting. 5 (In astronomy,) The occultation of a star. E. सम् with, आगम coming.
समाघात: समाघात m. (-तः) 1 War, battle. 2 Striking, beating, killing. E. सम् together, आघात striking.
समाचर: समाचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what observes, practices, proceeds, &c. E. सम् and आङ् before चर to go, ट aff.
समाचरण: समाचरण n. (-णं) Following, practising, observing, proceeding. E. सम्, and आङ् before चर to go, ल्युट् aff.
समाचरत्: समाचरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Following, practising, behaving, proceeding, &c. सम्, and आङ् before चर to go, शतृ aff.
समाचार: समाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Equal or like in virtuous conduct. m. (-रः) 1 Proper practice or conduct. 2 Proceeding, going. 3 Information, tradition, news. E. सम्, and आङ् before चर to go, घञ् aff.
समाच्छन्न: समाच्छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Covered with, involved in. E. सम्, and आच्छन्न covered.
समाज: समाज m. (-जः) 1 A multitude, a number, (of any thing except beasts.) 2 An assembly, a meeting. 3 A convivial meeting, a club. 4 An elephant. E. सम् like, and अज to go, aff. घञ्.
समाज्ञा: समाज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Fame, reputation. E. सम् all, आङ् before ज्ञा to know, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
समादान: समादान n. (-नं) 1 Receiving suitable donations. 2 Taking. 3 The daily observances of the Jaina sect. E. सम् with, आदान taking.
समादाय: समादाय ind. 1 Having taken. 2 Having accepted. E. सम्, and आङ before दा to give, ल्यप् aff.
समादिष्ट: समादिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Enjoined, commanded. E. सम्, and आदिष्ट enjoined.
समादेय: समादेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Acceptable, to be selected or taken. E. सम्, and आङ् before दा to give, यत् aff.
समाधान: समाधान n. (-नं) 1 Religious meditation, restraining the mind from external objects, and fixing it in profound absorption. 2 Promising, declaring. 3 (In the drama,) The leading incident, that which gives rise sometimes unexpectedly to the whole plot. E. सम् intensitive, and आङ् before धा to have or hold, aff. ल्युट्.
समाधाय: समाधाय ind. Having fixed upon, (the mind,) being intent upon. E. सम्, and आङ् before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
समाधि: समाधि f. (-धिः) 1 Deep and devout meditation, restraining the senses and confining the mind to contemplation on the true nature of spirit, &c. 2 A religious vow or obligation. 3 Silence. 4 Promise, assent, engagement. 5 Composing or reconciling differences, putting a stop to a dispute. 6 Requital, return, retaliation. 7 Attempting impossibilities; exertion or perseverance in extreme difficulties. 8 Storing corn on account of a dearth. 9 A Jaina saint of a future age. 10 A figure of rhetoric; connexion or proximity of two events accidentally connected, and expressed by a common verb and the government of the verb by a double nominative, as उत्कण्ठिता च कुस्तटा जगामास्तञ्च भानुमान् the disloyal woman went sorrowfully, and the sun (went) down. 11 Demonstrated conclusion. 12 The joint of the neck. 13 A tomb, a grave. E. सम् together, घा to have or hold, with आङ् prefix, and कि aff.
समाधिमत्: समाधिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Contemplative, engaged in meditation. 2 Making a promise, announcing assent or permission. E. समाधि, and मतुप् aff.
समाधिस्थ: समाधिस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Devoted to meditation. E. समाधि, and स्थ who is.
समाध्मात: समाध्मात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blown or puffed up, inflated. E. सम् and आङ् before ध्मा to blow, क्त aff.
समान: समान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Like, similar. 2 Good, virtuous. 3 One, uniform, same. m. (-नः) 1 One of the vital airs, that which is considered essential to digestion. 2 A corresponding letter of the alphabet, as a long vowel to its short one, &c. E. सम all, अन to breathe, aff. घञ्, or सम् and आङ् before णी to get, aff. अच्.
समानकालीन: समानकालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Occurring or produced at the same period. E. समान same, काल time, ख aff.
समानगोत्र: समानगोत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Of the same lineage or family: see सगोत्र. E. समान, and गोत्र family.
समानजन्मन्: समानजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Of equal age. E. समान, and जन्मन् birth.
समानजाति: समानजाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of a common tribe, sort, &c. E. समान, and जाति sort.
समानजातीय: समानजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of the same caste or species. E. समान, and जातीय of a caste.
समानता: समानता f. (-ता) 1 Sameness, equality, likeness. 2 Community of kind or quality. E. समान, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, aff. समानत्वं.
समानयत: समानयत mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Making equal or like to. 2 Leading, bringing. E. समान used as a verb, or सम् and आङ् before णी to get, शतृ aff.
समानयन: समानयन n. (-नं) Bringing, conducting. E. सम् and आङ् before णी to take, ल्युट् aff.
समानाधिकरण: समानाधिकरण n. (-णं) 1 Common or generick property. 2 A predicament or condition including several things or persons. m. (-णः) A generick character. E. समान, and अधिकरण possession.
समानाधिकार: समानाधिकार m. (-रः) 1 Similar or equal duty, office, or government. 2 Generick character. E. समान, and अधिकार office.
समानित: समानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken, led, conducted. E. सम् and आङ् before णी to take, क्त aff.
समानीय: समानीय ind. Having taken. E. सम् and आङ् before णी to take, ल्यप् aff.
समानोदक: समानोदक m. (-कः) A kinsman, one who when distinct from the Sapiṇḍa is next in order and succession, and is connected by oblations of water only, to the manes of common ancestors; this relationship extends to the fourteenth in descent, i. e. the seven first or Sapin'da's presenting water as well as the cakes, are also Samānodakas, whilst the seven next presenting water alone are Samānodakas only. E. समान common, उदक water.
समानोदर्य: समानोदर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A brother of whole blood. E. समान same, उदर belly, यत् aff.
समानोदर्य्य: समानोदर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A brother of whole blood. E. समान same, उदर belly, यत् aff.
समान्त: समान्त n. (-न्तं) The end of a year. E. समा a year, and अन्त end.
समाप: समाप m. (-पः) Sacrificing, offering oblations to the gods. E. सम् same, आप water; in which libations of water are made.
समापक: समापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Filling, completing, finishing. 2 Killing. E. सम् together, आप to get, aff. ण्वुल्.
समापन: समापन n. (-नं) 1 Conclusion, completion, finish. 2 A section, a chapter, a division. 3 Killing, destroying. 4 Profound meditation. 5 Gain, acquisition. E. सम् with, together with, आप to obtain, aff. ल्युट्.
समापन्न: समापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Finished, done, completed, concluded. 2 Got, gained, obtained. 3 Distressed, afflicted. 4 Killed. 5 Accomplished, perfect, (in any branch of study.) 6 Come, occurred, happened. E. सम् implying completion, &c., आङ् before पद to go, aff. क्त.
समापित: समापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Finished, done, concluded. E. सम् before आप to get, aff. क्त, and इट् inserted.
समाप्त: समाप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Finished, done, concluded, completed. E. सम् before आप to get, aff. क्त, without the augment.
समाप्ति: समाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 End, completion, perfection, conclusion, finish. 2 Reconciling differences, putting an end to disputes, &c. E. सम् implying completion, आप to get or gain, aff. क्तिन्.
समाप्तिक: समाप्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Finite, final, concluding, completing. m. (-कः) 1 One who has completed a course of holy study. 2 A finisher, an ender. E. समाप्त, and ठक् aff.
समाप्त्यर्था: समाप्त्यर्था f. (-र्था) Part of a stanza given as a task or trial of skill to be completed. E. समाप्ति completion, अर्थ sense.
समाप्लुत: समाप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drenched, drowned. E. सम् and आङ् before प्लु to go, क्त aff.
समाय: समाय m. (-यः) A visit, arrival. E. सम् and आङ् before या to go, ड aff.
समायत: समायत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lengthened, extended. E. सम् and आङ् before यम to restrain, क्त aff.
समायात: समायात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Come, arrived. E. सम् and आङ् before या to go, क्त aff.
समायुत: समायुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Joined, connected, attached to or united with. 2 Decorated, adorned. E. सम् and आङ् before युत joined.
समाम्नाय: समाम्नाय m. (-यः) Totality, the aggregate. E. सम् and आङ् before म्ना to remember, घञ् and युक् affs.
समायोग: समायोग m. (-गः) 1 Union, junction, connection, association. 2 Heap, multitude, assemblage. 3 Cause, origin, motive, object. E. सम् and आङ् before युज to join, aff. घञ्.
समारब्ध: समारब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Begun, commenced. E. सम् and आङ् before रभि to begin, क्त aff.
समारम्भ: समारम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Commencement, beginning. 2 Undertaking. E. सम् and आङ् before रभि to commence, घञ् aff.
समारूढ: समारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Ascended, gone up or upon. 2 Mounted. 3 Agreed to, determined. E. सम् and आङ् before रुह to grow, क्त aff.
समारोपण: समारोपण n. (-णं) Placing or fixing in or on. E. सम् and आङ् before रुह to grow, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
समारोपित: समारोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Placed in or upon. E. सम् and आङ् before रुह to grow, causal v., क्त aff.
समारोह: समारोह m. (-हः) 1 Going up, ascending. 2 Mounting, riding upon. 3 Agreeing. E. सम् and आङ् before रुह to rise, घञ् aff.
समार्थिन्: समार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 1 Desirous of equality. 2 Seeking peace. E. सम्, and अर्थिन् who asks.
समालम्बन: समालम्बन n. (-नं) Resting upon, being supported by. E. सम् and आङ् before लवि to depend, घञ् aff.
समालम्भ: समालम्भ m. (-म्भः) Smearing the body with coloured perfumes, as with saffron, sandal, &c. E. सम् and आङ् before लभि to sound, aff. अच्; also with ल्युट् aff. समालम्भन.
समालम्भन: समालम्भन n. (-नं) Smearing the body with coloured fragrant substances: see the last.
समाली: समाली f. (-ली) A collection of flowers, a nosegay, &c. E. स for सम् with, माला a garland, affs. अच् and ङीष्.
समावर्तन: समावर्त्तन n. (-नं) A pupil's return home after finishing his religious studies. E. सम् and आङ् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
समावर्त्तन: समावर्त्तन n. (-नं) A pupil's return home after finishing his religious studies. E. सम् and आङ् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
समावाय: समावाय m. (-यः) 1 A multitude, a number, a heap or quantity. 2 Association. 3 Integral or inseparable aggregation. E. सम् and आङ् implying aggregation, वय to go, aff. घञ्.
समावास: समावास m. (-सः) Residence, abode. E. सम् and आङ् before वस to dwell, घञ् aff.
समावासित: समावासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sojourning, taking up a residence. E. समावास, and इतच् aff.
समाविष्ट: समाविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Entered or engrossed by, absorbed by, (feeling, passion, &c.) possessed by, (as an evil spirit.) 2 Entered, (as a mansion.) E. सम् and आङ् implying entireness, and विष्ट entered.
समावृत: समावृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Surrounded, encompassed. 2 Covered, inclosed. E. सम् and आङ् before वृ to choose, क्त aff.
समावृत्त: समावृत्त m. (-त्तः) A pupil who has completed his studies and taken leave of his preceptor. E. सम् and आङ् before वृत to be, aff. क्त; also with कन् added, समावृत्तक.
समावेद्य: समावेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be announced or communicated. E. सम् and आङ् before विद to know, causal v., यत् aff.
समावेश: समावेश m. (-शः) 1 Affection, passion, emotion. 2 Possession by evil spirits. 3 Entrance. E. सम् and आङ् before विश to enter, घञ् aff.
समावेशित: समावेशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Placed, fixed. 2 Entered, penetrated. 3 Brought in or into. E. सम् and आङ् before विश to enter, causal v., aff. क्त.
समाशङ्कित: समाशङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Doubtful, fearing, apprehensive. E. सम् and आङ before शकि to doubt, क्त aff.
समाश्रय: समाश्रय m. (-यः) 1 Protection, refuge. 2 Seeking protection. E. सम् intensitive, आश्रय asylum.
समाश्रित: समाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Protected, defended, cherished, refuged. E. सम् intensitive, and आश्रित refuged.
समाश्रित्य: समाश्रित्य ind. 1 Depending upon, trusting to. 2 Having engaged in, agreed to, &c. E. सम् and आङ् before श्री to serve, ल्यप् aff.
समाश्वस्त: समाश्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Trusting, confiding in. E. सम् and आङ् before श्वस to breathe, क्त aff.
समाश्वास: समाश्वास m. (-सः) Trust, belief, confidence. E. सम् and आङ् before श्वस to breathe, घञ् aff.
समास्: समास् m. (-माः) A year. E. स for सह with, and मास a month.
समास: समास m. (-सः) 1 Contraction, abridgment, conciseness. 2 Composition of words, formation of compound terms, (in grammar.) 3 Composition of differences, reconciling quarrels. 4 Aggregation, assemblage, collection. 5 Whole. E. सम् together, अस to throw or direct, aff. घञ्.
समासक्त: समासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Joined, united. 2 Reached, attained. 3 Marked, affected by, &c. 4 Combined, comprehended. E. सम् and आङ् before षञ्ज to be in contact with, aff. क्त.
समासक्ति: समासक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Union. 2 Comprehension, inclusion. 3 Affection, attachment. E. सम् and आङ् before षञ्ज to be in contact, क्तिन् aff.
समासज्जत्: समासज्जत् mfn. (-ज्जन्-ज्जन्ती-ज्जत्) Joining, or connecting with. E. सम् and आ before षञ्ज to unite, शतृ aff.
समासज्जन: समासज्जन n. (-नं) Joining, uniting, union, combination, connection, contact. E. सम् and आङ् before षञ्ज to be in contact with, aff. ल्युट्.
समासतस: समासतस ind. Briefly, summarily. E. समास, and तसि aff.
समासन्न: समासन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Obtained, attained. E. सम् and आङ् implying union or contiguity, षद to go, aff. क्त.
समासभावना: समासभावना f. (-ना) Composition by the sum of the products. E. समास, and भावना contemplating.
समासवत्: समासवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Abridged, contracted. 2 Compounded. m. (-वान्) The Tūn tree, (Cedrela Tunna.) E. समास, and मतुप् aff.
समासर्जण: समासर्जण n. (-णं) Delivering, consigning, abandoning. E. सम् and आङ् before सृज to leave, ल्युट् aff.
समासादन: समासादन n. (-नं) Attaining, effecting, accomplishing. E. सम् and आङ् before षद to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
समासादित: समासादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done, effected, attained, obtained, accomplished. E. सम् and आङ् before षद to go, causal v., aff. क्त.
समासाद्य: समासाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Attainable, what may be obtained or effected. ind. Having obtained, &c. E. सम् and आङ् before षद to go, aff. ण्यत् or ल्यप्.
समासाध्याहार: समासाध्याहार m. (-रः) Supplying an ellipsis. E. समास, and अध्याहार the same.
समासार्थ: समासार्थ m. (-र्थः) The sense of a compound. f. (-र्था) Part of a stanza to be completed. E. समास connexion, composition, and अर्थ meaning.
समासीन: समासीन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Sitting, seated. E. सम् before अस to sit, क्त aff.
समासृष्ट: समासृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Left, abandoned, given, made over. E. सम् and आङ् before सृज to leave, क्त aff.
समासेवन: समासेवन n. (-नं) 1 Following, practising. 2 Serving. E. सम् and आङ् before सेव to serve, ल्युट् aff.
समासेवित: समासेवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Followed, practised. 2 Served. E. सम् and आङ् before सेव to serve, क्त aff.
समासोक्ति: समासोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A protracted metaphor, (in rhetoric.) E. समास, and उक्ति saying.
समास्या: समास्या f. (-स्या) Interview, colloquy. E. सम् together, अम to be, ण्यत् aff.
समाहत: समाहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck, wounded. E. सस् and आङ् before हन to strike, क्त aff.
समाहरण: समाहरण n. (-णं) Uniting, combining, collecting, composition. E. सम् together, आङ् before हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्.
समाहार: समाहार m. (-रः) 1 Aggregation, collection, assemblage, either in fact or thought. 2 Contraction, abridgement. 3 Composition of words (in grammar). 4 Conjunction of equal words or sentences, the power of the particle and. 5 A particular form of composition, a subdivision of the class Dvanda, in which several words are joined together, and the compound is a term in the neuter gender, as अहिनकुलं the snake and mungoos. 6 The combination of two letters of the alphabet into a syllable, which designates all the letters intermediate between the two of which it consists. E. सम् together, आङ् before हृ to take or convey, and घञ् aff.
समाहित: समाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised, agreed or assented to. 2 Absorbed in meditation, absent, abstracted or having the senses steadily held in subjection. 3 Concluded, demonstrated, following from what has been said. 4 Composed, reconciled, put an end to, as a contest or dispute. 5 Placed, deposited, delivered. 6 Pure, purified. 7 Finished, completed. 8 Cool, collected, firm. 9 Assembled. n. (-तं) (In rhetoric,) The expression or description of attentiveness. E. सम् and आङ् implying collection or perfection, घा to have or hold, aff. क्त.
समाहृत: समाहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Accepted, received, taken. 2 Collected, assembled, combined. 3 Compiled. E. सम् and आङ् before हृत taken.
समाहृति: समाहृति f. (-तिः) Compilation, abridgement, an abridgement. E. सम् together, आङ्, and हृ to take, to bring, aff. क्तिन्: see समाहार.
समाह्व: समाह्व mf. (-ह्वः-ह्वी) Calling out or to, mutual calling. 2 Acclaim. 2 Defiance. f. (-ह्वा) A plant, commonly Gojiwha. E. सम् and आङ् before ह्वेञ् to call, क aff.
समाह्वय: समाह्वय m. (-यः) 1 A match, a main, the conflict of animals or birds for sport, cockfighting, &c. 2 War, battle. 3 Calling out. E. सम् and आङ् before ह्वेङ् to call, घ aff.
समाह्वान: समाह्वान n. (-नं) Challenge. E. समाह्व to call out, ल्युट् aff.
समिक: समिक n. (-कं) A pike, a dart. E. सम even, ठक् aff.
समित्: समित् f. (-मित्) War, battle. E. सम् together, इ to go, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् final augment.
समिता: समिता f. (-ता) Wheat flour. E. सम् before इ to go, aff. क्त.
समिति: समिति f. (-तिः) 1 War, battle. 2 Assembly, company. 3 Association, meeting, union. 4 Sameness, likeness, equality. E. सम् with, इ to go, aff. क्तिन्.
