समिथ: समिथ m. (-थः) 1 Fire. 2 War, battle. E. सम् together, इन् to go, थक् Uṇādi aff.
समिद्ध: समिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Lighted, kindled, set alight or on fire. E. सम् before इन्ध to kindle, क्त aff.
समिध्: समिध् f. (-मित् or मिट्) Fuel, wood, grass, &c. so employed. E. सम् together, इन्धि to kindle or inflame, क्विप् aff., and the nasal rejected.
समिध: समिध m. (-धः) AGNI or fire. E. सम् and इन्ध to kindle, aff. क.
समिन्धन: समिन्धन n. (-नं) Fuel. E. सम् with, इन्ध to kindle, aff. ल्युट्.
समिन्धान: समिन्धान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Augmenting, prospering. E. सम् before इधि to increase, शानच् aff.
समिर: समिर m. (-रः) Wind, air. E. सम् with, ईर to go, aff. क, and the vowel made short; also समीर.
समीक: समीक n. (-कं) 1 War, battle. 2 A pike, a dart. E. षम to be sad or confused, ईकन् aff.
समीकरण: समीकरण n. (-णं) Equalizing, making equal to. 2 (In arithmetic,) Equation. E. सम, and करण making, च्चि augment.
समीक्रिया: समीक्रिया f. (-या) (In arithmetic,) Equation. E. सम, and क्रिया operation, च्चि augment.
समीकृत: समीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Equalized, made even or equal. 2 Imitated, done in like manner, &c. 3 Added, summed up. 4 Balanced, equipoised. E. सम same, even, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
समीक्ष: समीक्ष n. (-क्षं) The Sāṃkhya system of philosophy. f. (-क्षा) Nature, essential nature, or according to the Sāṃkhya system, crude matter or any of its twenty-four essential parts. 2 Understanding, intellect. 3 Sight, seeing, inspection, looking. 4 Effort. 5 Search, investigation. 6 A book, a work supplementary to the Vedas, treating of the modes of sacrifice. E. सम् before ईक्ष to see, aff. अच् and टाप्.
समीक्षण: समीक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Search, looking for, investigation. 2 Seeing, looking at. E. सम् intensitive prefix, and ईक्षण seeing.
समीक्षित: समीक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seen, looked at. 2 Considered, investigated. E. सम् before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
समीक्ष्यकारिन्: समीक्ष्यकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Acting after due deliberation. E. समीक्ष्य having inspected, कारिन् who does.
समीच: समीच m. (-चः) The ocean. f. (-ची) 1 A deer, a doe. 2 Praise, eulogium. E. सम् before इण to go, Uṇādi aff. चट्, and the vowel made long.
समीचक: समीचक m. (-कः) Copulation. E. कन् added to the last.
समीचीन: समीचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 True. 2 Right, correct. 3 Fit, proper. n. (-नं) Truth. E. सम्यक् true, aff. ख.
समीन: समीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Yearly, annual, relating to a year. 2 Hired for a year. 3 After a year, a year hence, &c. E. समा a year, aff. ख.
समीनिका: समीनिका f. (-का) A cow calving every year. E. समीन a year, कन् aff.
समीप: समीप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Near, contiguous, proximate, at hand. E. सम together, आप water, and ई substituted for आ; analogous to the confluence of water.
समीपग: समीपग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Approaching, going or gone near to. E. समीप, and ग who or what goes.
समीपतस्: समीपतस् ind. Before, near. E. समीप, and तसि aff.
समीपता: समीपता f. (-ता) Proximity, contiguity. E. तल् added to the last; also समीपत्व.
समीभूत: समीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Equalised. 2 Identified. 3 Equipoised. E. सम same, भूत become, च्चि aug.
समीय: समीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of like cause or origin. E. सम same, छ aff.
समीयिवस्: समीयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युषी-वः) Going to, arriving at, attaining. E. सम् before इण् to go, क्वसु aff.
समीर: समीर m. (-रः) Air, wind. E. सम् every way, ईर to go, aff. अच्.
समीरण: समीरण m. (-णः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A plant, commonly Marüa. 3 A traveller. n. (-णं) Throwing. E. सम् completely, ईर to go, aff. ल्युट्.
समीरित: समीरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Tossed, thrown. 2 Gone. 3 Sent. E. सम् before ईर to send, क्त aff.
समीहित: समीहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired. n. (-तं) Wish, desire. E. सम् before ईह to wish, क्त aff.
समुख: समुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Eloquent. E. स with, and मुख a mouth.
समुचित: समुचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fit, right, proper. E. सम् intensitive, and उचित proper.
समुच्चय: समुच्चय m. (-यः) 1 Assemblage, collection, either in thought or fact. 2 Conjunction of words or sentences, the power of the particle and, or also; but it implies the conjunction of different objects of one act or different acts with the same object, as ईश्वरं गुरुञ्च भजस्व worship GOD, and (or also) the Guru. E. सम् and उत् before चि to collect, aff. णच्.
समुच्चर: समुच्चर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what goes about or up, traverses, ascends, flies, &c. E. सम् and उत् before चर to go, अच् aff.
समुच्चरत्: समुच्चरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Going up or about. E. सम् and उट् before चर to go, शतृ aff.
समुच्छेद: समुच्छेद m. (-दः) Destroying, destruction. E. सम् and उत् before छिद to cut, aff. घञ्.
समुच्छ्रय: समुच्छ्रय m. (-यः) 1 Opposition, enmity. 2 Height, elevation. E. सम्, and उट् up, above, and श्रिञ् to serve, aff. णच्.
समुच्छ्राय: समुच्छ्राय m. (-यः) Height, elevation. E. सम् and उट् before श्रि to serve, aff. णच्, and the vowel made long.
समुच्छ्रित: समुच्छ्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) High, elevated, lofty. E. सम् and उट् before श्रि to serve, aff. क्त.
समुच्छ्रिसित: समुच्छ्रिसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sighing. n. (-तं) A sigh. E. सम् and उट् before श्वस to breathe, and क्त aff.
समुच्छ्वास: समुच्छ्वास m. (-सः) Heavy expiration, sighing. E. सम् and उट् before श्वस to breathe, घञ् aff.
समुञ्झित: समुञ्झित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Left, abandoned, quitted, resigned. E. सम् intensitive, and उञ्झित left.
समुत्क्रम: समुत्क्रम m. (-मः) Rise, ascent, going up. E. सम् and उट् up, क्रम going.
समुत्क्रोश: समुत्क्रोश m. (-शः) An osprey. E. सम् intensitive, and उत् before क्रुश to cry, aff. घञ्.
समुत्तरत्: समुत्तरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Crossing, passing over or beyond. E. सम् and उत् before तृ to cross, शतृ aff.
समुत्तेजन: समुत्तेजन n. (-नं) Inflaming, inciting, irritating. E. सम् and उत् before तिज to be sharp, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
समुत्तेजित: समुत्तेजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inflamed, incited, excited, irritated. E. सम् and उत् before तिज to be sharp, causal v., क्त aff.
समुत्थ: समुत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं) 1 Rising, risen, getting or got up. 2 Born, produced. 3 Occasioned, occuring. E. सम् intensitive, उट् up, स्था to stand, क aff.
समुत्थान: समुत्थान n. (-नं) Performance of work, occupation, effort, industry. 2 Positive indication or symptom of disease. 3 Rising, getting up. 4 Common growth or increase, (as of size or wealth, &c.) 5 Healing a wound or sore, cure or recovery from any injury. E. सम् intensitive, उट् up, स्था to stay or be, aff. ल्युट्.
समुत्थित: समुत्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Risen, got up. 2 Increased. 3 Derived or obtained from. 4 Cured, healed. E. सम् and उत् before स्था to stay, क्त aff.
समुत्पतन: समुत्पतन n. (-नं) 1 Going. 2 Ascending. 3 Making effort, energy, exertion. E. सम् and उत् before पत् to go, ल्युट् aff.
समुत्पतित: समुत्पतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone, gone up, ascended. 2 Exerted, vigorous. E. सम् and उत् before पत to go, क्त aff.
समुत्पत्ति: समुत्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Origin, production, birth. 2 Occurrence, incidence. E. सम् and उत् before पद to go, क्तिन् aff.
समुत्पन्न: समुत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Born, produced. 2 Occurring, taking place. E. सम् and उत् before पद to go, क्त aff.
समुत्पाट: समुत्पाट m. (-टः) Detaching, separating from, tearing from, &c. E. सम् and उत् before पट to go, causal v., अच् aff.
समुत्पाटित: समुत्पाटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Detached or severed from, torn from, &c. E. सम् and उत् before पट to go, causal v., क्त aff.
समुत्पादन: समुत्पादन n. (-नं) 1 Producing, fabricating. 2 Effecting. E. सम् and उत् before पद to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
समुत्पादित: समुत्पादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Produced, effected. E. सम् and उत् before पद् to go, causal v., क्त aff.
समुत्पिञ्ज: समुत्पिञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) Excessively confused or confounded, bewildered, lost, overcome. m. (-ञ्जः) An army in great disorder. E. सम् and उत् before पिजि to hurt, aff. अच्; also समुत्पिञ्जल, and simply पिञ्ज, &c.
समुत्सर्ग: समुत्सर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 Leaving, abandoning. 2 Giving. 3 Evacuation of urine or fæces. E. सम् and उत् before सृज to abandon, aff. घञ्.
समुत्सव: समुत्सव m. (-वः) Festivity. E. सम्, उत्सव festival.
समुत्सुक: समुत्सुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sorrowful, regretting, missing or grieving for any one absent, &c. E. सम् intensitive, उत्सुक sorrowful.
समुत्सेध: समुत्सेध m. (-धः) Height, elevation. E. सम् and उत् before षिघ to go, aff. घञ्.
समुदक्त: समुदक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Drawn, raised, lifted or thrown up from a deep place. E. सम् with, and उट् up, अञ्च to go, aff. क्त.
समुदय: समुदय m. (-यः) 1 Multitude, number, heap or quantity. 2 War, battle. 3 Assent, rise. 4 Rising, (as of the sun, &c.) 5 Effort, exertion, perseverance. 6 A day. E. सम् and उट् before इ to go, aff. णच्; also समुदाय.
समुदागम: समुदागम m. (-मः) Knowledge in general. E. सम् and उद् before आगम knowledge.
समुदात्रार: समुदात्रार m. (-रः) Intention, purpose, design, motive. E. सम with, उट् and आङ् before चर to go, aff. घञ्.
समुदाय: समुदाय m. (-यः) 1 War, battle. 2 Multitude, quantity, number, heap. 3 Rise, ascent. 4 The rear or reserve of an army. E. सम् and उट् up, इण् to go, aff. णच्; also समुदय.
समुदाहरण: समुदाहरण n. (-णं) Declaring, uttering. 2 Illustrating. E. सम् and उट् before हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
समुदाहृत: समुदाहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Declared. 2 Illustrated. E. सम् and उट् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
समुदित: समुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Risen, ascended. 2 Risen, (as the sun, &c.) 3 Produced, excited, occasioned. 4 Possessed of. E. सम्, and उदित risen.
समुदीरण: समुदीरण n. (-णं) Repeating, declaring, speaking, reciting. E. सम् and उट् before ईर to send, and ल्युट् aff.
समुदीरित: समुदीरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said, spoken, declared, recited. E. सम् and उट् before ईर, क्त aff.
समुद्ग: समुद्ग mfn. (-द्गः-द्गा-द्गं) 1 Who or what rises or goes up. 2 Who or what pervades entirely. m. (-द्गः) A casket, a covered box. 2 A stanza in which two or more of the Pādas correspond in sound, though in a different sense. E. सम् and उट् before गम to go, aff. ड.
समुद्गक: समुद्गक m. (-कः) 1 A casket, a covered box. 2 A sort of stanza: one, each half of which consists of the very same words but in different acceptations, those of one half being respectively the the attributives or adjectives to those of the other. E. सम् and उट् before गम to go, aff. ड and कन् added.
समुद्गम: समुद्गम m. (-मः) 1 Rising, ascent. 2 Birth, production. E. सम् and उट् before गम to go, aff. अच्.
समुद्गयमक: समुद्गयमक n. (-कं) (In rhetoric,) The repetition of the same words in different pādas of a stanza, but in a different sense. E. समुद्ग what goes completely, यमक alliteration.
समुद्गीर्ण: समुद्गीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Brought up (as food), vomited. 2 Raised or lifted up (from a depth, &c.) 3 Uttered, exclaimed, raised (as a cry, &c.) E. सम् and उट् before गॄ to swallow, or sound, aff. क्त.
समुद्दिष्ट: समुद्दिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Pointed out, shewn. 2 Particularised, enumerated. 3 Explained. E. सम् and उट् before दिश to shew, क्त aff.
समुद्देश: समुद्देश m. (-शः) 1 Describing. 2 Pointing out. 3 Particularising, explaining, enumerating. E. सम् and उट् before दिश to shew, घञ् aff.
समुद्धत: समुद्धत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ill-mannered, behaving ill or improperly, conducting one's self discreditably. 2 Raised or drawn up. 3 Upheld, supported. 4 Arrogant, proud, puffed up with pride, &c. E. सम् and उट् before हन to hurt or kill, aff. क्त.
समुद्धरण: समुद्धरण n. (-णं) 1 Food vomited or thrown up. 2 Drawing up, raising, lifting (as water from a well, &c.) 3 Eradicating a  tree, &c. pulling up by the roots. 4 Extricating, lifting out. 5 Taking out from, as a part or share. E. सम् and उट् before हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्.
समुद्धर्तृ: समुद्धर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Who or what lifts, raises, extricates, &c. m. (-र्त्ता) A redeemer, a deliverer. E. सम् and उट् before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
समुद्धर्त्तृ: समुद्धर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Who or what lifts, raises, extricates, &c. m. (-र्त्ता) A redeemer, a deliverer. E. सम् and उट् before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
समुद्धस्त: समुद्धस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Wiped off by the hand. E. सम्, and उट् before हस्त the hand.
समुद्धृत: समुद्धृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ill-behaved. 2 Thrown up (as food, &c.) 3 Raised or drawn up. 4 Extricated, lifted out or from. 5 Taken as a share, set apart, divided. 6 Seized, possessed of. E. सम् and उट् before धृ to have, or हृ to take, aff. क्त.
समुद्भव: समुद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced. m. (-वः) Production, origin. E. सम् and उट् before भव being.
समुद्भूत: समुद्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Born, produced, derived. E. सम् and उट् before भू to be, क्त aff.
समुद्यत: समुद्यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ready, prepared. E. सम् intensitive, उद्यत active.
समुद्यम: समुद्यम m. (-मः) 1 Commencement, onset. 2 Effort, exertion. E. सम्, and उद्यम effort.
समुद्र: समुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Sealed, stamped. m. (-द्रः) A sea, an ocean. E. सम् before उन्दि to be wet, and रक aff.; or स for सह with, and मुद्रा a seal; also thence signifying a limit, (i. e. bounded by continents,) or a jewel, (the receptacle of gems,) or सम with उद्र an otter; or स with, मुद pleasure, or सम् together, उद water, and रा to give or have, aff. क, &c.
समुद्रकफ: समुद्रकफ m. (-फः) Cuttle fish bone. E. समुद्र the sea, and कफ phlegm.
समुद्रकान्ता: समुद्रकान्ता f. (-न्ता) A river. E. समुद्र the sea, and कान्ता the mistress.
समुद्रग: समुद्रग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Ocean-going, sea-faring. m. (-गः) 1 A trader by sea. 2 A seaman. f. (-गा) A river. E. समुद्र the sea, and ग who goes to.
समुद्रगृह: समुद्रगृह n. (-हं) A sort of pleasure or summer house, built in the midst of water, &c. E. समुद्र the sea, and गृह house.
समुद्रचुलुक: समुद्रचुलुक m. (-कः) The saint, AGASTYA. E. समुद्र the sea, चुलुक a pot; having drank up the ocean.
समुद्रतट: समुद्रतट n. (-टं) The sea coast. E. समुद्र, and तट a bank.
समुद्रतीर: समुद्रतीर n. (-रं) The sea shore. E. समुद्र, and तीर a bank.
समुद्रदयिता: समुद्रदयिता f. (-ता) A river. E. समुद्र the sea, and दयिता beloved.
समुद्रनवनीत: समुद्रनवनीत n. (-तं) The beverage of immortality. 2 The moon. E. समुद्र the ocean, and नवनीत butter: being produced or recovered by the churning of the ocean.
समुद्रफेन: समुद्रफेन m. (-नः) Cuttle fish bone. E. समुद्र the sea, and फेन froth or foam.
समुद्रमेखला: समुद्रमेखला f. (-ला) The earth. E. समुद्र the sea, मेखला a zone; the sea girt; surrounded by the ocean as by a girdle.
समुद्रयान: समुद्रयान n. (-नं) A sea voyage. E. समुद्र, and यान going.
समुद्रयायिन्: समुद्रयायिन् m. (-यी) A sailor, a navigator, a merchant trading by sea. E. समुद्र, and यायिन् who goes.
समुद्ररसना: समुद्ररसना f. (-ना) The earth. E. समुद्र the sea, and रसना a zone.
समुद्रलवण: समुद्रलवण n. (-णं) Sea salt. E. समुद्र the sea, and लवण salt.
समुद्रवह्नि: समुद्रवह्नि m. (-ह्निः) Submarine fire. E. समुद्र the sea, and वह्नि fire.
समुद्रविजय: समुद्रविजय m. (-यः) The father of the Jina or Jaina pontiff of the present era. E. समुद्र the sea, and विजय victor.
समुद्रवेला: समुद्रवेला f. (-ला) A wave of the sea. E. समुद्र, and वेला a wave.
समुद्रान्त: समुद्रान्त n. (-न्तं) 1 The nutmeg. 2 The sea shore. f. (-न्ता) 1 A shrub, (Hedysarum alhagi.) 2 The cotton plant. 3 A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. समुद्र the sea, and अन्त end or boundary.
समुद्राम्बरा: समुद्राम्बरा f. (-रा) The earth. E. समुद्र the sea, and अम्वर vesture; clothed or invested by the ocean.
समुद्रारु: समुद्रारु m. (-रुः) 1 A shark. 2 A large fabulous fish, perhaps intending the whale, hyperbolically described. 3 RĀMA'S bridge. E. समुद्र the sea, ऋ to go, aff. उण्.
समुद्रिय: समुद्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Marine, oceanic, maritime. E. समुद्र the sea, घ aff.
समुद्वह: समुद्वह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Who or what lifts or bears up. 2 Moving up and down. E. सम् and उट् before वह to bear, घञ् aff.
समुद्वहत्: समुद्वहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 1 Lifting or raising up. 2 Moving up and down. E. सम् and उट् before वह to bear, शतृ aff.
समुन्दन: समुन्दन n. (-नं) Wetness, damp, moisture. E. सम् before उन्दि to be moist or wet, aff. ल्युट्.
समुन्न: समुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Wet, moist, moistened. E. सम् before उन्द to be wet, aff. क्त.
समुन्नत: समुन्नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 High, lofty, elevated. 2 Full, prominent. 3 Exalted, dignified. 4 Proud, arrogant. 5 Lifted up, raised. E. सम् and उट् before नम to bow, aff. क्त.
समुन्नति: समुन्नति f. (-तिः) 1 Height, elevation. 2 Consequence, rank, dignity, exaltation. 3 Pride, loftiness. 4 Lifting up. 5 Increase, thriving, prosperity. E. सम् and उट् before नम to bow, aff. क्तिन्.
समुन्नद्ध: समुन्नद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Conceited of learning, thinking one's self learned. 2 Proud, arrogant. 3 Produced, born. 4 Tied up or above. 5 Supreme, lord or master. E. सम् and उट् before णह to tie, aff. क्त.
समुन्नय: समुन्नय m. (-यः) 1 Occurrence, event, advent. 2 Gaining, attaining. E. सम् and उत् before णी to take, अच् aff.
समुन्नयत्: समुन्नयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Attaining, gaining. E. सम् and उट् before णी to get, शतृ aff.
समुपगत: समुपगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Approached, approximated. E. सम्, and उप near, गत gone.
समुपगम: समुपगम m. (-मः) Approach, approximation, contact. E. सम् and उप before गम to go, घञ् aff.
समुपचित: समुपचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Collected, heaped, accumulated. E. सम् and उप before चि to collect, क्त aff.
समुपजोषम्: समुपजोषम् ind. Happily, fortunately. E. सम् and उप before जुष to gratify, aff. अम्; also read उपजोषम् and उपयोषम् or समुपयोषम्.
समुपविष्ट: समुपविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Seated, sat down. E. सम् and उप before विश to enter, क्त aff.
समुपवेश: समुपवेश m. (-शः) Welcoming, entertaining, causing to sit down. E. सम् and उप before विश to enter, causal v., घञ् aff.
समुपवेशित: समुपवेशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Welcomed, made to sit or rest. E. सम् and उप before विश to enter, causal v., क्त aff.
समुपस्था: समुपस्था f. (-स्था) 1 Proximity, approximation. 2 Happening, befalling. E. सम् and उप before ष्ठा to be, अङ् and टाप् affs.; also समुपस्थान and समुपस्थिति.
समुपस्थित: समुपस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Attained, acquired. 2 Brought or come near to, approximated. E. सम् and उप before ष्ठा to stay, क्त aff.
समुपेक्षित: समुपेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld. E. सम् and उप before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
समुपेत: समुपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Come together. E. सम् and उप before इ to go, क्त aff.
समुपेयिवस्: समुपेयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युषी-वत्) Going, proceeding. E. सम् and उप before ई to go, क्वसु aff. of the present participle.
समुपोढ: समुपोढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Suppressed, restrained. E. सम् and उप before वह to bear, क्त aff.
समुल्लसत्: समुल्लसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Sporting, wantoning. 2 Shining, beautiful. E. सम् and उट् before लस to play, शतृ aff. of the present participle.
समुल्लसित: समुल्लसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sportive, sporting. 2 Brilliant, beautiful. E. सम् and उत् before लस to play, क्त aff.
समूढ: समूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Heaped, accumulated, assembled, collected. 2 Crooked, bent. 3 Produced quickly. 4 Accompanying, associated, a companion. 5 Tamed, tranquillized. 6 Married. 7 Purified, cleansed. E. सम् before वह to bear, aff. क्त.
समूर: समूर m. (-रः) A deer. E. षम to be confused, aff. ऊर.
समूरु: समूरु m. (-रुः) A deer, one of the sorts of which the skin may be used as a student's seat, &c. E. षम to be confused, ऊरु aff.; also with कन् added समूरुक. According to some, this sort of deer is distinguished by a white mane.
समूल: समूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having a root, joined or in connexion with the root. E. स with, मूल a root.
समूलघात: समूलघात n. (-तं) Utter destruction or eradication. E. समूल radical, घातं killing.
समूह: समूह m. (-हः) Assemblage, aggregate in general, heap, number, multitude, quantity, &c. E. सम् together, ऊह to reason, or वह to bear, घञ् aff.
समूहकार्य: समूहकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Interests or business of a number, general affair. E. समूह, and कार्य्य affair.
समूहकार्य्य: समूहकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Interests or business of a number, general affair. E. समूह, and कार्य्य affair.
समूहत्: समूहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) Collecting, gathering. E. सम् before वह to bear, aff. शतृ.
समूहनी: समूहनी f. (-नी) A broom. E. समूह heap (of dirt), णी to take, aff. ड and ङीष्.
समूह्य: समूह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be assembled or collected. m. (-ह्यः) 1 Sacrificial fire. 2 A place prepared for the reception of a sacrificial fire. ind. Having collected. E. सम् completely, वह to bear, or ऊह to reason, aff. क्यप् or ल्यप्.
समृद्ध: समृद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Happy, prosperous, thriving. 2 Grown, encreased, augmented. 3 Flourishing. 4 Full, entire. 5 Accelerated. E. सम् completely, ऋद्ध to increase, aff. क्त.
समृद्धवेग: समृद्धवेग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Very swift. E. समृद्ध, and वेग speed.
समृद्धि: समृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Thriving, increase. 2 Prosperity, success. 3 Power, supremacy, sway. E. सम् completely, ऋध to increase, aff. क्तिन्.
समेत: समेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Near, approximated, approached. 2 Agreed, covenanted. 3 Collected, associated. 4 Having, possessed of. E. सम् with, इत gone.
समेधित: समेधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Increased, augmented. E. सम् before एधित increased.
समोदक: समोदक n. (-कं) A mixture of half butter milk and half water E. सम equal, and उदक water.
सम्प: सम्प m. (-म्पः) Descending, falling, alighting. f. (-म्पा) Lightning. E. सम्, and पत to fall, aff. ड.
सम्पत्ति: सम्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Prosperity, success, increase of wealth, power, or happiness. 2 A sort of medicinal root. E. सम् implying perfection, पद to go, aff. क्तिन्; also सम्पट्.
सम्पद्: सम्पद् f. (-पत् or पट्) 1 Success, prosperity, increase of any favourable kind, or of wealth, fame, power, &c. 2 Advancement in good qualities, perfection, excellence. 3 A necklace of pearls, &c. E. सम् before पट् to go, aff. क्विप्.
सम्पद: सम्पद n. (-दं) Standing with the feet even. E. सम् together, and पद a foot.
सम्पद्धर: सम्पद्धर m. (-रः) A king, a prince. E. सम् before पद to go, ष्वरच् Uṇādi aff.
सम्पन्न: सम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Accomplished, completed, effected, obtained. 2 Prosperous, fortunate, thriving, happy. 3 Possessed of, endowed with. 4 Mature, full grown. 5 Perfectly acquainted with or performing, (duty, &c.) E. सम् with, पद to go, aff. क्त; also with कन् aff. सम्पन्नक.
सम्पराय: सम्पराय m. (-यः) 1 Calamity, adversity. 2 Futurity. 3 War, battle. 4 A son. E. सम् and पर before इण् to go, नच् aff.
सम्परायक: सम्परायक n. (-कं) War, battle. E. कन् added to the last.
सम्परायिक: सम्परायिक m. (-कं) War, battle. E. सम्पराय war, ठन् aff.; also सम्परायक.
सम्परिशोषण: सम्परिशोषण n. (-णं) A withering or drying up. E. सम्, and परि implying entirely, शोषण drying.
सम्पर्क: सम्पर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 Mixture, mingling, contact, union, junction. 2 Copulation. E. सम् with, वृच to be in contact, aff. अच्.
सम्पर्किन्: सम्पर्क्किन् mfn. (-र्क्की-र्क्किणी-र्क्कि) 1 Mixed, blended. 2 Connected or united with. 3 In contact with. E. सम् together, पृच् to be in contact, घिनुण् aff.
सम्पर्क्किन्: सम्पर्क्किन् mfn. (-र्क्की-र्क्किणी-र्क्कि) 1 Mixed, blended. 2 Connected or united with. 3 In contact with. E. सम् together, पृच् to be in contact, घिनुण् aff.
सम्पर्कीय: सम्पर्कीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Liable to come in contact, relating to contact or connexion. E. सम्पर्क, and छ aff.
सम्पश्यत्: सम्पश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) Seeing, beholding. E. सम् before दृश to see, शतृ aff.
सम्पाक: सम्पाक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Reasoning, a reasoner, a logician. 2 Impudent, shameless. 3 Small, little, low. 4 Lecherous, libertine. m. (-कः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) E. सम् completely, पाक ripening or maturing; also शम्पाक.
सम्पाट: सम्पाट m. (-टः) 1 A spindle. 2 The intersection of the prolonged side of a triangle by the perpendicular. E. सम् before पट to go, aff. घञ्.
सम्पात: सम्पात m. (-तः) 1 Descending, falling, coming down. 2 Alighting, (as a bird.) 3 Going, moving. 4 The son of GARUḌA. E. सम् before पत to alight, aff. घञ्.
सम्पाति: सम्पाति m. (-तिः) The son of GARUḌA, a fabulous bird. E. सम्, पा intensitive, to cherish or drink, अति Uṇādi aff.
सम्पातिक: सम्पातिक m. (-कः) The eldest son of GARUḌA, and like him a sort of fabulous and supernatural bird. E. कन् added to the last.
सम्पादक: सम्पादक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what fulfils, accomplished, &c. E. सम् before पद to go, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
सम्पादन: सम्पादन n. (-नं) 1 Gaining, acquiring, reaching, attaining. 2 Accomplishing, effecting. E. सम् before पद to go, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
सम्पादित: सम्पादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Attained, obtained, gained, gotten. 2 Effected, accomplished. E. सम् before पद to go, causal form, aff. क्त.
सम्पिष्ट: सम्पिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pounded, bruised, crushed, destroyed. E. सम्, and पिष्ट ground.
सम्पीड: सम्पीड m. (-डः) 1 Agitating, disturbing. 2 Sending, directing. 3 Pain, torture. E. सम् before पीड to give pain to, &c., aff. अच्.
सम्पीडन: सम्पीडन n. (-नं) 1 Castigation, punishment. 2 Agitating. 3 Sending. 4 Pressing, squeezing. E. सम् before पीड to give pain, ल्युट् aff.
सम्पीडित: सम्पीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pained, tortured. 2 Punished. 3 Agitated. 4 Sent. 5 Pressed, squeezed. E. सम् before पीड to pain, क्त aff.
सम्पीति: सम्पीति f. (-तिः) Drinking in company. E. सम् together, पा to drink, क्तिन् aff.
सम्पुट: सम्पुट m. (-टः) 1 A casket, a covered box. 2 A flower; also Kuruvaka. E. सम् together, पुट to contract, aff. क.
सम्पुटक: सम्पुटक m. (-कः) A casket. E. सम् with पुट to contract, aff. क, and कन् added.
सम्पूजन: सम्पूजन n. (-नं) Treating with great respect. E. सम्, and पूज to worship, ल्युट् aff.
सम्पूजनीय: सम्पूजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be, what may or ought to be respected, &c. E. सम्, and पूज to respect, अनीयर् aff.; also सम्पूजितव्य and सम्पूज्य.
सम्पूजित: सम्पूजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Honoured, respected. E. सम्, and पूजित worshipped.
सम्पूर्ण: सम्पूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Whole, entire. 2 Complete, finished. m. (-र्णः) Any mode of music in which all the notes of the gamut are employed. n. (-र्णं) Æther, the etherial matter or atmosphere. E. सम् intensitive, and पूर्ण full, finished.
सम्पूर्णता: सम्पूर्णता f. (-ता) Fulness, completion. E. सम्पूर्ण, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, सम्पूर्णत्वं.
सम्पृक्त: सम्पृक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Mixed, blended, combined, inlaid, interspersed. 2 Joined, untied. 3 Close to, in contact with. E. सम् together, पृच to be in contact, aff. क्त.
सम्प्रकॢप्त: सम्प्रकॢप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Possessed of, having. E. सम् and प्र before कॢप्त made.
सम्प्रणर्दित: सम्प्रणर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bellowed. E. सम् and प्र before नर्द्द to sound, क्त aff.
सम्प्रणर्द्दित: सम्प्रणर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bellowed. E. सम् and प्र before नर्द्द to sound, क्त aff.
सम्प्रणीत: सम्प्रणीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Brought, conveyed. E. सम् and प्र before णी to take, क्त aff.
सम्प्रणेतृ: सम्प्रणेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what guides, leads, &c. m. (-ता) A judge, a ruler. E. सम् and प्र before णी to get, तृच् aff.
सम्प्रतापन: सम्प्रतापन n. (-नं) 1 Heating, burning. 2 Afflicting. 3 One of the twenty-one hells. E. सम् and प्र before तप to heat, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
सम्प्रति: सम्प्रति ind. Now, at present, at this time. m. (-तिः) A Jina or Jaina pontiff, of the last era. E. सम्, and प्रति with respect to, &c. conjoined.
सम्प्रतिपत्ति: सम्प्रतिपत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Agreed, convened, consentient. f. (-त्तिः) 1 Assent, concurrence. 2 Admission, acknowledgment, confession. 3 Agreement. 4 Co-operation. 5 Presence, company. 6 Assault. 7 Doing, performing, effecting. E. सम् together, प्रतिपत्ति agreement, assent.
सम्प्रतिपन्न: सम्प्रतिपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Done, performed. 2 Come, arrived. 3 Agreed, concurred. 4 Attached. E. सम् and प्रति before पद to go, क्त aff.
सम्प्रतिरोधक: सम्प्रतिरोधक n. (-कः) Durance, actual confinement or restraint. E. सम्प्रति present, रोधक what restricts.
सम्प्रतीक्षा: सम्प्रतीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Expecting, awaiting. E. सम् and प्रति before ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् aff.
सम्प्रतीति: सम्प्रतीति f. (-तिः) Fame, notoriety. E. सम् before प्रतीति the same.
सम्प्रदान: सम्प्रदान n. (-नं) 1 Gift, donation. 2 (In grammar,) The dative case. E. सम् and प्र before दा to give, ल्युट् aff.
सम्प्रदाय: सम्प्रदाय m. (-यः) 1 Traditional doctrine, what has been transmitted from one teacher to another, and is established as of sacred authority. 2 A sect, a schism, a peculiar doctrine and exclusive worship of one divinity. E. सम् and प्र before दा to give, घञ् aff., and युक् augment.
सम्प्रधान: सम्प्रधान n. (-नं) Consideration, ascertainment. E. सम् and प्र before धा to have, ल्युट् aff.
सम्प्रधारणा: सम्प्रधारणा nf. (-णं-णा) Determination, deliberation, the determining on the propriety or impropriety of any thing. E. सम् and प्र before धृ to have or hold, causal form, aff. युच्.
सम्प्रपद: सम्प्रपद n. (-दं) Roaming, peregrination. E. सम् and प्र before पद to go, aff. अच्.
सम्प्रयाण: सम्प्रयाण n. (-णं) Departure. E. सम् and प्र before या to go, ल्युट् aff.
सम्प्रयुक्त: सम्प्रयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Acquainted or connected with. 2 Joined, united with, &c. E. सम् and प्र before युज to join, क्त aff.
सम्प्रयोग: सम्प्रयोग m. (-गः) 1 Connexion, relation, mutual proportion, dependance or association. 2 Order, natural and connected series or arrangement. 3 Copulation. 4 Union, joining. 5 Magic. E. सम् and प्र before युज to join, aff. घञ्.
सम्प्रयोगिन्: सम्प्रयोगिन् m. (गी) 1 A libertine, a lecher. 2 A catamite. 3 A joiner or uniter, any one who effects a union or connexion. 4 A conjuror. E. सम्प्रयोग union in general, or coition, aff. इनि.
सम्प्रवदन: सम्प्रवदन n. (-नं) Conversation, talking together. E. सम् and प्र before वद to speak, ल्युट् aff.
सम्प्रश्न: सम्प्रश्न m. (-श्नः) Asking, enquiring civilly. E. सम्, and प्रश्न asking.
सम्प्रवृत्त: सम्प्रवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Passed, gone by. E. सम् and प्र before वृत्त been.
सम्प्रसाद: सम्प्रसाद n. (-दं) Trust, confidence. E. सम् and प्र before सद to go, घञ् aff.
सम्प्रसाधन: सम्प्रसाधन n. (-नं) Effecting, accomplishing, performing well or completely. E. सम् and प्र before साध to accomplish, ल्युट् aff.
सम्प्रसारण: सम्प्रसारण n. (-णं) The mutual substitution of the letters इ, उ, ऋ, ऌ, and their respective semivowels, ब, य, र, and स्न. E. सम् and प्र before सृ to go, causal form, aff. ल्यट्.
सम्प्रस्थान: सम्प्रस्थान n. (-नं) Setting out on a journey. E. सम् and प्र before स्था to stay, ल्युट् aff.
सम्प्रस्थित: सम्प्रस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Set forth, gone on a journey. E. सम् and प्र before स्था to stay, क्त aff.
सम्प्रहार: सम्प्रहार m. (-रः) 1 War, battle. 2 Striking, wounding, killing. 3 Going, motion. E. सम् and प्र before हृ to take, aff. घञ्.
सम्प्रहास: सम्प्रहास n. (-सं) 1 Laughter. 2 Joy. E. सम् and प्र before हस to laugh, घञ् aff.
सम्प्राप्त: सम्प्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Attained, obtained, gotten. 2 Effected, accomplished. 3 Become. 4 Arrived, come. E. सम् and प्राप्त obtained.
सम्प्राप्ति: सम्प्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Obtaining, getting, acquisition. E. सम् before प्राप्ति obtaining.
सम्प्रीत: सम्प्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well pleased, delighted. E. सम्, and प्रीत liking.
सम्प्रीति: सम्प्रीति f. (-तिः) 1 Attachment, affection. 2 Delight. E. सम् before प्रीति affection.
सम्प्रेक्षण: सम्प्रेक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Deliberating, considering, investigating. 2 Looking at, seeing. E. सम् and प्र before ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.
सम्प्रेक्षित: सम्प्रेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Considered, investigated. 2 Seen, beheld. E. सम् and प्र before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
सम्प्रेषित: सम्प्रेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sent, ordered. 2 Dismissed, sent away. E. सम् before प्रेषित sent.
सम्प्रैष: सम्प्रैष m. (-षः) 1 Ordering, commanding, directing. 2 Dismissing, sending away. E. सम् and प्र before इष to go, aff. घञ्.
सम्प्रोक्षण: सम्प्रोक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Sprinkling. 2 Consecrating a temple. E. सम and प्र before उक्ष to sprinkle, ल्युट् aff.; see प्रोक्षण.
सम्प्रोक्षित: सम्प्रोक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sprinkled, wetted, (especially with holy water.) 2 Consecrated. E. सम् and प्र before उक्ष to sprinkle, क्त aff.
सम्प्लव: सम्प्लव m. (-वः) 1 Falling in various directions. 2 Submerging, inundation. E. सम्, and प्लु to go, अच् aff.
सम्फाल: सम्फाल m. (-लः) A ram. E. सम् before फल to bear fruit, aff. ण.
सम्फुल्ल: सम्फुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Blown, blossomed, opened, (as a flower.) E. सम् completely, and फुल्ल blown.
सम्फेट: सम्फेट m. (-टः) (In dramatic language) Wrathful encounter, defiance, combat.
सम्ब: सम्ब r. 1st cl. (सम्बति) To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (सम्बयति) To unite, to join, to connect or collect; also षम्ब.
सम्ब n. (-म्बं) 1 Water. 2 Twice ploughing. E. सम्ब to go, aff. अच्.
सम्बद्ध: सम्बद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Connected with, endowed with, possessing as a predicate or property. 2 Bound, tied, attached. E. सम् with, बन्ध to bind, aff. क्त.
सम्बन्ध: सम्बन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) 1 Able, capable. 2 Fit, right, proper. 3 Adjunct, annexed or connected, inherent, &c. m. (-न्धः) 1 Prosperity, success. 2 Fitness, propriety. 3 Connexion, natural or essential connexion, as of a property with a substance, subject matter with a work, proper meaning with a word, &c. 4 Connexion by birth or marriage, relationship. 5 The application of authority, as of the Upaniṣads to prove a theological assertion, &c. 6 Mental association of objects, conceiving them in connexion with each other. 7 (In grammar,) The possessive case. E. सम् with, and बन्ध a binding.
सम्बन्धक: सम्बन्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Relating to, concerning. E. कन् added to the last.
सम्बन्धिन्: सम्बन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) 1 Possessing good qualities, learned, amiable, liberal, &c. 2 Having adjoined or connected with, inherent. 3 Related to, a relation, a connexion. 4 Connected with, belonging or relating to. E. सम्बन्ध connexion, and इनि aff.
सम्बर: सम्बर n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Restraint, forbearance, self-controul. 3 A religious observance of the Bauddhas. m. (-रः) 1 The name of a demon or Daitya. 2 A deer. 3 A sort of fish. 4 A mountain. 5 A Jina, one of the pontiffs of the future age. 6 A kind of dramatic entertainment. 7 A bridge, a dam, a causeway. f. (-री) 1 A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) 2 A medicinal plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. सम्ब to accumulate, अरच् aff.; also शम्बर and सम्बर.
सम्बल: सम्बल mn. (-लः-लं) Provender or stock for travelling expences. n. (-लं) Water. E. षम्ब to go, aff. अलच्; also शम्बल.
सम्बाकृत: सम्बाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Twice ploughed. E. सम्ब a second ploughing, कृत made, डाच् augment; also शम्बाकृत.
सम्बाध: सम्बाध adj. m. only, but having the three genders when the last term of a compound adjective. (-धः) 1 Narrow, contracted, impassible, either from being naturally confined, or from being blocked up or crowded. 2 Crowded. Subst. 1 The vulva. 2 The road to tartarus or hell. 3 Fear, dread. E. सम् before बाध to impede, aff. अच्.
सम्बाधक: सम्बाधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Crowding, contracting, pressing upon. E. सम् before बाध to obstruct, ण्वुल् aff.
सम्बाधन: सम्बाधन n. (-नं) 1 A gate, a barrier. 2 The point of a stake or spit. 3 A door-keeper. 4 Obstructing, opposing. E. सम् before बाध to impede, aff. ल्युट्.
सम्बुद्ध: सम्बुद्ध m. (-द्धः) A Jaina deified sage. E. सम् implying perfection, and बुद्ध wise.
सम्बुद्धि: सम्बुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Calling or calling to. 2 An epithet. 3 The vocative case. E. सम् with बुध to know, aff. क्तिन्.
सम्बोध: सम्बोध m. (-धः) 1 Explaining, instructing, informing. 2 Throwing, sending. 3 Loss, destruction. E. सम् completely, बुध to know, causal form, aff. अच्.
सम्बोधन: सम्बोधन n. (-नं) 1 Calling, addressing, calling to. 2 The vocative case, (in grammar.) E. सम्, and बुध to know, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
सम्भली: सम्भली f. (-ली) A bawd, a procuress. E. सम् with, भल to speak, affs. अच् and ङीष्; also शम्भली.
सम्भव: सम्भव m. (-वः) 1 Cause, origin, motive. 2 Birth, production. 3 Mixing, union, combination. 4 Capacity, appropriateness, adaptation, the conformity of the receptacle to the thing received, or supported to the thing supported. 5 Agreement, engagement. 6 Loss, destruction. 7 Acquaintance, intimacy. 8 Possibility. 9 Ability, adequacy. 10 Consistency, compatibility. 11 The third Jina of the present age. E. सम् implying perfection or co-existence, and भव being.
सम्भव्य: सम्भव्य m. (-व्यः) The wood-apple, (Feronia elephantium.) E. सम् with, भव being, यत् aff.
सम्भार: सम्भार m. (-रः) 1 Multitude, number, quantity, heap, assemblage. 2 Maintaining, supporting. 3 Provision, preparation, getting  every thing ready or complete. 4 Fulness, completion. 5 Apparatus, necessaries, things required for any act or affair. E. सम् before भृ to maintain, aff. घञ्.
सम्भार्य: सम्भार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be nourished, a dependant. E. सम्, and भॄ to nourish, ण्यत् aff.
सम्भार्य्य: सम्भार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be nourished, a dependant. E. सम्, and भॄ to nourish, ण्यत् aff.
सम्भावन: सम्भावन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Considering, reflecting. 2 Fame, celebrity. 3 Fitness, suitableness. 4 Adequacy, competency, ability. 5 Possibility. 5 Worship, honour. 7 (In grammar,) The sense of the potential mood. 8 (In rhetoric,) The use of the verb in the imperative or potential mood. 9 (In Logic,) Doubt. E. सम् before भू to be, causal form, aff. युच्.
सम्भावित: सम्भावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Equal or adequate to, suited to or fit for. 2 Possible. 3 Considered, reflected. 4 Satisfied or occupied with. E. सम् with, भू to be, &c., causal form, aff. क्त.
सम्भावितात्मन्: सम्भावितात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Noble-minded. E. सम्भावित equal, आत्मन् self.
सम्भाव्य: सम्भाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Suitable, to be adapted to, made, or fit for. E. सम्, and भू to be, causal v., यत् aff. also सम्भावनीय, &c.
सम्भाषण: सम्भाषण n. (-णं) 1 Conversation, discourse. 2 War-cry, watchword. E. सम् together, भाषण speaking.
सम्भाषा: सम्भाषा f. (-षा) 1 War-cry, watch-word. 2 Conversation, discourse. 3 Contract, agreement. E. सम् together, भाषा speech.
सम्भाषित: सम्भाषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said, spoken. 2 Spoken to, addressed. E. सम् before भाष to speak, क्त aff.
सम्भिन्न: सम्भिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Shaken, agitated. 2 Divided, broken. 3 Combined or united with. E. सम्, and भिन्न broken.
सम्भु: सम्भु m. (-म्भुः) A parent, a progenitor. E. सम् with भू to be, डु aff.
सम्भुग्न: सम्भुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Bent, curved. E. सम्, and भुग्न bent.
सम्भूत: सम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Equal, adequate. 3 Combined with, being together. E. सम् with, भू to be, aff. क्त.
सम्भूतविजय: सम्भूतविजय m. (-यः) A sacred person peculiar to the Jainas.
सम्भूति: सम्भूति f. (-तिः) 1 Birth, production. 2 Combination. 3 Power. E. सम्, and भू to be, क्तिन् aff.
सम्भूय: सम्भूय ind. Having united or combined. E. सम् together, भू to be, ल्यप् aff.
सम्भूयकारिन्: सम्भूयकारिन् m. (-री) A coadjutor, copartner, or colleague. E. सम्भूय, and कारिन् who acts.
सम्भूयसमुत्थान: सम्भूयसमुत्थान n. (-नं) Partnership, association in trade, joint execution of work or conduct of business. E. सम्भूय, and समुत्थान performance of work.
सम्भृत: सम्भृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Collected, assembled. 2 Gained, got, possessed of. 3 Filled, full. 4 Complete, ready, prepared. 5 Nourished, maintained. E. सम् before भृ to nourish, &c. aff. क्त.
सम्भृति: सम्भृति f. (-तिः) 1 Nourishment, support. 2 Plenitude, fulness. 3 Preparation, provision. E. सम्, and भृ to possess, aff. क्तिन्, see the last.
सम्भृत्य: सम्भृत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) To be nourished. E. सम्, and भृ to nourish, aff. क्यप्.
सम्भेट्: सम्भेट् m. (-टः) 1 The confluence of two rivers, or the junction of a river with the sea. 2 Breaking, splitting, bursting. 3 Union, junction. E. सम् with, भिट् to break, aff. घञ्.
सम्भोग: सम्भोग m. (-गः) 1 Enjoyment, pleasure, delight. 2 Coition, copulation. 3 A Jaina or Bauddha Śasana or edict, &c. 4 One branch of the Śṛṅgāra rasa, or sentiment of love, happy or successful love, meeting or union of lovers. 5 A catamite. 6 Use, employment. E. सम् with, भोग enjoyment.
सम्भोगिन्: सम्भोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) 1 Sensual, sensualist, &c. 2 Enjoying, as pleasure or property. m. (-गी) A catamite. E. सम्भोग enjoyment, इनि aff.
सम्भोजन: सम्भोजन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Convivial, friendly, (as a dinner, &c.) n. (-नं) A meal, &c. partaken together, a convivial party. E. सम् together, भुज to enjoy, ल्युट् aff.
सम्भ्रम: सम्भ्रम m. (-मः) 1 Haste, hurry. 2 Fear, terror. 3 Flurry, confusion, haste or hurry arising from joy, fear, &c. 4 Error, ignorance. 5 Turning round, whirling, revolving. 6 Respect, reverence. E. सम् before भ्रम to revolve, &c., aff. अच्.
सम्भ्रान्त: सम्भ्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Bewildered, agitated. 2 Flurried. E. सम्, and भ्रम to err, क्त aff.
सम्मत: सम्मत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Assented or agreed to, concurred in, approved of. 2 Conformable to. 3 Attached to. E. सम्, and मन to mind, क्त aff.
सम्मति: सम्मति f. (-तिः) 1 Wish, desire. 2 Order, command. 3 Agreement, assent, similarity of opinion, or purpose. 4 Approbation. 5 Self or real knowledge. 6 Regard, affection, love. 7 Respect, homage. E. सम् implying union or perfection, and मति mind, understanding.
सम्मद: सम्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Happy, glad. m. (-दः) Happiness, joy, pleasure. E. सम् with, मट् to delight, aff. अप्.
सम्मर्द: सम्मर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Trampling or treading on. 2 Friction, rubbing. 3 War, battle. E. सम् together, मृद् to trample, aff. अच्.
सम्मर्द्द: सम्मर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Trampling or treading on. 2 Friction, rubbing. 3 War, battle. E. सम् together, मृद् to trample, aff. अच्.
सम्मर्दिन्: सम्मर्द्दिन् mfn. (-र्द्दी-र्द्दिनी-र्द्दि) 1 Trampling. 2 Rubbing. E. सम्मर्द्द, and इनि aff.
सम्मर्द्दिन्: सम्मर्द्दिन् mfn. (-र्द्दी-र्द्दिनी-र्द्दि) 1 Trampling. 2 Rubbing. E. सम्मर्द्द, and इनि aff.
सम्मातुर: सम्मातुर m. (-रः) The son of a virtuous woman. E. सत् good, मातृ a mother, अण् aff.
सम्माद: सम्माद m. (-दः) Phrensy, intoxication. E. सम् intensitive, मद to be mad, aff. घञ्.
सम्मान: सम्मान n. (-नं) 1 Respect, homage. 2 Measure. E. सम्, and मन to respect, with घञ् aff., or मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्.
सम्मानन: सम्मानन n. (-नं) Worship, homage. E. सम् intensitive, मन to respect, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
सम्मानित: सम्मानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Treated with reverence or respect. E. सम् before मन to respect, causal v., क्त aff.
सम्मान्य: सम्मान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Respectable, honourable. E. सम्मन् to respect, ण्यत् aff.
सम्मार्जक: सम्मार्जक m. (-कः) A sweeper. E. सम् completely, मृज to clean, ण्वुल् aff.
सम्मार्जन: सम्मार्जन n. (-नं) Sweeping, brushing, cleaning. f. (-नी) A broom. E. सम् before मृज to clean, aff. ल्युट्.
सम्मित: सम्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Like, similar, same. 2 Of equal measure or extent. 3 Meted, measured. E. सम् with, मित measured, compared.
सम्मिश्र: सम्मिश्र mfn. (-श्रः-श्रा-श्रं) Mixed, mingled, blended, joined. E. सम् together, and मिश्र mixed.
सम्मुख: सम्मुख mfn. (-खः-खा or -खी-खं) Encountering, facing, in front of. E. सम् with, मुख the face.
सम्मुखिन्: सम्मुखिन् m. (-खी) A mirror. E. सम् with, मुख the face, इनि aff.
सम्मुखीन: सम्मुखीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Before, in front or in face of. E. सम्मुख the same, and ख aff.
सम्मुग्ध: सम्मुग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Fascinated, bewildered. 2 Stupified, astounded. 3 Beautiful. E. सम् before मुह to fascinate, क्त aff.
सम्मूढ: सम्मूढ mfn. (-ढः-टा-ढं) 1 Heaped, accumulated. 2 Produced rapidly. 3 Broken. 4 Foolish, ignorant, senseless. 5 Bewildered, beguiled. 6 Stupified, astounded. E. सम् entirely, मुह to be foolish, and क्त aff.
सम्मूढचेतस्: सम्मूढचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) Foolish, infatuated. E. सम्मूढ, and चेतस् the mind.
सम्मूर्च्छन: सम्मूर्च्छन n. (-नं) 1 Uniform or universal expansion or permeation, pervading, co-extension. 2 Height, elevation. 3 Fainting, insensibility. 4 Increasing, augmenting. E. सम् before मूर्च्छ to faint, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
सम्मूर्च्छनोद्भव: सम्मूर्च्छनोद्भव m. (-वः) A fish or aquatic animal. E. सम्मूर्च्छन insensibility, उद्भव produced.
सम्मृत: सम्मृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dead, deceased. E. सम्, and मृत dead.
सम्मृष्ट: सम्मृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Strained, filtered. 2 Cleaned, cleansed. 3 Swept. E. सम् completely, मृष्ट cleansed.
सम्मोद: सम्मोद m. (-दः) 1 Pleasure, delight. E. सम् intensitive, मुद to be happy, aff. घञ्.
सम्मोह: सम्मोह m. (-हः) 1 Ignorance. 2 Folly. 3 Beguilement, fascination. 4 Stupefaction. 5 Fainting. E. सम् before मुह to be foolish, घञ् aff.
सम्मोहित: सम्मोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Beguiled, fascinated. 2 Enraptured, overcome with delight, &c. E. सम् before मुह to be foolish, causal v., क्त aff.
सम्यक्: सम्यक् ind. 1 All, wholly. 2 Properly, fitly, in the right manner: see सम्यच्.
सम्यक्त्व: सम्यक्त्व n. (-त्वं) Accuracy, totality. E. सम्यक्, and त्व aff.
सम्यक्दण्डन: सम्यक्दण्डन n. (-नं) Inflicting the penalty of the law, punishing in a legal manner. E. सम्यक् properly, according to the Śāstras, and दण्डन punishing.
सम्यच्: सम्यच् or सम्यञ्च् mfn. (सम्यङ् समीची सम्यक्) 1 True, right. 2 Accompanying, going with. 3 Pleasant, agreeable. 4 Same, common, identical, uniform. 5 Accurate, correct. 6 All, entire. E. सम् with, अञ्च to go, क्विन् aff.
सम्यगुक्त: सम्यगुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Of equal weight or authority, (a precept.) E. सम्यक् proper, उक्त said.
सम्यग्वर्तमान: सम्यग्वर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Continuing in the discharge of duty, &c. E. सम्यक्, and वर्त्तमान being.
सम्यग्वर्त्तमान: सम्यग्वर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Continuing in the discharge of duty, &c. E. सम्यक्, and वर्त्तमान being.
सम्यग्वृत्ति: सम्यग्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Steady and regular discharge of prescribed duties. E. सम्यक्, and वृत्ति practice.
सम्राज्: सम्राज् m. (-राट्) A paramount sovereign, one who rules-over other princes, and has performed the Rājasūya sacrifice. E. सम् all, राजृ to rule, aff. क्विप्.
सयत्न: सयत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Endeavouring, taking pains. n. adv. (-त्नं) Vigorously, assiduously. E. स with, यत्न effort.
सयोनि: सयोनि m. (-निः) 1 INDRA. 2 Proximity to a wife. 3 A pair of nippers for cutting betel-nut. E. स for सह with, or सम् like, and योनि pudendum muliebre.
सर: सर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what goes, occurring chiefly in composition, as अनुसर, अवसर, &c. m. (-रः) 1 The thick part or coagulum of curds or milk, cream, &c. 2 Going, motion. 3 An arrow. 4 Saltness, salt. n. (-रं) 1 A lake, a pool. 2 Water. mf. (-रः-रा) or री) A cascade, a water-fall; also शर. E. सृ to go, aff. अप्.
सरःकाक: सरःकाक m. (-कः) A gander. f. (-की) A goose. E. सरस् a pool, and काक a crow.
सरक: सरक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Going, moving, proceeding. mn. (-कः-कं) 1 Spirituous liquor, especially distilled from sugar, rum. 2 Drinking spirits. 3 A drinking vessel. 4 Distribution of liquor. 5 A continuous line of road. n. (-कं) 1 A lake, a pool. 2 Heaven, sky. E. सृ to go, Uṇādi. aff. वुन्.
सरघा: सरघा f. (-घा) A bee. E. सर one who is going, हन् to injure, aff. ड, and the radical final changed.
सरज: सरज n. (-जं) Fresh butter. E. सर cream, and ज produced.
सरजस्: सरजस् f. (-जाः) A woman during menstruation. E. स for सह with, रजस् the menses.
सरट्: सरट् m. (-ट्) 1 Air, wind. 2 A cloud. 3 (In the language of the Vedas,) A bee. 4 A lizard, a chameleon. E. सृ to go, अटि Uṇādi aff.
सरट: सरट m. (-टः) A lizard, a chameleon, a guana, &c. E. सृ to go, अटन् aff.; also शरट.
सरटि: सरटि m. (-टिः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A cloud. E. सृ to go, अटिन् Uṇādi aff.
सरटु: सरटु n. (-टुः) A lizard, a chameleon, &c. E. सृ to go, अटु aff.
सरण: सरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Going, moving, who or what goes or moves. n. (-णं) 1 Oxidized iron, either in the state of rust or filings. 2 Going, proceeding. f. (-णा or णी) 1 A plant, (Pæderia fetida.) 2 A sort of Teori. E. सृ to go, aff. युच्, or ल्युट् fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्; also शरण, &c.
सरणि: सरणि f. (-णिः-णी) 1 A road, a path, a way. 2 A straight or continuous line. 3 A disease of the throat. E. सृ to go, Uṇādi aff. अनि, and ङीष् optionally added; also शरणि, &c.
सरण्ड: सरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A rogue, a cheat. 2 A sort of ornament. 3 A bird. E. सृ to go, Uṇādi aff. अण्डन्, more usually शरण्ड.
सरण्यु: सरण्यु m. (-ण्युः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A cloud. 3 Water. E. सृ to go, अन्यु Uṇādi aff.
सरत्: सरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Going, proceeding. E. सृ to go, शतृ aff.
सरत् m. (-रत्) Thread. E. सृ to go, अति aff.
सरत्नि: सरत्नि mf. (-त्निः-त्निः) A short cubit. E. सृ to go, कत्निच् aff.; more commonly रत्नि, q. v.
सरपत्रिका: सरपत्रिका f. (-का) The new leaf of a lotus.
सरभस: सरभस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Quick, speedy. 2 Delighted. 3 Agitated, distressed. n. adv. (-सं) Quickly, delightedly, agitatedly, &c. E. स with, रभस speed, &c.
सरमा: सरमा f. (-मा) 1 The wife of RĀVAṆA'S brother. 2 A bitch. E. सृ to go, अम aff., or स with रम sport, pleasure.
सरयु: सरयु m. (-युः) Air, wind. f. (-युः-यूः) The Sarju or Saryu river. E. सृ to go, अयु Uṇādi aff.: also शरयु.
सरल: सरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Honest, sincere, candid, upright. 2 Straight. m. (-लः) 1 A sort of pine, (Pinus longifolia.) 2 A bird, (Pavo bicalcarata.) f. (-ला) A variety of the plant called Teori. E. सृ to go, (to spread fragrance abroad, &.,) कल Uṇādi aff.
सरलद्रव: सरलद्रव m. (-वः) A fragrant resin, the exudation of the Saral or pine tree. E. सरल as above, द्रव what exudes.
सरलयायिन्: सरलयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Going in a straight line. 2 Upright, honest. f. (-नी) A plant with an upright stem. E. सरल, and यायिन् who or what goes or grows.
सरव्य: सरव्य n. (-व्यं) A butt or mark for shooting at. E. सर an arrow, व्येञ् to cover, aff. ड; also शरव्य.
सरस्: सरस् nf. (-रः-सी) 1 A large pond or pool. 2 A piece of water in which the lotus grows or may grow. n. (-रः) Water. E. सृ to go (into, to bathe or drink), असुन् Uṇādi aff.
सरस: सरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Tasty, juicy, sapid. 2 Comprising the expression of the poetical Rasas or sentiments, (a work, &c.) 3 Impassioned. n. (-सं) A tank, a pond, a lake. f. (-सा) A sort of Teori. E. स with, रस juice.
सरसम्प्रत: सरसम्प्रत n. (-तं) A sort of Euphorbia, commonly Tiṅkātā Sij.
सरसिक: सरसिक m. (-कः) The Indian crane. E. सरस a pool, ठन् aff.
सरसिज: सरसिज n. (-जं) A lotus. E. सरस् a pool, (seventh case,) and ज born.
सरसीरुह: सरसीरुह n. (-हः) A lotus. E. सरसी a pool, and रुह what grows.
सरस्तीर: सरस्तीर n. (-रं) The bank of a lake or pond. E. सरस्, and तीर bank.
सरस्वत्: सरस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) 1 Juicy, sapid. 2 Elegant. 3 Sentimental. m. (-स्वान्) 1 The ocean. 2 A male river. 3 A buffalo. f. (-स्वती) 1 The wife of BRAHMĀ, the goddess of speech and eloquence, the patroness of music and the arts, and the inventress of the Sanscrit language and Devanāgarī letters. 2 Speech, the faculty or its exercise. 3 A river, the Sarsooty, which rises in the mountains bounding the north-east part of the province of Dehli, whence it runs in a south-westerly direction, and is lost in the sands of the great desart in the country of the Bhatti; according to the Hindus the river only disappears in this place, and continuing its course under ground, joins the Ganges and Jumna at Allahabad. 4 A river in general. 5 An excellent woman. 6 A crow, 7 The wife of a Muni. 8 A female divinity, peculiar to the Jainas. 9 The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) E. सरस् a lake, and मतुप् poss. aff., or स with, रस flavour, taste, and the same aff.
सराग: सराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Coloured, tinted. 2 Impassioned. E. स with, राग colour, &c.
सराव: सराव m. (-वः) A lid, or a shallow cup or saucer, used as one: see शराव.
सरि: सरि mf. (-रिः-री) A waterfall. E. सृ to go, इन् aff.; also सर, &c.
सरिका: सरिका f. (-का) 1 A drug, commonly Hingupatri. 2 Going, proceeding. 3 A woman going, or moving. E. सृ to go, वुन् aff. fem. form.
सरित्: सरित् f. (-रित्) 1 A river in general. 2 Thread. E. सृ to go, इति Uṇādi aff.
सरिताम्पति: सरिताम्पति m. (-तिः) The ocean. E. सरित् a river, (second case plural,) and पति lord.
सरित्पति: सरित्पति m. (-तिः) The ocean. E. सरित् a river, and पति lord.
सरित्वत्: सरित्वत् m. (-त्वान्) The ocean. E. सरित् a river, and मतुप् poss. aff.
सरित्सुत: सरित्सुत m. (-तः) BHĪṢMA, the son of GAṄGĀ. E. सरित् the river, and सुत son.
सरिद्वरा: सरिद्वरा f. (-रा) The Ganges. E. सरित् a river, and वर best.
सरिन्नाथ: सरिन्नाथ m. (-थः) The ocean. E. सरित् a river, and नाथ lord.
सरिन्मुख: सरिन्मुख n. (-खं) The source of a river. E. सरित्, and मुख face.
सरिमन्: सरिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Going, proceeding. 2 Air, wind. E. सृ to go, इमनिन् Uṇādi aff.
सरिल: सरिल n. (-लं) Water. E. see सलिल, the ल being changed to र.
सरीसृप: सरीसृप m. (-पः) A snake. E. सृप to go, irr. reiterative form, and अच् aff.
सरु: सरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Thin, small, fine, minute. m. (-रुः) The hilt or handle of a sword, &c. E. सृ to go, उ aff.
सरूप: सरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Like, resembling. E. स for समान like, same, रूप form.
सरूपता: सरूपता f. (-ता) Likeness, resemblance. E. सरूप like, तल् aff. of the abstract; also सरूपत्व n. (-त्वं).
सरोग: सरोग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Sick, diseased. E. स, and रोग sickness.
सरोगिता: सरोगिता f. (-ता) Sickness, disease. E. स, and रोगिता sickness.
सरोज: सरोज n. (-जं) A lotus. m. (-जः) A foot (in Prosody,) of six long instants. E. सरस् a pond, and ज born.
सरोजन्मन्: सरोजन्मन् n. (-न्म) A lotus. E. सरस् a pond, and जन्मन् birth.
सरोजल: सरोजल n. (-लं) The water of a pond or lake. E. सरस् a pond, and जल water.
सरोजिन्: सरोजिन् m. (-जी) BRAHMĀ. f. (-नी) 1 A lotus. 2 A pond abounding in lotuses. 3 A multitude of lotuses. E. सरोज a lotus, and इनि aff.
सरोत्सव: सरोत्सव m. (-वः) The Indian crane. E. सर water, उत्सव pleasure, delight.
सरोध: सरोध m. (-धः) 1 Loss, destruction. 2 Opposition, obstruction. E. स for सह with, रोघ hindrance.
सरोरुह्: सरोरुह् n. (-रुट्) A lotus. E. सरस् a pond, and रुह् what grows; also with a final vowel सरोरुह n. (-हं)
सरोरुहासन: सरोरुहासन m. (-नः) BRAHMĀ. E. सरोरुह a lotus, and आसन a seat; first appearing from the interior of a lotus in order to create the world; the flower is supposed to have sprung from the navel of VIṢṆU.
सरोवर: सरोवर m. (-रः) A lake or large pond, any piece of water deep enough for the lotus to grow. E. सरम् a pool, and वर best.
सरोष: सरोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Angry, wrathful. n. adv. (-षं) Angrily. E. स with, रोष wrath.
सर्ग: सर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 Nature, natural property or disposition. 2 Tendency of a thing. 3 Creation. 4 Effort, perseverance. 5 Assent, agreement. 6 Relinquishment, abandoning, letting go or getting rid of. 7 Voiding, as excrement. 8 A chapter, a book, a section. 9 Certainty, ascertainment. E. सृज to quit, &c., aff. घञ्.
सर्गबन्ध: सर्गबन्ध m. (-न्धः) A principal or great poem, one comprising many Sargas or Cantos. E. सर्ग a section, and बन्ध a binding.
सर्ज: सर्ज्ज r. 1st cl. (सर्ज्जति) To gain or get.
सर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) 1 The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) 2 Another tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) 3 The resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. सृज to quit, aff. घञ्, and the final consonant unchanged.
सर्ज्ज: सर्ज्ज r. 1st cl. (सर्ज्जति) To gain or get.
सर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) 1 The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) 2 Another tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) 3 The resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. सृज to quit, aff. घञ्, and the final consonant unchanged.
सर्जक: सर्ज्जक m. (-कः) 1 The Pentaptera arjuna. 2 The Śāl tree. f. (-र्जिका) 1 Natron, alkali. 2 Borax. E. वुन् added to the last.
सर्ज्जक: सर्ज्जक m. (-कः) 1 The Pentaptera arjuna. 2 The Śāl tree. f. (-र्जिका) 1 Natron, alkali. 2 Borax. E. वुन् added to the last.
सर्जगन्धा: सर्ज्जगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, commonly Rasan, supposed to be the serpent Ophioxylon. E. सर्ज्ज the Śāl tree, गन्ध smell.
सर्ज्जगन्धा: सर्ज्जगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, commonly Rasan, supposed to be the serpent Ophioxylon. E. सर्ज्ज the Śāl tree, गन्ध smell.
सर्जन: सर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 The reserve or rear of an army. 2 Abandoning, quitting. 3 Voiding, as excrement. 4 Making, creating. E. सृज to abandon, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
सर्ज्जन: सर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 The reserve or rear of an army. 2 Abandoning, quitting. 3 Voiding, as excrement. 4 Making, creating. E. सृज to abandon, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
सर्जमणि: सर्ज्जमणि m. (-णिः) Resin in general, or the resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. सर्ज्ज the Śāl, and मणि a jewel.
सर्ज्जमणि: सर्ज्जमणि m. (-णिः) Resin in general, or the resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. सर्ज्ज the Śāl, and मणि a jewel.
सर्जरस: सर्ज्जरस m. (-सः) Resin in general, or the resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. सर्ज्ज the Śāl, and रम juice.
सर्ज्जरस: सर्ज्जरस m. (-सः) Resin in general, or the resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. सर्ज्ज the Śāl, and रम juice.
सर्जि: सर्ज्जि f. (-र्ज्जिः) Natron, alkali. E. सृज to abandon, इनि aff.
सर्ज्जि: सर्ज्जि f. (-र्ज्जिः) Natron, alkali. E. सृज to abandon, इनि aff.
सर्जिका: सर्ज्जिका f. (-का) Natron, alkali, or the impure carbonate of soda, commonly termed Sejji Mitti or Sejji earth, and used in India as a soap for cleaning linen, &c. E. सर्ज्जि the same, and कन् added, fem. form.
सर्ज्जिका: सर्ज्जिका f. (-का) Natron, alkali, or the impure carbonate of soda, commonly termed Sejji Mitti or Sejji earth, and used in India as a soap for cleaning linen, &c. E. सर्ज्जि the same, and कन् added, fem. form.
सर्जिकाक्षार: सर्ज्जिकाक्षार m. (-रः) Impure carbonate of soda, alkali, natron. E. सर्ज्जिका the same, and क्षार ashes; also स्वर्ज्जिकाक्षार.
सर्ज्जिकाक्षार: सर्ज्जिकाक्षार m. (-रः) Impure carbonate of soda, alkali, natron. E. सर्ज्जिका the same, and क्षार ashes; also स्वर्ज्जिकाक्षार.
सर्जू: सर्ज्जू m. (-र्ज्जूः) A trader. f. (-र्ज्जूः) 1 Lightning. 2 A necklace. 3 Going, following. E. सर्ज्ज to gain, Uṇādi aff. ऊ.
सर्ज्जू: सर्ज्जू m. (-र्ज्जूः) A trader. f. (-र्ज्जूः) 1 Lightning. 2 A necklace. 3 Going, following. E. सर्ज्ज to gain, Uṇādi aff. ऊ.
सर्प: सर्प m. (-र्पः) 1 A snake, a serpent. 2 Gentle or twining motion, gliding, flowing, creeping. f. (-र्पी) The female of the snake. E. सृप to go, to glide, aff. अच्.
सर्पकङ्काली: सर्पकङ्काली f. (-ली) A plant, commonly Sāmpkaṅkāli or serpent's skeleton. E. सर्प a snake, कङ्काल a skeleton, fem. aff. of diminutiveness or comparison, ङीष्; also with कन् added सर्पकङ्कालिका.
सर्पगन्धा: सर्पगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, perhaps the same as the serpent ophioxylon. E. सर्प a snake, and गन्ध fragrance.
सर्पघातिनी: सर्पघातिनी f. (-नी) A plant: see सर्पकङ्काली. E. सर्प a snake, and घातिनी destructress.
सर्पच्छत्र: सर्प्पछत्र n. (-त्रं) A mushroom. E. सर्प्प, and छत्र an umbrella.
सर्प्पछत्र: सर्प्पछत्र n. (-त्रं) A mushroom. E. सर्प्प, and छत्र an umbrella.
सर्पण: सर्प्पण n. (-णं) 1 Going, gliding. 2 The slow flight of an arrow nearly parallel to the ground. E. सृप to go, ल्युट् aff.
सर्प्पण: सर्प्पण n. (-णं) 1 Going, gliding. 2 The slow flight of an arrow nearly parallel to the ground. E. सृप to go, ल्युट् aff.
सर्पत्: सर्प्पत् mfn. (-र्प्पन्-र्प्पन्ती-र्प्पत) Going, gliding, creeping. E. सृप to go, शतृ aff.
सर्प्पत्: सर्प्पत् mfn. (-र्प्पन्-र्प्पन्ती-र्प्पत) Going, gliding, creeping. E. सृप to go, शतृ aff.
सर्पदंष्ट्र: सर्पदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) 1 A snake's tooth. 2 A plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.) f. (-ष्ट्रा) A plant, (Tragia involucrata.) E. सर्प, and दंष्ट्र a tooth.
सर्पफणज: सर्प्पफणज m. (-जः) The snake-stone, a gem or pearl said to resemble in form the berry of the Abrus precatorius, and to be found in the head of the snake. E. सर्प्प a snake, फण hood, and ज born.
सर्प्पफणज: सर्प्पफणज m. (-जः) The snake-stone, a gem or pearl said to resemble in form the berry of the Abrus precatorius, and to be found in the head of the snake. E. सर्प्प a snake, फण hood, and ज born.
सर्पभुज्: सर्पभुज् m. (-भुक्) 1 A peacock. 2 A crane. 3 A large snake. E. सर्प a snake, and भुज् who eats.
सर्पमणि: सर्पमणि m. (-णिः) The snake-stone or carbuncle, or a jewel said to be found in the head of a snake, possessing also alexipharmic properties. E. सर्प a snake, and मणि a gem.
सर्पमाला: सर्पमाला f. (-ला) A plant, commonly Serpakankali.
सर्पराज: सर्पराज m. (-जः) VĀSUKI, sovereign of the serpent race, inhabiting Pātāla or the regions under the earth. E. सर्प a snake, and राज a sovereign.

सव्यसाचिन्: सव्यसाचिन् m. (-ची) A name of ARJUNA. E. सव्य left, षच to be joined or attached, aff. णिनि; drawing the bow with his left hand, as well as his right.
सव्याज: सव्याज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Cunning, plausible, pretending. 2 Fraudulent. E. स with, व्याज pretext.
सव्येष्ठ: सव्येष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A charioteer. E. सव्ये on the left, and स्थ who stands.
सव्येष्ठृ: सव्येष्ठृ m. (-ष्ठा) A charioteer. E. सव्ये on the left, स्था to stand, ऋन् Uṇādi aff. with the effect of ड, स, and थ changed.
सव्रीड: सव्रीड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Modest, ashamed. E. स with, व्रीडा shame.
सशङ्क: सशङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Fearful, doubtful. E. स with, शङ्का fear.
सशल्क: सशल्क mfn. (-ल्कः-ल्का-ल्कं) Scaly, (as a fish, &c.) E. स, and शल्क scale.
सशल्य: सशल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Troublesome, difficult. 2 Pierced by a thorn or dart. E. स with, शल्य a thorn.
सशूक: सशूक m. (-कः) A believer, one who believes the existence of GOD, &c.
सशोक: सशोक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sorrowful, sad. n. adv. (-कं) Sorrowfully. E. स with, शोक sorrow.
सश्मश्रु: सश्मश्रु f. (-श्रुः) A woman with a beard. E. स for सह with, श्मश्रु a beard.
सश्रम: सश्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Wearied, fatigued. E. स with, श्रम fatigue.
सस: सस r. 2nd cl. (सलि) To sleep; also षस.
ससंशय: ससंशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Doubtful, uncertain. E. स with, संशय doubt.
ससत्वा: ससत्वा f. (-त्वा) A pregnant woman. E. स for सह with, सत्व a living being.
ससन: ससन n. (-नं) Immolation, offering a living victim. E. सस to sleep, &c., aff. ल्युट्; also शसन and शमन.
ससम्पद: ससम्पद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Happy, delighted. E. स with, सम्पद pleasure.
ससाध्वस: ससाध्वस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Frightened, alarmed. E. स with, साध्वस fear.
ससौष्ठव: ससौष्ठव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Quick, fleet. 2 Excellent. E. स with, सौष्ठव speed, &c.
सस्तर: सस्तर m. (-रः) A bed of leaves, &c. E. स for समान common, and लर spreading, covering.
सस्पृह: सस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Desirous, wishing for. E. स with, स्पृहा desire.
सस्मित: सस्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smiling, laughing. E. स for सह with, स्मित a smile.
सस्य: सस्य n. (-स्यं) 1 Fruit. 2 Corn, grain. 3 A weapon. 4 A quality, an excellence. E. सस to sleep, य Uṇādi aff.; also शस्य, &c.
सस्यक: सस्यक m. (-कः) 1 A sort of precious stone, described as of the colour of the inner fruit of the cocoanut, (Opal?) 2 A sword. E. कन् added to the last.
सस्यसंवर: सस्यसंवर m. (-रः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. सस्य fruit, and संवर a covering.
सस्याद्: सस्याद् mfn. (-द्) Fructivorous, granivorous, eating grain or fruit. E. सस्य, अद to eat, क्विप् aff.
सस्येष्टि: सस्येष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Sacrifice offered on the ripening of new grain. E. सस्य, and इष्टि sacrifice.
सस्वेद: सस्वेद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Perspiring, exuding. f. (-दा) A virgin deflowered, a girl who has committed a breach of chastity. E. स with, स्वेद perspiration.
सस्त्रि: सस्त्रि mfn. (-स्त्रिः-स्त्रिः-स्त्रि) Who or what goes. E. सृ to go, इ aff., v. redup.
सह: सह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Patient, enduring, suffering, bearing, m. (-हः) The month Agrahāyaṇa. mn. (-हः-हं) Strength, power. f. (-हा) 1 The earth. 2 The Aloe plant. 3 A sort of bean, commonly Mudgaparṇī. 4 A drug, commonly Nakhi. 5 A plant; also Daṇḍotpalā. 6 Barleria, (the white sort.) 7 The ichneumon plant or Rasan. 8 A medicinal sort of moon plant. ind. 1 With, together with; a particle implying association, connexion; 2 Union, junction; 3 Increase, addition; 4 Presence, present time; 5 Completeness, entireness; 6 Resemblance, &c. E. षह to have patience, aff. अच्, fem. aff. टाप्.
सहकार: सहकार m. (-रः) A fragrant sort of mango. E. सह with, कृ to make, अण् aff.
सहकारिता: सहकारिता f. (-ता) Co-operation, assistance. E. सहकारिन्, and तल् aff.; also सहकारित्वं.
सहकारिन्: सहकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) An implement, an assistant or associate, that or who, by which or whom, any object is effected, &c. E. सह with, कृ to make, णिनि aff.
सहकृत्: सहकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Assisting, an assister. E. सह, and कृत् who does.
सहकृत्वन्: सहकृत्वन् mfn. (-त्वा-त्वा-त्व) Co-operating, assisting. E. सह with, कृ to do, क्वनिप् aff.
सहगत: सहगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Accompanied, associated. E. सह with, गत gone.
सहगमन: सहगमन n. (-नं) 1 Going with, accompanying. 2 A woman's burning herself on the funeral pile with her deceased husband. E. सह with, गमन going.
सहगामिन्: सहगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going with, accompanying. f. (-नी) A woman who burns herself with her husband's body. E. सह with, गामिन् who goes.
सहचर: सहचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Accompanying, going or associating with, &c. mf. (-रः-री) Yellow Barleria. m. (-रः) 1 A companion, a follower. 2 A surety. f. (-री) 1 A wife. 2 A woman's female friend or confidence. E. सह with, चर to go, टच् aff.
सहचरत्: सहचरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Accompanying, attending. E. सह with, चर to go, शतृ aff.
सहचरित: सहचरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Who or what accompanies, attends, associates with, &c. E. सह with, चर to go, क्त aff.
सहचारिन्: सहचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) A companion, an attendant. E. सह with, चारिन् who goes.
सहज: सहज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Co-existent, cognate, born or produced together. 2 Innate, inherent, natural. m. (-जः) 1 A brother of whole blood. 2 The natural state or disposition. E. सह with, and ज born.
सहजमित्र: सहजमित्र m. (-चः) A friend by birth; as a sister's son, &c. E. सहज cognate, मिच friend.
सहजारि: सहजारि m. (-रिः) A natural enemy, one hostile by birth; as the son of the same father by another mother, the son of a paternal uncle, &c. E. सहज cognate, अरि an enemy.
सहजेतर: सहजेतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Incidental, accidental, not inherent or innate, (in the dual it may imply both innate and adventitious.) E. सहज, and इतर other.
सहजोदासीन: सहजोदासीन m. (-नः) A person, unconnected by birth, born neither an enemy nor friend. E. सहज cognate, उदासीन a stranger.
सहत्व: सहत्व n. (-त्वं). 1 Sufferance, endurance. 2 Association, union. E. सह patient, or with, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, सहता.
सहदेव: सहदेव m. (-वः) The youngest of the five Pāṇḍava princes. f. (-वा) 1 A plant, a sort of Sida. 2 A twining shrub, (Echites frutescens.) 3 Another plant, also Daṇḍotpala. f. (-वी) 1 A sort of Sida. 2 A shrub, bearing a fragrant seed, Priyangu. E. सह with देव who or what sports.
सहधर्म: सहधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Community of duty, law, property, &c. E. सह with, धर्म्म duty.
सहधर्म्म: सहधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Community of duty, law, property, &c. E. सह with, धर्म्म duty.
सहधर्मिन्: सहधर्म्मिन् mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) 1 Following the same law, acknowledging the same obligations. 2 Possessing same or like properties. f. (-णी) A woman married according to the ritual of the Vedas. E. सह with, धर्म्म the law, इनि aff.
सहधर्म्मिन्: सहधर्म्मिन् mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) 1 Following the same law, acknowledging the same obligations. 2 Possessing same or like properties. f. (-णी) A woman married according to the ritual of the Vedas. E. सह with, धर्म्म the law, इनि aff.
सहन: सहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Patient, enduring. n. (-नं) Bearing, enduring. E. सह to bear, युच् or ल्युट् aff.
सहनर्तन: सहनर्त्तन n. (-नं) Dancing together in a circle, &c. E. सह together, and नर्त्तन dancing.
सहनर्त्तन: सहनर्त्तन n. (-नं) Dancing together in a circle, &c. E. सह together, and नर्त्तन dancing.
सहपांशुकिल: सहपांशुकिल m. (-लः) A contemporary and friend.
सहपान: सहपान n. (-नं) Drinking together. E. सह with, पान drinking.
सहभाविन्: सहभाविन् m. (-वी) A friend, a companion, an adherent or partisan. E. सह with, भाव quality, इनि aff.
सहभोजन: सहभोजन n. (-नं) Eating in company. E. सह together, भोजन food.
सहमरण: सहमरण n. (-णं) Concremation, a widow's burning herself with the corpse of her husband. E. सह with, मरण dying.
सहयुध्वन्: सहयुध्वन् mfn. (-ध्वा-ध्वा-ध्व) Fighting with or along with. m. (-ध्वा) A brother in arms. E. सह, युध to fight, क्वनिप् aff.
सहयुध्वान: सहयुध्वान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fighting with. E. सह, युध्वान fighting.
सहरसा: सहरसा f. (-सा) A sort of bean; see मुद्गपर्णी. E. सह with, रस juice.
सहरि: सहरि m. (-रिः) 1 The sun. 2 A bull. ind. Resembling HARI or VIṢṆU. E. स for सह with, or समान same, हरि the deity.
सहर्ष: सहर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Envy, emulation. 2 Pleasure, delight. E. स with, हर्ष pleasure.
सहस्: सहस् m. (-हां) 1 The month Agrahāyaṇa, (Nov.-Dec.) 2 The winter season. n. (-हः) 1 Strength, power. 2 Light. E. षह to bear, असुन् aff.
सहसा: सहसा ind. Quickly, precipitately, inconsiderately, without consideration or pause. E. षह to bear, असा aff.
सहसादृष्ट: सहसादृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Seen quickly. m. (-ष्टः) An adopted son. E. सहसा quickly, दृष्ट seen.
सहसान: सहसान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Patient, enduring. m. (-नः) 1 A peacock. 2 Sacrifice, oblation. E. षह to bear, असानच् Uṇādi aff.
सहस्य: सहस्य m. (-स्यः) The month Pauṣa, (Dec.-Jan.) E. सह to bear, यत् aff., form irr.
सहस्रकिरण: सहस्रकिरण m. (-णः) The sun. E. सहस्र a thousand, and किरण a ray.
सहस्रकृत्व: सहस्रकृत्व ind. Repeatedly, reiteratedly, a thousand or many times. E. सहस्र, and कृत्वसुच् aff.
सहस्रद: सहस्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Liberal, giving by thousands. E. सहस्र, and द who gives.
सहस्रदंष्ट्र: सहस्रदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus pelorius, BUC.) E. सहस्र a thousand, and दंष्ट्र tooth.
सहस्रदंष्ट्रिन्: सहस्रदंष्ट्रिन् m. (-ष्ट्री) A sheat fish: see the last. E. सहस्र a thousand, दंष्ट्र a tooth, and इनि aff.
सहस्रदृश्: सहस्रदृश् m. (-दृक्) INDRA. E. सहस्र, and दृश् the eye.
सहस्रदोस्: सहस्रदोस् m. (-दोः) KĀRTAVĪRYA, a prince so named. E. सहस्र a thousand, and दोस् the arm.
सहस्रधा: सहस्रधा ind. In a thousand ways. E. सहस्र, and धाच् aff.
सहस्रधार: सहस्रधार m. (-रः) The discus of VIṢṆU. E. सहस्र a thousand, and धार an edge.
सहस्रनयन: सहस्रनयन m. (-नः) INDRA. E. सहस्र a thousand, and नयन the eye.
सहस्रनेत्र: सहस्रनेत्र m. (-त्रः) INDRA. E. सहस्र a thousand, and नेत्र the eye.
सहस्रपति: सहस्रपति m. (-तिः) The governor of a district, or of a thousand villages. E. सहस्र, and पति chief.
सहस्रपत्र: सहस्रपत्र n. (-त्रं) A lotus. E. सहस्र a thousand, and पत्र a leaf.
सहस्रपाद्: सहस्रपाद् m. (-त् or -द्) BRAHMĀ. E. सहस्र a thousand, and पाद् for पाद a foot.
सहस्रपाद: सहस्रपाद m. (-दः) 1 The sun. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 A sort of duck. E. सहस्र a thousand, and पाद a foot.
सहस्रयुग: सहस्रयुग m. (-गः) A period of a thousand ages. E. सहस्र, and युग an age.
सहस्ररश्मि: सहस्ररश्मि m. (-श्मिः) The sun. E. सहस्र a thousand, and रश्मि a ray.
सहस्ररोमन्: सहस्ररोमन् n. (-म) A blanket. E. सहस्र, and रोमन् hair.
सहस्रवदन: सहस्रवदन m. (-नः) VIṢṆU. E. सहस्र, a thousand, and वदन a face.
सहस्रवीर्या: सहस्रवीर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A bent grass, (Panicum dactylon, the Agrostis linearis of LINNÆIS.) E. सहस्र a thousand, वीर्य्य splendor.
सहस्रवीर्य्या: सहस्रवीर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A bent grass, (Panicum dactylon, the Agrostis linearis of LINNÆIS.) E. सहस्र a thousand, वीर्य्य splendor.
सहस्रवेधिन्: सहस्रवेधिन् n. (-धि) Asafoetida. m. (-धी) A sort of cane, (Calamus fasciculatus.) E. सहस्र a thousands, and वेधिन् what pierces.
सहस्रशस्: सहस्रशस् ind. By a thousand or thousands, thousand-fold. E. सहस्र, and शसि aff.
सहस्रशिखर: सहस्रशिखर m. (-रः) The Vindhya mountain. E. सहस्र a thousand, and शिखर a crest.
सहस्रहर्याश्व: सहस्रहर्य्याश्व m. (-श्वः) The car of INDRA. E. सहस्र a thousand, हरि green, and अश्व a horse.
सहस्रहर्य्याश्व: सहस्रहर्य्याश्व m. (-श्वः) The car of INDRA. E. सहस्र a thousand, हरि green, and अश्व a horse.
सहस्रांशु: सहस्रांशु m. (-शुः) The sun. E. सहस्र a thousand, and अंशु a ray.
सहस्राक्ष: सहस्राक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Thousand-eyed; used figuratively, vigilant, all-perceiving, all-inspecting, all-powerful. m. (-क्षः) INDRA. E. सहस्र a thousand, and अक्ष the eye: INDRA having been covered over with marks resembling the female organ, in consequence of a curse of GAUTAMA, those marks were changed subsequently to eyes by the relenting saint.
सहस्राधिपति: सहस्राधिपति m. (-तिः) The governor of a district or chief over a thousand villages. E. सहस्र, and अधिपति ruler.
सहस्रार: सहस्रार n. (-रं) The top of the head, the seat of the soul. E. सहस्र, and अर a spoke.
सहस्रावर: सहस्रावर m. (-रः) A fine of from five hundred to a thousand Paṇas. E. सहस्र, and अवर below.
सहस्रिन्: सहस्रिन् mfn. (-स्री-स्रिणी-स्रि) Having a thousand. m. (-स्री) 1 A body of a thousand men, &c. 2 Commander or prefect of a thousand. E. सहस्र a thousand, इनि aff.
सहाचर: सहाचर m. (-रः) A yellow sort of Barleria, (B. prionitis.) E. सह with आङ् before चर to go, aff. टच्; also सहचर.
सहाय: सहाय m. (-यः) 1 A companion, a follower, an adherent. 2 A patron, a helper. 3 A sort of drug and perfume, commonly Gahantāpārali. 4 The ruddy goose. E. सह with, इण् to go, aff. अच्.
सहायता: सहायता f. (-ता) 1 A multitude of companions, a company of associates or followers. 2 Association, assistance, friendship. E. सहाय a companion, तल् aff. of number, or the abstract.
सहायत्व: सहायत्व n. (-त्वं) Fellowship, companionship, friendship. E. सहाय a companion, त्व aff. of the quality.
सहायवत्: सहायवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Befriended, assisted, accompanied, E. सहाय, and मतुप् poss. aff.
सहार: सहार m. (-रः) The mango. E. षह to bear, आरन् Uṇādi aff.
सहारोग्य: सहारोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Well, convalescent. E. सह with, आरोग्य health.
सहार्थ: सहार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Having one object. 2 Synonymous, having the same meaning. E. सह with, अर्थ object, &c.
सहार्द: सहार्द्द mfn. (-र्द्दः-र्द्दा-र्द्दं) Tender, affectionate. E. स with, हार्द्द affection.
सहार्द्द: सहार्द्द mfn. (-र्द्दः-र्द्दा-र्द्दं) Tender, affectionate. E. स with, हार्द्द affection.
सहासन: सहासन n. (-नं) Sitting on the same seat. E. सह with, आसन a seat.
सहित: सहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Accompanied by, in company with, associated with, &c. 2 Borne, endured. n. adv. (-तं) With, together with. E. सह with, इतच् aff.; or षह to bear, क्त aff., with इट् augment.
सहितृ: सहितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Bearing, enduring. E. सह to bear, तृच् aff.
सहित्र: सहित्र n. (-त्रं) Patience, endurance. E. षह to suffer, and इत्र aff.
सहिष्णु: सहिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Patient, enduring, resigned. E. षह to bear, इष्णुच् aff.
सहिष्णुता: सहिष्णुता f. (-ता) Patience, resignation. E. तल affix of the abstract, added to the preceding.
सहुरि: सहुरि m. (-रिः) The sun. f. (-रिः) The earth. E. षह to bear, उरिन् Uṇādi aff.
सहृदय: सहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Good-hearted. m. (-यः) A Paṇḍita, a learned man. E. स with, हृदय a heart.
सहेल: सहेल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Sportive, playing. E. स with हेल sport.
सहोक्ति: सहोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A figure of rhetoric; either the employment of a word in a double meaning, or connecting different circumstances in one sentence by the use of the term सह with, along with. E. सह with, उक्ति saying.
सहोटज: सहोटज m. (-जः) A hut of leaves, &c. inhabited by ascetics.
सहोढ: सहोढ m. (-ढः) The son of a woman pregnant at the time of her marriage. 1 A thief caught with stolen property upon him. E. सह with, ऊढा a bride; or स with, होढ stolen goods.
सहोढज: सहोढज m. (-जः) The son of a woman pregnant at the time of marriage. E. स with, ऊढा a bride, ज born.
सहोदर: सहोदर m. (-रः) A brother of whole blood, one by the same father and mother. E. सह with, उदर the belly.
सहोदित: सहोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said or declared, comprehensively or collectively. E. सह with, उदित said.
सहोर: सहोर m. (-रः) A saint, a pure or pious man. E. सह to bear, ओरन् Uṇādi aff.
सहोवल: सहोवल n. (-लं) Violence, aggression. E. सहस् and वल, both meaning power, strength.
सहोषित: सहोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dwelling or abiding with, being together with. E. सह, and उषित abiding.
सह्य: सह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 To be borne or suffered. 2 Equal or adequate to. 3 Sweet, agreeable. 4 Powerful, strong. n. (-ह्यं) Health, convalescence. m. (-ह्यः) One of the principal ranges of the mountains of India; the mountainous country on the north-west side of the Peninsula or towards Poonah, &c., and in which the Godāvarī river takes its rise. E. षह to bear, aff. यत्.
सा: सा f. (सा) 1 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 2 The goddess GAURĪ. 3 She, (the third personal feminine pronoun or the feminine inflection of तद् that, &c.) E. षो to destroy, &c., aff. ड.
सांयाचिक: सांयाचिक n. (-कः) A voyaging merchant, one who trades by sea, &c. E. संयात्रा travelling together, ठञ् aff.
सांयुगीन: सांयुगीन m. (-नः) An able leader, a soldier skilled in war. E. संयुग war, and खञ् aff.
सांराविण: सांराविण n. (-णं) 1 Shout, acclamation, the calling out of a number of people together. 2 Crying or complaining aloud. E. सम् together, राविन् who calls or cries, and अण् added.
सांवत्सर: सांवत्सर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Annual, perennial. m. (-रः) An astrologer. E. संवत्सर a year, अण् aff.
सांवत्सरिक: सांवत्सरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Yearly, annual, relating to a year, produced in a year, &c. E. संवत्सर a year, and ठञ् aff.; also with वुञ्, aff. सांवत्सरक.
सांवादिक: सांवादिक m. (-कः) A logician. E. संवाद dispute, ठक् aff.
सांशयिक: सांशयिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Dubious, doubtful. 2 Uncertain, irresolute, in doubt. E. संशय doubt, ठञ् aff.
सांसारिक: सांसारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Worldly, of or belonging to the world. E. संसार, and ठक् aff.
सांसिद्धिक: सांसिद्धिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Spontaneous, effected naturally. E. संसिद्धि perfection, ठक् aff.
सांस्थानिक: सांस्थानिक m. (-कः) A countryman, an inhabitant or native of the same place. E. सम् together, स्थान place, ठन् aff.
साकम्: साकम् ind. With, together with. E. स for सह with, अक to go, अम् aff.
साकल्य: साकल्य n. (-ल्यं) The whole, the entire, all. E. सकल all, and यञ् aff.
साकाङ्क्ष: साकाङ्क्ष mfn. (-ङ्क्षः-ङ्क्षा-ङ्क्ष) Wishing, desirous. E. स with, आकाङ्क्षा desire.
साकार: साकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Having form or shape. E. स with, आकार form.
साकूत: साकूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Significant. 2 Wanton. E. स with, आकूत meaning, wish.
साकूतस्मित: साकूतस्मित n. (-तं) A wanton glance. E. साकूत, and स्मित a smile.
साकेत: साकेत n. (-तं) The city Ayodhya, or ancient Oude.
साक्तुक: साक्तुक m. (-कः) Barley. n. (-कं) A quantity of fried grain, &c. E. सक्तु fried or parched grain ground, and ठञ् aff.
साक्षात्: साक्षात् ind. 1 Before, in presence, in sight. 2 As, like. 3 Evidently, manifestly. E. स for सह with, अक्ष the eye, अत to go or to be, aff. क्विप्.
साक्षिता: साक्षिता f. (-ता) Evidence, testimony. E. साक्षिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, साक्षित्वं.
साक्षिन्: साक्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) 1 Witnessing, seeing, an eye-witness. 2 Attesting, testifying, evidence. m. (-क्षी) A witness, (in law.) E. स for सह with, (in presence of,) अक्षि the eye, इनि aff.
साक्षिपरीक्षा: साक्षिपरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Examination of a witness's credibility. E. साक्षिन्, and परीक्षा trial; also साक्षिपरीक्षणं.
साक्षिभावित: साक्षिभावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made known by testimony. E. साक्षिन्, and भावित caused to be perceived or known.
साक्षिमत्: साक्षिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Having or requiring evidence. E. साक्षिन्, and कतुप् aff.
साक्षिलक्षण: साक्षिलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Defined or proved by testimony. E. साक्षिन्, and लक्षण a mark.
साक्ष्य: साक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) Testimony, evidence. E. साक्षिन्, and यत् aff.
साक्ष्यभाव: साक्ष्यभाव m. (-वः) Absence or deficiency of witnesses or testimony. E. साक्षिन्, and अभाव non-existence.
साखेय: साखेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Friendly, amicable. E. सखि a friend, ढञ् aff.
साख्य: साख्य n. (-ख्यं) Friendship. E. सखि a friend, यञ् aff.
सागर: सागर m. (-रः) 1 The ocean. 2 A sort of deer. E. सगर a king, and अण् aff.; to bathe the bones of SAGARA'S 60,000 sons the Ganges is said to have been led by BHAGĪRATHA, his great-great-grandson, to the ocean, at the place now called Gaṅgā-Sāgar.
सागरगामिनी: सागरगामिनी f. (-नी) A river in general. E. सागर the ocean, and गामिनी going to.
सागरनेमि: सागरनेमि f. (-मिः) The earth. E. सागर the sea, and नेमि a circumference; surrounding the earth.
सागरमेखला: सागरमेखला f. (-ला) The earth. E. सागर the ocean, and मेखला a zone.
सागराम्बरा: सागराम्बरा f. (-रा) The earth. E. सागर the ocean, अम्बर vesture.
सागरालय: सागरालय m. (-यः) VARUṆA, deity of the water. E. सागर the ocean, and आलय abode.
सागरोत्थ: सागरोत्थ n. (-त्थं) Sea salt. E. सागर the sea, and उत्थ produced.
साग्निक: साग्निक m. (-कः) A householder, who maintains a sacred fire. E. स with, अग्नि fire, कन् aff.
साङ्कर्य: साङ्कर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Mixture, blending. 2 The concurrence of various properties in one subject. E. सङ्कर mixing, यञ् aff.
साङ्कर्य्य: साङ्कर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Mixture, blending. 2 The concurrence of various properties in one subject. E. सङ्कर mixing, यञ् aff.
साङ्कल: साङ्कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Effected or produced by addition, collection, &c. E. सङ्कल collection, aff. अञ्.
साङ्कुर: साङ्कुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Budding, in bud. E. स with, अङ्कुर a bud.
साङ्क्षेपिक: साङ्क्षेपिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Short, summary, concise, contracted, abridged. E. सङ्क्षेप abridgement, ठक् aff.
साङ्ख्य: साङ्ख्य mfn. (-ङ्ख्यः-ङ्ख्यी-ङ्ख्यं) 1 Numeral, relating to number. 2 Rational, discriminative. m. (-ङ्ख्यः) The Sāṃkhya system of philosophy, ascribed originally to the Muni KAPILA. E. संख्या number, &c., and अण् aff.
साङ्ग: साङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) 1 Having all the members. 2 Comprising all the subdivisions. E. स with, अङ्ग a limb or part.
साङ्गतिक: साङ्गतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Social, associating, relating to or derived from encounter or society. m. (-कः) A visitor. E. सङ्गति acquaintance, ठक् aff.
साङ्गम: साङ्गम m. (-मः) Union, meeting. E. सङ्गम the same, अण् pleonasm.
साङ्ग्रामिक: साङ्ग्रामिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Warlike, martial, &c. m. (-कः) A commander, a general. E. सङ्ग्राम war, ठञ् aff.
साचि: साचि ind. Crookedly, awry, bent. E. षच to collect, इञ् aff.
