साचिविलोकित: साचिविलोकित n. (-तं) A side glance. E. साचि, and विलीकित looked at.
साचिव्य: साचिव्य n. (-व्यं) 1 Ministry, administration. 2 Friendship, fellowship. E. सचिव a friend, यञ् aff.
साचिस्थित: साचिस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Crooked. 2 Standing or placed unevenly. E. साचि, and स्थित stood.
साचीकृत: साचीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made crooked. 2 Seen crookedly or tortuously, distorted, misrepresented. n. (-तं) Prejudice, distortion or perversion of mind. E. साचि crookedly, च्चि aff., कृत made.
साञ्जन: साञ्जन m. (-नः) A lizard, a chameleon. E. स with, अञ्जन unguent.
साटोप: साटोप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Proud, haughty, consequential. n. adv. (-पं) Arrogantly, consequentially. E. स with, आटोप pride.
सात्: सात् n. (सात्) BRAHMA, GOD. E. साति to cause happiness, aff. क्विप्.
सात: सात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Given. 2 Destroyed. n. (-तं) Pleasure, delight. E. सत to give, or षो to destroy, aff. क्त, form irr.: see सित.
सातय: सातय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who or what causes pleasure. E. साति a Sautra root in the causal form, to cause pleasure, श aff.
सातला: सातला f. (-ला) A shrub, commonly Carmaghās. E. सात pleasure, and ला to give, affs. अङ् and टाप्; also शातला.
सातवाहन: सातवाहन m. (-नः) The sovereign SĀLIVĀHANA. E. सात a Gandharba, changed according to the leg end to a lion, on which this prince was discovered riding when a child, and वाहन a vehicle.
साति: साति f. (-तिः) 1 End, conclusion, cessation of action. 2 Destruction. 3 Gift, giving. 4 Sharp pain. E. षो to destroy, or षण् to give, क्तिन् or क्तिच् aff.; also read सति and सन्ति.
सातिसार: सातिसार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dysenteric, afflicted with dysentery. E. स for सह with, अतिसार dysentery.
सातिलक: सातिलक m. (-कः) Peas; also सतीलक, सतीनक, &c.
सात्यकि: सात्यकि m. (-किः) The charioteer of KṚṢṆA.
सात्यवत: सात्यवत m. (-तः) The poet and sage VYĀSA. E. सत्यवती the mother of the bard, and अण् aff.; also with ढक्, aff. सात्यवतेय.
सात्वत्: सात्वत् m. (-त्वान्) 1 A worshipper, a follower. 2 A man of the Yādava tribe. E. साति to cause happiness, वतु participial aff.
सात्वत: सात्वत m. (-तः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 BALADEVA. m. plu. (-ताः) The people of one of the countries of midland India, apparently inhabiting a district in the vicinity of the Pārijātra mountains, said to be descendants from outcaste Vaiśyas. f. (-ती) 1 One of the four great divisions of the drama, described as the representation of gentle and amiable sentiments or passions. 2 The mother of ŚIŚUPĀLA. E. सत्वत a proper name, &c., अण् aff.
सात्विक: सात्विक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Spontaneous, sincere, (as applied to the actions or signs of the Sātvika Bhāva.) 2 Relating to or proceeding from the Sattva quality, honest, true, good, gentle, amiable, &c. m. (-कः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 One of the Bhāvas or classes into which the affections of the mind or their expression, are distinguished, in poetry and the drama: this class holds a middle place between the Sthāyi, and Vyabhicāri Bhāvas, and implies the honest and spontaneous indication of strong feeling, as evinced especially in eight acts, viz. inability to move whilst the faculties or limbs are unaffected, perspiration, horripilation, inarticulate speech, trembling or tremor, change of colour, tears, and mental absorption or indifference, approaching to loss of sense, to every object but one which engrosses the attention. f. (-की) DURGĀ. E. सत्व the Sattva Guṇa or quality, and ठक् aff.
साद: साद m. (-दः) 1 Purity, cleanness. 2 Lassitude, weariness, exhaustion. 3 Perishing, decay. E. षट् to decay, to be weary, &c., aff. घञ्.
सादन: सादन n. (-नं) 1 A house, a dwelling. 2 Dispelling. 3 Destroying. 4 Wearying, exhausting. 5 Exhaustion, decay. E. षद to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
सादयत्: सादयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Destroying. 2 Exhausting. 3 Expelling, removing, extracting. E. षद to go, causal v., शतृ aff.
सादयितव्य: सादयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be destroyed. E. षद to go, causal v., तव्य aff.
सादर: सादर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Respectful. n. adv. (-रं) Respectfully. E. स with, आदर respect.
सादि: सादि m. (-दिः) 1 A charioteer. 2 A warrior. E. षद to be weary, &c., इञ् Uṇādi aff.
सादित: सादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Destroyed, exterminated. 2 Wearied, exhausted, harassed. 3 Wasted, decayed. 4 Broken, cut. 5 Drawn, dragged. E. षद to go, &c., aff. क्त.
सादिन्: सादिन् m. (-दी) 1 A horseman, a cavalier. 2 One who rides on an elephant. 3 One who rides on or is mounted in a car. E. षद to go, aff. णिनि.
सादृश्य: सादृश्य n. (-श्यं) Resemblance, similarity. E. सदृश like, यञ् aff.
साद्यस्क: साद्यस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Quick, instantaneous. E. सद्यस्, and वुञ् aff.
साध: साध (उ) साधु r. 4th cl. (साध्यति) (औ) साधौ r. 5th cl. (साध्नोति) To finish, to perfect, to complete, or accomplish; also षाध.
साधक: साधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Completing, perfecting, finishing, who or what effects or completes. E. साघ to finish, ण्वुल् aff.
साधन: साधन n. (-नं) 1 Accomplishing, effecting. 2 Matter, materials, that of which any thing is composed or consists. 3 Thing, substance. 4 Means, expedient. 5 Instrument, agent. 6 Authority. 7 The premises leading to a conclusion. 8 Cause. 9 Going, motion. 10 Following. 11 Killing, destroying. 12 Obsequies, ceremonies observed after the death of a relative. 13 Drug, medicament. 14 Wealth. 15 An army. 16 The penis. 17 Friendship. 18 Enforcement of the delivery of any thing, especially juridically, as the infliction and levy of a fine, &c. 19 Killing metals, depriving them (especially mercury) by oxidation, &c. of their metallic properties, for medicinal or alchemical purposes. 20 Good works, or the observance of the moral and ceremonial parts of the Hindu religion, as secondary means of obtaining purity and emancipation. 21 Proof, substantiation. E. षाघ to accomplish, aff. ल्युट्.
साधननिर्देश: साधननिर्द्देश m. (-शः) Production or indicative of proof (in law). 2 Establishment of premises, leading to a conclusion. E. साधन proof, &c., and निर्द्देश pointing out.
साधननिर्द्देश: साधननिर्द्देश m. (-शः) Production or indicative of proof (in law). 2 Establishment of premises, leading to a conclusion. E. साधन proof, &c., and निर्द्देश pointing out.
साधनीय: साधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Perfective, to be perfected, accomplished, proved. E. साध to complete, अनीयर् aff.
साधन्त: साधन्त m. (-न्तः) A beggar, a mendicant. E. षाध to accomplish, Uṇādi aff. झच्.
साधयत्: साधयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Perfecting, accomplishing. 2 Purifying. 3 Proving. 4 Recovering, (as a debt.) E. षाध to accomplish, शतृ aff.
साधर्म्म्य: साधर्म्म्य n. (-र्म्म्यं) Community of duty, office, property, &c. E. सधर्म्म of one duty, ष्यञ् aff.
साधारण: साधारण mfn. (-णः-णा-णी-णं) 1 Like, similar. 2 Common, belonging to all or many. 3 Generic. n. (-णं) 1 A common rule or precept, one applicable to many persons or things. 2 A specific or generic character, one common to all the individuals of a species, or all the species of a genus, &c. f. (-णी) A small bolt or bar. E. स for सह with, धारण a having, aff. अच्.
साधारणधर्म: साधारणधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Common or universal duty, conduct to be observed by all castes or orders, as humanity, &c. E. साधारण general, and धर्म्म merit, duty.
साधारणधर्म्म: साधारणधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Common or universal duty, conduct to be observed by all castes or orders, as humanity, &c. E. साधारण general, and धर्म्म merit, duty.
साधारणस्त्री: साधारणस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A whore. E. साधारण common, and स्त्री a woman.
साधारण्य: साधारण्य n. (-ण्यं) Community, universality. E. साधारण, and यञ् aff.
साधिका: साधिका f. (-का) Deep or sound sleep. E. साध to finish, aff. वुन्, fem. form.
साधित: साधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Amerced, fined, punished by fine, (as the culprit.) 2 Awarded, (as the thing or fine.) 3 Awarded to or in favour of, (as the person to whom the fine is to be paid.) 4 Recovered, (as a debt.) 5 Accomplished, finished. 6 Discharged, fulfilled. 7 Conferred, bestowed, enabled to procure or effect. E. साध to accomplish, क्त aff., with इट् augment.
साधिदैव: साधिदैव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) One with supreme divinity. E. स with, अधिदैव superintending godhead.
साधिभूत: साधिभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Identified or one with elementary essence. E. स with, अधिभूत essential matter.
साधियज्ञ: साधियज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) One with the Supreme Being. E. स with, अधियज्ञ the object of sacrifice.
साधिष्ठ: साधिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Very hard. 2 Very fit, proper, or right. E. साधु good, or considered as irregularly substituted for वाढ heavy, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative; also with इयसुन्, aff. साधीयस्.
साधीयस्: साधीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very right or proper. 2 Very hard or firm. 3 Very handsome. E. see the last.
साधु: साधु mfn. (-धुः-धुः-ध्वी-धु) 1 Pleasing, beautiful. 2 Well-born, of honorable descent. 3 Right, fit, proper. 4 Good, virtuous, pious, pure. 5 Pure, classical, (as applied to language.) 6 Excellent, good. 7 Eminent. m. (-धुः) 1 A Muni, a saint, a sage in general, one of subdued passions and contemplative habits. 2 A Jina, a deified saint venerated by the Jainas. 3 A usurer. 4 A derivative or inflected noun. f. (-धुः or ध्वी) A virtuous wife. E. साध to accomplish or perfect, Uṇādi aff. उण्.
साधुक: साधुक m. (-कः) A low or degraded tribe. E. कन् added to the preceding.
साधुज: साधुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Well-born, of respectable family or descent. E. साधु the same, and ज born.
साधुत्व: साधुत्व n. (-त्वं) Goodness, correctness. E. त्व added to साधु; also with तल्, साधुता.
साधुधी: साधुधी f. (-धीः) A wife's or husband's mother. E. साधु pious, धा to have, affs. क and ङीष्.
साधुपुष्प: साधुपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) E. साधु pure, पुष्प a flower.
साधुम्मन्य: साधुम्मन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Thinking one's self pure or virtuous. E. साधु, and मन to think, खश् aff.
साधुवाहिन्: साधुवाहिन् m. (-ही) A well trained horse. E. साधु agreeable, pleasing, वाह bearing, and इनि aff.
साधुवृक्ष: साधुवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea Cadamba.) E. साधु handsome or excellent, and वृक्ष a tree.
साधुवृत्त: साधुवृत्त m. (-त्तः) A virtuous or pious person. n. (-त्तं) Virtue, piety. E. साधु, and वृत्त practice.
साधुवृत्ति: साधुवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Virtuous. f. (-त्तिः) The institutes or moral and ritual observances of the Hindus. E. साधु excellent, वृत्ति practice.
साधुशील: साधुशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Virtuous, righteous, wisely or virtuously inclined. E. साधु, and शील disposition.
साधुशीलत्व: साधुशीलत्व n. (-त्वं) Virtuous or righteous inclination or disposition. E. साधुशील, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, साधुशीलता.
साधूक्त: साधूक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Said or declared by the good. E. साधु, and उक्त said.
साधृत: साधृत n. (-तं) 1 A flock of peacocks. 2 A stall, a shop. 3 An umbrella or parasol. E. स for सह with, आधृत held.
साध्य: साध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 To be perfected or accomplished. 2 Accomplishable, attainable. 3 To be inferred or concluded, (in logic.) 4 To be proved or demonstrated. 5 To be cured, curable, (in medicine.) m. (-ध्यः) An inferior deity or demigod, one of a class of twelve. 2 A deity in general. 3 The twenty-second astronomical Yoga. n. (-ध्यं) 1 Accomplishment, perfection. 2 (In law,) The matter in debate, the thing to be proved. 3 (In logic,) The subject of the proposition. E. साध to accomplish, ण्यत् aff.
साध्यमान: साध्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being subjected to, or capable, or in course of proof. 2 Being in course of accomplishment. 3 Being proceeded against, (at law.) E. षाध to accomplish, pass. v., शानच् aff.
साध्यवत्: साध्यवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Comprehending that which is to be proved. m. (-वान्) (In law,) The party on whom rests the onus probandi. E. साध्य, and मतुप् poss. aff.
साध्यसाधन: साध्यसाधन n. (-नं) Effecting what is to be or may be done, &c. E. साध्य, and साधन accomplishing.
साध्यसिद्धि: साध्यसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Proof, conclusion, the establishing of that which was to be proved. 2 Completion, accomplishment, fulfilment. E. साध्य to be effected, &c., and सिद्धि perfection.
साध्यसिद्धिपाद: साध्यसिद्धिपाद m. (-दः) The fourth stage or division of a suit at law, judgment or decision. E. साध्य to be proved, सिद्धि conclusion, and पाद division.
साध्याभाव: साध्याभाव m. (-वः) 1 Absence of the thing to be proved. 2 Absence of the subject of a proposition. 3 Impossibility of cure. E. साध्य, and अभाव non-existence.
साध्वनिन्दित: साध्वनिन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unreproached, irreproachable. E. साधु the pious, and अनिन्दित not reproved.
साध्वस: साध्वस n. (-सं) Fear, terror. E. साधु a pious man, अस to throw or disperse, aff. अङ्.
साध्वाचार: साध्वाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Virtuous. E. साधु, and आचार observance.
सानन्द: सानन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Happy, delighted, enjoying and endowed with happiness. E. स with, आनन्द happiness.
सानल: सानल m. (-लः) The resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. स with, अनल fire.
सानसि: सानसि m. (-सिः) Gold. E. षण to give, Uṇādi aff. असि, and the radical vowel made long.
सानिका: सानिका f. (-का) A flute, a pipe. E. षण to give (pleasure), वुन् aff.
सानु: सानु mn. (-नुः-नु) 1 Table land, level ground on the top or edge of a mountain. 2 A wood. 3 A road. 4 A gale of wind. 5 Point, end, top. 6 A sage, a learned man or Paṇḍita. 7 A shoot, a sprout. 8 The sun. E. षण to give (pleasure,) Uṇādi aff. ञुण्.
सानुकम्प: सानुकम्प mfn. (-म्पः-म्पा-म्पं) Sympathizing, kind. E. स with, अनुकम्पा kindness.
सानुक्रोश: सानुक्रोश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Compassionate. E. स with, अनुक्रोश compassion.
सानुनय: सानुनय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Willing, civil, kind. n. (-यं) Kindly, civilly. E. स with, अनुनय assent.
सानुमत्: सानुमत् m. (-मान्) A mountain. E. सानु a summit, and मतुप् aff.
सानुराग: सानुराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Attached, passionate, impassioned. E. स with, अनुराग affection.
सानेयिका: सानेयिका f. (-का) A flute, or pipe. E. कन् added to सानेयी.
सानेयी: सानेयी f. (-यी) A flute, a pipe, a fife.
सान्तपन: सान्तपन n. (-नं) 1 A sort of penance; the lighter kind is feeding on a mixture of curds, &c. for one day and fasting the next; the severer is feeding six successive days, severally, on the same articles, or on cow's urine, cow's ordure, milk, curds, Ghee, and water in which Kuśa grass has been steeped, and fasting on the seventh. E. सम् completely, तपन austerity, अण् added.
सान्तर: सान्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) With intervals, or interstices, E. स for सह with, अन्तर between.
सान्तराल: सान्तराल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Separated, distinct from, apart. E. स with, अन्तराल interval.
सान्तानिक: सान्तानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Expansive, (as a shrub, &c.) 2 Relating to descendants, posterity, &c. m. (-कः) A Brahman intending to marry for the sake of issue. E. सन्तान, and ठक् aff.
सान्त्व: सान्त्व r. 10th cl. (सान्त्वयति) 1 To appease, to conciliate. 2 To comfort; also षान्त्व.
सान्त्व mn. (-न्त्वः-न्त्वं) 1 Conciliation, reconciling, appeasing. 2 Pleasing and conciliatory language. 3 Cleverness, dexterity. E. सान्त्व to console or appease, अच् aff.
सान्त्वन: सान्त्वन n. (-नं) Conciliation, reconcilement. nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Friendly or affectionate salutation and enquiry. 2 Speaking in a kindly and conciliatory manner. E. सान्त्व to console or appease, aff. युच्.
सान्त्वयत्: सान्त्वयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Consoling, appeasing. E. सान्त्व to console, शतृ aff.
सान्त्ववाद: सान्त्ववाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Speaking in a kindly and affectionate manner. E. सान्त्व affection, and वाद speech, (whose.)
सान्दृष्टिक: सान्दृष्टिक n. (-कं) Immediate consequence. E. सम् with, दृष्टि sight, present perception, ठञ् aff.
सान्द्र: सान्द्र mfn. (-न्द्रः-न्द्रा-न्द्रं) 1 Thick, coarse, gross. 2 Soft, bland. 3 Pleasing, agreeable. 4 Much, abundant. 5 Unctuous, oily. 6 Close, compact, but having interstices. 7 Stout, robust. 8 Clustering, collected. n. (-न्द्र) 1 A wood, a thicket. 2 A heap, a cluster. E. स for सह with, together, अदि to bind, रक् aff.
सान्द्रता: सान्द्रता f. (-ता) Thickness, grossness, viscidity. E. सान्द्र, and तल् added; also with त्व, सान्द्रत्व.
सान्द्रपुष्प: सान्द्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) Beleric myrobalan. E. सान्द्र thick, and पुष्प a flower.
सान्द्रस्निग्ध: सान्द्रस्निग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Thick and unctuous. E. सान्द्र thick, and स्निग्ध unctuous.
सान्धिक: सान्धिक m. (-कः) A distiller. E. सन्धा distilling, ठञ् aff.
सान्ध्य: सान्ध्य mfn. (-न्ध्यः-न्ध्यी-न्ध्यं) Produced at or relating to the evening, &c. E. सन्ध्या twilight, अण् aff.
सान्नहनिक: सान्नहनिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Calling to arms, sounding, (as an alarum, &c.) 2 Bearing or putting on armour. m. (-कः) A squire, an armour-bearer. E. सन्नाहन arming, ठक् aff. implying relation or causation.
सान्नाय्य: सान्नाय्य n. (-य्यं) An intended oblation, the thing to be offered with fire, usually clarified butter. E. सम् before णी to bring, (to the sacrificial fire,) ण्यत् aff., form irr.
सान्निध्य: सान्निध्य n. (-ध्यं) Proximity, vicinity. E. सन्निध near, यञ् aff.
सान्निपातिक: सान्निपातिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Complicated, (as disease,) relating to the morbid state of the three humors collectively. 2 Miscellaneous, promiscuous, collective. E. सन्निपात collection, mixture, aff. ठञ्.
सान्वय: सान्वय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Related or of kin to. 2 In connexion with family or descendants. 3 In order or succession. E. स with, अन्वय descendants.
सान्न्यासिक: सान्न्यासिक m. (-कः) A beggar, a Brahman of the fourth or mendicant order. E. सन्न्यास abandonment, (of the world,) ठक् aff.
सापत्न्य: सापत्न्य m. (-त्न्यः) An enemy. n. (-त्न्यं) Plurality of wives, or the -condition of the wife of one who has other wives. E. सपत्नी a fellow-wife, or सपत्न an enemy, ष्यञ् pleonasm or aff. of the abstract.
सापत्य: सापत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Having progeny. E. स with, अपत्य offspring.
सापराध: सापराध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Faulty, offending. E. स with, अपराध fault.
सापिण्ड्य: सापिण्ड्य n. (-ण्ड्यं) Consanguinity, kindred, connexion, by presenting obsequial offerings to the same persons. E. सपिण्ड, and ष्यञ् aff.
साप्तपदीन: साप्तपदीन n. (-नं) Friendship. E. सप्त seven, पद a step or pace, and खञ् aff.; to be formed with any with whom seven paces are walked together.
साप्तपौरुष: साप्तपौरुष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Extending to seven generations, &c. E. सप्त seven, पुरुष male, अञ् aff.
साफल्य: साफल्य n. (-ल्यं) Productiveness, fruitfulness. E. स with, फल fruit, प्यञ् aff.
साब्दी: साब्दी f. (-ब्दी) A sort of grape.
साभ्यसूय: साभ्यसूय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Envious, malicious. E. स with, अभ्यसूया malice.
साम: साम r. 10th cl. (सामयति) 1 To conciliate, to appease. 2 To pacify, to tranquillize.
सामक: सामक n. (-कं) The principal of a debt, &c. E. सम equal, वुञ् aff.
सामक m. (-कः) A whet-stone. E. षो to pare or whet, वुन् aff., form irr.
सामग: सामग m. (-गः) A Brahman who chants or recites the Sāma Veda. f. (-गी) The wife of a Sāma Veda Brahman. E. साम the Sāma Veda, गै to sing, ड aff.
सामग्र्य: सामग्र्य nf. (-ग्र्यं-ग्री) 1 Entireness, wholeness, the whole. 2 Train, retinue. 3 Implements, instruments, apparatus. 4 Stock, effects. E. समग्र all, whole, and ष्यञ् aff.
सामज: सामज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Producing from or produced by the Sāma Veda. m. (-जः) An elephant. E. साम the Veda, and ज born; also सामजात, &c.
सामञ्चस्य: सामञ्चस्य n. (-स्यं) Fitness, accordance, propriety. E. समञ्जस, and यञ् aff.
सामन्: सामन् n. (-म) The Sāma Veda, the third of the four Vedas, the prayers of which composed in metre, are always sung or chanted: the Chāndogya Upaniṣad belongs to this Veda. 2 Conciliation, reconciling, appeasing. 3 Calming, tranquillizing. 4 Speaking kindly or tenderly. f. (-नी) A rope, for tying cattle. E. षो to destroy, (sin,) Uṇādi aff. मनिन्, and ङीष् added for the fem. form.
सामन्त: सामन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) 1 Limitative, boundary, bounding. 2 Bordering, neighbouring. m. (-न्तः) 1 The chief of a district. 2 A neighbour. 3 An attendant or companion of a chieftain, a leader, a captain, a champion. n. (-न्तं) Neighbourhood. E. समन्त end, term, अण् aff. of relation.
सामन्तवासिन्: सामन्तवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Dwelling in the borders, bordering, neighbouring. E. सामन्त, and वासिन् who abides.
सामन्य: सामन्य m. (-न्यः) A Brahman conversant with the Sāma Veda. E. सामन्, and यत् aff.
सामय: सामय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Sick, diseased. E. स with, आमय sickness.
सामयिक: सामयिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Seasonable, punctual, observing time or season. 2 Precise, exact, stipulated, according to agreement. 3 Conventional, customary. E. समय time or engagement, ठञ् or ठक् aff. of relation or possession.
सामयोनि: सामयोनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Born from or produced by the Sāma. m. (-निः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 An elephant. E. सामन् the Veda, and योनि place of birth.
सामर्थ्य: सामर्थ्य n. (-र्थ्यं) 1 Power, strength. 2 Fitness, suitableness. 3 Ability, adequacy. 4 (In grammar,) Mutual relation of words. 5 Sense or force of words. E. समर्थ able, ष्यञ् aff.
सामर्ष: सामर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) Enraged, in wrath. E. स with, अमर्ष anger.
सामवायिक: सामवायिक m. (-कः) 1 A principal minister or counsellor. 2 The chief of a company or corporation. E. समवाय an assembly, ठक् aff.
सामसंगायक: सामसंगायक m. (-कः) A chanter of the Sāma Veda. E. साम, and सङ्गायक chanter.
सामाजिक: सामाजिक m. (-कः) An assistant or spectator at an assembly, &c. E. समाज an assembly, and ठक् aff.
सामानाधिकरण्य: सामानाधिकरण्य n. (-ण्यं) 1 Common office, function, government, &c. 2 The receptacle or substratum of common properties. E. समानाधिकरण, and यञ् aff.
सामान्य: सामान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Common, general, generic, universal. n. (-न्यं) 1 Kind, sort, specific or generic property or character. 2 Common property, generality, community. 3 Public affairs or business. 4 Totality, entireness. 5 A figure of rhetoric, the connexion of different objects by common properties. f. (-न्या) A female who is common to all men, a harlot. E. समान common, (to many individuals,) यञ् aff.
सामान्यलक्षण: सामान्यलक्षण n. (-णं) A generic or specific character. E. सामान्य, and लक्षण mark or description.
सामान्यशासन: सामान्यशासन n. (-नं) A general edict or enactment. E. सामान्य common, and शासन a grant, an edict, &c.
सामासिक: सामासिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Compounded, composite. 2 Comprehensive, collective. 3 Brief, summary. E. समास, and ठक् aff. of relation.
सामि: सामि ind. 1 Half. 2 Blameably. E. षाम for षान्त्व to appease, अच् added, and इ substituted for the final.
सामिकृत: सामिकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Halved, divided. E. सामि half, and कृत made.
सामिभुक्त: सामिभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Half eaten. E. सामि half, and भुक्त eaten.
सामिपीत: सामिपीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Half drank. E. सामि half, and पीत drank.
सामिधेन्य: सामिधेन्य m. (-न्यः) A Mantra or mystical prayer, &c. f. (-नी) 1 A prayer used on adding fuel to the sacrificial fire. 2 Fuel. E. समिध् fuel, aff. षेण्यण्.
सामीप्य: सामीप्य n. (-प्यं) Proximity, nearness. E. समीप near, ष्यञ् aff.
सामुद्र: सामुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) Marine, sea, sea-born, &c. n. (-द्रं) 1 A spot or mark on the body. 2 Sea salt. 3 Cuttle-fish bone. m. (-द्रः) A mariner, a voyager. E. समुद्र the sea, and अण् aff.
सामुद्रिक: सामुद्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to spots on the body, or the circumstance of good or ill fortune supposed to be indicated by them. m. (-कः) 1 An interpreter of spots on the body. 2 A work on the same subject. E. समुद्र a spot or mole, ठक् aff.
सामोद: सामोद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Fragrant, odoriferous. E. स with, आमोद fragrance.
साम्नी: साम्नी f. (-म्नी) A sort of metre, one of the classes occurring in the Vedas. E. सामन the Sāma Veda, and ङीप् aff.
साम्परायिक: साम्परायिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Future, of or in a future state of being. 2 Calamitous. 3 Relating to war or battle. n. (-कं) War, battle. E. सम्पराय futurity, &c., and ठक् or ठञ् aff.
साम्प्रतम्: साम्प्रतम् ind. 1 Now, at this time. 2 Fitly, properly. E. सम् and प्र before तन to spread, aff. डम्, and the first vowel made long.
साम्ब: साम्ब r. 10th cl. (साम्बयति) To join, to connect, to assemble; also सम्ब.
साम्बरी: साम्बरी f. (-री) A female juggler. E. see शाम्बरी; the श being changed.
साम्भस्: साम्भस् mfn. (-म्भाः-म्भाः-म्भः) Having or being united with water. E. स with, अम्भस् water.
साम्य: साम्य n. (-म्यं) 1 Equality, sameness. 2 Likeness, similarity. E. सम same, and यञ् aff.
साम्यता: साम्यता f. (-ता) Equality, sameness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, साम्यत्वं.
साम्राज्य: साम्राज्य n. (-ज्यं) Imperial rule, dominion, empire. m. (-ज्यः) The descendant of a prince or man of the military tribe. E. सम्राज् an emperor, ष्यञ् aff. of the abstract, or ण्य patronymic aff.
साय: साय m. (-यः) 1 Evening, close of day. 2 An arrow. 3 End, close in general. E. षो to end or destroy, &c., घञ् aff.
सायंकाल: सायंकाल m. (-लः) Eventide, evening. E. सायम् evening, and काल time.
सायक: सायक m. (-कः) 1 An arrow. 2 A sword. f. (-यिका) Standing in order. E. षो to destroy, ण्वुल् aff.
सायन: सायन n. (-नं) The longitude of a planet reckoned from the vernal equinoctial point. E. स with, अयन the equinoctial period.
सायन्तन: सायन्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging to the evening. E. साय evening, and द्यु aff.
सायम्: सायम् ind. Evening, close of the day, in the evening. See साय.
सायमण्डन: सायमण्डन n. (-नं) The place or time of sunset. E. साय, and मण्डन embellishing.
सायाह्न: सायाह्न m. (-ह्नः) The evening, eventide. E. सायम् evening, and अहन् day.
सायिन्: सायिन् m. (-यी) A horseman, a groom. E. स for सह with, अय to go, णिनि aff.
सायुज्य: सायुज्य n. (-ज्यं) 1 Likeness, similarity. 2 Identification, intimate union, (especially with the Deity.) E. स with, युज what joins, ष्यञ् aff.
साये: साये ind. In the evening, at the close of the day. E. साय evening, the seventh case, used as a particle.
सार: सार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Best, excellent. 2 Irrefragable, (as an argument.) m. (-रः) 1 The pith or sap of trees, &c. 2 Strength, vigour. 3 The essence of any things, the essential or vital part of it. 4 The substance or material part (of a speech, book, message, &c.) 5 Marrow. 6 Air, wind. 7 Sickness, disease. 8 Firmness, hardness. 9 The coagulum of curds, &c. cream. 10 Fresh butter. 11 Prowess, valour, heroism. m. (-रः-री) A man at chess, backgammon, &c. n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Wealth. 3 Properity, fitness. 4 Steel. 5 (In rhetoric,) Climax. f. (-रा) Dūrbbā grass. (-री) The Shalik or Sārikā, (Turdus salica, BUC.) E. सृ to go, aff. घञ्.
सारगन्ध: सारगन्ध m. (-न्धः) Sandal wood. E. सार essence, and गन्ध smell.
सारघ: सारघ n. (-घं) Honey. E. सरधा a bee, and अण् aff.
सारङ्ग: सारङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Variegated, of a variegated colour. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Variegated colour. 2 A lion. 3 An elephant. 4 A deer. 5 The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 6 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. 7 A large kind of crane, (Ardea Sarunga, CAREY.) 8 A peacock. 9 A cloud. 10 A tree. 11 A parasol. 12 A garment, cloth, cloths. 13 Hair. 14 A lotus. 15 A flower. 16 A conch shell. 17 A jewel. 18 Gold. 19 A bow. 20 KĀMADEVA. 21 Sandal. 22 Camphor. 23 The earth. 24 Night. 25 Light. f. (-ङ्गी) A sort of fiddle. E. सृ to go, अङ्गच् Uṇādi aff., or सार strength, &c., गम to go, खच् aff.; also शारङ्ग.
सारङ्गिक: सारङ्गिक m. (-कः) A bird or deer-catcher, &c. E. सारङ्ग as above, and ठक् aff.
सारज: सारज n. (-जं) Fresh butter. E. सार cream, and ज produced.
सारण: सारण m. (-णः) 1 Dysentery, diarrhoea. 2 Hog-plum, (Spondias mangifera.) 3 A counsellor and embassador from RĀVAṆA to RĀMA. f. (-णी) 1 A plant, (Pæderia fetida.) 2 A canal, a small river. E. सृ to go, (causal form,) ल्युद aff.
सारणि: सारणि f. (-णिः) 1 A small river. 2 A plant, (Pæderia fetida.) 3 A drain, a canal or water-pipe. E. सृ to go, (causal form,) अनि Uṇādi aff.
सारणिक: सारणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Travelling, way-faring, &c. m. (-कः) A traveller. E. सरणि a road, and ठञ् aff.
सारणिकघ्न: सारणिकघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A robber. E. सारणिक a traveller, and घ्न who kills.
सारण्ड: सारण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A snake's egg. E. सृ to go, (causal form,) अण्डन् aff.
सारतरु: सारतरु m. (-रुः) The plantain tree, (Musa sapientum.) E. सांर sap, तरु a tree, having no timber in the stem.
सारतस्: सारतस् ind. By or with vigour or essence, vigorously, essentially. E. सार, and तसि aff.
सारता: सारता f. (-ता) 1 Strength, substance. 2 Essence. E. सार, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, सारत्वं.
सारथि: सारथि m. (-थिः) A charioteer. E. सृ to go, (causal form,) अथिन् Uṇādi aff.
सारथ्य: सारथ्य n. (-थ्यं) 1 Charioteering, driving. 2 Conveyance. E. सारथि, and यञ् aff.
सारदा: सारदा f. (-दा) 1 A name of SARASVATĪ. 2 A name of DURGĀ. E. सार essence, (of wisdom and eloquence,) दा to give, अङ् and टाप् affs.
सारभङ्ग: सारभङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Void of pith, substance, real strength, &c. n. (-ङ्गं) Destroying vigour, overcoming strength, &c. E. सार, and भङ्ग a breaking.
सारभाण्ड: सारभाण्ड n. (-ण्डः) A natural vessel, as the bag or skin in which musk is sold, &c. E. सार essence, and भाण्ड a vessel.
सारमेय: सारमेय m. (-यः) A dog. f. (-यी) A bitch. E. सरमा a bitch, ढक् aff.
सारयोग: सारयोग m. (-गः) Possession or application of the essence of any thing. E. सार, and योग union.
सारलोह: सारलोह n. (-हं) Steel. E. सार, the same, and लोह iron.
सारव: सारव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Belonging or relating to the Saryu river. E. सरयु the river, अण् aff., form special.
सारवत्: सारवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Substantial, having pith, substance, strength, &c. E. सार, and मतुप् aff.
सारवर्जित: सारवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pithless, sapless. E. सार substance, and वर्ज्जित deprived of.
सारवर्ज्जित: सारवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pithless, sapless. E. सार substance, and वर्ज्जित deprived of.
सारस: सारस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Relating or belonging to a lake or pond, &c. n. (-सं) 1 A lotus. 2 A woman's zone. mf. (-सः-सी) The Sāras or Indian crane, male and female, (Ardea Sibirica.) m. (-सः) The moon. E. सरस् a pond, a lake, अण् aff.
सारसन: सारसन n. (-नं) 1 A woman's zone or girdle, formed of twentyfive strings. 2 A military belt or girdle, worn round the waist or chest, upon the coat of mail, to bind it to the body. E. सार strength, and षण to give, aff. अच्, or अस to diffuse, aff. ल्युट्.
सारस्वत: सारस्वत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) 1 Relating to the goddess SARASVATĪ, or to the river, &c. 2 Eloquent, learned. m. plu. (-ताः) 1 The people of the Saraswata country, or the north-west part of the province of Delhni. m. (-तः) 1 A staff of the Vilva tree. 2 The north-west part of the province of Delhi or part of the Punjab. 3 A saint, sprung according to the legend, indirectly from the personified Sarasvatī river. 4 A Brahman of a particular family, called Sārasvata, from his coming from that country, or supposed descent from the sanctified person last mentioned. E. सरस्वती the goddess, and अण् aff.
सारासार: सारासार m. (-रः) Strength and weakness, substance and emptiness, &c. E. सार, and असार want of vigour.
सारि: सारि mf. (-रिः-री) A man at chess or backgammon, &c. E. सृ to go, causal form, इन् aff.; also शारि.
सारिका: सारिका f. (-का) A kind of bird, (Turdus Salica, BUC.) but applied also to the Maina, (Gracula religiosa.) E. सृ to go, aff. ण्वुल, also शारिका.
सारिवा: सारिवा f. (-वा) A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens.) E. see शारिवा.
सारूप्य: सारूप्य n. (-प्यं) 1 Identity of form. 2 Close resemblance. 3 (In the drama,) Surprise at seeing an object or its likeness previously seen elsewhere. E. स with, रूप form, यञ् aff.
सार्थ: सार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Opulent, wealthy. 2 Of like meaning or purport. 3 Significant, importing, having meaning. m. (-र्थः) 1 A multitude of similar animals. 2 A company of traders, a caravan, &c. 3 A number or multitude in general. 4 A wealthy man. E. सृ to go, causal form, थन् Uṇādi aff., or स for सह, &c., and अर्थ wealth, or meaning.
सार्थवत्: सार्थवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Meaning, intending. 2 Numerous in company. E. सार्थ, and मतुप् aff.
सार्थवाह: सार्थवाह m. (-हः) 1 A merchant, a trader. 2 The leader of a caravan. E. सार्थ a company, a caravan, and वह to bear, aff. अण्.
सार्थिक: सार्थिक m. (-कः) A merchant, a trader. E. सार्थ, and ठक् aff.
सार्द्र: सार्द्र mfn. (-र्द्रः-र्द्रा-र्द्रं) Wet, moist, damp. E. स for सह with, and आर्द्र wet.
सार्द्ध: सार्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धी-र्द्धं) Joined with half, (used chiefly in composition, as सार्द्धशतं a hundred and a half, i. e. fifty. E. स with, अर्द्ध half.
सार्द्धम्: सार्द्धम् ind. With, together with. E. स for सह with, ऋद्ध increased.
सार्पिष: सार्पिष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Dressed, &c. with Ghee or clarified butter. E. सर्पिस् Ghee, अण् aff.
सार्पिष्क: सार्पिष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) Cooked or dressed with Ghee or clarified butter. E. सर्पिस् Ghee, ठक् aff.
सार्प: सार्प्प mfn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पी-र्प्पं) Relating to a snake. f. (-र्प्पी) The ninth lunar asterism, of which the serpents are the presiding deities. E. सर्प्प a snake, and अण् aff.
सार्प्प: सार्प्प mfn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पी-र्प्पं) Relating to a snake. f. (-र्प्पी) The ninth lunar asterism, of which the serpents are the presiding deities. E. सर्प्प a snake, and अण् aff.
सार्व: सार्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) Suitable to or fit for all, relating to all, &c. m. (-र्व्वः) A Jina or Jaina deified sage. E. सर्व्व all (knowledge, &c.), and अण् aff.
सार्व्व: सार्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) Suitable to or fit for all, relating to all, &c. m. (-र्व्वः) A Jina or Jaina deified sage. E. सर्व्व all (knowledge, &c.), and अण् aff.
सार्वकालिक: सार्व्वकालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of all times or seasons. E. सर्व्वकाल, and ठञ् aff.
सार्व्वकालिक: सार्व्वकालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of all times or seasons. E. सर्व्वकाल, and ठञ् aff.
सार्वजनिक: सार्व्वजनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging, fit or suited to all men. E. सर्व्वजन all men, ठञ् aff.
सार्व्वजनिक: सार्व्वजनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging, fit or suited to all men. E. सर्व्वजन all men, ठञ् aff.
सार्वजनीन: सार्व्वजनीन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging or relating, fit or suited to all men, &c. E. सर्व्वजन all mankind, and खञ् aff.
सार्व्वजनीन: सार्व्वजनीन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging or relating, fit or suited to all men, &c. E. सर्व्वजन all mankind, and खञ् aff.
सार्वत्रिक: सार्व्वत्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Suited to, or belonging to every place. E. सर्व्वच every where, ठक् aff.
सार्व्वत्रिक: सार्व्वत्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Suited to, or belonging to every place. E. सर्व्वच every where, ठक् aff.
सार्वदैवत्य: सार्व्वदैवत्य mfn. (-त्यः-ती-त्यं) Presided over by, or sacred to all the gods. E. सर्व्व, देवता a god, यञ् aff.
सार्व्वदैवत्य: सार्व्वदैवत्य mfn. (-त्यः-ती-त्यं) Presided over by, or sacred to all the gods. E. सर्व्व, देवता a god, यञ् aff.
सार्वधातुक: सार्व्वधातुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Applicable to the whole of a radical term, (an affix, &c.) E. सर्व्व, and धातु a root, ठक् aff.
सार्व्वधातुक: सार्व्वधातुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Applicable to the whole of a radical term, (an affix, &c.) E. सर्व्व, and धातु a root, ठक् aff.
सार्वभौतिक: सार्व्वभौतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to all elements, being, &c. E. सर्व्वभूत, and ठञ् aff.
सार्व्वभौतिक: सार्व्वभौतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to all elements, being, &c. E. सर्व्वभूत, and ठञ् aff.
सार्वभौम: सार्व्वभौम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Relating to or consisting of the whole earth, known throughout the earth, &c. m. (-मः) 1 The elephant of KUVERA, as regent of the north. 2 An emperor, a universal monarch. E. सर्व्व all, भूमि earth, and अण् aff.
सार्व्वभौम: सार्व्वभौम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Relating to or consisting of the whole earth, known throughout the earth, &c. m. (-मः) 1 The elephant of KUVERA, as regent of the north. 2 An emperor, a universal monarch. E. सर्व्व all, भूमि earth, and अण् aff.
सार्वलौकिक: सार्व्वलौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Universally known, prevailing throughout the universe. E. सर्व्व all, लोक a world, and ठञ् aff.
सार्व्वलौकिक: सार्व्वलौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Universally known, prevailing throughout the universe. E. सर्व्व all, लोक a world, and ठञ् aff.
सार्ववर्णिक: सार्व्ववर्णिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Of every kind or sort. 2 Belonging or relating to every tribe, &c. E. सर्व्ववर्ण, and ठञ् aff.
सार्व्ववर्णिक: सार्व्ववर्णिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Of every kind or sort. 2 Belonging or relating to every tribe, &c. E. सर्व्ववर्ण, and ठञ् aff.
सार्वविभक्तिक: सार्व्वविभक्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Applicable or belonging to all the cases of a noun. E. सर्व्व, विभक्ति inflection, ठक् aff.
सार्व्वविभक्तिक: सार्व्वविभक्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Applicable or belonging to all the cases of a noun. E. सर्व्व, विभक्ति inflection, ठक् aff.
सार्ववेद्य: सार्व्ववेद्य m. (-द्यः) A Brahman conversant with all the Vedas. E. सर्व्व all, वेद a Veda, and यञ् aff.
सार्व्ववेद्य: सार्व्ववेद्य m. (-द्यः) A Brahman conversant with all the Vedas. E. सर्व्व all, वेद a Veda, and यञ् aff.
सार्षप: सार्षप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Mustard, made of or from mustard. n. (-पं) Mustard oil. E. सर्षप, and अण् aff.
साल: साल m. (-लः) 1 A wall surrounding a building, &c. 2 A tree in general. 3 The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) 4 A fish (Ophiocephalus Wrahl, HAM.) f. (-ला) A house; more usually शाला. E. षल to go, घञ् aff.; also शाल.
सालग्राम: सालग्राम n. (-मं) A stone, a species of ammonite common in the Gandhak river, and worshipped by the Vaiṣṇavas, as a type of VIṢṆU. E. स with, अर a ring, ग्राम multitude.
सालन: सालन m. (-नः) The resin of the Śāl tree.
सालनिर्यास: सालनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) The resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. साल the tree, and निर्य्यास exudation.
सालनिर्य्यास: सालनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) The resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. साल the tree, and निर्य्यास exudation.
सालपर्णी: सालपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum;) also शालपर्णी.
सालपुष्प: सालपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) A shrub, (Hibiscus mutabilis). E. साल the Śāl tree, and पुष्प a flower.
सालभञ्जिका: सालभञ्जिका f. (-का) A doll, a puppet. E. साल the Śāl tree or its wood, भञ्ज to rub, वुन् aff., fem. form.
सालरस: सालरस m. (-सः) The resinous juice of the Śāl tree. E. साल the Śāl, and रस juice.
सालवाहन: सालवाहन m. (-नः) The sovereign SĀLAVĀHANA. E. साल the Śāl. tree, and वाहन a vehicle: see शालवाहन, &c.
सालवेष्ट: सालवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Turpentine, or the resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. साल the tree, and वेष्ट exudation.
सालशृङ्ग: सालशृङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The upper part or coping of a wall. E. साल a wall, and शृङ्ग horn or summit.
सालाकरी: सालाकरी f. (-री) A female overcome or won in battle. E. साला a house, कृ to make, ट aff.
सालातुरीय: सालातुरीय m. (-यः) A name of PĀṆINI. E. also read शालातुरीय.
सालार: सालार n. (-रं) A pin, a bracket, or shelf, projecting from a wall. E. साल a wall, ऋ to go, अण् aff.
सालावृक: सालावृक m. (-कः) 1 A dog. 2 A wolf. 3 A jackal. E. साला a house, and वृक a wolf, more usually शालावृक.
सालूर: सालूर m. (-रः) A frog. E. षल to go, ऊरच् aff.; the first vowel made long, and the initial changed; also शालुर.
सालेय: सालेय m. (-यः) A sort of fennel or dill, (Anethum sowa.) E. see शालेय.
सालोक्य: सालोक्य n. (-क्यं) Habitation with, residing with, (especially with the deity.) E. स with, लोक world, ष्यञ् aff.
सालोक्यता: सालोक्यता f. (-ता) Habitation, state of abiding or dwelling. E. तल् added to the last.
साल्व: साल्व mfn. (-ल्वः-ल्वी-ल्वं) Belonging to the Sālva country: the word is more usually read, शाल्व. m. (-ल्वः) 1 The name of a demon, the enemy of VIṢṆU. 2 The name of a country or place. m. pl. (-ल्वाः) The people.
साल्वहन्: साल्वहन् m. (-हा) A name of VIṢṆU. E. साल्व a demon, and हन् destroyer.
साल्विक: साल्विक m. (-कः) A sort of bird.
सावक: सावक mfn. (-कः-विका-कं) 1 Generative, productive, causing birth, &c. 2 Obstetric, parturient. f. (-विका) A midwife. E. षू to bear young, causal form, षुन् aff.
सावज्ञ: सावज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Despising, disdainful. E. स with अवज्ञा disrespect.
सावधान: सावधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Careful, cautious. 2 Dilligent. E. स with, अवधान care.
सावन: सावन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Natural, (in astronomy) as Sāvana Dina, a natural day, from sunrise to sunrise. m. (-नः) 1 The conclusion of a sacrifice, the ceremonies by which it is terminated. 2 An employer of priests for a sacrifice. 3 The deity VARUṆA. 4 A month of thirty solar days. E. षू to bear or produce, aff. ल्युट्, and अण् added.
सावर: सावर m. (-रः) 1 The Lodh tree. 2 Sin, crime. 3 Fault, offence. E. see शावर.
सावर्ण: सावर्ण m. (-र्णः) The second Menu. E. सवर्ण the father of this person, and अञ् aff.
सावर्णि: सावर्णि m. (-र्णिः) 1 The second Menu. 2 A name applied to the 8th, 9th, 10th, 11th, and 12th Menus, or Brahma Sāvarṇi, Dakṣa Sāvarṇi, &c. E. सवर्ण, and इञ् aff.
सावर्ण्य: सावर्ण्य n. (-र्ण्यं) Identity of caste, class, &c. E. सवर्ण, and ष्यञ् aff.
सावशेष: सावशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 Imperfect, incomplete. 2 Leaving a residue or remainder. E. स with, अवशेष remains.
सावहेल: सावहेल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Despising, disdaining. E. स with, अवहेल disrespect.
सावित्र: सावित्र m. (-त्रः) 1 A Brahman. 2 ŚIVA. 3 A Vasu or demigod so named. 4 The sun. 5 The embryo or foetus. f. (-त्री) 1 UMĀ, the wife of ŚIVA. 2 The holy verse of the Vedas, the repetition of which forms an essential part of the ceremonies, enjoined to the Brahman, as daily observances: the prayer is personified as the wife of BRAHMĀ, and mystical mother of the Hindu classes, which are regenerated by investiture with the sacrificial string. 3 The wife of SATYAVĀN. 4 A beam of light, a cluster of solar rays. n. (-त्रं) The sacrificial string. E. सवित्र the sun, and अण् aff. of reference: the prayer is in fact addressed to that luminary, and the deities, &c. are manifestations of the planet or prayer.
सावित्रीपतित: सावित्रीपतित m. (-तः) A man of the three first classes, not invested at the proper time with the sacrificial cord. E. सावित्री, and पतित fallen.
सावित्रीपरिभ्रष्ट: सावित्रीपरिभ्रष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A man of the three first classes, not invested with the string at the proper season. E. सावित्री, and परिभ्रष्ट broken.
सावित्रीसूत्र: सावित्रीसूत्र n. (-त्रं) The sacrificial or characteristic cord of the three first classes. E. साविची the sacred text, (the repetition of which forms part of the ceremony of investiture,) and सूत्र a thread.
साविष्कार: साविष्कार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Proud, haughty. 2 Manifest. E. स with, आविष्कार manifestation.
साश्चर्य: साश्चर्य्य n. adv. (-र्य्यं) With surprise. E. स with, आश्चर्य्य astonishment.
साश्चर्य्य: साश्चर्य्य n. adv. (-र्य्यं) With surprise. E. स with, आश्चर्य्य astonishment.
साश्रुधी: साश्रुधी f. (-धी) A wife's or husband's mother.
सासहि: सासहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Able to bear much. E. सह to bear, intens. v., कि aff.
सास्थिताम्रार्द्ध: सास्थिताम्रार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) Bell-metal. E. स with, अस्थि substance, ताम्र copper, and अर्द्धं a half.
सास्ना: सास्ना f. (-स्ना) The dewlap of an ox. E. सस to sleep, न Uṇādi aff.
सास्र: सास्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं) 1 Weeping, in tears. 2 Cornered, angular. E. स with, अस्र a tear, or an angle.
साहङ्कार: साहङ्कार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Proud, arrogant. 2 United with the principle of egotism. E. स with, अहङ्कार pride, &c.
साहचर्य: साहचर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Company, association, society, fellowship. E. सह with, चर going, aff. ष्यञ्.
साहचर्य्य: साहचर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Company, association, society, fellowship. E. सह with, चर going, aff. ष्यञ्.
साहन: साहन n. (-नं) Sufferance, endurance. E. षह to bear, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
साहय: साहय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Causing or enabling to endure. E. षह to bear, causal form, साहि, and श aff.
साहयक: साहयक n. (-कं) Friendship, fellowship. E. साहय a friend, aff. वुञ्.
साहस: साहस n. (-सं) 1 Punishment, chastisement, fine. 2 Violence, the perpetration of any act of rapine or aggression. 3 Oppression, cruelty. 4 Hatred. 5 Rape, ravishment. 6 Boldness, daring. 7 Rashness. 8 Oblation with fire. E. सहस् strength, अण् aff.
साहसाङ्क: साहसाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A name of VIKRAMĀDITYA. E. साहस violence, अङ्क a mark.
साहसिक: साहसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Castigatory, inflicted as punishment. 2 Perpetrated by violence. 3 Violent, felonious, rapacious, brutal, cruel. 4 Impetuous, rash. 5 Bold, daring. m. (-कः) A robber, a free-booter. E. साहस violence, and ठक् aff.
साहसिन्: साहसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 1 Violent, ferocious. 2 Rash. 3 Daring, bold. E. साहस, and इनि aff.
साहसैकरसिक: साहसैकरसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Intent on violence, brutal, ferocious. E. साहस, एक alone, रस taste, and ठञ् aff.
साहस्र: साहस्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्री-स्रं) 1 Bought with a thousand. 2 Paid per thousand, as interest, duty, &c. 3 Relating or belonging to a thousand. m. (-स्रः) An army or detachment, a thousand strong. n. (-स्रं) An aggregate of many thousands. E. सहस्र a thousand, and अण् aff.
साहाय्य: साहाय्य n. (-य्यं) 1 Friendship, fellowship. 2 Help, succour. 3 Alliance. E. सहाय a friend, ष्यञ् aff.
साहित्य: साहित्य nf. (-त्यं-ती) Society, association, connexion, combination. n. (-त्यं) Poetry, belles-lettres. E. सहित with, together with, aff. ष्यञ्
साह्य: साह्य n. (-ह्यं) Society, conjunction. E. सह with, together with, aff. of the abstract ष्यञ्.
साह्यकृत्: साह्यकृत् m. (-कृत्) A companion. E. साह्य society, कृत् who makes.
साह्वय: साह्वय m. (-यः) Fighting animals, (as cocks, &c.) for sport or money. E. स with, आह्वय challenging.
सिंह: सिंह m. (-हः) 1 A lion. 2 LEO, the sign of the zodiac. 3 (In composition) Pre-eminent. f. (-ही) 1 The egg-plant, (Solanum Melongena) 2 A shrub, (Justicia.) 3 A prickly nightshade. 4 The mother of RĀHU. E. षिच to sprinkle, क Uṇādi aff. ह substituted for the final, and नुम् inserted; or हिसि to injure or kill, अच् aff., and the radical consonants transposed.
सिंहकेलि: सिंहकेलि m. (-लिः) A Bauddha saint, also named MAÑJUGHOṢA.
सिंहकेशर: सिंहकेशर m. (-रः) 1 A lion's mane. 2 A plant, (Mimusops elengi.) E. सिंह a lion, and केशर a mane, &c.
सिंहतल: सिंहतल m. (-लः) The open hands joined. E. सिंह a lion, and तल the open palm; also read संहतल.
सिंहतुण्ड: सिंहतुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of fish. E. सिंह, and तुण्ड face.
सिंहद्वार: सिंहद्वार n. (-रं) A gate, an entrance, especially the chief gate of a mansion or palace. E. सिंह chief, and द्वार a door-way.
सिंहध्वनि: सिंहध्वनि m. (-निः) 1 The roar or sound of a lion. 2 A war cry. E. सिंह, and ध्वनि sound.
सिंहनर्दिन्: सिंहनर्द्दिन् mfn. (-र्द्दी-र्द्दिनी-र्द्दि) Roaring like a lion. E. सिंह, and नर्द्दिन् who or what sounds.
सिंहनर्द्दिन्: सिंहनर्द्दिन् mfn. (-र्द्दी-र्द्दिनी-र्द्दि) Roaring like a lion. E. सिंह, and नर्द्दिन् who or what sounds.
सिंहनाद: सिंहनाद m. (-दः) War-cry, war-hoop, shouting or roaring upon making an onset. E. सिंह a lion, and नाद cry.
सिंहनादक: सिंहनादक m. (-कः) 1 The roar or yelp of a lion. 2 War-cry. f. (-का) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. सिंह a lion, नाद sounding, and कन् added.
सिंहपर्णी: सिंहपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda.) E. सिंह a lion, and पर्ण a leaf.
सिंहपुच्छी: सिंहपुच्छी f. (-च्छी) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. सिंह a lion, and पुच्छ tail; also with कन् added, सिंहपुच्छिका.
सिंहयाना: सिंहयाना f. (-ना) DURGĀ. E. सिंह a lion, and यान a vehicle.
सिंहरथा: सिंहरथा f. (-था) The goddess DURGĀ. E. सिंह a lion, and रथ a vehicle, mounted on that animal.
सिंहविक्रान्त: सिंहविक्रान्त m. (-न्तः) A horse. E. सिंह a lion, and विक्रान्त valour.
सिंहल: सिंहल n. (-लं) 1 Tin. 2 Brass. 3 Cassia bark. nf. (-लं-ला) Ceylon. E. सिंह a lion, &c., ला to give or get, aff. क.
सिंहलास्थान: सिंहलास्थान m. (-नः) A tree, apparently a sort of palm. E. सिंहला Ceylon, and स्थान place.
सिंहसहनन: सिंहसहनन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Handsome and well-shaped. E. सिंह the beast, सहनन rivalling or surpassing.
सिंहाढ्य: सिंहाढ्य mfn. (-ढ्यः-ढ्या-ढ्यं) Abounding with lions. E. सिंह, and आद्य wealthy.
सिंहाण: सिंहाण n. (-णं) 1 Rust of iron; also सिंहान. 2 The mucus of the nose. E. see the next.
सिंहान: सिंहान n. (-नं) 1 Rust of iron. 2 The mucus of the nose. E. शिधि, to smell, आनक् aff., form irr.; also शिङ्घाण, सिंहाण, सिङ्घाण, &c.
सिंहासन: सिंहासन n. (-नं) A throne. E. सिंह a lion, (supported by lions, &c. wrought in gold,) and आसन a seat.
सिंहास्य: सिंहास्य m. (-स्यः) A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda, &c.) E. सिंह a lion, and आस्य the face; to which the flowers are compared.
सिंहिका: सिंहिका f. (-का) The mother of RĀHU. E. सिंही a lioness, कन् aff. of comparison, &c.
सिंहिकासूनु: सिंहिकासूनु m. (-नुः) The personified ascending node. E. सिंहिका the mother of RĀHU, and सूनु son.
सिकता: सिकता f. (-ता) 1 Sandy soil. 2 Gravel or stone, (the disease.) m. plu. (-ताः) Sand. E. सिकि Sautra root, to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. अतच्.
सिकतामय: सिकतामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sandy. n. (-यं) A sand bank, or an island with sandy shores. E. सिकप्ता sand, मयट् aff.
सिकतावत्: सिकतावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sandy, (in general.) E. सिकत sand, मतुप् aff.
सिकतिल: सिकतिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Sandy, as a soil or country. E. सिकता sand, aff. इलच्.
सिक्त: सिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Sprinkled, wetted. E. षिच to sprinkle, क्त aff.
सिक्त्वा: सिक्त्वा ind. Having sprinkled, effused, &c. E. षिच to sprinkle, क्त्वा aff.
सिक्थ: सिक्थ m. (-क्थः) 1 A handful or mouthful of boiled rice. 2 Boiled rice. n. (-क्थं) 1 Bee's wax. 2 Indigo. E. षिच् to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. थक्.
सिक्थक: सिक्थक n. (-कं) Bee's wax. E. कन् added to the last.
सिङ्घाण: सिङ्घाण n. (-णं) The mucus of the nose. E. शिघि to smell, Uṇādi aff. आनक्, and the last syllable of the aff. optionally rejected; also सिंघाणक. n. (-कं) सिंहाण, &c.
सिङ्घाणक: सिङ्घाणक n. (-कं) The mucus of the nose. E. see the last.
सिङ्घिनी: सिङ्घिनी f. (-नी) The nose. E. शिघि to smell, affs. इनि and ङीप्, and the initial changed.
सिच्: सिच् f. (सिक्) Clothes. E. षिच to sprinkle, aff. क्विप्.
सिचय: सिचय m. (-यः) 1 Cloth, clothes. 2 Old or ragged raiment. E. षिचि to cause to sprinkle, aff. श.
सिच्यमान: सिच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being sprinkled. E. षिच् to sprinkle, pass. v., शानच् aff.
सिञ्चत्: सिञ्चत् mfn. (-ञ्चन्-ञ्चन्ती-ञ्चत्) Sprinkling, throwing water. E. षिच to sprinkle, शतृ aff. of the present participle.
सिञ्जा: सिञ्जा f. (-ञ्जा) The sound of metallic ornaments, jingling, ringing, tinkling; more usually शिञ्जा, q. v.
सित: सित mfn. (-तः-ता- or ती-तं) 1 White. 2 Bound, tied. 3 Finished, destroyed. 4 Completed, concluded. 5 Known. m. (-तः) 1 White, (the colour.) 2 The planet VENUS. 3 An arrow. n. (-तं) 1 Silver. 2 Sandal. f. (-ता) 1 Clayed or candied sugar. 2 Arabian jasmine. 3 A sort of Clitoria. 4 Bent grass with white blossoms. 5 Moonlight. 6 Spirituous liquor. 7 A handsome or well made woman. E. षि to tie or bind, aff. क्त; or षो to destroy, क्त aff., and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
सितकुञ्जर: सितकुञ्जर m. (-रः) 1 INDRA. 2 INDRA'S elephant. E. सित white, कुञ्जर an elephant.
सितचिह्न: सितचिह्न m. (-ह्नः) A sort of fish, (Lacerta scincus.) E. सित white, चिह्न a mark.
सितछच: सितछच n. (-चं) A white umbrella, especially as one of the emblems of royalty. f. (-त्री) A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) E. सित white, and छच an umbrella.
सितच्छद: सितछद m. (-दः) A goose. f. (-दा) White Dūrbbā grass. E. सित white, and छद a feather or leaf.
सितछद: सितछद m. (-दः) A goose. f. (-दा) White Dūrbbā grass. E. सित white, and छद a feather or leaf.
सितदीधिति: सितदीधिति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. सित white, and दीधिति a ray of light.
सितदूर्वा: सितदूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A bent grass with white blossoms. E. सित white, and दूर्व्वा Doob grass.
सितदूर्व्वा: सितदूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A bent grass with white blossoms. E. सित white, and दूर्व्वा Doob grass.
सितद्रु: सितद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A plant, commonly Moraṭā. E. सित white, and द्रु a tree.
सितधातु: सितधातु m. (-तुः) Chalk. E. सित white, and धातु a mineral.
सितपक्ष: सितपक्ष m. (-क्षः) A goose. E. सित white, पक्ष a feather.
सितपुष्प: सितपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) A sort of grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) m. (-ष्पः) 1 A sort of tree, the Tagara tree. 2 A kind of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) f. (-ष्पा) Arabian jasmine. E. सित white, and पुष्प a flower.
सितमरिच: सितमरिच n. (-चं) White pepper. E. सित white, and मरिच pepper.
सितमाष: सितमाष m. (-षः) A sort of bean, (Dolichos catjang.) E. सित white, and माष pulse.
सितरञ्जन: सितरञ्जन m. (-नः) Yellow, (the colour.) E. सित white, and रञ्जन colouring.
सितरश्मि: सितरश्मि m. (-श्मिः) The moon. E. सित white, and रश्मि a ray.
सितशिम्बिक: सितशिम्बिक m. (-कः) Wheat. E. सित white, and शिम्बिका an awn; also read शितशिम्बिक, &c.
सितशिव: सितशिव n. (-वं) Rock salt. E. सित white, and शिव auspicious; also शितशिवं, सितसिवं.
सितशूक: सितशूक m. (-कः) Barley. E. शित white, and शूक an awn or ear.
सितसप्ति: सितसप्ति m. (-प्तिः) A name of ARJUNA. E. सित white, and सप्ति a horse.
सितसर्षप: सितसर्षप m. (-पः) White mustard. E. सित white, and सर्षप mustard.
सितसिन्धु: सितसिन्धु f. (-न्धुः) The Ganges. E. सित white, and सिन्धु a river.
सितसिव: सितसिव n. (-वं) Rock salt. E. सित white, and सिव for शिव auspicious; also सितशिव, &c.
सितांशु: सितांशु m. (-शुः) The moon. E. सित, and अंशु a ray.
सिताखण्ड: सिताखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Clayed sugar, said to be prepared from honey. E. सित white, आखण्ड sugar.
सिताङ्क: सिताङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A kind of fish, (Lacerta scincus.) E. सित white, and अङ्क a mark or spot.
सिताग्र: सिताग्र m. (-ग्रः) A thorn. E. सित white, and अग्र point.
सितादि: सितादि m. (-दिः) Treacle, molasses. E. सिता sugar, before दा to give, aff. कि.
सितानन: सितानन m. (-नः) GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. सित white, आनन face.
सितापाङ्ग: सितापाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A peacock. E. सित white, and अपाङ्ग the angle of the eye.
सिताब्ज: सिताब्ज n. (-ब्जं) The white lotus. E. सित white, and अब्ज a lotus.
सिताभ: सिताभ m. (-भः) Camphor. E. सित white, आङ् before भा to shine, aff. ड.
सिताभ्र: सिताभ्र mn. (-भ्रः-भ्रं) Camphor. E. सित white, and अभ्र a cloud, also with कन् added, सिताभ्रक n. (-कं).
सिताम्बर: सिताम्बर m. (-रः) An ascetic wearing white garments. E. सित white, and अम्बर vesture.
सिताम्भोज: सिताम्भोज n. (-जं) A white lotus. E. सित white, and अम्भोज a lotus.
सितालता: सितालता f. (-ता) Doob or Dūrbbā grass with white blossoms. E. सित white, and लता a creeper.
सिताश्व: सिताश्व m. (-श्वः) ARJUNA. E. सित white, and अश्व a horse.
सितालिका: सितालिका f. (-का) A cockle. E. सित white, आलि a line, कन् aff., fem. form.
सितासित: सितासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) White and black. m. (-तः) A name of BALADEVA. E. सित white, (skin,) and असित black, (rainment.)
सिति: सिति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 White. 2 Black. E. सि to bind, aff. क्ति.
सितिमन्: सितिमन् m. (-मा) Whiteness. E. सिति white, and इमनिच् aff.
सितिवासस्: सितिवासस् m. (-साः) BALADEVA. E. सिति black, and वासस् vesture.
सितेतर: सितेतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Black. E. सित white, इतर reverse.
सितेतरगति: सितेतरगति m. (-तिः) AGNI or fire. E. सितेतर black, (smoke,) गति going.
सितोदर: सितोदर m. (-रः) KUVERA. E. सित white, and उदर the belly; the deity is properly of a black colour, but is whitened by a leprous taint.
सितोपल: सितोपल n. (-लं) Chalk, or a mineral substance of similar appearance, considered as a variety. m. (-लः) Crystal. f. (-ला) Clayed or candied sugar. E. सित white, and उपला a stone.
सितोष्णवारण: सितोष्णवारण n. (-णं) A white umbrella. E. सित, and उष्णवारण keeping off the heat.
सिद्ध: सिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Accomplished, effected, completed. 2 Liberated, emancipated. 3 Always, eternal. 4 Celebrated, famous. 5 Judged, decided, terminated, (as a law suit.) 6 Valid, (in law.) 7 Adept, initiated, in alchymy or magic. 8 Demonstrated, proved, (in logic.) 9 Finished. 10 Cooked, dressed. 11 Prepared, compounded, (in medicine.) 12 Shining, splendid. 13 Discharged, settled, (as a debt.) m. (-द्धः) 1 A divine personage of undefined attributes or character; a sort of demigod or spirit, inhabiting, together with the Vidyādharas, Munis, &c. the middle air, or the region between the earth and sun. 2 An inspired or prophetic writer, as VYĀSA and others, or one to whom the past, present, and future, are supposed to be known, a sage, a seer. 3 The twenty-first of the astronomical Yogas. 4 An adept, a magician, one who by the performance of certain mystical and magical rites has acquired superhuman powers. 5 An ascetic, who by mystical and austere practices has effected one or all of five purposes, viz. the affluence, the form, or the society of the gods, residence in the divine Lokas, or identification with a deity. n. (-र्द्धं) Sea salt. f. (-द्धा) A medicinal root, commonly Ṛddhi. E. षिध to effect, aff. क्त.
सिद्धगङ्गा: सिद्धगङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The Ganges of heaven. E. सिद्ध a spirit of midheaven, and गङ्गा the Ganges.
सिद्धजल: सिद्धजल n. (-लं) Sour rice-gruel. E. सिद्ध perfect, and जल water.
सिद्धदेव: सिद्धदेव m. (-वः) ŚIVA. E. सिद्ध a saint, and देव deity.
सिद्धधातु: सिद्धधातु m. (-तुः) Quicksilver. E. सिद्ध adept, (in alchymy,) and धातु a mineral.
सिद्धरस: सिद्धरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Mineral, metallic, &c. m. (-सः) 1 Quicksilver. 2 An alchymist. E. सिद्ध perfect, or perfected by alchymical operation, and रस fluid.
सिद्धसङ्घ: सिद्धसङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) A company of saints or the beings called Siddhas. E. सिद्ध, and सङ्घ a company.
सिद्धसलिल: सिद्धसलिल n. (-लं) Sour rice-gruel. E. सिद्ध perfect, and सलिल water.
सिद्धसाधन: सिद्धसाधन m. (-नः) White mustard. n. (-नं) The performance of magical rites, &c. or the materials employed in magical or alchemical processes. E. सिद्ध perfect, adept, &c., and साधन accomplishing, (the act or instrument.)
सिद्धसाध्य: सिद्धसाध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Effected, proved. 2 Having done what was to be done. n. (-ध्यं) Demonstrated proof or conclusion. E. सिद्ध, and साध्य to be proved, &c.
सिद्धसिन्धु: सिद्धसिन्धु f. (-न्धुः) The Ganges. E. सिद्ध a divine being or sage, and सिन्धु a river.
सिद्धसेन: सिद्धसेन m. (-नः) The deity of war, KĀRTTIKEYA. E. सिद्ध a divine being, and सेना an army; commanding the hosts of heaven.
सिद्धान्त: सिद्धान्त m. (-न्तः) Demonstrated conclusion, established truth: it may be either the result of an argument in which one opinion is refused and another undeniably established; or the concurrent doctrine of all the authorities on any subject similarly interpreted. E. सिद्ध completed, perfect, and अन्त end, conclusion.
सिद्धान्तिन्: सिद्धान्तिन् m. (-न्ती) 1 A follower of the Mīmāṃsā philosophy. 2 A demonstrator, one who establishes his conclusions. E. सिद्धान्त demonstrated conclusion, इनि aff.
सिद्धापगा: सिद्धापगा f. (-गा) The Ganges. E. सिद्ध a divine being, and अपगा a river.
सिद्धायिका: सिद्धायिका f. (-का) One of the tutelary goddesses of the Jainas.
सिद्धार्थ: सिद्धार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Successful, prosperous. m. (-र्थः) 1 The father of the last and most celebrated Jina or Jaina teacher of the present era. 2 White mustard. 3 A name of Sāhyasiṃha or Buddha. f. (-र्था) The mother of the fourth Jina. E. सिद्ध complete, &c., and अर्थ meaning or wealth.
सिद्धि: सिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Fulfilment, accomplishment, the entire completion of any undertaking or attainment of any object. 2 A Yoga, either the sixteenth of the astronomical periods termed Yogas, or the nineteenth of the twenty-eight astrological Yogas. 3 Final emancipation from existence, supreme felicity. 4 Prosperity, success. 5 Knowledge, understanding. 6 Accuracy, correctness, indisputable conclusion or position. 7 Validity (in law.) 8 Acquittance, discharge, (of a debt.) 9 Concealment, secreting, covering. 10 The result or fruit of the adoration of the gods or of ascetic severities. 11 The supposed acquirement of supernatural powers by the completion of magical, mystical, or alchemical rites and processes. 12 A wooden shoe or slipper, especially one over which some mystical formulæ have been repeated, and which will then, it is supposed, convey the wearer every where safely and rapidly. 13 A medicinal root; also Ṛddhi. E. षिध to accomplish, aff. क्तिन्.
सिध्म: सिध्म n. (-ध्मं) A blotch, a scab. E. षिध to go, (on the body,) मक् aff.; also सिध्मन्.
सिध्मन्: सिध्मन् n. (-ध्म) A blotch, a scab. E. षिध to go, मनिन् aff.: see the last.
सिध्मल: सिध्मल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Scabby. f. (-ला) 1 Dried or salt fish. 2 A scab. 3 A sort of leprosy. E. सिध्म a scab, लच् aff.
सिध्मवत्: सिध्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Scabby, pocky. E. सिध्म a blotch, मतुप् aff.
सिध्य: सिध्य m. (-ध्यः) The asterism Puṣya, stars in Cancer. E. षिध to accomplish or to be accomplished, क्यप् aff.
सिध्र: सिध्र m. (-ध्रः) 1 A pious or virtuous man. 2 A tree. E. षिघ to be perfect, रक् Uṇādi aff.
सिध्रका: सिध्रका f. (-का) A plant, so named. E. कन् added to the preceding.
सिध्रकावण: सिध्रकावण n. (-णं) A garden of the gods. E. सिध्रका a plant, and वन a wood, न changed to ण.
सिन: सिन mf. (-नः-नी) One-eyed. m. (-नः) A mouthful, or such a quantity bound together. E. षि to bind, नक् Uṇādi aff. or षि to bind, क्त aff. in this particular application.
सिनीवाली: सिनीवाली f. (-ली) 1 The day preceding that of new moon, or that on which the moon rises scarcely visible. 2 The goddess UMĀ. E. सा good fortune, इनि aff., fem. form, सिनी a digit of the moon, वल to contain, aff. अण्, fem. aff. ङीष्; several other etymologies occur.
सिन्दुक: सिन्दुक m. (-कः) A small tree, (Vitex negundo.) E. स्यन्द to ooze, aff. उ, and कन् added; the semivowel of the root changed to इ.
सिन्दुवार: सिन्दुवार m. (-रः) A small tree, (Vitex negundo.) E. सिन्दु oozing, (as before,) वृ to screen or choose, aff. अण्.
सिन्दूर: सिन्दूर n. (-रं) Red lead, minium. m. (-रः) A sort of tree. f. (-री) 1 Red cloth or clothes. 2 Rocani, (a sort of Crinum.) 3 A plant, (Lythrum fruticosum.) E. स्यन्द to ooze, Uṇādi aff. ऊरन्; also read सिन्दुर.
सिन्दूरकारण: सिन्दूरकारण n. (-णं) Lead. E. सिन्दूर minium, and कारण origin.
सिन्दूरतिलक: सिन्दूरतिलक m. (-कः) An elephant. f. (-का) A woman whose forehead is marked with minium. E. सिन्दूर red lead, and तिलक the mark on the forehead.
सिन्दूरिका: सिन्दूरिका f. (-का) Red lead. E. सिन्दूर, कन् added, fem. form.
सिन्दूरित: सिन्दूरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reddened, made red. E. सिन्दूर, and इतच् aff.
सिन्धु: सिन्धु m. (-न्धुः) 1 The ocean, the sea. 2 The Indus. 3 The country along the Indus or Sindh. 4 The juice that exudes from an elephant's temples. 5 An elephant. 6 A division of a Rāga or musical mode. 7 A small tree, (Vitex negundo.) f. (-न्धुः) A river in general. E. स्यन्द to trickle or flow, उ Uṇādi aff., the form. irr.
सिन्धुक: सिन्धुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Marine. 2 Born or produced in Sindh. m. (-कः) A small tree, (Vitex negundo.) E. कन् added to the last, implying place of origin or production.
सिन्धुकफ: सिन्धुकफ m. (-फः) Cuttle-fish bone. E. सिन्धु the sea, and कफ phlegm.
सिन्धुखेल: सिन्धुखेल m. (-लः) The country of Sindh. E. सिन्धु the Indus, खिल to go or sport, aff. अच्.
सिन्धुज: सिन्धुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 River or sea-born, marine, aquatic. 2 Born or produced in Sindh. n. (-जं) Rock salt. f. (-जा) The goddess LAKṢMĪ. E. सिन्धु the country or river, &c., and ज born.
सिन्धुजन्मन्: सिन्धुजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) The moon. n. (-न्म) Rock salt. E. सिन्धु the sea, &c., and जन्मन् birth.
सिन्धुनन्दन: सिन्धुनन्दन m. (-नः) The moon. E. सिन्धु the ocean, and नन्दन the son; being produced at the churning of the ocean.
सिन्धुनाथ: सिन्धुनाथ m. (-थः) The ocean. E. सिन्धु a river, and नाथ lord.
सिन्धुपुत्त्र: सिन्धुपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 A sort of ebony. 2 The moon. E. सिन्धु the sea, &c., and पुत्त्र offspring.
सिन्धुपुष्प: सिन्धुपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A conch. E. सिन्धु the sea, and पुष्प a flower.
सिन्धुमन्थज: सिन्धुमन्थज n. (-जं) Rock salt. E. सिन्धुमन्थ the ocean churning, (a mountain,) and ज born.
सिन्धुर: सिन्धुर m. (-रः) An elephant. E. स्यन्द to ooze, (the ichor from his temples,) उरच् aff., and the form irr.
सिन्धुरद्वैषिन्: सिन्धुरद्वैषिन् m. (-सी) A lion. E. सिन्धुर an elephant, and द्वैषिन् enemy.
सिन्धुलवण: सिन्धुलवण n. (-णं) Rock salt. E. सिन्धु Sindh, and लवण salt.
सिन्धुवार: सिन्धुवार m. (-रः) 1 A horse of a good breed, brought probably from Sindh or the borders of India and Persia. 2 A small tree, (Vitex negundo.) E. सिन्धु the country or the sea, वृ to choose or screen; aff. घञ्; also सिन्दुवार in the second sense, and with कन् added, सिन्धुवारक.
सिन्धुवारित: सिन्धुवारित m. (-तः) A small tree, (Vitex negundo.) E. सिन्धु the sea, and वारित selected or chosen.
सिन्धुशयन: सिन्धुशयन m. (-नः) VIṢṆU. E. सिन्धु the ocean, and शयन a couch.
सिन्धुसङ्गम: सिन्धुसङ्गम m. (-मः) The mouth of a river, or its point of junction with the sea. E. सिन्धु the sea, and सङ्गम confluence.
सिन्धूद्भव: सिन्धूद्भव n. (-वं) Rock salt. E. सिन्धु Sindh, and उद्भव produced.
सिन्धूपल: सिन्धूपल n. (-लं) Rock salt. E. सिन्धु Sindh, and उपला a stone.
सिप्र: सिप्र m. (-प्रः) 1 Perspiration, sweat. 2 The moon. f. (-प्रा) 1 The Sipra, a river near Oujein. 2 A woman's zone. 3 A female buffalo.
सिम: सिम m. (-मः) All, entire. E. षि to bind, मन् Uṇādi aff.
सिम्बा: सिम्बा f. (-म्बा-म्बिः or -म्बी) A legume, a pod: see शिम्बा, &c.
सिम्बिका: सिम्बिका f. (-का) Grain in pods, as pulse, &c. E. सिम्बा a pod, कन् aff., fem. form.
सिर: सिर m. (-रः) The root of long-pepper. f. (-रा) 1 Any tubular vessel of the body, or one so considered, as a nerve, a vein, an artery, a tendon, &c. 2 A bucket, a baling vessel. E. षि to bind, aff. रक्, form irr.; also शिर.
सिराजाल: सिराजाल m. (-लः) 1 A plexus of vessels. 2 Enlargement of the vessels of the eye. E. सिरा, and जाल a net.
सिरामोक्ष: सिरामोक्ष m. (-क्षः) Venesection. E. सिरा a vein, and भोक्ष loosing.
सिराव्यध: सिराव्यध m. (-धः) Venesection. E. सिरा, and व्यध piercing; also सिराव्यधनं.
सिराहर्ष: सिराहर्ष m. (-र्षः) Flow of discoloured tears. E. सिरा, and हर्ष joy.
सिरोत्पात: सिरोत्पात m. (-तः) Redness and inflammation of the eyes. E. सिरा, and उत्पात affliction.
सिल्लकी: सिल्लकी f. (-की) The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) E. see सल्लकी, the इ being substituted for अ.
सिषङ्ग्रामयिषु: सिषङ्ग्रामयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing or intending to make war. E. सङ्ग्राम to make war, desid, v., उ aff.
सिषाधयिषा: सिषाधयिषा f. (-षा) Wish or purpose to effect, prove, &c. E. षाध to accomplish, desid. form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
सिषाधयिषु: सिषाधयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous to accomplish, to prove, &c. E. षाध to accomplish, desid. v., उ aff.
सिसृक्षा: सिसृक्षा f. (-क्षा) Wish or purpose to create. E. सृज to create, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
सिसृक्षु: सिसृक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Wishing or purposing to create. E. सृज to create, desid. v., उ aff.
सिहुण्ड: सिहुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The milk-hedge plant, (Euphorbia antiquorum.)
सिह्ण: सिह्ण m. (-ह्णः) Incense, gum Benjamin or Olibanum, &c. E. ष्णिह to be affectionate, to love, लक aff., form irr.; also with कन् added, सिह्णक. m. (-कः).
सिह्णकी: सिह्णकी f. (-की) The Olibanum tree. E. सिह्ण incense, कन् added, and ङीष् fem. aff.
सिह्णभूमिका: सिह्णभूमिका f. (-का) The Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) E. सिह्ण incense, भूमि place, site, and कन् added.
सीक: सीक r. 1st and 10th cls. 1 To touch. 2 To bear. (ऋ) सीकृ r. 1st cl. (सीकति) To sprinkle, to shed or shower.
सीकर: सीकर m. (-रः) Thin drizzling rain. E. सीक to scatter, (as water,) अरन् aff.; also शीकर.
सीता: सीता f. (-ता) 1 A furrow, the track of the plough-share. 2 The daughter of JANAKA and wife of RĀMACANDRA. 3 One of the four great branches into which the Ganges, after having fallen on mount Meru, is fabled to divide: the eastern branch, flowing into the Varṣa Bhadrāśva. 4 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. 5 UMĀ the wife of ŚIVA. 6 A goddess presiding over fruits, &c. an Indian FLORA or POMONA. 7 Spirituous liquor. E. षि to bind, (the earth,) क्त aff., form irr.; it is then applicable to the princess as having been turned up in the soil by a plough-share; and to the goddess, as they may be supposed to have been incarnate in the wife of RĀMA; also, as differently derived शीता, q. v.
सीतापति: सीतापति f. (-तिः) The hero RĀMA. E. सीता the princess, and पति husband.
सीतायाःपति: सीतायाःपति m. (-तिः) RĀMA. E. सीता in the poss. case, and पति husband.
सीतीनक: सीतीनक m. (-कः) Pease: see सतीलक, सतीनक, &c.
सीत्कार: सीत्कार n. (-रं) Uttering an inarticulate sound, such as is made with the lips when a person shivers with cold, or in fainting, sighing, &c. E. सीत् imitative sound, and कार making; also सीत्कृत n. (-तं).
सीत्कृत: सीत्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uttered as an inarticulated sound. n. (-तं) An inarticulate sound: see the last. E. सीत्, and कृत made.
सीत्य: सीत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Ploughed, tilled. n. (-त्यं) Corn, grain, rice, &c. E. सीता a furrow, यत् aff.; also शीत्य.
सीदत्: सीदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) 1 Sorrowing, grieving, desponding. 2 Decaying. 3 Suffering from, distressed or pained by. 4 Going. E. षद to wane, शतृ aff.
सीधु: सीधु m. (-धुः) Spirit, distilled from molasses. E. see शीधु, the sibilant being changed.
सीधुगन्ध: सीधुगन्ध m. (-न्धः) A plant, (Mimusopa elengi.) E. सीधु rum, and गन्ध smell.
सीधुप: सीधुप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Drinking spirits. E. सिधु, and पा to drink, टच् aff.
सीमन्: सीमन् m. (-मा) A boundary, a limit, a landmark, or mound, &c. serving to fix the limits of estates, &c. 2 A field. 3 The nape of the neck. 4 The scrotum. E. षिञ् to bind, इमनिन् Uṇādi aff.; also with the aff. डाष्, or a final vowel, fem. form, सीमा.
सीमन्त: सीमन्त m. (-न्तः) A separation of the hair on each side, so as to leave a distinct line on the top of the head. mn. (-न्तः-न्तं) The head. E. सीमन् limit, of the hair, and अन्त end, form irr.
सीमन्तक: सीमन्तक m. (-कः) An infernal being. n. (-कं) Red lead, a mark with which is sometimes made along the division of the hair. E. कन् added to the last.
सीमन्तिनी: सीमन्तिनी f. (-नी) A woman in general. E. सीमन्त the separation of the hair, and इनि aff.
सीमन्तोन्नयन: सीमन्तोन्नयन n. (-नं) One of the Saṃskāras, or a purificatory and sacrificial ceremony, observed by women in the fourth, sixth, or eighth month of their pregnancy. E. सीमन्त partition of the hair, and उन्नयन arranging; this forming an essential part of the rite.
सीमन्त्यमान: सीमन्त्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being parted or divided. E. सीमन्त used as a passive verb, शानच् aff.
सीमा: सीमा f. (-मा) 1 A boundary, a limit. 2 A field. 3 A bank, a shore. 4 Rectitude, observance of due bounds in morals, &c. 5 The nape of the neck. 6 The scrotum. E. see सीमन्.
सीमालिङ्ग: सीमालिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A land or boundary mark. E. सीमा, and लिङ्ग mark.
सीमाविवाद: सीमाविवाद m. (-दः) Litigation or dispute respecting boundaries. E. सीमा, and विवाद dispute.
सीमावृक्ष: सीमावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A tree serving as a boundary mark. E. सीमा, and वृक्ष a tree.
सीमासन्धि: सीमासन्धि m. (-न्धिः) The meeting of two boundaries. E. सीमा, and सन्धि junction.
सीमीक: सीमीक m. (-कः) A kind of tree. E. ष्यम to sound, and कीकन् Uṇādi aff., य changed to इ, and that made long.
सीर: सीर m. (-रः) 1 A plough. 2 The sun. E. षि to bind, Uṇādi aff. रन्, and the vowel made long; also शीर.
सीरक: सीरक m. (-कः) A porpoise. E. सीर a plough, कन् aff. of comparison.
सीरपाणि: सीरपाणि m. (-णिः) BALADEVA. E. सीर a plough, and पाणि the hand.
सीरिन्: सीरिन् m. (-री) BALARĀMA. E. सीर a plough, and इणि aff.
सीवन: सीवन n. (-नं) Sewing, stitching. f. (-नी) The frenum of the prepuce. E. षिव to sew, ल्युट् aff.; also सेवन.
सीस: सीस n. (-सं) Lead. E. षि to bind, क्विप् aff., सी a binding, षो to destroy, aff. क.
सीसक: सीसक n. (-कं) Lead. E. कन् added to the last.
सीहुण्ड: सीहुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The milk-hedge plant, (Euphorbia antiquorum, &c.) E. सी for सिद्ध complete, and हुण्ड a heap, from हुडि to collect, aff. घञ्, form irr.
सु: सु r. 1st cl. (सवति) 1 To bring forth, as young. 2 To possess power. 3 To go: see षु and षू.

सु ind. A particle and prefix analogous to good, well, or the Greek Eu, and implying, reverence, worship, honour; 2 Assent; 3 Encrease, prosperity; 4 Excess, exceeding; 5 Pain, distress; 6 Pleasure, delight. E. षु to go, aff. डु.
सुकण्टका: सुकण्टका f. (-का) The Aloe plant. E. सु good or much, and कण्टक a thorn.
सुकण्डु: सुकण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) Psora, itch. E. सु much, कण्डु the same disease.
सुकन्द: सुकन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 The onion. 2 A yam. 3 A sort of grass, (Scirpus kyssoor.) 4 An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum.) E. सु good, excellent, and कन्द a root.
सुकन्दक: सुकन्दक m. (-कः) An onion. E. सु good, कन्द a root, and कन् added.
सुकर: सुकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Easy, practicable, attainable. 2 Doing well or becomingly. n. (-रं) Doing good to, charity, benevolence. f. (-रा) A tractable cow. E. सु pleasure, कृ to make or confer, खल् aff.
सुकर्णिका: सुकर्णिका f. (-का) A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. सु good, कर्ण an ear, कन् aff. of comparison, and fem. form.
सुकर्मन्: सुकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) 1 Virtuous, good, acting virtuously, doing what is right and fit. 2 Active, diligent. m. (-र्म्मा) 1 The artist or architect of the gods. 2 One of the astronomical Yogas. E. सु good, कर्म्मन् act, action.
सुकर्म्मन्: सुकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) 1 Virtuous, good, acting virtuously, doing what is right and fit. 2 Active, diligent. m. (-र्म्मा) 1 The artist or architect of the gods. 2 One of the astronomical Yogas. E. सु good, कर्म्मन् act, action.
सुकल: सुकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Liberal, both in giving and using. E. सु good, कल to call, aff. अच्.
सुकाण्डिन्: सुकाण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) A bee. E. सु good, काण्ड a shrub, and इनि aff.
सुकालिन्: सुकालिन् m. (-ली) A progenitor of a particular class considered as those of the Śūdra tribe. E. सु good, काल time, इनि aff.
सुकुन्दक: सुकुन्दक m. (-कः) An onion; also सुकन्दक, मुकुन्दक, &c.
सुकुमार: सुकुमार mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Soft, smooth, tender. 2 Youthful, young. m. (-रः) A variety of the sugar-cane. 3 A sort of grain, (Panicum colonum, &c.) 4 A wild kind of Champak. 5 The name of a Daitya. f. (-रा) 1 Double jasmine. 2 Great-flowered jasmine. 3 The plantain. 4 The name of a river. E. सु very, exceedingly, कुमार soft, young.
सुकृत्: सुकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) 1 Virtuous, pious. 2 Fortunate, well-fated. E. सु well, कृत् who does.
सुकृत: सुकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Virtuous, pious. 2 Befriended, assisted, treated with kindness. 3 Fortunate, auspicious. 4 Done well, properly, ably, &c. n. (-तं) 1 Virtue, moral merit. 2 Fortune, auspiciousness. 3 Kindness, bounty, friendly aid or assistance. 4 Any kind or friendly act. 5 Reward, recompense, especially heaven as the reward of virtue. E. सु well, and कृत made or done.
सुकृति: सुकृति f. (-तिः) 1 Virtue, well-doing. 2 Kindness, acting in a friendly or kindly manner. 3 The practice of religious austerities, &c. E. सु good, and कृति action.
सुकृतिन्: सुकृतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) 1 Fortunate, well-fated. 2 Virtuous, pious, good. 3 Benign, benevolent. 4 Learned, wise. E. सुकृत auspiciousness, &c. इनि poss. aff.
सुकोली: सुकोली f. (-ली) A medicinal root, commonly Kṣīrakākolī.
सुक्रिया: सुक्रिया f. (-या) 1 A good action, a good work; a moral or religious observance. E. सु, and क्रिया act.
सुख: सुख r. 10th cl. (सुखयति) To make happy.

सुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) 1 Happy, joyful, delighted. 2 Virtuous, pious. 3 Easy, practicable. n. (-खं) 1 Happiness, pleasure, delight. 2 Heaven, paradise. 3 Water. f. (-खा) The capital of VARUṆA. E. सु good, excellent, ख an organ of sense.
सुखकर: सुखकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Conferring happiness. 2 Doing any thing easily. 3 Done easily. E. सुख, and कर who or what makes.
सुखङ्घुण: सुखङ्घुण m. (-णः) A kind of weapon or staff with which ŚIVA is armed.
सुखचार: सुखचार m. (-रः) An excellent horse. E. सुख pleasure, चर to go, aff. अण्.
सुखच्छेद्य: सुखछेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Easily to be cut or destroyed. E. सुख, and छेद्य to be cut or cut off.
सुखछेद्य: सुखछेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Easily to be cut or destroyed. E. सुख, and छेद्य to be cut or cut off.
सुखजात: सुखजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Happy, taking pleasure. 2 Born or produced easily. E. सुख, and जात born.
सुखद: सुखद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Conferring or affording pleasure, &c. f. (-दा) A courtezan of INDRA'S heaven. n. (-दं) The seat of VIṢṆU. E. सुख pleasure, दा to give, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
सुखदोह्या: सुखदोह्या f. (-ह्या) A cow easily milked. E. सुख (with) pleasure, दोह्य to be milked.
सुखप्रतीक्ष: सुखप्रतीक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Hoping or expecting happiness. E. सुख, and प्रति before ईक्ष to see, ण aff.
सुखभाग: सुखभाग m. (-गः) Happiness, good fortune. E. सुख, and भाग share.
सुखभागिन्: सुखभागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Happy, delighted. E. सुखभाग, and इनि aff.
सुखभेद्य: सुखभेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Easily broken or disunited. E. सुख, and भेद्य to be broken.
सुखमय: सुखमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Full or consisting of happiness, delightful. E. सुख, and मयट् aff.
सुखवर्चक: सुखवर्च्चक m. (-कः) Natron, alkali. E. सुख pleasure, बर्च्च to shine, aff. क्वुन्.
सुखवर्च्चक: सुखवर्च्चक m. (-कः) Natron, alkali. E. सुख pleasure, बर्च्च to shine, aff. क्वुन्.
सुखवासन: सुखवासन m. (-नः) Perfume for the mouth. E. सुख pleasure, and वासन perfuming; also मुखवासन and शुभवासन.
सुखवेदन: सुखवेदन n. (-नं) Consciousness of pleasure. E. सुख, and वेदन knowing.
सुखसन्दुह्या: सुखसन्दुह्या f. (-ह्या) A tractable and gentle cow, one easily milked. E. see the next.
सुखसन्दोह्या: सुखसन्दोह्या f. (-ह्या) A tractable cow, one easily and quickly milked. E. सुख pleasure, सम् before दुह to milk, ण्यत् aff.; also with क्यप् aff. सुखसंदुह्या as above.
सुखसाध्य: सुखसाध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Easy of accomplishment or attainment. 2 Easy of cure. 3 Easy to be discomfited. E. सुख, and साध्य to be broken.
सुखस्पर्श: सुखस्पर्श mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं) Gratifying, agreeable to the touch or feelings. E. सुख, and स्पर्श touch.
सुखाधार: सुखाधार m. (-रः) Svarga, the heaven of INDRA, and paradise of the Hindus. E. सुख pleasure, and आधार a receptacle or reservoir.
सुखानुभव: सुखानुभव m. (-वः) Anticipation or consciousness of pleasure. E. सुख, and अनुभव perception.
सुखान्त: सुखान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Wishing well, friendly, attached. 2 Subversive of happiness. E. सुख, and अन्त end.
सुखायत: सुखायत m. (-तः) An excellent and well-trained horse. E. सुख pleasure, and आयत restrained.
सुखायन: सुखायन m. (-नः) A good horse. E. सुख pleasure, and अयन going.
सुखार्थ: सुखार्थ n. adv. (-र्थं) For the sake of ease, happiness, &c. E. सुख, and अर्थम् on account of.
सुखार्थिन्: सुखार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Seeking or wishing for happiness. E. सुख, and अर्थिन् seeking.
सुखावतीश्वर: सुखावतीश्वर m. (-रः) A deified teacher of the Bauddhas.
सुखावह: सुखावह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Conferring pleasure, delighting, pleasing. E. सुख pleasure, आङ् before वह to convey, aff. अच्.
सुखाश: सुखाश m. (-शः) 1 VARUṆA, deity of water. 2 A cucumber, (Cucumis sativus.) 3 Eating with pleasure, feeding on dainties, &c. E. सुख pleasure, अश to eat, अच् aff.
सुखाशक: सुखाशक m. (-कः) The common cucumber. E. सुखाश the same, and कन् added.
सुखासीन: सुखासीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Seated or sitting at ease. E. सुख, and आसीन seated.
सुखास्वाद: सुखास्वाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Well-flavoured. 2 Delightful, agreeable. m. (-दः) 1 Enjoyment. 2 Flavour. E. सुख, and आस्वाद taste.
सुखाहर: सुखाहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Conferring pleasure, agreeable, delightful. E. सुख and आङ् before हृ to take, अच् aff.
सुखिन्: सुखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) Happy, pleasant, possessing happiness or pleasure. m. (-खी) A Yati or religious ascetic. E. सुख pleasure, इनि poss. aff.
सुखिस्वभाव: सुखिस्वभाव m. (-वः) A happy or contented disposition. E. सुखिन्, and स्वभाव nature.
सुखेच्छा: सुखेच्छा f. (-च्छा) Hope or desire of happiness. E. सुख, and इच्छा wish.
सुखैषिन्: सुखैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Wishing well to, seeking another's happiness. E. सुख, and एषिन् who wishes.
सुखोत्सव: सुखोत्सव m. (-वः) A husband. E. सुख pleasure, and उत्सव a festival.
सुखोदय: सुखोदय m. (-यः) Realization or occurrence of pleasure. E. सुख, and उदय arising.
सुखोदर्क: सुखोदर्क mfn. (-र्कः-र्का-र्कं) Yielding or leading to happiness or pleasure. E. सुख, and उदर्क consequence.
सुखोद्य: सुखोद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be uttered easily or agreeably. E. सुख, and उद्य to be spoken.
सुखोपविष्ट: सुखोपविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Seated comfortably or at ease. E. सुख, and उपविष्ट seated.
सुखोपसर्प्य: सुखोपसर्प्य mfn. (-र्प्यः-र्प्या-र्प्यं) Easy of access. E. सुख, and उपसर्प्य to be approached.
सुख्यात: सुख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Celebrated, famous. E. सु, and ख्यात renowned.
सुख्याति: सुख्याति f. (-तिः) Fame, celebrity. E. सु, and ख्याति fame.
सुग: सुग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Graceful, elegant, going well or elegantly. 2 Well rid of. 3 Plain, intelligible. 4 Easy of access. n. (-गं) Fæces, ordure. E. सु well, good, गम to go, ड aff.
सुगण्: सुगण् mfn. (-गण्) Counting well, a ready reckoner, or of easy calculation. E. सु well, easily, गण to number, क्विप् aff.
सुगणित: सुगणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Easily or accurately calculated. E. सु, and गणित counted.
सुगत: सुगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Passed, gone. 2 Well-bestowed. m. (-तः) A Buddha in general, one of the generic terms for a deified sage, and teacher of the Bauddha sect. E. सु well, and गत gone or known, (by whom.)
सुगन्ध: सुगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Fragrant, sweet-smelling. n. (-न्धं) 1 Small cummin seed. 2 A fragrant grass; also कत्तृण. 3 The blue lotus. 4 Sandal. m. (-न्धः) 1 Fragrance, odour. 2 Sulphur. 3 A sort of Morinda. 4 A trader, a dealer. f. (-न्धा) 1 The ichneumon plant. 2 Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) 3 A fragrant grass. 4 A sort of line. 5 Holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.) 6 Jasmine, (of various sorts.) E. सु good, and गन्ध smell.
सुगन्धक: सुगन्धक m. (-कः) 1 Sulphur. 2 The orange. 3 A sort of gourd, (Momordica mixta.) E. कन् added to the last.
सुगन्धि: सुगन्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि) 1 Fragrant, sweet-smelling. 2 Virtuous, pious. m. (-न्धिः) 1 A perfume, a fragrance. 2 A fragrant sort of mango. n. (-न्धि) 1 A drug and perfume, commonly Elavāluka. 2 The root of long-pepper. 3 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus). 4 Another sort, (Scirpus kyssoor.) 5 Coriander seed.
