E. सु good, well, गन्ध smell, and इ substituted for the final.
सुगन्धिक: सुगन्धिक m. (-कः) 1 A large sort of rice. 2 Incense. 3 Sulphur. n. (-कं) The white lotus. E. सु pleonasm, गन्ध smell, ठक् aff.; also सौगन्धिक.
सुगन्धिकुसुम: सुगन्धिकुसुम m. (-मः) A sort of Nerium with yellowish flowers. f. (-मा) A plant, (Trigonella corniculata. E. सुगन्धि fragrant, and कुसुम flower.
सुगन्धिता: सुगन्धिता f. (-ता) Fragrance, pleasing scent, such as is produced by the trituration of perfumes. E. सुगन्धि fragrant, and तल् aff.
सुगन्धिमूल: सुगन्धिमूल n. (-लं) The root of the Andropogon muricatum. f. (-ला) Rasan, the ichneumon plant. E. सुगन्धि fragrant, and मूल root.
सुगन्धिमूषिका: सुगन्धिमूषिका f. (-का) The musk rat or shrew. E. सुगन्धि fragrant, and मूषिका a mouse.
सुगम: सुगम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Accessible, good, (as a road.) 2 Easy, practicable. 3 Plain, intelligible. E. सु well, ready, and गम going.
सुगहन: सुगहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Thick, close, impervious. f. (-ना) An enclosure round a place of sacrifice, to exclude profane access or sight. E. सु well, much or thoroughly, गह to be thick, युच् aff.
सुगुप्त: सुगुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Secret, well hidden or kept secret. n. adv. (-प्तं) Secretly, privily. E. सु, and गुप्त hidden.
सुगुप्ति: सुगुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Closeness, secrecy. E. सु, and गुप्ति secrecy.
सुगृह: सुगृह m. (-हः) The tailor bird, (Sylvia sutoria.) E. सु handsome or good, and गृह a house or nest.
सुगृहीत: सुगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Held fast or firmly, seized, grasped. 2 Taken or applied properly or auspiciously. E. सु well, and गृहीत taken.
सुगृहीतनामन्: सुगृहीतनामन् m. (-मा) An epithet of YUDHIṢṬHIRA, and others, whose names it is auspicious to invoke early in the morning. E. सु auspicious, and गृहीत taken, and नामन् a name.
सुग्राह्य: सुग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Easily apprehensible, easy to be laid hold of, &c. E. सु, and ग्राह्य to be taken.
सुग्रीव: सुग्रीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Handsome-necked. m. (-वः) 1 One of the horses of KṚṢṆA'S car. 2 A monkey king, the son of the sun, and sovereign of Kiṣkindhya, and friend and confederate of RĀMACANDRA. 3 The father of the ninth Jina of the present age. 4 ŚIVA. 5 INDRA. 6 A goose. 7 A hero. 8 A piece of water. 9 The name of a mountain. 10 A sort of weapon. 11 The countenance of a friend. 12 A serpent of Pātāla. E. सु handsome, and ग्रीवा a neck.
सुग्रीवेश: सुग्रीवेश m. (-शः) RĀMA. E. सुग्रीव the monkey king, and ईश lord.
सुग्ल: सुग्ल mfn. (-ग्लः-ग्ला-ग्लं) 1 Very weary. E. सु very, ग्लै to be weary, aff. क.
सुघटित: सुघटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well contrived or devised, well arranged or managed. 2 Well joined or united. 3 Brought into agreeable contact. E. सु, and घटित contrived.
सुघोर: सुघोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hideous, terrific. E. सु very, घोर fearful.
सुघोष: सुघोष m. (-षः) A pleasant sound. E. सु, and घोष sound or cry.
सुचक्षुस्: सुचक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) 1 The glomerous fig tree. 2 A wise or learned man.
सुचरित: सुचरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well conducted, well behaved. 2 Well managed or pursued. n. (-तं) Good conduct. E. सु, and चरित gone, &c.
सुचरित्र: सुचरित्र n. (-त्रं) Good or virtuous course of life. f. (-त्रा) A virtuous wife. E. सु good, and चरित्र custom.
सुचारु: सुचारु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-र्व्वी-रु) 1 Very beautiful. 2 Pleasing, delightful. E. सु very, चारु lovely.
सुचारुस्वन: सुचारुस्वन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Melodious, mellifluous. E. सुचारु, and स्वन sound.
सुचिचक: सुचिचक m. (-कः) A kingfisher. E. सु much, चिचक variegated.
सुचिन्तन: सुचिन्तन n. (-नं) Deliberate consideration. E. सु, and चिति to think, ल्युट् aff.
सुचिन्ता: सुचिन्ता f. (-न्ता) Due reflection or consideration. E. सु, and चिन्ता thinking.
सुचिन्तित: सुचिन्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well weighed, well considered. E. सु well, चिति to think, क्त aff.
सुचिरम्: सुचिरम् ind. Very long, (a time.) E. सु much, and चिरम् long time.
सुचिरायुस्: सुचिरायुस् m. (-युः) A god, a divinity. E. सु very, चिर a long time, and आयुस् life.
सुचुटी: सुचुटी f. (-टी) A pair of nippers or tongs, &c. E. सु well, चुट to cut, aff. क, and ङीष् added.
सुचेलक: सुचेलक m. (-कः) Cloth or fine cloth. E. सु excellent, चेल cloth, and कन् added.
सुजन: सुजन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Virtuous, good, respectable. 2 Kind, benevolent. m. (-नः) The charioteer of INDRA. E. सु good, and जन person.
सुजनता: सुजनता f. (-ता) 1 Goodness, benevolence. 2 A number of respectable persons. E. सुजन, and तल् aff.
सुजनत्व: सुजनत्व n. (-त्वं) Kindness, benevolence. E. त्व added to सुजन.
सुजन्मन्: सुजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Legitimate, of respectable birth. E. सु, and जन्मन् birth.
सुजल: सुजल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having clear or sweet water. n. (-लं) Good water. E. सु, and जल water.
सुजाति: सुजाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of a good tribe or species. E. सु, and जाति tribe.
सुजीर्ण: सुजीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Well-digested. 2 Decayed, worn out. E. सु, and जीर्ण digested.
सुजीवित: सुजीवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lived well or to some purpose. E. (-तं) A lucky or happy life. E. सु well, जीवित living.
सुट्ट: सुट्ट r. 10th cl. (सुट्टयति) 1 To disregard, to despise. 2 To be low, small, or shallow; also षुट्ट.
सुत: सुत m. (-तः) 1 A son. 2 A prince. f. (-ता) 1 A daughter. 2 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. षु to bear or bring forth, aff. क्त.
सुतङ्गम: सुतङ्गम m. (-मः) The father of a son. E. सुत, गम to obtain, खच् aff.
सुज्ञात: सुज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well or easily known. E. सु, and ज्ञात known.
सुतनु: सुतनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः-न्वी-नु) Very thin or delicate. f. (-नुः or -न्वी) A woman. E. सु excellent, तनु thin.
सुतपस्: सुतपस् m. (-पाः) 1 A hermit, an ascetic. 2 The sun. E. सु very, profoundly, तपस् religious austerity, or तप to heat, असि Uṇādi aff.
सुतप्त: सुतप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Hot, very hot. E. सु, and तप्त heated.
सुतराम्: सुतराम् ind. 1 Better, more excellently. 2 Consequently, of course. E. सु good, and तराम् aff.
सुतर्दन: सुतर्द्दन m. (-नः) The Coïl or Indian cuckoo. E. सु much, तर्द्द to hurt, aff. युच्.
सुतर्द्दन: सुतर्द्दन m. (-नः) The Coïl or Indian cuckoo. E. सु much, तर्द्द to hurt, aff. युच्.
सुतल: सुतल m. (-लः) 1 A division of the lower regions, the sixth in descent. 2 The basement or foundation of a large building (?) E. सु well, and तल deep, profound.
सुतवत्: सुतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having children. m. (-वान) 1 A drinker of the Asclepias juice. 2 The father of a son. E. सुत, and मतुप् aff.
सुतवस्करा: सुतवस्करा f. (-रा) The mother of seven children.
सुतश्रेणी: सुतश्रेणी f. (-णी) A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. सुत offspring, and श्रेणी a line.
सुतस्नेह: सुतस्नेह m. (-हः) Paternal affection. E. सुत, and स्नेह affection.
सुतात्मज: सुतात्मज m. (-जः) A grandson. f. (-जा) A grand-daughter. E. सुत a son, or सुता a daughter, and आत्मजा a daughter.
सुतारका: सुतारका f. (-का) A sort of tutelar goddess peculiar to the Jainas.
सुतार्थिन्: सुतार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Desirous of having a son. E. सुत, and अर्थिन् who seeks.
सुतिक्तक: सुतिक्तक m. (-कः) A kind of gentian, (Gentiana cherayta.) 2 The coral tree. E. सु very, तिक्त bitter, कन् added.
सुतिन्: सुतिन् m. (-ती) A father, one who has a son. f. (-नी) A mother, the mother of a son. E. सुत, and इनि aff., fem. form.
सुतीक्ष्ण: सुतीक्ष्ण mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं) 1 Very sharp. 2 Very pungent. 3 Acutely painful. m. (-क्ष्णः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) E. सु exceedingly, and तीक्ष्ण sharp, &c.
सुतुङ्ग: सुतुङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Very lofty or tall. m. (-ङ्गः) The cocoanut tree. E. सु very, तुङ्ग tall.
सुतेजस्: सुतेजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) 1 Very bright, splendid. 2 Potent. m. (-जाः) One of the Jinas of the last age. E. सु much, तेजस् light or glory.
सुतोत्पत्ति: सुतोत्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Birth of a son. E. सुत, and उत्पत्ति birth.
सुत्या: सुत्या f. (-त्या) Religious bathing. E. षु to bear, क्यप् aff., form irr., more usually सूत्या.
सुत्रामन्: सुत्रामन् m. (-मा) INDRA. E. सु good, चा to preserve, (the world,) मनिन् aff.; also सूत्रामन्.
सुत्वन्: सुत्वन् m. (-त्वा) A student who has performed his ablutions subsequent, or according to some, preparatory to a sacrifice. 2 A drinker of the Asclepias juice. 3 An offerer of the same. E. षु to bring forth, क्वनिप् aff., तुक् augment.
सुदक्षिण: सुदक्षिण m. (-णः) A sovereign of Vidarbha. f. (-णा) The wife of DILĪPA. E. सु very, दक्षिण clever.
सुदत्: सुदत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Having handsome teeth. E. सु handsome, and दतृ for दन्त a tooth.
सुदत्त: सुदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Well or properly given. E. सु, and दत्त given.
सुदन्त: सुदन्त m. (-न्तः) An actor, a dancer. f. (-न्ती) The female elephant of the N. W. quarter. E. सु good, handsome, and दन्त a tooth.
सुदम: सुदम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Easy to be subdued. E. सु, and दम taming.
सुदर्शन: सुदर्शन mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं) Handsome, good looking. m. (-नः) 1 The discus of KṚṢṆA. 2 Mount Meru. 3 The rose-apple, (Eugenia jambu.) 4 The father of the eighteenth Jaina pontiff of the present era. 5 One of the nine Śuklabalas or BALARĀMAS of the Jainas. 6 A vulture. nf. (-नं-नी) The city of INDRA. f. (-ना) 1 A drug. 2 Order, command. 3 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 4 A woman, a handsome woman. E. सु good, दर्शन sight or appearance.
सुदान्त: सुदान्त m. (-न्तः) A follower of Śākya Muni, the teacher of the Bauddhas. E. सु well, and दान्त tamed, (whose passions).
सुदामन्: सुदामन् m. (-मा) 1 A cloud. 2 A mountain. 3 INDRA'S elephant. 4 The name of a cowherd. 5 The sea. 6 A poor Brahman raised to wealth and honours by KṚṢṆA. E. सु good, excellent, and दामन् a cord.
सुदाय: सुदाय m. (-यः) A special gift, as alms to a student at his initiation, a nuptial present, &c. E. सु auspicious, and दाय a gift.
सुदारु: सुदारु m. (-रुः) The Pāriyātra mountains, part of the Vindhya range.
सुदि: सुदि ind. The light half of the lunar month.
सुदिन: सुदिन n. (-नं) A fine day, fine weather. E. सु, and दिन a day.
सुदिनाह: सुदिनाह n. (-हं) A fine day. E. सुदिन fair weather, and अह for अहन् a day.
सुदिव: सुदिव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Happy daily, passing pleasant days. E. सु, and दिव a day.
सुदीर्घ: सुदीर्घ mfn. (-र्घः-र्घा-र्घं) Very long, (in space or time.) E. सु very, and दीर्ध long.
सुदुराचार: सुदुराचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very wicked, abandoned, a profligate. E. सु very, दुराचार bad.
सुदुरारुह: सुदुरारुह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Inaccessible. E. सु and दुर with आङ before रुह to mount, क aff.
सुदुर्जय: सुदुर्जय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Difficult to be overcome. E. सु very, दुर्जय difficult to be conquered.
सुदुर्दर्श: सुदुर्द्दर्श mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं) Difficult to be beheld. E. सु very, दुर्द्दर्श difficult to be seen.
सुदुर्द्दर्श: सुदुर्द्दर्श mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं) Difficult to be beheld. E. सु very, दुर्द्दर्श difficult to be seen.
सुदुर्लभ: सुदुर्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Difficult to be attained, unattainable, impracticable. E. सु very, दुर्लभ difficult.
सुदुश्चर: सुदुश्चर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Very arduous or painful, difficult to be performed or attained. E. सु very, दुश्चर arduous.
सुदुष्कर: सुदुष्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Very difficult. E. सु very, दुष्कर difficult.
सुदुस्तर: सुदुस्तर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Impassable, difficult to be passed or crossed. E. सु very, दुर् difficult, तॄ to cross, टच् aff.
सुदुस्सह: सुदुस्सह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Very difficult to be endured. E. सु very, दुस्सह unendurable.
सुदूर: सुदूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very distant. E. सु very, and दूर remote.
सुदृश्: सुदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Having handsome eyes. f. (-दृक्) A pretty woman. E. सु excellent, and दृश् sight.
सुदृढ: सुदृढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Solid, firm. n. adv. (-ढं) Very hard or firm. E. सु very, and दृढ hard.
सुधन्वन्: सुधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) 1 An archer, a bowman. 2 VIŚVAKARMA, the artist of the gods. 3 A prince so named. E. सु good, and धनुम् a bow, अनङ् substituted for the final.
सुधर्म: सुधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) One of the principal disciples of Mahāvīra, the last Jina of the present age; he survived his master, and the different ascetics or candidates for holiness are traced from him in regular succession; none of the other ten disciples of Mahāvīra having left successors. f. (-र्म्मी) A council of the gods. E. सु excellent, and धर्म्म virtue.
सुधर्म्म: सुधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) One of the principal disciples of Mahāvīra, the last Jina of the present age; he survived his master, and the different ascetics or candidates for holiness are traced from him in regular succession; none of the other ten disciples of Mahāvīra having left successors. f. (-र्म्मी) A council of the gods. E. सु excellent, and धर्म्म virtue.
सुधर्मन्: सुधर्म्मन् mf. (-र्म्मा) The council or assembly of the gods. m. (-र्म्मा) A man attentive to the proper maintenance of his family. E. सु excellent, धर्म्म virtue, अनिच् aff.
सुधर्म्मन्: सुधर्म्मन् mf. (-र्म्मा) The council or assembly of the gods. m. (-र्म्मा) A man attentive to the proper maintenance of his family. E. सु excellent, धर्म्म virtue, अनिच् aff.
सुधा: सुधा f. (-धा) 1 Nectar, the beverage of immortality and sustenance of the gods. 2 The nectar or honey of flowers. 3 Juice. 4 Plaster, mortar. 5 A brick. 6 The Ganges. 7 Water. 8 Lightning. 9 The milk-hedge plant, (Euphorbia antiquorum, &c.) 10 A plant, (Aletris Hyacinthoides.) 11 Emblic myrobalan. 12 Yellow myrobalan. E. सु pleasure, धे to drink, or धा to have, to support, (life,) अङ् and टाप् affs.
सुधांशु: सुधांशु m. (-शुः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. सुधा nectar, and अंशु a ray of light, the moon being the supposed repository of the beverage of the gods.
सुधांशुतैल: सुधांशुतैल n. (-लं) Camphorated oil. E. सुधांशु Camphor, and तैल oil.
सुधांशुरत्न: सुधांशुरत्न n. (-त्नं) A pearl. E. सुधांशु the moon, and रत्न a jewel.
सुधाकर: सुधाकर m. (-रः) The moon. E. सुधा nectar, आकर a mine.
सुधाङ्ग: सुधाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The moon. E. सुधा nectar, and अङ्ग body or substance.
सुधाजीविन्: सुधाजीविन् m. (-वी) A bricklayer, a plasterer. E. सुधा plaster, and जीविन् who lives by.
सुधाधवलित: सुधाधवलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) White-washed, stuccoed, plastered. E. सुधा, and धवलित whitened.
सुधाधार: सुधाधार m. (-रः) The moon. E. सुधा nectar, and आधार a receptacle.
सुधानिधि: सुधानिधि m. (-धिः) The moon. E. सुधा nectar, and निधि a receptacle.
सुधापाणि: सुधापाणि m. (-णिः) The divine physician, DHANVANTARI. E. सुधा nectar, पाणि hand, bearing in his hands the beverage of immortality.
सुधाभवन: सुधाभवन n. (-नं) 1 A stuccoed house. 2 The fifth Muhūrta or hour after noon. E. सुधा, and भवन mansion.
सुधाभुज्: सुधाभुज् m. (-भुक्) A deity, an immortal. E. सुधा nectar, भुज to enjoy, aff. क्विप्.
सुधाभृति: सुधाभृति m. (-तिः) 1 Sacrifice, oblation. 2 The moon. E. सुधा nectar, and भृति cherishing.
सुधामय: सुधामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Made of plaster, &c. 2 Consisting of nectar. m. (-यः) A palace, a mansion, a brick or stone building. E. सुधा mortar or a brick, and मयट् aff.
सुधावर्ष: सुधावर्ष m. (-र्षः) A shower of ambrosia. E. सुधा, and वर्ष rain.
सुधावर्षिन्: सुधावर्षिन् m. (-र्षी) 1 A Buddha or deified sage of the Bauddha religion. 2 BRAHMĀ. E. सुधा nectar, and वर्षिन् raining.
सुधावृष्टि: सुधावृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A shower of ambrosia. E. सुधा, and वृष्टि rain.
सुधाश्रवा: सुधाश्रवा f. (-वा) The uvula or soft palate. E. सुधा nectar or water, श्रु to distil, अप् and टाप् affs.
सुधासूति: सुधासूति m. (-तिः) 1 The moon. 2 Sacrifice, oblation. 3 A lotus. E. सुधा nectar, सूति birth, production.
सुधास्यन्द: सुधास्यन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दी-न्दं) Shedding ambrosia. E. सुधा, and स्यन्द what sheds.
सुधाहर: सुधाहर m. (-रः) GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. सुधा nectar, and हर who steals; having on one occasion stolen the moon for the sake of the Amṛta which was to be communicated to the serpent children of KADRU, in consideration of which his mother VINATĀ was to be released from a state of servitude to KADRU, the wife, as well as herself, of the sage KAŚYAPA.
सुधाहृत्: सुधाहृत् m. (-हृत्) GARUḌA. E. सुधा nectar, and हृत् taking, stealing; see the last.
सुधिति: सुधिति mf. (-तिः-तिः) An axe. E. सु well, धि to hold, क्तिन् aff.; more correctly स्वधितिः.
सुधी: सुधी m. (-धीः) 1 A Paṇḍita, a learned man or teacher. 2 An intelligent person. E. सु well, ध्यै to think, aff. क्विप्.
सुधोद्भव: सुधोद्भव m. (-वः) DHANVANTARI, the physician of Svarga. f. (-वा) Chebulic myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) E. सुधा nectar, and उद्भव produced.
सुनन्द: सुनन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Pleasing, delighting. n. (-न्दं) The club of BALARĀMA. f. (-न्दा) 1 The goddess UMĀ. 2 A sort of pigment and drug: see गोरोचना. 3 A woman. 4 One of UMĀ'S female companions. 5 A plant, (Aristolochia Indica.) E. सु well, thoroughly, नदि to please, aff. अच्.
सुनय: सुनय m. (-यः) 1 Policy. 2 Good conduct. E. सु, and णी to take, अच् aff.
सुनयन: सुनयन m. (-नः) A deer. f. (-ना) A woman. E. सु good, excellent, and नयन the eye.
सुनाभ: सुनाभ m. (-भः) A mountain; part of the ranges of southern India, personified as the son of Himālaya, and Menā. E. सु well, नाभि the navel.
सुनार: सुनार m. (-रः) 1 The udder of a bitch. 2 The egg of a snake. 3 A sparrow.
सुनासीर: सुनासीर m. (-रः) INDRA. E. सु good, excellent, नासीर the van of an army, the leader of the celestial hosts; also शुनासीर.
सुनिग्रह: सुनिग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Easily restrained. E. सु, and निग्रह confinement.
सुनिद्रा: सुनिद्रा f. (-द्रा) Sound sleep. E. सु, and निद्रा sleep.
सुनिभृत: सुनिभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Very lonely or private. E. सु, and निभृत lonely.
सुनिभृतम्: सुनिभृतम् ind. Privately, very secretly. E. सु, and निभृतम् privately.
सुनिरूपित: सुनिरूपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well observed or inspected. E. सु, and निरूपित seen.
सुनिश्चित: सुनिश्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ascertained, determined. 2 Commended, approved. m. (-तः) A deified sage, according to the Jainas or Bauddhas. E. सु well, thoroughly, and निश्चित ascertained.
सुनिषण्णक: सुनिषण्णक n. (-कं) A potherb, (Marsilia quadrifolia.) E. सु well, निषण्ण depression of spirits or drowsiness, कन् aff.; also without the final, सुनिषण्ण.
सुनिष्टप्त: सुनिष्टप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Burnished. E. सु well, thoroughly, and निष्टप्त heated.
सुनीत: सुनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well behaved. 2 Politic. n. (-तं) 1 Good conduct. 2 Policy. E. सु well, णी to guide, क्त aff.
सुनीति: सुनीति f. (-तिः) 1 Propriety of behaviour, good manners. 2 The mother of DHRUVA. E. सु good, excellent, and नीति morals or manners.
सुनीथ: सुनीथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Virtuous, moral, good, of proper disposition or conduct. E. सु well, नी to obtain, aff. थक्.
सुनील: सुनील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Very black or blue, dark. m. (-लः) The pomegranate tree. n. (-लं) The root of the Andropogon muricatum. E. सु much, नील blue or black.
सुनीलक: सुनीलक m. (-कः) 1 The blue shrike. 2 The emerald or sapphire. E. सु very, नील blue or black, कन् aff.
सुन्दर: सुन्दर mfn. (-रः-रा or -री-रं) Handsome, beautiful. m. (-रः) KĀMADEVA. f. (-री) 1 A handsome woman. 2 A small timber tree, (Heritiera minor.) 3 Turmeric. 4 A species of metre. E. सु good, excellent, दृ to respect, aff. अप्; or सु, with उन्दि to moisten, aff. अरन्.
सुन्वत्: सुन्वत् mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वती-न्वत्) Sacrificing, offering sacrifice. E. षुञ् to sacrifice, and शतृ aff.
सुपक्व: सुपक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) Ripe, mature. m. (-क्वः) A sort of mango. E. सु well, thoroughly, and पक्व ripe.
सुपच: सुपच n. (-चं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. सु good, and पच leaf.
सुपथ: सुपथ m. (-थः) 1 A good road. 2 Good conduct. E. सु good, पथिन् a road, अच् aff.
सुपथिन्: सुपथिन् m. (-न्थाः) 1 A good road. 2 A country, &c. having good roads. E. सु good, and पथिन् a road.
सुपरीक्षण: सुपरीक्षण n. (-णं) Examining or trying well or thoroughly. E. सु, and परीक्षण trying.
सुपरीक्षित: सुपरीक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well examined or tried. E. सु, and परीक्षित tried.
सुपर्ण: सुपर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. 2 A tree, (Cassia fistula.) 3 A cock. 4 A being of a superhuman character, or GARUḌA, and other birds of an equally fanciful description; one of those classes first created by the BRAHMĀDIKAS, and included in the daily presentation of water to deceased ancestors, &c. f. (-र्णा or र्णी) 1 The mother of GARUḌA. 2 A number of lotuses, or a pool abounding with them. E. सु handsome, and पर्ण a leaf or feather.
सुपर्णक: सुपर्णक m. (-कः) 1 A kind of Cassia, (C. fistula.) 2 A small tree, (Echites scholaris.) 3 A bird of superhuman character: see the last. E. सु good, पर्ण a wing, and कन् added.
सुपर्णकेतु: सुपर्णकेतु m. (-तुः) VIṢṆU. E. सुपर्ण GARUḌA, and केतु symbol.
सुपर्णाख्य: सुपर्णाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) E. सुपर्ण Cassia, and आख्य appellation.
सुपर्णीतनय: सुपर्णीतनय m. (-यः) GARUḌA. E. सुपर्णी a name of VINATĀ, and तनय a son.
सुपर्वन्: सुपर्व्वन् m. (-र्व्वा) 1 A god, a deity. 2 An arrow. 3 A bambu. 4 A lunar day, in which religious ceremonies are particularly performed, as the new moon, and the eighth and the fourteenth days of each fortnight. 5 Smoke. E. सु good or much, and पर्व्वन् a knot or joint.
सुपर्व्वन्: सुपर्व्वन् m. (-र्व्वा) 1 A god, a deity. 2 An arrow. 3 A bambu. 4 A lunar day, in which religious ceremonies are particularly performed, as the new moon, and the eighth and the fourteenth days of each fortnight. 5 Smoke. E. सु good or much, and पर्व्वन् a knot or joint.
सुपर्याप्त: सुपर्य्याप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Extensive, vast. 2 Comprehensive. 3 Well laid out, (as a palace with all sorts of buildings.) E. सु, and पर्य्याप्त complete.
सुपर्य्याप्त: सुपर्य्याप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Extensive, vast. 2 Comprehensive. 3 Well laid out, (as a palace with all sorts of buildings.) E. सु, and पर्य्याप्त complete.
सुपलायित: सुपलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Completely fled or run away. n. (-तं) A total rout or retreat. E. सु, and पलायित fled.
सुपात्र: सुपात्र m. (-त्रः) 1 An able or clever man. 2 A vessel of earthen ware, &c. E. सु good, and पात्र a vessel.
सुपाद्: सुपाद् mfn. (-पात् or पाद्) Having a handsome foot. E. सु, and पाद् for पाद a foot.
सुपान: सुपान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Drinking well, easily, or deeply. E. सु well, षा to drink, युच् aff.
सुपार्श्व: सुपार्श्व m. (-र्श्वः) The seventh Jina or Jaina deified teacher of the present era. E. सु good, पार्श्व side.
सुपार्श्वक: सुपार्श्वक m. (-कः) 1 The third Jina of the future era. 2 The veined leaf fig, (Ficus venosa.) E. सु good, पार्श्व a side, कन् added.
सुपीडन: सुपीडन n. (-नं) Rubbing and kneading the hands and feet. E. सु pleasantly or intensely, पीड to pain, aff. ल्युट्.
सुपुत्त्र: सुपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) An excellent son. E. सु, and पुत्त्र a son.
सुपुष्प: सुपुष्प m. (-ष्पं) 1 The coral tree. 2 The Śirīṣa tree, (Mimosa Sirisha.) n. (-ष्पं) Cloves. f. (-ष्पी) 1 The plantain. 2 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa and panmorium.) 3 A flower, (Clitoria ternatea, the white sort.) E. सु excellent, पुष्प a flower.
सुपूर: सुपूर m. (-रः) A sort of lime or citron. E. सु well, and पूर what is full, (of seeds.)
सुप्त: सुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Sleeping, asleep. 2 Senseless, numbed. n. (-प्तं) Sleep, deep or sound sleep. E. ष्वप to sleep, क्त aff., and the semivowel changed to its congener.
सुप्तघातक: सुप्तघातक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mischievous, murderous. E. सुप्त asleep, and घातक killing.
सुप्तजन: सुप्तजन m. (-नः) Midnight. E. सुप्त asleep, and जन mankind.
सुप्तज्ञान: सुप्तज्ञान n. (-नं) Dreaming, a dream. E. सुप्त asleep, and ज्ञान knowledge.
सुप्तत्वच्: सुप्तत्वच् mfn. (-त्वक्) Benumbed, paralytic. E. सुप्त, and त्वच the skin.
सुप्तविज्ञान: सुप्तविज्ञान n. (-नं) A dream, dreaming. E. सुप्त sleeping, and विज्ञान knowledge.
सुप्ति: सुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Sleep, sleeping. 2 Numbness, insensibility, paralysis. 3 Drowsiness, sleepiness. 4 Trust, confidence. E. ष्वप to sleep, aff. क्तिच्.
सुप्रकाश: सुप्रकाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Manifest, apparent. 2 Public. E. सु very, प्रकाश apparent.
सुप्रतिष्ठा: सुप्रतिष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) 1 Consecration, erection, (as of a temple or idol.) 2 Fame. 3 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines, containing five syllables each. E. सु and प्रति intensitives, ष्ठा to stay or be, अङ् and टाप् affs.
सुप्रतिष्ठित: सुप्रतिष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Consecrated. 2 Celebrated. E. सु, and प्रतिष्ठा to consecrate, क्त aff.
सुप्रतिष्णात: सुप्रतिष्णात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Certain, ascertained. E. सु and प्रति before ष्णा to bathe, क्त aff.
सुप्रतीक: सुप्रतीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Well-made, handsome. m. (-कः) 1 The elephant of the north-east quarter. 2 KĀMADEVA. 3 ŚIVA. E. सु handsome, प्रतीक form.
सुप्रभ: सुप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Splendid, brilliant, glorious. m. (-भः) One of the nine Śuklabalas or BALARĀMAS of the Jainas. E. सु excellent or excessive, and प्रभा light, lustre.
सुप्रभात: सुप्रभात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Enlightened. E. सु, and प्रभात shining.
सुप्रयुक्त: सुप्रयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Joined, attached, closely connected or in contact. 2 Well managed, as an instrument or weapon. E. सु well, and प्रयुक्त joined.
सुप्रयोग: सुप्रयोग m. (-गः) 1 Dexterity, expertness. 2 Contact, approximation. E. सु well, प्रयोग junction.
सुप्रयोगविशिख: सुप्रयोगविशिख m. (-खः) A good archer. E. सु well, प्रयोग possessing, managing, and विशिख an arrow.
सुप्रलम्भ: सुप्रलम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) Easy of attainment. E. सु well, प्र before लभ to get, खल् aff.
सुप्रलाप: सुप्रलाप m. (-पः) Eloquence, elegant discourse, speaking or discoursing well. E. सु well, and प्रलाष speaking.
सुप्रसन्न: सुप्रसन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Well-pleased, favouring, favourable. m. (-न्नः) KUVERA. E. सु well, and प्रसन्न pleased.
सुप्रसाद: सुप्रसाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Kind, complacent, auspicious. m. (-दः) ŚIVA. E. सु well, good, and प्रसाद favour.
सुप्रात: सुप्रात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dawning finely, (as the day.) E. सु, प्रातर dawn, अच् aff.
सुप्रिय: सुप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Agreeable, pleasant, liked, loved. m. (-यः) (In prosody,) A foot of two short syllables, a Pyrrhic. E. सु, and प्रिय beloved.
सुफल: सुफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Bearing good fruit, (literally or figuratively.) m. (-लः) 1 The wood apple, (Feronia elephantium.) 2 The pomegranate. 3 Jujube. 4 A sort of bean, (Phaseolus Mungo.) f. (-ला) 1 Colocynth. 2 A pumpkin gourd. 3 The plantain. 4 The brown grape. E. सु good, फल fruit.
सुफेन: सुफेन n. (-नं) Cuttle-fish bone. E. सु good, फेन froth or foam.
सुबन्ध: सुबन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Well-secured, having a good binding. m. (-न्धः) Sesamum. E. सु, and बन्ध binding.
सुबुद्धि: सुबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Wise, clever, intelligent. E. सु, and बुद्धि intellect.
सुबोध: सुबोध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 1 Easily taught. 2 Of easy apprehension. m. (-धः) 1 Knowledge. 2 Waking. E. सु, and बोध making known.
सुब्रह्मण्य: सुब्रह्मण्य m. (-ण्यः) KĀRTTIKEYA. E. सु good, and ब्रह्मण्य the Brahmanical order, of whom he is the special guardian.
सुभग: सुभग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Pleasing to the eye, grateful to the sight. 2 Beloved, liked. 3 Fortunate, auspicious. m. (-गः) 1 Borax. 2 The Asoca tree. 3 The Champac, (Michelia champaca.) f. (-गा) 1 A woman beloved by her husband, a favourite wife. 2 A respectable and auspicious mother. 3 A wild variety of Arabian jasmine. 4 Turmeric. 5 Holy basil. 6 A shrub, (Hedysarum Gangeticum.) E. सु good, excellent, and भग fortune, beauty, &c.
सुभगम्भावुक: सुभगम्भावुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Become pleasant or agreeable. E. सुभग, भू to be, खुकञ् aff.
सुभगासुत: सुभगासुत m. (-तः) The son of an auspicious mother. E. सुभगा as above, and सुत son.
सुभङ्ग: सुभङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Separating or dividing easily. m. (-ङ्गः) The cocoanut tree. E. सु, and भङ्ग breaking.
सुभट: सुभट m. (-टः) A champion, a warrior. E. सु, and भट a warrior.
सुभद्र: सुभद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Propitious, auspicious, fortunate. m. (-द्रः) A name of VIṢṆU. f. (-द्रा) 1 The sister of JAGANNĀTHA, whose image is worshipped with those of that deity, and his brother BALARĀMA, and carried in procession with them in the Raṭh Yātra, or annual movement of the car of JAGANNĀTHA; she is the wife of ARJUNA. 2 A creeper, (Echites frutescens.) 3 A plant, commonly Ghṛtamaṇḍā. E. सु exceedingly, भद्र auspicious.
सुभद्रक: सुभद्रक n. (-कं) A car of the gods. m. (-कः) A tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. कन् added to the last.
सुभद्राणी: सुभद्राणी f. (-णी) A plant and drug, commonly Trāyamāṇa.
सुभद्रेश: सुभद्रेश m. (-शः) A name of ARJUNA. E. सुभद्रा the sister of JAGANNĀTHA, and ईश lord.
सुभर: सुभर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Heavily burthened. E. सु, and भर bearing.
सुभाञ्जन: सुभाञ्जन m. (-नः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) E. a various reading of शुभाञ्जन.
सुभाषित: सुभाषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Spoken well or eloquently. 2 Wellspoken, speaking or discoursing well. n. (-तं) Eloquence. m. (-तः) A deified sage, according to the Bauddhas. E. सु good, excellent, भाषा speech, इतच् aff., or भाष to speak, aff. क्त.
सुभिक्षा: सुभिक्षा f. (-क्षा) A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. सु well, भिक्ष to beg, or obtain by begging, aff. घञ्.
सुभीरक: सुभीरक m. (-कः) The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.)
सुभूम: सुभूम m. (-मः) A name of KĀRTAVĪRYA, as the eighth Cakravartī, or universal emperor, according to the Jainas. E. सु good, भूमि land, domain.
सुभृत: सुभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cherished, protected. E. सु well, भृत nourished.
सुभृश: सुभृश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Much, exceeding. n. adv. (-शं) Much, excessive. E. सु insensitive prefix, and भृश much.
सुभोगीन: सुभोगीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Desirable, fit to be enjoyed. E. सु, भोग enjoyment, ख aff.
सुभैरव: सुभैरव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Very fearful, terrific. E. सु, and भैरव the same.
सुभ्रु: सुभ्रु f. (-भ्रुः or भ्रूः) A woman. E. सु handsome, and भ्रु or भ्रू an eyebrow.
सुम: सुम n. (-मं) A flower. E. सु excellent, मा the goddess LAKṢMI; prized by her, &c.: see कुसुम.
सुमङ्गल: सुमङ्गल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Very fortunate or auspicious. f. (-ला) A plant, commonly Ghṛtamaṇḍā. E. सु very, मङ्गल auspicious.
सुमत: सुमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Friendly, well or kindly disposed. E. सु well, मन to mind, aff. क्त.
सुमति: सुमति m. (-तिः) 1 The fifth Jina or Jaina teacher of the present era. 2 One of the Jainas of the past era. f. (-तिः) Friendship, kindness. E. सु good, and मति intelligence or understanding.
सुमद: सुमद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Very drunk, mad, or empassioned. E. सु, and मद madness.
सुमदात्मजा: सुमदात्मजा f. (-जा) An Apsaras or courtesan of INDRA'S heaven. E. सु much, मद intoxication, and आत्मजा a daughter.
सुमधुर: सुमधुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Pleasant, gentle, soothing, (speech or discourse.) 2 Sweet, saccharine. E. सु very, and मधुर sweet.
सुमध्यमा: सुमध्यमा f. (-मा) A woman with a handsome waist. E. सु, and मध्यम middle.
सुमन: सुमन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Handsome, beautiful. m. (-नः) 1 Wheat. 2 The thorn-apple, (Datura metel,) f. (-ना) Great-flowered jasmine. E. सु good, मन to think, aff. अच्.
सुमनःफल: सुमनःफल m. (-लः) Elephant or wood-apple, (Feronia elephantium.) E. सुमनस् a flower, and फल fruit.
सुमनस्: सुमनस् m. (-नाः) 1 A god, an immortal. 2 A Paṇḍita, a learned man or teacher. 3 A student of the Vedas, and supplementary  sciences. 4 A plant, (Cæsalpinia Bonducella.) 5 Wheat. 6 The Nimb tree. mn. (-नाः-नः) or fem. but then always plur. even in the singular acceptation. (-सः) A flower in general. f. sing. (-नाः) Great-flowered jasmine. E. सु well, excellent, मन to think, असि aff.
सुमनोभर: सुमनोभर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Ornamented with or having flowers. E. सुमनस्, and भर who has.
सुमनोरजस्: सुमनोरजस् n. (-जः) The pollen of a flower. E. सुमनस् a flower, and रजस् dust.
सुमनोहर: सुमनोहर mn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very agreeable, pleasing, beautiful, &c. E. सु, and मनोहर grateful.
सुमन्त्रित: सुमन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well or wisely counselled, well-advised. n. (-तं) Wise counsel. E. सु, and मन्त्रित advised.
सुमन्तु: सुमन्तु m. (-न्तुः) A saint and legislator so named.
सुमहत्: सुमहत् mfn. (-हान्-हती-हत्) Very large or abundant. E. सु, and महत् great.
सुमित्र: सुमित्र m. (-त्रः) The father of the twentieth Jina of the present era. f. (-त्रा) One of the wives of DAŚARATHA, and the mother of LAKṢMAṆA. E. सु good, and मित्र a friend.
सुमित्रभू: सुमित्रभू m. (-भूः) 1 SAGARA, as one of the Cakravartīs or emperors of the Jainas. 2 The twentieth Jina of the present period. E. सुमित्र a proper name, and भू born.
सुमुख: सुमुख mfn. (-खः-खा or खी-खं) 1 Pleasing, agreeable. 2 Lovely, handsome-faced. m. (-खः) 1 The son of GARUḌA. 2 One of the serpents of Pātāla. 3 A kind of potherb. 4 A Paṇḍita, a learned man or teacher. 5 GAṆEŚA. 6 GARUḌA. n. (-खं) The mark or scratch of a finger nail. f. (-खी) A species of the Triṣṭubh metre. f. (-खा or -खी) 1 A handsome woman. 2 A mirror. E. सु excellent, मुख countenance.
सुमुखसू: सुमुखसू m. (-सूः) GARUḌA. E. सुमुख his son, and सू producing.
सुमू: सुमू mfn. (-मूः-मूः-मु) Who or what binds well. E. सु, मू to bind, क्विप् aff.
सुमेधस्: सुमेधस् mfn. (-धाः-धाः-धः) Sensible, intelligent, of good capacity or understanding. f. (-धाः) Heart pea. E. सु good, मेघस् apprehension.
सुमेरु: सुमेरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Best, excellent. m. (-रुः) 1 The sacred mountain Meru: see मेरु. 2 ŚIVA. E. सु excellent, मि to shed or scatter, (radiance,) रु aff.
सुम्नयु: सुम्नयु m. (-युः) A chanter of hymns. E. सुम्न a particular hymn, used as a verb, उ aff.
सुम्भ: सुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A country so named.
सुयन्त्रित: सुयन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-governed or regulated. E. सु, and यन्त्रित restrained.
सुयामुन: सुयामुन m. (-नः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A prince, sovereign of Kauśāmbī; also named VATSA. 3 A palace. 4 A mountain. E. सु well, यमुना the river, and अण् aff.
सुयुद्ध: सुयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) A well fought war or battle. E. सु, and युद्ध war.
सुयोधन: सुयोधन m. (-नः) A name of DURYODHANA, the chief of the Kuru family and confederates. E. सु well, or with pleasure, युध to combat, युच् aff.
सुर: सुर r. 6th cl. (सुरति) 1 To possess supreme or superhuman power. 2 To shine; also षुर.

सुर m. (-रः) 1 A god, a deity. 2 The sun. 3 A sage, a learned man. f. (-रा-री) 1 Spirituous liquor in general personified: also as a nymph, produced at the churning of the ocean. 2 A drinking vessel. 3 A snake. E. षु to possess power, Uṇādi aff. रक्, or षुर to be radiant, क affix, or सुरा wine (whose, that falling to the share of the gods,) or सु excellent, राज to shine, aff. ड, &c.
सुरक्त: सुरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Deeply or well coloured or dyed. 2 Deep red, crimson. 3 Strongly affected or impassioned. E. सु well, रञ्ज to dye, &c., aff. क्त.
सुरक्तक: सुरक्तक m. (-कः) 1 A variety of red chalk, that called golden. 2 A fruit tree, apparently a sort of mango, bearing a small red fruit. E. सुरक्त very red, and कन् added.
सुरक्षण: सुरक्षण n. (-णं) Taking good care of, protecting, preserving. E. सु, and रक्षण preserving.
सुरक्षित: सुरक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-preserved or protected. E. सु well, रक्षित preserved.
सुरगण: सुरगण m. (-णः) A class or company of divinities. E. सुर, and गण a number.
सुरगुरु: सुरगुरु m. (-रुः) VṚHASPATI, regent of Jupiter and preceptor of the gods. E. सुर a deity, and गुरु spiritual preceptor.
सुरग्रामणी: सुरग्रामणी m. (-णीः) INDRA, the ruler of Svarga. E. सुर a god, and ग्रामणी leader.
सुरङ्ग: सुरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The orange. 2 Bright or good colour or dye. n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Red sanders. 2 Vermilion. f. (-ङ्गा) A hole cut in a wall to break into a house, &c.; see सुरुङ्गा. 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) 3 Crystal. E. सु well, and रङ्ग colour.
सुरङ्गद: सुरङ्गद n. (-दं) Red sanders. E. सुरङ्ग good colour, and द what yields.
सुरङ्गधातु: सुरङ्गधातु m. (-तुः) Red chalk. E. सुरङ्ग good or much colour, and धातु a mineral.
सुरङ्गयुज्: सुरङ्गयुज् m. (-युक्) A house-breaker. E. सुरङ्ग a hole in a wall, and युज् who joins or makes.
सुरजःफल: सुरजःफल m. (-लः) The jack-fruit tree. E. सुरजस् abundant farina, and फल fruit.
सुरजनी: सुरजनी f. (-नी) Night. E. सु well, रजनी the same.
सुरज्येष्ठ: सुरज्येष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) BRAHMĀ. E. सुर a deity, and ज्येष्ठ elder.
सुरञ्जन: सुरञ्जन m. (-नः) The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.) E. सु well, and रञ्जन pleasing, affecting.
सुरत: सुरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Compassionate, tender. n. (-तं) Copulation, coition. f. (-ता) Godhead, divinity. E. सु well, रम to sport or play, aff. क्त, or सुर a deity, and तल् aff. of state or condition.
सुरतताली: सुरतताली f. (-ली) 1 A female messenger, a go-between. 2 A chaplet, a garland for the head. E. सुरत coition, and ताल tune, &c., aff. ङीष्.
सुरतोषक: सुरतोषक m. (-कः) The jewel worn by KṚṢṆA on his breast. E. सुर a deity, तुष to please, खुल् aff.
सुरदारु: सुरदारु n. (-रु) A sort of Pine, (Pinus Devadaru.) E. मुर a deity, and दारु wood.
सुरदीर्धिका: सुरदीर्धिका f. (-का) The Ganges of heaven. E. सुर a god, and दीर्धिका a pond or pool.
सुरद्विप: सुरद्विप m. (-पः) An elephant of the gods, either that of INDRA or of either of the other rulers of the different quarters. E. सुर a god, and द्विप an elephant.
सुरद्विष्: सुरद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) An Asura, an infernal being, the natural enemy of the gods. E. सुर a deity, and द्विष् an enemy.
सुरद्रुम: सुरद्रुम m. (-मः) The Deodar Pine. E. सुर, and द्रुम a tree.
सुरधनुस्: सुरधनुस् n. (-नुः) The rain-bow. E. सुर a god, and धनुस् a bow; the bow of INDRA.
सुरधूप: सुरधूप m. (-पः) Resin, turpentine. E. सुर a god, and धूप incense.
सुरनदी: सुरनदी f. (-दी) The Ganges of heaven. E. सुर a god, and नदी a river.
सुरनिम्नगा: सुरनिम्नगा f. (-गा) The Ganges. E. सुर a deity, and निम्नगा a river.
सुरन्दला: सुरन्दला f. (-ला) A river so named.
सुरपति: सुरपति m. (-तिः) INDRA, ruler of Svarga, and sovereign of the gods. E. सुर a deity, and पति master.
सुरपथ: सुरपथ n. (-थं) Sky, heaven. E. सुर a deity, and पथिन् a path.
सुरपर्ण: सुरपर्ण n. (-र्णं) A drug, probably a leaf, commonly called Machi perṇi, and described as pungent and bitter, anthelmintic, stomachic, and a remover of phlegm and catarrh. E. सुर a deity, and पर्ण a leaf.
सुरपर्णिका: सुरपर्णिका f. (-का) A tree, (Rottleria tinctoria.) E. कन् fem. form added to the last.
सुरपुरी: सुरपुरी f. (-री) The capital of INDRA. E. सुर a god, and पुरी a city.
सुरप्रिय: सुरप्रिय m. (-यः) 1 INDRA. 2 VṚHASPATI, the preceptor of the gods. 3 The Elœocarpus. E. सुर a deity, and प्रिय beloved by.
सुरभि: सुरभि mfn. (-भिः-भिः or भी-भि) 1 Fragrant, sweet-smelling. 2 Pleasing, beloved. 3 Friendly, a friend. 4 Celebrated, famous. 5 Wise, learned. 6 Handsome. 7 Good, virtuous. m. (-भिः) 1 A fragrance, a perfume, a sweet-smelling substance. 2 The Michelia Champaca. 3 Nutmeg. 4 Spring. 5 The month Chaitra, (March-April.) 6 Resin. f. (-भिः or भी) 1 The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 2 Murā, a sort of drug and perfume. 3 One of the divine Mātṛs. 4 A cow. 5 A fabulous cow, the cow of plenty, granting every wish. 6 Spirituous liquor. 7 The earth. 8 A holy basil. 9 Jasmine, of several sorts. n. (-भि) 1 Gold. 2 Sulphur. E. सु well, excellently, रभ to begin, इन् aff.
सुरभिगन्धि: सुरभिगन्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि) Fragrant, sweet-smelling. E. सुरभि fragrant, गन्ध smell, इ substituted for the final.
सुरभित: सुरभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perfumed, rendered fragrant. E. सुरभि, and इतच् aff.
सुरभित्वच्: सुरभित्वच् n. (-त्वक्) Large cardamoms. E. सुरभि fragrant, त्वच् bark.
सुरभिवल्कल: सुरभिवल्कल n. (-लं) The Laurus Cassia, or its bark. E. सुरभि fragrant, and वल्कल bark.
सुरभिवाण: सुरभिवाण m. (-णः) KĀMA. E. सुरभि a fragrance, a flower, and वाण an arrow.
सुरभिस्रवा: सुरभिस्रवा f. (-वा) The gum Olibanum tree. E. सुरभि a fragrance, and स्रव what distils.
सुरभीपचा: सुरभीपचा f. (-चा) The rose-apple, (Eugenia jambu.) E. सुरभी fragrant, and पचा leaved.
सुरभीरसा: सुरभीरसा f. (-सा) The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) E. सुरभी fragrant, रस juice, टाप् added.
सुरभूय: सुरभूय n. (-यं) The condition of a deity, deification, apotheosis. E. सुर, and भूय becoming.
सुरर्षि: सुरर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Ṛṣi, or sage of divine order, as NĀRADA, &c. E. सुर a deity, and ऋषि a saint.
सुरला: सुरला f. (-ला) 1 The Ganges. 2 Another river so named. E. सुर a deity, and ला to get or have, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
सुरलोक: सुरलोक m. (-कः) Svarga, the heaven of INDRA, and residence of the celestials. E. सुर a deity, and लोक world.
सुरवर्त्मन्: सुरवर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) Heaven, sky, ether, atmosphere. E. सुर a divinity, and वर्त्मन् a road.
सुरविद्विष्: सुरविद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) An Asura, a titan. E. सुर, and विद्विष् foe.
सुरवैरिन्: सुरवैरिन् m. (-री) An Asura, an infernal spirit. E. सुर a city, and वैरिन् an enemy.
सुरशत्रु: सुरशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) An Asura, an infernal spirit. E. सुर a deity, and शत्रु an enemy.
सुरस: सुरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Sweet. 2 Well-flavoured, sapid, juicy. 3 Elegant, (as a composition.) m. (-सः) A plant, (Vitex trifolia.) nf. (-सं-सा) Holy basil. f. (-सा) 1 The mother of the Nāgas. 2 A plant, commonly Rasan, a kind of Ophiorrhiza, (Ophiorrhiza mangos.) 3 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) 4 The moon-plant, (Asclepias acida.) 5 A name of DURGĀ. 6 A species of the Atidhṛti metre. n. (-सं) 1 Gum myrrh. 2 Cassia bark. 3 Fragrant grass. E. सु excellent, रस juice or flavour.
सुरसङ्घ: सुरसङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) A company, a number of gods. E. सुर, and सङ्घ a troop, &c.
सुरसद्मन्: सुरसद्मन् n. (-द्म) Svarga, the heaven of INDRA. E. सुर a deity, and सद्मन् a dwelling.
सुरसमिति: सुरसमिति f. (-तिः) An assemblage of the gods. E. सुर, and समिति assembling.
सुरसरित्: सुरसरित् f. (-रित्) The Ganges. E. सुर a deity, and सरित् a river.
सुरसाष्ट: सुरसाष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A class of eight plants, the Vitex trifolia, acid Asclepias, &c. E. सुरसा a juicy plant, and अष्ट eight.
सुरसिन्धु: सुरसिन्धु f. (-न्धुः) The river Ganges. E. सुर a deity, and सिन्धु a river.
सुरसुन्दरी: सुरसुन्दरी f. (-री) 1 An Apsaras or courtesan of heaven. 2 A name of DURGĀ. E. सुर a deity, and सुन्दरी a beauty.
सुराकर: सुराकर m. (-रः) The cocoanut tree. E. सुरा vinous spirit or Toddy, and कर what makes.
सुराङ्गना: सुराङ्गना f. (-ना) An Apsaras or courtesan of heaven, a nymph, a sylph, a fairy. E. सुर a deity, and अङ्गना a female.
सुराचार्य: सुराचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) VṚHASPATI, regent of JUPITER, and preceptor of the gods. E. सुर a deity, and आचार्य्य a spiritual teacher.
सुराचार्य्य: सुराचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) VṚHASPATI, regent of JUPITER, and preceptor of the gods. E. सुर a deity, and आचार्य्य a spiritual teacher.
सुराजा: सुराजा m. (-जा) A divinity. E. सु particle of eminence, राज to shine, aff. टाप् and अच्.
सुराजीव: सुराजीव m. (-वः) A distiller. E. सुरा, and आजीव livelihood.
सुराजीविन्: सुराजीविन् m. (-वी) A distiller. E. सुरा spirits, and जीविन् who lives by.
सुरात्रि: सुरात्रि f. (-त्रिः) A fine night. E. सु, and रात्रि night.
सुराधिप: सुराधिप m. (-पः) INDRA. E. सुर, and अधिप chief.
सुराध्वज: सुराध्वज n. (-जं) A tavern flag or sign. E. सुरा, and ध्वज a flag.
सुराप: सुराप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Drinking spirits. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Wise. 2 Pleasant, agreeable. 3 Preserving spirits. E. सुरा vinous liquor, or सुर a deity, पा to drink or cherish, with or without the prefix आङ्, and ठक् or क aff.
सुरापगा: सुरापगा f. (-गा) The Ganges. E. सुर a deity, and अपगा a river.
सुरापाण: सुरापाण m. plu. (-णाः) The inhabitants of eastern India. E. सुरा vinous liquor, and पान drinking; the final changed to ण.
सुरापान: सुरापान n. (-नं) 1 Drinking spirituous liquors. 2 Eating any thing to excite thirst and promote drinking. E. सुरा spirits, and पान drinking.
सुरापिन्: सुरापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Drinking wine. E. सुरा, and पा to drink, णिनि aff.
सुरापीत: सुरापीत mf. (-तः-ता-तं) Drinking wine. E. सुरा and पीत drunk.
सुराभाग: सुराभाग m. (-गः) Yeast, barm. E. सुरा spirits, and भाग a part.
सुराभाजन: सुराभाजन n. (-नं) A wine cup. E. सुरा, and भाजन a vessel.
सुरामण्ड: सुरामण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The upper part or froth of vinous liquor during fermentation, yeast, barm. E. सुरा wine, and मण्ड scum.
सुरारि: सुरारि m. (-रिः) 1 An Asura, an infernal being opposed to the gods. 2 A sprite, a goblin, a Piśāca or Yakṣa. 3 The chirp of the cricket. E. सुर a deity, and अरि an enemy.
सुरार्चन: सुरार्च्चन n. (-नं) Worshipping. E. सुरा, and अर्च्चन worshipping.
सुरार्च्चन: सुरार्च्चन n. (-नं) Worshipping. E. सुरा, and अर्च्चन worshipping.
सुरार्ह: सुरार्ह n. (-र्हं) Gold. E. सुर a god, and अर्ह worthy.
सुरालय: सुरालय m. (-यः) 1 The sacred mountain Meru, the extremity of the world's axis, and residence of the gods. 2 Svarga or paradise. 3 A tavern. E. सुर a deity, or सुरा spirituous liquor, and आलय abode.
सुराष्ट्र: सुराष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A country on the western side of India, Surat. E. सु good, and राष्ट्र district.
सुराष्ट्रज: सुराष्ट्रज nf. (-जं-जा) A fragrant earth. m. (-जः) 1 A sort of bean, a black variety of the Phaseolus Mungo. 2 A kind of poison. E. सुराष्ट्र Surat, and ज born or produced.
सुरासव: सुरासव n. (-वं) Spirituous liquor, the produce of rapid distillation. E. सुरा, and आसव spirits.
सुराह्व: सुराह्व n. (-ह्वं) A kind of Pine, (Pinus Devadaru.) E. सुर a deity, and आह्व appellation; being generally called the tree or timber of the gods, or देवद्रु, देवदारु; also सुराह्वय, &c.
सुरुङ्ग: सुरुङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) f. (-ङ्गा) A hole made under ground, or through the walls of a building, for military or felonious purposes; a mine, a breach, &c. E. सु well, रञ्ज to be intent on, aff. अच्, and उ substituted for the radical vowel.
सुरुङ्गाहि: सुरुङ्गाहि m. (-हिः) A house-breaker. E. सुरुङ्गा a hole in the wall, and अहि a snake.
सुरुज: सुरुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Sick, unwell. E. सु much, रुज sick.
सुरूढ: सुरूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Prominent, standing well up or out. E. सु, and रूढ ascended.
सुरूप: सुरूप mfn. (-पः-पा or -पी-पं) 1 Handsome, well-formed. 2 Wise, learned. E. सु excellent, and रूप form.
सुरूहक: सुरूहक m. (-कः) A horse of the colour of an ass. E. सु well, रूह to mount, क्वुन् aff.
सुरेज्य: सुरेज्य m. (-ज्यः) VṚHASPATI, teacher of the gods. E. सुर a deity, and इज्य a preceptor.
सुरेन्द्र: सुरेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of INDRA. E. सुर a deity, and इन्द्र chief.
सुरेन्द्रजित्: सुरेन्द्रजित् m. (-जित्) GARUḌA. E. सुरेन्द्र INDRA, and जित् victor; having beaten off that deity, when pursued by him to recover the nectar which GARUḌA had stolen.
सुरेन्द्रलोक: सुरेन्द्रलोक m. (-कः) The heaven of INDRA. E. सुरेन्द्र, and लोक a region.
सुरेभ: सुरेभ n. (-भं) Tin. E. सु well, रेभ to sound, aff. अच्.
सुरेवट: सुरेवट m. (-टः) A sort of betel-nut tree, (Areca gracilis or triandra.)
सुरेश्वर: सुरेश्वर m. (-रः) ŚIVA, or a personification of him, especially as one of the eleven Rudras. f. (-री) 1 The Ganges of heaven. 2 A name of DURGĀ. E. सुर a deity, and ईश्वर lord.
सुरेष्ट: सुरेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) 1 A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.) 2 The Śāl tree. 3 A kind of Punnag or Rottleria. f. (-ष्टा) The moon-plant, (Asclepias acida.) E. सुर a deity, and इष्ट wished.
सुरै: सुरै mf. (-राः) An opulent person. E. सु very, रै wealth.
सुरोत्तम: सुरोत्तम m. (-मः) The sun. E. सुर a deity, and उत्तम best.
सुरोत्तर: सुरोत्तर m. (-रः) Sandal wood. E. सुर a deity, and उत्तर excellent.
सुरोद: सुरोद m. (-दः) The sea of spirituous liquor. E. सुरा wine, and उद water.
सुलक्षण: सुलक्षण n. (-णं) Ascertaining, determining. f. (-णा) One of DURGĀ'S female companions. E. सु good, लक्षण a mark.
सुलक्षित: सुलक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-determined or ascertained. E. सु, and लक्षित marked.
सुलभ: सुलभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Easy, feasible, attainable, of easy acquisition or attainment, not difficult to be obtained or effected. E. सु ready, and लभ acquiring; opposed to दुर्लभ or difficult.
सुललित: सुललित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sporting gracefully. 2 Pleased, happy. n. adv. (-तं) Delightedly, easily. E. सु, and ललित sported.
सुलोचन: सुलोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fine-eyed. m. (-नः) 1 A deer. 2 DURYODHANA. f. (-ना) A handsome woman. E. सु excellent, and लोचन an eye.
सुलोहक: सुलोहक n. (-कं) Brass. E. सु good, लोह iron, and कन् added.
सुलोहित: सुलोहित mfn. (-तः-ता or हिणी-तं) Very red. f. (-ता) One of the seven tongues of AGNI or fire. E. सु very, लोहित red.
सुवचन: सुवचन n. (-नं) Eloquence, speaking well or elegantly. E. सु good, and वचन speech.
सुवचस्: सुवचस् mfn. (-चाः-चाः-चः) Speaking much, and eloquently or well. E. सु good, and वचस् speech.
सुवन: सुवन m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 The moon. E. षु to produce, Uṇādi aff. क्युन्.
सुवर्चक: सुवर्च्चक mf. (-र्च्चका-र्च्चिका) Natron, alkali. E. सु well, वर्च्च to shine, aff. ण्वुल्.
सुवर्च्चक: सुवर्च्चक mf. (-र्च्चका-र्च्चिका) Natron, alkali. E. सु well, वर्च्च to shine, aff. ण्वुल्.
सुवर्चला: सुवर्च्चला f. (-ला) 1 A wife of the sun. 2 Linseed, (Linum utilatissimum.) m. (-लः) A country so named. E. सु well, वर्च्च to shine, अलच् aff.
सुवर्च्चला: सुवर्च्चला f. (-ला) 1 A wife of the sun. 2 Linseed, (Linum utilatissimum.) m. (-लः) A country so named. E. सु well, वर्च्च to shine, अलच् aff.
सुवर्ण: सुवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Of a good tribe or caste. 2 Brilliant, bright. 3 Of a good colour. n. (-र्णं) 1 Gold. 2 A sort of Sandal wood. 3 A kind of red chalk or ochre. 4 Wealth, property. 5 A flower, (Mesua ferrea.) mn. (-र्णः-र्णं) A weight of gold, equal to sixteen Māṣas, which at five Rattis to each Māṣa makes the Suvarṇa equal to about 175 grains Troy. m. (-र्णः) 1 A tree, (Cassia fistula.) 2 A sort of sacrifice. f. (-र्णा) 1 Aloe wood, the black kind. 2 Turmeric. 3 A bitter gourd, (Colocynth.) 4 Sida, (Cordifolia, &c.) E. सु excellent, वर्ण tribe or colour, &c.
सुवर्णक: सुवर्णक m. (-कः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) n. (-कं) Lead. कन् added to the last.
सुवर्णकदली: सुवर्णकदली f. (-ली) A sort of plantain bearing a bright yellow fruit. E. सुवर्ण gold, and कदली the plantain.
सुवर्णकर्तृ: सुवर्णकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A goldsmith. E. सुवर्ण, and कर्त्तृ who makes.
सुवर्णकर्त्तृ: सुवर्णकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A goldsmith. E. सुवर्ण, and कर्त्तृ who makes.
सुवर्णकार: सुवर्णकार m. (-रः) A goldsmith. E. सुवर्ण gold, and कार a workman.
सुवर्णकृत्: सुवर्णकृत् m. (-कृत्) A goldsmith. E. सुवर्ण gold, and कृत् who makes.
सुवर्णगणित: सुवर्णगणित n. (-तं) (In arithmetic,) Allegation medial. E. सुवर्ण, and गणित calculation.
सुवर्णगैरिक: सुवर्णगैरिक n. (-कं) A variety of red chalk, a sort of ochre, E. सुवर्ण gold, and गैरिक red chalk.
सुवर्णचौर: सुवर्णचौर m. (-रः) A stealer of gold. E. सुवर्ण gold, and चौर theft.
सुवर्णयूथी: सुवर्णयूथी f. (-थी) Yellow jasmine. E. सुवर्ण gold, and यूथी jasmine.
सुवर्णवत्: सुवर्णवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Golden, having or being of gold. 2 Beautiful, handsome. ind. (-वत्) Like gold. E. सुवर्ण, and मतुप् or वति aff.
सुवर्णवर्णा: सुवर्णवर्णा f. (-र्णा) Turmeric. E. सुवर्ण gold, and वर्ण colour.
सुवर्णविन्दु: सुवर्णविन्दु m. (-न्दुः) VIṢṆU. E. सुवर्ण, gold, and विन्दु a dot or spot.
सुवर्णस्तेय: सुवर्णस्तेय n. (-यं) Stealing gold. E. सुवर्ण, and स्तेय theft.
सुवर्णाख्य: सुवर्णाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A flower, (Mesua ferrea.) E. सुवर्ण gold, and आख्या appellation.
सुवल्लि: सुवल्लि f. (-ल्लिः-ल्ली) A shrub, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. सु excellent, and वल्ली a stalk.
सुवस्: सुवस् mfn. (-वः) What covers or clothes well. E. सु, वस to clothe, क्विप् aff.
सुवसन्त: सुवसन्त m. (-न्तः) The day of full moon in the month Chaitra, a festival in honour of KĀMADEVA. E. सु well, वसन्त spring; being in March-April.
सुवसन्तक: सुवसन्तक m. (-कः) 1 A large creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) 2 A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA in the month of Chaitra. E. सु excellent, वसन्त the spring, and कन् added.
सुवह: सुवह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Bearing or conveying well or pleasantly. 2 Pleasant of burthen, to be borne with pleasure. 3 Patient, enduring. f. (-हा) 1 A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.) 2 A shrub, (Mimosa octandra.) 3 Rasan, conjectured to be the ichneumon plant, (Ophiorrhyza mangos.) 4 A scandent shrub, (Cissus pedata.) 5 The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 6 A Vinā, or lute. 7 A medicinal plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum.) E. सु well, much, or pleasantly, and वह bearing.
सुवास: सुवास m. (-सः) 1 A pleasant or reputable dwelling. 2 An agreeable perfume. E. सु good, and वास abode, &c.
सुवासिन्: सुवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Dwelling in a comfortable or respectable abode. f. (-नी) A woman married or unmarried, residing in her father's house. E. सु well, वास abode, इनि and ङीष् affs.
सुविक्रम: सुविक्रम m. (-मः) Prowess, valour. E. सु, and विक्रम power.
सुविक्रान्त: सुविक्रान्त m. (-न्तः) A hero. n. (-न्तं) Heroism, prowess. E. सु, and विक्रान्त valiant.
सुविचक्षण: सुविचक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Very clever. E. सु, and विचक्षण intelligent.
सुविचार: सुविचार m. (-रः) Deliberate or due consideration. E. सु, and विचार consideration.
सुविचारित: सुविचारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-weighed, deliberately considered. E. सु, and विचारित considered.
सुविदित: सुविदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-known or understood. E. सु well, विदित known.
सुविद्: सुविद् m. (-विद्) A Paṇḍita, a learned man. f. (-विद्) A shrewd or clever woman. E. सु well, विद to know, aff. क्विप्.
सुविद: सुविद m. (-दः) An attendant on the women's apartments. E. सु well, विद to know, aff. क; also सौविद.
सुविदत्: सुविदत् m. (-दः) A king. E. सुविट् a Paṇḍita, अत to associate with, aff. क्विप्.
सुविदत्र: सुविदत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Related, of kin, a kinsman, &c. E. सु well, विद to know, कचन् Uṇādi aff.
सुविदल्ल: सुविदल्ल n. (-ल्लं) A haram, a seraglio. f. (-ल्ला) A woman. E. सुविदत् a king, ला to be or have, aff. ड, form irr.
सुविध: सुविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Of a good kind, in a good or easy way. n. (-धं) Easily. E. सु, and विध kind.
सुविधि: सुविधि m. (-धिः) The ninth Jaina deified teacher of the present age. E. सु good, and विधि a precept.
सुविनीत: सुविनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-trained, properly behaved. f. (-ता) A tractable cow. E. सु exceeding, and विनीत well-behaved.
सुविलय: सुविलय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Easily fusible, liquefying. E. सु and वि before ली to melt, अच् aff.
सुविश्वस्त: सुविश्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Trusty, confidential. E. सु, and विश्वस्त trusted in.
सुविस्तर: सुविस्तर n. adv. (-रं) Fully, at length. E. सु, and विस्तर expansion.
सुविस्तीर्ण: सुविस्तीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Well spread or laid out. 2 Very broad. E. सु, and विस्तीर्ण spread.
सुवीरक: सुवीरक n. (-कं) A collyrium, prepared from the Amomum anthorhizon. E. सु well, वीर power, efficacy, and कन् added.
सुवीराम्ल: सुवीराम्ल n. (-म्लं) Sour rice-gruel. E. सु very, वीर essence, अम्ल sour.
सुवीर्य: सुवीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Great vigour. 2 The fruit of the jujube. f. (-र्य्या) Wild cotton. E. सु good, and वीर्य्य essence.
सुवीर्य्य: सुवीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Great vigour. 2 The fruit of the jujube. f. (-र्य्या) Wild cotton. E. सु good, and वीर्य्य essence.
सुवृत्त: सुवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Virtuous, good. 2 Well or handsomely round. E. सु, and वृत्त practised, &c.
सुवेल: सुवेल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Bowed, bent, stooping. 2 Tamed, humble, quiet. m. (-लः) A mountain; also called Trikūṭa. E. सु well, and वेल to move or shake, aff. अच्.
सुवेश: सुवेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Well-dressed. E. सु, and वेश attire; also सुवेष.
सुवेषिन्: सुवेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Well-dressed, ornamented, decorated. E. सु excellent, वेष ornament, decoration, इनि poss. aff.
सुव्यक्त: सुव्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Plain, manifest. n. adv. (-क्तं) Evidently, clearly. E. सु, and व्यक्त manifested.
सुव्यस्त: सुव्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Dispersed. E. सु, and व्यस्त scattered.
सुव्रत: सुव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Virtuous, strict, rigidly observing any religious vow or obligation. m. (-तः) 1 The twentieth Jina of the present age; also named Munisuvrata. 2 One of the Jainas of the future era. 3 The religious student. f. (-ता) 1 The mother of the fifteenth Jaina of the present age. 2 A cow easily milked, one of a tractable and gentle disposition. 3 A virtuous wife. E. सु well, good, व्रत a vow.
सुशक: सुशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Easily made or done. E. सु, and शक able.
सुशर्मन्: सुशर्म्मन् mfn. (-म्मा-म्मा-म्म) Exquisitely happy. m. (-र्म्मा) The name of a prince. E. सु exceeding, शर्म्मन् pleasure.
सुशर्म्मन्: सुशर्म्मन् mfn. (-म्मा-म्मा-म्म) Exquisitely happy. m. (-र्म्मा) The name of a prince. E. सु exceeding, शर्म्मन् pleasure.
सुशवी: सुशवी f. (-वी) 1 A kind of gourd, (Momordica charantia.) 2 A sort of spice, (Nigella Indica.) E. सु well, शव to go, aff. अच् and ङीष्; also सुषवी, सुसवी, &c.
सुशासित: सुशासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-governed. E. सु, and शासित governed.
सुशिख: सुशिख m. (-खः) AGNI or fire. E. सु handsome, and शिखा a crest.
सुशिरस्: सुशिरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-रः) Having a fine head. E. सु, and शिरस् head.
सुशीत: सुशीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Very cold or cooling. n. (-तं) A yellow fragrant sort of Sandal wood. 1 E. सु very, शीत cold.
सुशीतल: सुशीतल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Very cold or cooling, frigid, freezing. n. (-लं) A fragrant sort of grass; also कत्तृण. E. सु very, शीतल cold.
सुशीम: सुशीम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Cold, frigid. m. (-मः) Cold, coldness. E. सु much, श्यै to go, aff. मन्, more usually read सुषीम.
सुशील: सुशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Well-disposed, of good temper or disposition. f. (-ला) The wife of YAMA. E. सु well, and शील nature.
सुशीलता: सुशीलता f. (-ता) Natural amiability, excellence of temper or disposition. E. तल् added to the last, also सुशीलत्व n. (-त्वं).
सुशीविका: सुशीविका f. (-का) A sort of yam.
सुश्रुत: सुश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well-heard. 2 Versed in the Vedas. E. सु well, श्रुत heard.
सुश्लिष्ट: सुश्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Closely united or adhering to. E. सु, and श्लिष्ट united.
सुश्लेष: सुश्लेष m. (-षः) 1 Close or intimate union. 2 A close embrace. E. सु, and श्लेष embrace.
सुषम: सुषम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Beautiful, handsome, pleasing. 2 Same, even, all. f. (-मा) 1 Exquisite beauty. 3 A period of time peculiar to the Jainas, the second division or Ara of a large period, containing six such portions, and that in which steady happiness is enjoyed by mankind: (the word however more usually occurs written सुखमा, as derived from सुख pleasure.) E. मु handsome, सम even, all, and the स changed after this particle.
सुषवी: सुषवी f. (-वी) 1 A sort of gourd, (Momordica charantia.) 2 Black cumin-seed, generally confounded with Kalonji, (Nigella Indica.) 3 Cumin-seed. E. सु well, षु to send or direct, aff. अच्, fem. aff. ङीष्; also सुशवी, &c.
सुषामन्: सुषामन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) Sweet or kindly spoken. E. सु, and सामन् calming.
सुषि: सुषि f. (-षिः) 1 A hole. 2 Drying. 3 A tube or pipe. E. स substituted for श; see शुषि.
सुषिर: सुषिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Perforated, pierced. n. (-रं) 1 A hole. 2 A wind instrument. f. (-रा) Nali, a perfume. m. (-रः) Fire. E. स substituted for शः see शुषिर.
सुषीम: सुषीम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Cold, frigid. 2 Pleasant, agreeable. m. (-मः) 1 Cold. 2 A sort of snake. 3 The moon gem. E. सु well, सीमा a limit; also read सुषिम and सुशीम.
सुषुप्त: सुषुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Fast asleep. E. सु well, ष्वप to sleep, aff. क्त.
सुषुप्ति: सुषुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Deep sleep, profound repose, entire insensibility. E. स well, ष्वप to sleep, क्तिन् aff.
सुषुप्सु: सुषुप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Wishing to sleep. E. ष्वप, to sleep, desid. v., उ aff.
सुषेण: सुषेण m. (-णः) 1 A fruit, (Carissa Carondas.) 2 VIṢṆU. 3 The physician of the monkey chief SUGRĪVA. 4 A cane or reed, the ratan. f. (-णी) A plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum.) E. सु excellent, सेना a host or cluster.
सुषेणिका: सुषेणिका f. (-का) Black Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum.) E. कन् added to the last.
सुष्ठु: सुष्ठु ind. 1 Much, very much. 2 Well, excellent. E. सु well, स्था to stay, aff. कु.
सुश्म: सुश्म n. (-श्मं) A rope, a cord.
सुसंस्कृत: सुसंस्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dressed, seasoned, prepared with condiments, sauces, &c. 2 Entirely perfected, very highly finished, &c. E. सु well, संस्कृत made perfect.
सुसंस्थित: सुसंस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well situated or placed. 2 Being or doing well. 3 Circumscribed, well defined. E. मु and सम् before स्था to stay, क्त aff.
सुसंहत: सुसंहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well compacted or united, well knit. E. सु, and संहत collected.
सुसङ्गृहीत: सुसङ्गृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well kept or preserved. 2 Well abridged. E. सु, and सङ्गृहीत taken.
सुसवी: सुसवी f. (-वी) A sort of pungent seed, either a black species of cumin-seed or the Nigella Indica: see सुषवी.
सुसम्पद्: सुसम्पद् f. (-म्पद् or म्पत्) Fortune, prosperity. E. सु good, and सम्पद् prosperity.
सुसह: सुसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Easily borne or suffered. 2 Bearing or enduring well. E. सु well, and सह suffering.
सुसार: सुसार m. (-रः) A sort of Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.) E. सु good, सार essence.
सुसारवत्: सुसारवत् n. (-वत्) Crystal. E. सु excellent, सार essence, मतुप् aff.
सुसीमा: सुसीमा f. (-मा) The mother of the sixth Jaina teacher.
सुसेवित: सुसेवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Assiduously served or attended upon. 2 Much addicted to. E. सु, and सेवित served.
सुस्थ: सुस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Well, healthy. 2 Happy, faring or living well. E. सु well, and स्थ being.
सुस्थता: सुस्थता f. (-ता) 1 Health. 2 Welfare, happiness. E. सुस्थ being well, तल् aff. of condition.
सुस्थयत्: सुस्थयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Setting at rest, appeasing, consoling. E. सुस्थ being well, used as a verb, शतृ aff.
सुस्थित: सुस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Living well or happily. 2 Being well, in health or condition. E. सु, and स्थित who or what stays in.
सुस्थिति: सुस्थिति f. (-तिः) 1 Well being, welfare. 2 Health, convalescence. E. सु, and स्थिति staying.
सुस्थिर: सुस्थिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Firm, steady, stable. 2 Resolute, cool. E. सु well, and स्थिर steady.
सुस्मूर्षमाण: सुस्मूर्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Wishing or trying to recollect. E. स्मृ to remember, desid. v., शानच् aff.
सुस्वप्न: सुस्वप्न n. (-प्नं) A lucky or good dream. E. सु, and स्वप्न a dream.
सुस्नात: सुस्नात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well bathed. m. (-तः) A student, who has performed his ablutions preparatory or subsequent to a sacrifice. E. सु auspiciously, स्नात bathed.
सुस्मित: सुस्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smiling. f. (-ता) A woman with a pleasing or smiling countenance. E. मु well, pleasant, and स्मित smiling.
सुहसानन: सुहसानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having a cheerful smiling face. E. सु, हस laughing, आनन face.
सुहस्ति: सुहस्ति m. (-स्तिः) One of the ten persons called Pūrbadharas by the Jainas.
सुहित: सुहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Satiate, satisfied. 2 Fit, right, suitable. 3 Kindly, friendly. f. (-ता) One of the tongues of AGNI or fire. E. सु well, हित placed, &c.
सुहृत्तम: सुहृत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Friendly, cordial, kind. E. सुहृत् a friend, तमप् aff.
सुहृत्ता: सुहृत्ता f. (-त्ता) Friendship, affection. E. सुहृत्, and तल् aff.; also सुहृत्वं.
सुहृद्: सुहृद् m. (-हृद् or हृत्) 1 A friend. 2 An ally. E. सु good, kind, हृद् heart.
सुहृदय: सुहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Good hearted. E. सु excellent, हृदय the heart.
सुहृद्बल: सुहृद्बल n. (-लं) The army of an ally. E. सुहृद्, and वल an army.
सुहृद्भेद: सुहृद्भेद m. (-दः) The separation of friends. E. सुहृद्, and भेद division.
सू: सू f. (-सूः) 1 Sending, ordering, dispatching. 2 Bearing, parturition. E. षू to bear or send, aff. क्विप्.
सूक: सूक m. (-कः) 1 Air, wind. 2 An arrow. 3 A lotus. E. षू to bring forth, क्विप् affix, and कन् added.
सूकर: सूकर m. (-रः) 1 A hog. 2 A potter. 3 A sort of deer, (the hog deer.) f. (-री) A sort of moss, (Lycopodium imbricatum.) E. स substituted for श; see शूकर.
सूक्त: सूक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Well or properly said. n. (-क्तं) A hymn in the Ṛk Veda. f. (-क्ता) The Śārika or Maina. E. सु well, उक्त spoken, (by which.)
सूक्षण: सूक्षण n. (-णं) Disrespect. E. सूक्ष to disrespect, aff. ल्युट्, and the र rejected; also सूर्क्षण.
सूक्ष्म: सूक्ष्म mfn. (-क्ष्मः-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मं) 1 Little, small. 2 Minute, atomic. 3 Fine, delicate. 4 Ingenious, subtle. m. (-क्ष्मः) 1 An atom. 2 Clearingnut plant, (Strychnos potatorum.) n. (-ह्यं) 1 The Supreme Soul, the subtle and invisible spirit that pervades all existence. 2 Fraud, cheating. 3 Fine thread, &c. 4 A figure of rhetoric, the delicate or subtle expression of act or intention. 5 Subtlety, ingenuity, craft. f. (-क्ष्मा) 1 A kind of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.) 2 Small cardamoms. 3 A perfume, consisting of a substance in small grains: see Elavāluka. E. सूच् to inform or make known, स्मन् Uṇādi aff.
सूक्ष्मतण्डुला: सूक्ष्मतण्डुला f. (-ला) 1 Long-pepper. 2 A sort of grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) E. सूक्ष्म fine, तण्डुला grain.
सूक्ष्मत्व: सूक्ष्मत्व n. (-त्वं) Fineness, subtilty. E. सूक्ष्म, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, सूक्ष्मता.
सूक्ष्मदर्शिन्: सूक्ष्मदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Acute, quick, sharp-sighted, intelligent. E. सूक्ष्म small, fine, and दर्शिन् who sees.
सूक्ष्मदारु: सूक्ष्मदारु m. (-रुः) A thin plank of wood. E. सूक्ष्म fine, small, and दारु wood.
सूक्ष्मपच: सूक्ष्मपच m. (-चः) 1 Coriander seed. 2 A wild kind of cumin. 3 A sort of mustard. 4 A red sort of sugar-cane. 5 The gum Arabic tree, (Mimosa Arabica.) E. सूक्ष्म fine, small, and पच a leaf.
सूक्ष्मपर्णी: सूक्ष्मपर्णी f. (-र्णी) Rāmadūtī, a plant so called. E. सूक्ष्म small, and पर्ण a leaf.
सूक्ष्मफला: सूक्ष्मफला f. (-ला) A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. सूक्ष्म small, and फल a fruit.
सूक्ष्मबुद्धि: सूक्ष्मबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) 1 Sharp, shrewd, intelligent, acute. f. (-द्धिः) Mental acumen. E. सूक्ष्म, and बुद्धि understanding.
सूक्ष्ममक्षिका: सूक्ष्ममक्षिका f. (-का) A musquito, a gnat. E. सूक्ष्म small, and मक्षिका a fly.
सूक्ष्मवस्त्र: सूक्ष्मवस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) Fine cloth. E. सूक्ष्म fine, वस्त्र cloth.
सूक्ष्मशरीर: सूक्ष्मशरीर n. (-रं) The subtle body invested by and the archetype of the grosser and perceptible frame. E. सूक्ष्म, and शरीर body.
सूक्ष्मशालि: सूक्ष्मशालि m. (-लिः) A small and fine kind of rice. E. सूक्ष्म small, and शालि rice.
सूक्ष्मषट्चरण: सूक्ष्मषट्चरण m. (-णः) A sort of tick or louse breeding at the roots of the eye-lashes. E. सूक्ष्म small, and षद्परण an insect.
सूक्ष्मीकृत: सूक्ष्मीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made thin or minute. E. सूक्ष्म, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
सूक्ष्मीभूत: सूक्ष्मीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become fine, subtle, minute. E. सूक्ष्म, भूत become, and च्चि augment.
सूच: सूच r. 10th cl. (सूचयति) To give information, to espy.

सूच m. (-चः) The shoot of the Kuśa grass. f. (-ची) A needle. see सूचि. (-चा) 1 Gesticulation. 2 Sight, seeing. 3 Piercing. E. सिव to sew, चट् Uṇādi aff., and ऊ substituted for the final, or सूच to make known, aff. अच् and टाप्.
सूचक: सूचक m. (-कः) 1 A spy, an informer. 2 A teacher, an instructor. 3 A needle. 4 A dog. 5 A crow. 6 A cat. 7 A scoundrel, a villain. 8 The manager or chief actor of a company. 9 A Buddha. 10 A Siddha. 11 A demon, an imp or goblin. E. सूच to make known, ण्वुल् aff.
सूचन: सूचन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Information, informing. 2 Teaching, shewing, describing. f. (-ना) 1 Piercing. 2 Wickedness. 3 Gesture, gesticulation, conveying any intimation by signs. 4 Sight, seeing. E. सूच to make known, aff. युच्.
सूचि: सूचि f. (-चिः-ची) 1 A needle. 2 Piercing, perforating. 3 Indication of a passion or feeling by signs, gesture, gesticulation. 4 A mode of dancing. 5 A mode of array, a sharp file or column. 6 A triangle formed by the sides of a trapezium produced to the point of meeting. 7 A cone, a pyramid. 8 (In astronomy,) The earth's disc in computing eclipses. 9 An index, a catalogue. E. सूच to make known, aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added; or सिव to sew, &c., Uṇādi aff. चट; see सूच.
सूचिक: सूचिक m. (-कः) A tailor. f. (-का) 1 An elephant's trunk. 2 A needle. E. सूचि a needle, ठक् aff., or कन् added to the last.
सूचिकाधर: सूचिकाधर m. (-रः) An elephant. E. सूचिका a trunk, and धर who has.
सूचिखात: सूचिखात m. (-तः) A sharp pyramid or pyramidal excavation. E. सूचि, and खात a pit.
सूचिकामुख: सूचिकामुख n. (-खं) A shell, a conch. E. सूचिका a needle, and सुख a mouth.
सूचित: सूचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Communicated, told, made known. E. सूच to make known or inform, क्त aff.
सूचिता: सूचिता f. (-ता) Needle-work. E. सूचि a needle, तल् aff.
सूचिन्: सूचिन् mfn. (-ची-चिनी-चि) 1 Spying, informing. 2 Piercing. m. (-ची) A spy, an informer. f. (-नी) 1 A needle. 2 Night. E. सूच to make known, णिनि aff.
सूचिपुष्प: सूचिपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) E. सूचि a needle, and पुष्प a flower.
सूचिरोमन्: सूचिरोमन् m. (-मा) A hog. E. सूचि a needle, (a bristle,) and रोमन् hair.
सूचिवत्: सूचिवत् m. (-वान्) GARUḌA. E. सूचि a needle, (a beak,) and मतुप् poss. aff.
सूचिवदन: सूचिवदन m. (-नः) 1 The mungoose. 2 A musquito. E. सूचि a needle, (a sharp nose or proboscis,) and वदन face.
सूचीपुष्प: सूचीपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) E. सूची a needle, a thorn, and पुष्प flower.
सूचीमुख: सूचीमुख n. (-खं) The diamond. m. (-खः) A bird. E. सूची a needle or a beak, and मुख chief.
सूचीभेद्य: सूचीभेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 Palpable, tangible. 2 To be pierced, or penetrated by a needle. E. सूची, and भेद्य to be pierced.
सूचीरोमन्: सूचीरोमन् m. (-मा) A hog. E. सूची a needle, (a bristle,) and रोमन् hair.
सूच्य: सूच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Informable, communicable. E. सूच to inform, यत् aff.; also सूचनीय and सूचितव्य.
सूच्यग्र: सूच्यग्र n. (-ग्रं) The point of a needle. E. सूची, and अग्र point.
सूच्यग्रस्थूलक: सूच्यग्रस्थूलक m. (-कः) A sort of grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.) E. सूचि a needle, अग्र a point, and स्थूलक thick.
सूच्यास्य: सूच्यास्य m. (-स्यः) A rat. E. सूची a needle, and आस्य face.
सूत: सूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, engendered. 2 Sent, dispatched. 3 Drank. 4 Gone, departed. m. (-तः) 1 A charioteer. 2 A carpenter. 3 A man of a mixed race, descended from a Kṣatriya father, and mother of the sacerdotal tribe; his occupation is managing horses and driving cars. 4 A bard, an encomiast. 5 The sun. mn. (-तः-तं) Quicksilver. f. (-ता) A woman lying in. E. षू to bring forth, क्त aff.
सूतक: सूतक n. (-कं) 1 Birth, production. 2 Impurity from child-birth or miscarriage. mn. (-कः-कं) Quicksilver. f. (-का-तिका) A woman recently delivered. E. कन् added to the last.
सूतपुत्त्र: सूतपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A name of KARṆA. E. सूत the sun, and पुत्त्र son; also सूतपुत्त्रक and similar compounds, as सूततनय, &c.
सूति: सूति f. (-तिः) 1 Birth, production, delivery, parturition, bringing forth. 2 Offspring, progeny. 3 Sewing. E. षू to bring forth, as young, or सिव to sew, क्तिच् aff.; in the latter ऊ is substituted for the finals.
सूतिकागृह: सूतिकागृह n. (-हं) A part of a house appropriated to the women, or to a lying-in woman especially. E. सूतका or सूतिका a lying-in woman. and गृह house or room; hence also सूतकागृह n. (-हं).
सूतिकाभवन: सूतिकाभवन n. (-नं) The lying-in chamber: see the last. E. सूतिका a lying-in woman, and भवन a house.
सूतिगृह: सूतिगृह n. (-हं) The lying-in chamber: see सूतिकागृह. E. सूति delivery, child-birth, गृह a house.
सूतीगृह: सूतीगृह n. (-हं) The lying-in chamber. E. सूति delivery, and गृह a house, and the vowel made long: see सूतिकागृह.
सूतीमास: सूतीमास m. (-सः) The last month of pregnancy. E. सूति delivery, and मास month.
सूत्कार: सूत्कार n. (-रं) Snorting, roaring, any sound expressive of impatience or aversion. E. सूत् imitative sound, and कार making.
सूत्तर: सूत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Superior. 2 Northern. E. सु very, उत्तर beyond.
सूत्त: सूत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Well or entirely given. E. सु, and दत्त given, form irr.
सूत्थान: सूत्थान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dexterous, clever. E. सु well, उत्थान exertion.
सूत्या: सूत्या f. (-त्या) Religious bathing, ablution, preparatory or subsequent to a sacrifice. 2 Drinking the juice of the acid Asclepias at a sacrifice. E. सू to bear, (fruit or offspring,) क्यप् aff., तुक् augment, and टाप् fem. aff.
सूत्याशौच: सूत्याशौच n. (-चं) Impurity from child-birth, continuing for ten days, or if in consequence of a miscarriage, for as many days as months had passed since conception. E. सूति child-bearing, अशौच impure.
सूत्र: सूत्र r. 10th cl. (सूचयति) To bind, to thread, to string.

सूत्र m. (-त्रं) 1 A thread in general. 2 A rule, a precept, in morals or science; a short, obscure, and technical sentence, enjoining some observance in law or religion, or intimating some rule in grammar, logic, &c.; in each case it is the fundamental and primitive part of Hindu learning, and is the form in which the works of the early and supposed inspired writers appear; the ingenuity and labour of subsequent authors having expanded and explained the original Sūtras in various commentaries and glosses. 3 An opinion or decree in law. 4 A string, a collection of threads, as that worn by the three first classes, &c. E. षिव to sew, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff., and इव changed to ऊ, or सूत्र to string, क aff.
सूत्रकण्ठ: सूत्रकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 A Brahman. 2 A wagtail. 3 A dove, a pigeon. E. सूत्र a thread, and कण्ठ throat.
सूत्रकोण: सूत्रकोण m. (-णः) A small hour-glass-shaped drum, struck by a string and button fastened to it. E. सूत्र a string, and कोण corner; also with कन् added, सूत्रकोणक m. (-कः)
सूत्रगण्डिका: सूत्रगण्डिका f. (-का) A stick used in spinning the threads to be employed in weaving.
सूत्रग्रह: सूत्रग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Who holds thread, &c. E. सूत्र, and ग्रह to take, अच् aff.
सूत्रग्राह: सूत्रग्राह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Who or what takes, but does not hold thread, &c. E. सूत्र, ग्रह to take, अण् aff.
सूत्रण: सूत्रण n. (-णं) 1 Arranging, putting in order. 2 Stringing. E. सूत्र used as a verb, ल्युट् aff.
सूत्रतर्कुटी: सूत्रतर्कुटी f. (-टी) A distaff, a spindle. E. सूत्र a thread, and तर्कुटी a spindle.
सूत्रतन्तु: सूत्रतन्तु m. (-न्तुः) A thread. E. सूत्र a thread, and तन्तु the same.
सूत्रधार: सूत्रधार m. (-रः) 1 The principal actor or manager of a company, and chief interlocutor in the prologue or prelude to a drama. 2 A carpenter. 3 The author of a set of rules or axioms. 4 INDRA. E. सूत्र a rule, &c., and धार who holds.
सूत्रपुष्प: सूत्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The cotton plant. E. सूत्र thread, and पुष्प a flower.
सूत्रभिद्: सूत्रभिद् m. (-भिद् or -भित्) A tailor. E. सूत्र thread, and भिद् who breaks or cuts.
सूत्रमध्यभू: सूत्रमध्यभू m. (-भूः) Incense. E. सूत्र thread, मध्य amidst, and भू born.
सूत्रयन्त्र: सूत्रयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) 1 A shuttle. 2 A loom. E. सूत्र a thread, and यन्त्र a machine.
सूत्रला: सूत्रला f. (-ला) A spindle or distaff. E. सूत्र thread, ला to get, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
सूत्रवीणा: सूत्रवीणा f. (-णा) A sort of lute. E. सूत्र a thread, and वीणा a lute.
सूत्रवेष्टन: सूत्रवेष्टन n. (-नं) A weaver's shuttle. E. सूत्र thread, and वेष्टन surrounding.
सूत्रामन्: सूत्रामन् m. (-मा) INDRA. E. सु well, चै to preserve, मनिन् aff., and the vowel of the prefix, optionally long; also सुत्रामन्.
सूत्राली: सूत्राली f. (-ली) A necklace or chain worn round the neck. E. सूत्र a thread, आली a line.
सूत्रित: सूत्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Arranged, methodised. 2 Ruled, directed in Sūtras. 3 Strung. E. सूत्र used as a vest, क्त aff.
सूत्रिन्: सूत्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) Having threads, rules, &c. m. (-त्री) A crow. E. सूत्र a thread, इनि aff.
सूद: सूद m. (-दः) 1 A cook. 2 Sauce, seasoning. 3 A made dish, any thing seasoned. 4 Split pease. 5 Mud, mire. E. षद to leak or distil, aff. अच् or घञ्.
सूदन: सूदन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 Destructive, destroyer. 2 Dear, beloved. n. (-नं) Destroying, killing. E. षूद to injure or kill, aff. ल्युट्.
सूदशाला: सूदशाला f. (-ला) A kitchen. E. सूद a cook, and शाला a hall.
सूदाध्यक्ष: सूदाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) Superintendant of the kitchen. E. सूद a cook, अध्यक्ष superintendant.
सूदित: सूदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Destroyed, killed. E. षूद to destroy, क्त aff.
सूदितृ: सूदितृ mfn. (-ता-ती-तृ) Destroyer, destroying. E. षूद, तृन् aff.
सून: सून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Blown, budded, (as a flower.) 2 Empty, vacant. 3 Born, produced. n. (-नं) 1 Bringing forth, (as young,) parturition. 2 A flower. f. (-ना) 1 A daughter. 2 The uvula. 3 A shambles, a slaughter-house. 4 A place or utensil in a house, where, or by which, insects may be killed, as the hearth, the slab, the pestle and mortar, the broom, and the water-pot. 5 Hurting, injuring. 6 Inflammation of the glands of the neck. 7 A zone, a girdle. 8 A ray. 9 A river. E. षू to bear, &c., aff. क्त, or षु the same, न Uṇādi aff.
सूनवत्: सूनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Budding. 2 Bearing. E. षू to bear, क्तवतु aff.
सूनिन्: सूनिन् m. (-नी) A butcher, a hunter, one who practices the death of animals. E. सूना a slaughter-house, इनि aff.
सूनु: सूनु m. (-नुः) 1 A son. 2 A younger brother. 3 The sun. 4 A daughter's son. f. (-नुः or -नूः) A daughter. E. षू to bear, (as children,) नु Uṇādi aff.
सूनृत: सूनृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 True. 2 Fortunate, auspicious. 3 Agreeable, pleasant, (as speech.) 4 Dear to, beloved by. n. (-तं) Agreeable discourse or speech, but also true. E. सु well, नृत to dance, (or excel,) घञ् aff., and the vowel of the prefix made long.
सून्मद: सून्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Mad, crazy, insane. E. सु much, उन्मद mad.
सून्माद: सून्माद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Mad, insane. E. सु much, उन्माद madness, (whose.)
सूप: सूप m. (-पः) 1 Sauce, condiment. 2 Soup, broth. 3 A cook. 4 A vessel. 5 An arrow. E. षु to bear, प Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.
सूपकार: सूपकार m. (-रः) A cook. E. सूप sauce, कार maker.
सूपधूपन: सूपधूपन n. (-नं) Asafoetida. E. सूप sauce, and धूपन perfuming; also सूपधूपक.
सूपपर्णी: सूपपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.)
सूपाङ्ग: सूपाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Asafoetida. E. सूप sauce, and अङ्ग member.
सूम: सूम mn. (-मः-मं) 1 Sky, heaven. 2 Milk. 3 Water. E. षू to bring forth, मक् Uṇādi aff.
सूर: सूर (ई) सूरी r. 4th cl. (सूर्य्यते) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To be stupid or dull.
सूर m. (-रः) 1 The sun. 2 The father of the 17th Jaina of the present era. 3 A Paṇḍita, a learned man. f. (-री) Black mustard. E. षू to bring forth, क्रन् Uṇādi aff.
सूरण: सूरण m. (-णः) An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum.) E. सूर to hurt, aff. ल्युट्; also शूरण.
सूरत: सूरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Compassionate, tender. 2 Tranquil, calm. E. सु well, रम to sport or rest, क्त Uṇādi aff., and the vowel of the prefix made long; also सुरत.
सूरसूत: सूरसूत m. (-तः) ARUṆA, the personification of the dawn, as the charioteer of the sun. E. सूर the sun, and सूत charioteer.
सूरि: सूरि m. (-रिः) 1 A Paṇḍita, a learned man. 2 A title commonly given to Jaina teachers. 3 KṚṢṆA. 4 The sun. E. षू to bear, Uṇādi aff. कि.
सूरिन्: सूरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wise, learned. m. (-री) A Paṇḍita, a scholar, a learned man. E. सूर to injure, to dispel (ignorance, &c.), णिनि aff.
सूर्क्षण: सूर्क्षण n. (-णं) Disrespect, contumely, contempt. E. षूर्क्ष to treat with disrespect, ल्युट् aff.
सूर्क्ष्य: सूर्क्ष्य r. 1st cl. (सूर्क्ष्यति) 1 To envy, to be impatient of another's success. 2 To be intolerant; also षूर्क्ष्य.
सूर्क्ष्य m. (-र्क्ष्यः) A kind of bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.) E. सूर्क्ष to disrespect, यत् aff.
सूर्प: सूर्प्प mn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पं) A winnowing basket. E. सूर्प्प to measure, aff. घञ्; or शृ to injure, प Uṇādi aff., and the vowel and initial changed: this word and its compounds are hence more usually written शूर्प्प, &c. q. v.
सूर्प्प: सूर्प्प mn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पं) A winnowing basket. E. सूर्प्प to measure, aff. घञ्; or शृ to injure, प Uṇādi aff., and the vowel and initial changed: this word and its compounds are hence more usually written शूर्प्प, &c. q. v.
सूर्प्पनखा: सूर्प्पनखा f. (-खा) The sister of RĀVAṆA. E. सूर्प्प, and नख a nail.
सूर्मि: सूर्म्मि f. (-र्म्मिः-र्म्मी) 1 An image of metal, chiefly of iron. 2 The pillar of a house. E. श changed to स, see शूर्म्मी.
सूर्म्मि: सूर्म्मि f. (-र्म्मिः-र्म्मी) 1 An image of metal, chiefly of iron. 2 The pillar of a house. E. श changed to स, see शूर्म्मी.
सूर्य: सूर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 The sun. 2 Gigantic swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.) 3 The son of BALI. f. (-र्य्या) 1 The wife of the sun. 2 A drug, a bitter gourd. 3 A new bride. E. सृ to go, (in the heavens,) क्यप् aff., form irr.
सूर्य्य: सूर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 The sun. 2 Gigantic swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.) 3 The son of BALI. f. (-र्य्या) 1 The wife of the sun. 2 A drug, a bitter gourd. 3 A new bride. E. सृ to go, (in the heavens,) क्यप् aff., form irr.
सूर्यकान्त: सूर्य्यकान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A gem, sometimes applied to crystal, but usually to a stone of fabulous existence and properties. 2 A tree, (Hibiscus phoeniceus,) the red sort. E. सूर्य्य the sun, and कान्त a gem.
सूर्य्यकान्त: सूर्य्यकान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A gem, sometimes applied to crystal, but usually to a stone of fabulous existence and properties. 2 A tree, (Hibiscus phoeniceus,) the red sort. E. सूर्य्य the sun, and कान्त a gem.
सूर्यकान्ति: सूर्य्यकान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 The flower of the Sesamum. 2 Sun-shine. E. सूर्य्य the sun, and कान्ति lustre.
सूर्य्यकान्ति: सूर्य्यकान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 The flower of the Sesamum. 2 Sun-shine. E. सूर्य्य the sun, and कान्ति lustre.
सूर्यकाल: सूर्य्यकाल m. (-लः) Day. E. सूर्य्य the sun, and काल time.
सूर्य्यकाल: सूर्य्यकाल m. (-लः) Day. E. सूर्य्य the sun, and काल time.
सूर्यग्रह: सूर्य्यग्रह m. (-हः) 1 The sun. 2 An eclipse of the sun. 3 The personified ascending and descending node, or KETU and RĀHU. 4 The bottom of a water-jar. E. सूर्य्य the sun, and ग्रह a planet; or seizing, laying hold of.

सूर्य्यसज्ञ: सूर्य्यसज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Saffron. E. सूर्य्य the sun, and सज्ञा appellation.

सूष: सूष r. 1st cl. (सूषति) To bring forth, to bear; also षूष.
सृ: सृ r. 1st cl. (सरति) r. 3d cl. (ससर्त्ति) To go. 1st cl. (सरति or धावति) To go fast, to run, (धै being substituted for the root.) With अनु prefixed, 1 To follow. 2 To conform to. With अप, To go back, to withdraw or remove. With अभि, 1 To spread out or abroad. 2 To go to or with, to accompany or attend, or to meet upon appointment. With उप, To approach, to advance; With निर्, To go forth or out. With प्र, 1 To proceed. 2 To extend. 3 To project. With वि, 1 To go separately or apart. 2 To come or arrive. 3 To forego, to quit or leave.
सृक: सृक m. (-कः) 1 A lotus. 2 Air, wind. 3 An arrow. E. सृ to go, कक् Uṇādi aff.
